jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: New York City · Full\-time **Help build the backend that makes better healthcare possible.** ----------------------------------------------------------------- At Nolla Health, we’re building AI\-powered healthcare that connects understanding a patient’s needs with actually delivering care. That takes more than a capable model: it takes software that brings together patient information, clinical decisions, and the systems needed to act on them. We’re looking for an experienced engineer to build and own that foundation. You’ll develop the services behind our patient apps and clinical workflows, connect healthcare systems, and build the infrastructure that lets AI agents work securely and reliably alongside clinicians. This is a hands\-on role with room to shape the architecture, engineering practices, and team as we grow. We welcome senior and staff engineers, early startup engineers, and former founders who want broad ownership and close involvement in the product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build the APIs and backend services powering our patient apps and clinical workflows. * Develop the systems that connect AI agents to patient information, clinical tools, and actions involved in delivering care. * Build tools that help clinicians review cases and care for patients. * Integrate with electronic medical records and other healthcare systems. * Own cloud infrastructure, deployments, monitoring, and production reliability. * Design secure systems for sensitive patient data, including access controls and audit trails. * Work with product, clinical, and AI teammates to take features from an idea through launch and ongoing operation. * Improve how we build software through automation, thoughtful tooling, and effective use of AI coding tools. * Help hire and mentor engineers as the team grows. **What you bring** ------------------ * Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems, typically six or more years. * Experience building at an early\-stage startup, shipping with a small team and owning multiple parts of the stack. * Strong judgment about APIs, data models, databases, background jobs, and integrations. * The ability to own cloud infrastructure and operate the services you build. * A practical understanding of security, reliability, and handling sensitive data. * Product judgment: you can work through an ambiguous problem, understand what users need, and choose an approach that gets useful software into their hands. * Effective use of AI coding tools, with the judgment to review, test, and maintain what they produce. * A desire to stay hands\-on while taking responsibility for technical decisions and outcomes. We care about what you’ve built, how you think, and the responsibility you’ve taken on. You should bring strong engineering practices and know how to apply them in a small team. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Backend systems for consumer or mobile products. * AI agents, tool integrations, or AI\-powered features in production. * Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EMR integrations, or HIPAA requirements. * Hiring or mentoring engineers. Healthcare experience is welcome, but it isn’t required. An interest in making healthcare better is. Your work will support both patients seeking care and the clinicians providing it. You’ll help decide how AI becomes part of a working healthcare service, from the information an agent can access to how a clinical workflow moves forward. You’ll have a direct say in how Nolla’s backend is built and how the engineering team works. As we grow, there’s room to take on technical leadership and help build the team while staying close to the code. This role is based in New York City. We’re open to candidates willing to relocate. **Compensation** ---------------- Salary: $180,000–$220,000\+, based on experience. Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Construction Scheduling & Project Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Construction Scheduling \& Project Controls Engineer** ======================================================== **A challenge for builders of plans** ------------------------------------- Imagine a utility conflict is discovered on a roadway reconstruction job. The milestone is at risk. You open Primavera P6, craft a fragnet, run a Time Impact Analysis, and model recovery options. You brief the Project Manager on critical path movement, float erosion, and the sequence that gets the team back on track—backed by quantities, production rates, and a revised look‑ahead. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, you’ll thrive here. **Role mission** ---------------- Turn contracts and drawings into dependable CPM schedules for heavy civil work—underground utilities, streets and roadways, and bridges—then keep those schedules current, insightful, and actionable. **Core responsibilities** ------------------------- * Build baseline CPM schedules in P6 in coordination with Project Managers, Estimating, and Operations leadership. * Translate plans, specifications, bids, contracts, and scheduling clauses into robust schedule structure and field‑realistic sequencing. * Develop calendars, WBS, activities, logic ties, durations, milestones, constraints, and coding standards in Primavera P6\. * Fold in contractual milestones; procurement, submittals, utility coordination, traffic control, testing, and closeout requirements. * Continuously update schedules to reflect progress, resequencing, change orders, and impacts; issue revisions and recovery paths. * Run what‑if scenarios to assess alternatives and recommend time‑recovery strategies. * Detect and communicate changes to critical path, float, activity sequences, and milestone dates to stakeholders. * Integrate estimating data—budgets, quantities, production rates—into baselines and short‑interval plans to track plan vs. actual. * Identify early slippage, constraints, and schedule risks; supply timely information for decision‑making. * Prepare TIAs, fragnets, and schedule exhibits for delays, changes, differing site conditions, utility conflicts, and change orders. * Advance standardized scheduling practices, templates, reporting, and project controls processes across Core Operations. * Present findings, risk trends, and recommendations to PMs, the Division Manager, and Leadership; maintain complete schedule records. * Undertake other related duties as assigned. **Experience \& qualifications** -------------------------------- * High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field strongly preferred. * 3–5 years in construction scheduling or project controls, preferably on heavy civil, roadway, utility, bridge, or infrastructure projects. * Advanced Primavera P6 user who can independently create complete CPM baselines from project documentation. * Strong grasp of heavy civil means, methods, and sequencing—particularly utilities, streets/roadways, and bridges. * Proficient reading and interpreting plans, specifications, contracts, bids, project budgets, and contractual scheduling requirements. * Microsoft Office proficiency; Microsoft Project and other project controls or construction‑management platforms preferred. **Working conditions** ---------------------- Expect extended seated computer work along with periods of standing and walking; occasional lifting up to 25 lbs. You’ll frequently use office equipment requiring fine motor skills. The role includes outdoor site visits and stakeholder interaction; sufficient mobility and stamina are required to attend meetings and navigate construction environments. **Benefits you can count on** ----------------------------- * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision * Company‑paid basic dental, life, and short‑/long‑term disability * Optional life, accident, critical illness, and pet insurance * 401(k) retirement plan * Quarterly bonus program * PTO, paid holidays, and a paid winter company break (eligible roles) * EAP and wellness resources * Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support * Dependent scholarship program (eligible employees) * Company events, community involvement, and quarterly State of the Company meetings **Equal Opportunity \& E‑Verify** --------------------------------- E\-Z Bel Construction, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. E\-Z Bel Construction, LLC participates in E\-Verify, a federal system that allows enrolled employers to confirm the employment eligibility of newly hired employees

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data \& Analytics team, responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and data models on our Databricks lakehouse on Azure, governed through Unity Catalog. You will work in an AI\-first team where agentic AI is part of how we design, build, test and operate our data platform every day. As part of the team, you’ll contribute to technical design and help shape our engineering standards. **YOUR CHALLENGE:** * Design and develop data pipelines in Python (PySpark) on Databricks, applying engineering best practices for performance, reliability and maintainability. * Ingest and integrate diverse data sources into the lakehouse in batch, following our bronze, silver and gold layering and ensuring data quality and accuracy. * Help introduce event streaming and real\-time ingestion to the platform: design, build and operate streaming pipelines on Databricks from sources such as Kafka, handling late, duplicate and out\-of\-order events reliably. * Maintain data models and the data estate codebase, with data governed, secured and documented in Unity Catalog. * Write automated tests for every change: unit tests for pipeline logic, integration tests against real data, and data quality checks that catch issues before they reach users. * Follow and contribute to the team’s engineering standards: clean, modular code, peer code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Databricks Asset Bundles) and clear documentation. * Use agentic AI tools (such as Claude Code) daily to build, test, review and troubleshoot, and help design and improve the AI agents and skills that automate our data workflows, with human review built in. * Monitor and operate our cloud data platform (Databricks on Azure) day to day: track pipelines and jobs, troubleshoot issues and support daily data operations. * Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders; support ad hoc data analysis requests. * Drive continuous improvement through training and self\-development. Any other ad hoc tasks that may be required by the business from time to time. * **TO DO IT, YOU WILL NEED:** * A Degree in IT, Computer Science, or related fields. * Proven experience as a Data Engineer, building and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for data lakes or lakehouses, with exposure to both batch and real\-time data. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks on Azure, including Unity Catalog (catalogs, schemas, permissions and lineage). * Hands\-on experience with event streaming and real\-time ingestion: Spark Structured Streaming and event platforms such as Kafka. * Strong SQL skills; experience with relational databases and complex queries. * Experience orchestrating pipelines with Databricks Workflows (Jobs) and deploying them with Databricks Asset Bundles; Azure Data Factory experience is an asset. * Coding proficiency in PySpark and Python. * A strong testing mindset: experience writing unit and integration tests (e.g. pytest) and data quality checks, and writing code that is designed to be tested. * Solid software engineering practices: Git, pull requests and code review, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or equivalent) and documentation. * Hands\-on experience working with agentic AI: using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) in daily engineering work, and designing, building or integrating LLM\-powered agents that orchestrate data workflows. * Comfortable delivering in a fast\-paced, agile environment. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and team collaboration. * Self\-motivated with a drive for continuous learning. Want to help build the future of Catena Media? Apply now for the opportunity to join our collaborative team!

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Linux Engineer — Networking \& Connectivity** ======================================================== **EMBEDDED PLATFORM · FULL TIME · ON\-SITE — SANTA CLARA, CALIFORNIA** **About SiFly Aviation** ------------------------ At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast. We are looking for a senior Embedded Linux Engineer to own connectivity on the aircraft: how a Q12 stays reachable over 5G, Wi\-Fi 6, and Wi\-Fi HaLow simultaneously, how traffic is routed and prioritized across those links as they degrade, and how video, telemetry, and command\-and\-control survive a handover mid\-flight. Remote beyond\-visual\-line\-of\-sight operation is the product, and the network is what makes it possible. The picture is also wider than the aircraft alone: the same links and routing decisions span the DroneFi ground station and the pilot application, and you will own how they behave as one system. This is a role with real ownership rather than a specification to implement. You will own our Dynamic Routing Engine — the service that decides, in flight, which link carries what — along with the link\-management daemons, the secure overlay back to our cloud, and the test rigs that prove any of it works. The engine is led part\-time today; ownership of it transfers to you as you onboard — and with it, the role of primary technical guide for DroneFi development, supported by the senior architect who owns our low\-level networking foundations. We are hiring two Embedded Linux Engineers with deliberately different centres of gravity: you own connectivity and routing, while a counterpart works broadly across the platform — platform services, integration, and new platform capabilities — alongside the senior engineers who already cover BSP, boot, and the update pipeline. You will work closely together. **The Role** ------------ You will own the networking stack on the aircraft and the software that manages it: multi\-link connectivity across cellular, Wi\-Fi 6, and Wi\-Fi HaLow, the Dynamic Routing Engine that selects and blends those links, traffic policy and QoS that keeps command\-and\-control alive when video wants all the bandwidth, the Tailscale mesh and TLS\-secured paths back to our AWS backend, and the behaviour of MQTT, WebRTC video, and the MAVLink router under real loss and latency. Day to day that means writing services in C, C\+\+, and Python on a Yocto\-based platform, living in packet captures, and building the emulation and field\-test setups that turn “it felt better” into a number. You own the connectivity picture in its totality: not just the Linux side, but partnering with the applications team so the software riding on these links is as resilient to degradation and handover as the network beneath it. You will collaborate closely with the rest of the embedded platform team — your generalist counterpart and the engineers who cover BSP, boot, updates, and the low\-level networking foundations — the firmware engineers who own the radios and supervisory MCUs, the part\-time engineer who leads the Dynamic Routing Engine today and will hand it over to you, the applications and autonomy teams whose traffic you carry and whose resilience you help design, the cloud team on the other end of every link, and our hardware and RF engineers in Santa Clara — including on antenna placement and integration on the airframe. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Own the Dynamic Routing Engine.** Design, implement, and harden the service that chooses and blends links in flight — link metrics and scoring, switching policy and hysteresis, failover timing, and behaviour at the edge of coverage — and close out the open risks against it. * **Make multi\-link connectivity dependable.** Own the cellular, Wi\-Fi 6, and Wi\-Fi HaLow links end\-to\-end on the Linux side: modem management, association and roaming, bonding and make\-before\-break handover, and graceful degradation rather than a cliff edge. * **Own routing and traffic policy.** Policy routing across multiple tables and interfaces, nftables, tc\-based QoS and shaping, VLANs, bridges, and network namespaces — so command\-and\-control, video, and bulk transfer each get what they need on a link that is shrinking. * **Keep video and telemetry alive under degradation.** Tune WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP) and RTP video, adaptive bitrate and congestion control, MQTT keepalive and reconnect behaviour, and MAVLink routing on lossy, high\-latency links — and make reconnection invisible to the operator. * **Make the applications resilient with you.** Own the contract between the network and everything riding on it: expose link state, quality, and bandwidth signals that applications can act on, and work with the applications team so onboard and ground\-side software handles degradation, handover, and offline periods by design rather than by surprise. * **Own the secure overlay.** The Tailscale/WireGuard mesh, TLS, per\-aircraft identity and certificate provisioning, NAT traversal, and an addressing plan that still works when the fleet is an order of magnitude larger. * **Instrument the network.** Per\-link metrics for signal quality, latency, loss, jitter, and throughput; structured connectivity logging that makes a post\-flight “why did the link drop” answerable from data rather than guesswork. * **Build the test rigs.** Network emulation with netem and programmable attenuators, shielded and bench setups, and structured field and drive testing — quantify handover time, packet loss, and throughput versus range, and reproduce field failures on the bench. * **Integrate on the platform.** Package your services into our Yocto\-based image as containerized or systemd\-managed services with proper configuration and device management, and work with the platform team and firmware owners on modem, Wi\-Fi, and radio drivers. * **Support the connected subsystems.** Provide the network\-side integration and debugging for Remote ID, ADS\-B\-In, and the ground\-side apps — Pilot, Crew, HQ, and mobile — working with the owners of each. **Required Experience** ----------------------- * Minimum 5\+ years of professional experience in embedded Linux development with a networking or connectivity focus. * A bachelor’s degree or higher in a related program — Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. **Compensation \& Location** ---------------------------- **Compensation range:** $150–$180k **Location:** On\-site in Santa Clara, CA. Small team, high ownership, and real hardware in the building.

jobs.description: **About Discernis** =================== Discernis builds AI for legal discovery at a scale where general legal AI tools fall apart. When a litigation team needs to know what a group of people knew, and when, across millions of emails, chats, and documents, our platform finds it with the recall attorneys can stake a case on. We deploy in private cloud and fully air\-gapped on\-prem for AmLaw firms and corporate legal teams. We're seed\-stage and venture\-funded, have paying Big Law customers, and have a pipeline of AmLaw firms and Fortune 500 companies lined up for paid pilots and future deals. Industry incumbents are coming to us to integrate. Discovery is our wedge: the bigger goal is helping enterprises understand and act on their largest, messiest datasets. We're a small team based in NYC, and you'd be joining before our next stage of growth. **How we work** =============== We value ownership, curiosity, and shipping. We hire people who teach themselves new things, make good calls without much direction, and care about getting it right for the attorneys who depend on us. We work hard at a sustainable pace, without crunch culture or arbitrary deadlines. **The role** ============ Today our founder runs the AI stack personally. He holds a Columbia PhD in AI and built Amazon's first customer\-facing RLHF pipeline. You'll take the stack over, all of it: agentic workflows, retrieval and evaluation, inference optimization, fine\-tuning, and post\-training. For your first \~90 days you'll work side by side with him. After that, you set our AI direction and grow the team around it. At a larger company, this would be three separate roles. Here, it's one. This is likely the single highest\-impact role at the company, and we need someone who can do the engineering and the science. **Rough split** =============== * **\~40% agentic systems:** orchestration, tool use, and reliability * **\~20% inference:** serving and optimization, including small models on constrained on\-prem hardware * **\~40% longer\-horizon research:** model adaptation, post\-training, and RL **Problems you'll own** ======================= * High\-recall retrieval and synthesis across billion\-token document collections * Agents that are reliable, testable, and deployable, not just impressive in a demo * Getting strong performance from small open\-source models in air\-gapped environments * Evals that capture what "correct" means to a litigator * RL that trades off tool use against compute **Our stack** ============= * **Models:** open\-weight models we fine\-tune, adapt, and post\-train for legal reasoning, then serve as our own versions * **Serving:** vLLM on our own H100 and H200 GPUs * **Deployment:** the same models run in private cloud and fully air\-gapped customer environments * **Language:** Python * **Around it:** PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes (K3s), Vue **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've trained or post\-trained real models (fine\-tuning, RLHF, or RL). Experience calling APIs is not enough. * You've also shipped LLM or agentic systems to production that real users depend on. * You have strong evaluation instincts and know how to tell real gains from noise. * You have hands\-on inference and serving experience. * **When you apply, please include a link to a repo, paper, write\-up, or system you built.** We're hiring for this role across levels, from strong AI engineer to AI lead. Compensation reflects the level we hire at. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience on a big tech AI team or at an AI startup * A PhD or MS in ML * Research publications or open\-source work in LLMs, agents, RL, or evaluation * Distributed training or large\-scale GPU experimentation **Our process** =============== * A call with our founder * A screen with our Head of Engineering * A deep dive on a real problem **Why Discernis** ================= * Research problems with a direct path to production and paying customers * A founder who speaks your language * Meaningful equity with a 4\-year vest and 1\-year cliff * Health insurance * Unlimited PTO plus standard US holidays If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, email us at admin@discernis.ai. Compensation Range: $170K \- $250K

Our platform is established and productive, and is now entering a deliberate modernization phase. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact. ### **Role Responsabilities** * Serve as technical owner and architect of our AWS environment, including account structure, IAM, networking, compute, and storage. * Lead and extend cost governance, including budgets, alerting, tagging enforcement, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle and tiering. * Define and own developer operations for the data platform, including infrastructure as code, CI/CD, container builds, and secrets and environment management. * Upgrade our data lake, managed orchestration, metadata and data ingestion workflows to scale with future data production and enhance the infrastructure that transfers data from the lab to the cloud. * Partner with ML and computational biology leaders to define the interface between platform and modelling. ### **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years building and operating production data infrastructure, with a track record of architecting and owning platforms end to end. * Deep AWS expertise: S3, IAM, EC2, Batch, Lambda, and Spark (EMR or equivalent). jobs.title: QA and Test Engineer Role
jobs.description: **About OPEN Data Jobs** OPEN Data Jobs (ODJ) is built to craft data careers. We connect high\-potential data, AI, and software professionals with meaningful work on the cutting edge of the federal sector, and our aim reaches beyond any single opening: to help you understand your strengths, find the right role, and grow throughout your career. ODJ is organized around Roles and Openings. A Role is a durable career type, such as Data Engineer or AI Engineer: it describes the work, the skills that count, and where the path can lead. An Opening is a specific position hiring right now, with a level, a location, and an application. Roles help you see where you fit; from there, there is more than one way to move. Today, you can apply to any Opening that fits you through our secure application system. You can also register for a Role to express interest in that broader category of work. A Role registration is not an application to every future Opening. **The work** QA and Test Engineers produce the evidence that tells a team whether software is ready to trust. They turn requirements, user stories, and risks into tests, run those tests by hand and through automation, and report what they find in terms a developer can act on and a decision\-maker can rely on. The work runs through the full stack, from the user interface through APIs, services, integrations, and databases to the environments they run in, and follows real user journeys end to end across all of them. It covers user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) testing, including usability testing with representative users; functional, regression, integration, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing; and performance and load testing. Accessibility testing checks conformance with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), and testers work with security specialists on the checks built into the delivery pipeline. QA and Test Engineers plan test strategies and schedules, build and maintain test environments and test data, write and maintain automated test suites, track defects to resolution, and define release criteria and report whether the evidence meets them. Testing starts early and continues throughout delivery, whether testers sit inside the delivery team or provide an independent assessment. QA and Test Engineers work with product owners, business analysts, developers, and DevSecOps engineers so that quality is designed in, measured continuously, and documented well enough to stand up to an audit or an independent review. **What you'll build** * Test strategies, test plans, test cases, and scenarios traced to requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Automated test suites at the unit, API, and UI levels, wired into CI/CD pipelines, including end\-to\-end tests that follow a user journey through the front end, APIs, services, and databases. * Usability, performance, load, compatibility, and accessibility results that show how a system behaves under the conditions tested, and where it falls short. * Defect reports, root\-cause evidence, and retest records that carry a problem through to a verified fix. * Traceability matrices, test evidence, and release\-readiness reports that support go\-live decisions, authorization reviews, and audits. **Who you are** You are skeptical in a useful way. You read a requirement and see the case that would break it, and when something looks wrong, you keep exploring after the script ends. You care as much about the user who cannot use a mouse as about the one who can. You report defects without drama, with reproducible steps and the evidence a developer needs to diagnose them. You would rather prevent a problem than report it, so you challenge unclear requirements early, and when the schedule pushes back, you make the unresolved release risks visible. **What you bring** * Experience designing and running tests for web applications or enterprise systems, with depth in at least one area: manual and exploratory testing, test automation, end\-to\-end testing across the UI, APIs, services, and databases, performance, or accessibility. * Working knowledge of test design techniques such as boundary value analysis and exploratory testing, applied to negative and regression tests. * Hands\-on skill with the tools your specialty uses, such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Postman for automation, JMeter or k6 for performance, or screen readers and automated checkers for accessibility. * The ability to trace a defect toward its source through reproducible steps, logs, data, and configuration, and to work with developers when the cause crosses system layers. * Disciplined defect tracking and test documentation in a tool such as Jira, with close attention to accuracy in regulated or mission\-critical work. **Register for QA and Test Engineer Role** Click Apply below to register for QA and Test Engineer Role. **Requirements** **What openings may require** Openings may emphasize manual and user acceptance testing, UI and UX testing, full\-stack and end\-to\-end testing, test automation engineering (sometimes titled software development engineer in test, or SDET), API and integration testing, performance engineering, accessibility testing, or quality leadership across a program. Some may call for a particular framework, a scripting or programming language, SQL, cloud\-hosted test environments, a testing certification such as one from the International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), or experience with independent verification and validation. Accessibility\-focused openings may require keyboard and screen\-reader testing, manual conformance checks, and automated accessibility tools. An AI\-enabled opening may involve testing applications that call models, checking their outputs against expected behavior and safeguards, and using AI\-assisted tools to generate and maintain tests, with every generated test reviewed before it is trusted. Specific openings will state the expected testing depth, tools, work location, citizenship, work authorization, background, suitability, clearance, and domain knowledge. **Benefits** Compensation, benefits, work location, and employment terms are set for each specific opening and will be stated with that opening.

jobs.description: Senior Data Scientist \& Data Engineering Expert — AI Review (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics Data
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Frontier AI is going physical, and the labs building it are bottlenecked on one thing: high\-quality data from the real world. We pair operational scale with the specialized engineering that physical\-world data demands. As a Software Engineer on Robotics, you'll sit between our data systems and our customers' infrastructure. Every frontier lab wants something different: container format, schema, fields, and quality requirements. You'll build infrastructure general enough that a new customer becomes a quick configuration, and you'll work directly with customer engineering teams on bespoke requests, feeding what you learn into scalable platform architecture decisions. An example might be modifying the segmentation model derived from a customer request for stricter filtering on hands being in frame and building this into a configurable pipeline feature. Prior robotics experience is not required. This is a backend and data engineering role at its core, developing pipelines, formats, and storage methods. If you've built high\-volume data infrastructure anywhere and want depth in robotics data, working directly with the engineers and researchers at the labs and robotics companies building physical AI, this role is for you. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the reusable infrastructure behind robotics data deliveries: the processing, packaging, and delivery systems * Format and transform datasets to per\-client specification: MCAP and other container formats, custom schemas, field mappings, metadata, and versioning * Work directly with customer engineering teams to scope and build bespoke schemas, custom fields, and one\-off transforms where requirements are custom * Build and operate the pipelines that move data from our systems into customer storage reliably at petabyte scale * Partner with operations and product to turn evolving requirements into shipped data deliveries, and prototype quickly when a new data type or customer arrives * Build automated validation techniques ### **What We're Looking For** * Strong backend and data engineering fundamentals in a modern language (Python, Go, Rust) and comfort operating production systems on AWS and GCP * Experience building and owning high\-volume data pipelines, not just contributing to them * Experience with large binary formats, streaming ingestion, distributed batch processing, and object storage economics * Customer\-facing instincts: you can lead a technical conversation, ask the right questions, and push back when a request is unreasonable * Comfort working through ambiguity and shipping iteratively with a product team, where requirements evolve with the customers and data types ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with robotics/AV data formats and tooling such as MCAP, ROS, protobuf, Foxglove * Prior work on data engines, pipelines, or delivery for multimodal data * Multi\-sensor data experience across video, depth, inertial, and audio, including calibration and synchronization * Forward\-deployed, solutions, or delivery engineering experience at a data or infrastructure company * Computer vision or multimodal ML exposure: detection, tracking, or VLM\-based labeling and QC Compensation Range: $130K \- $400K

With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. **This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.** **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** The person filling this role will join 3M’s world\-class Global Network \& Telecom Services organization as part of the Network Automation team, building the software, automation and Artificial Intelligence\-driven operations (AI\-ops) capabilities that keep 3M’s global network reliable and efficient. As a full\-stack product engineer, you will own the product surface of our internal tools — dashboards, network topology and graph visualizations, data\-dense operational views, and conversational (AI assistant) interfaces — and the Application programming interface (API) and data integrations behind them. You will contribute across a portfolio of work: our internally built platforms, vendor\-provided tools we extend and integrate, and new initiatives as they arise. You will work closely with the team’s AI engineers, consuming the AI services, agents and tools they build and growing your own AI engineering skills over time. This position requires occasional work outside normal business hours. **Primary Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:** * Design, develop, test and maintain the front\-end product surface of the team’s internal tools and platforms — operational dashboards, network topology/graph visualizations, large data views and real\-time/streaming displays — using TypeScript and modern web frameworks (for example React) * Build and refine conversational and agent\-driven interfaces (chat User Interface, streaming responses, rendering of tool/agent output) that provide natural\-language access to network and inventory data * Build and maintain the Application programming interface (API), services and data integrations behind these experiences, reconciling and exposing data from sources such as Configuration management Database (CMDB), cloud inventory, Axonius, Domain Name System(DNS)/IP Address Management (IPAM) and Information Technology Service Manager * Contribute across a portfolio of work — internally built platforms, vendor\-provided tools we extend and integrate, and new cross\-team initiatives (for example a network\-aware ‘golden path’ for application deployments with the platform engineering team) * Consume and integrate the AI services, agents and tools built by the team’s AI engineers (Large Language Model (LLM) assistants, summarization/triage, anomaly detection, natural\-language query) into production user experiences, using AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery * Use Git, GitHub Actions and continuous integration/continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD) to build, test and deploy in a repeatable, auditable way, applying front\-end quality practices (component/UI testing, accessibility and performance) * Translate business and operational requirements into technical solutions; document workflows and runbooks, provide support escalation as needed, and collaborate with a globally distributed team in Agile/Scrum practices **Your Skills and Expertise** To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology (completed and verified prior to start) and Five (5\) years’ experience in Information Technology in a manufacturing, private, public, government, or military environment. OR * High School Diploma/GED (completed and verified prior to start) and Eight (10\) years’ experience in Information Technology in a manufacturing, distribution center, private, public, government, or military environment AND * Five (5\) years of experience developing back\-end or integration code (for example in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js) and comfort working with YAML in private, public, government, or military environment Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: * Working knowledge of Git and version control, and of CI/CD concepts * Interest in and aptitude for applying AI — for example integrating LLM/AI services and agents into applications — with a desire to grow AI engineering skills * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication * Ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team in a fast\-paced environment * Experie example inventory/CMDB, DNS/IPAM, routing and switching) — the ability to understand and work with network data is a strong plus * Experience integrating or extending vendor\-provided platforms and working across multiple tools and systems * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure), containers or Linux * Familiarity with Agile frameworks and ITSM processes **Work location:** * **Maplewood, MN** **Travel: May include up to 15%** **domestic/international** **Relocation: Is not authorized** **Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).** **Supporting Your Well\-being** 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. jobs.title: Sr. ML Ops Engineer, Forward-Deployed
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. **Our People:** People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry\-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference\-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. **Senior MLOps Engineer, Forward Deployed** Forward Deployed Engineering · Predictive track · Senior **TEAM** Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Predictive track, in Data Science \& AI Engineering **REPORTS TO** MLOps engineering lead **LEVEL** Senior (6\+ years) **LOCATION** United States **THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH** This is a hands\-on MLOps engineering role. You will work across model training and refresh workflows, APIs, orchestration, data pipelines, production monitoring, and user\-facing experiences such as model dashboards and training controls. When a customer needs a better model, a refresh workflow, or visibility into model health, you will help make it real: build the experience, connect it to reliable backend systems, validate the outcome, and operate it safely in production. You'll be our first MLOps engineer in the US, working closely with the MLOps team in India so customer work reaches production in days, not weeks. Most of your work is behind the scenes, with customer conversations when the technical details matter. **What You'll Do** **Build for the customer** * Productionize customer\-tailored predictive models, configurations, and scoring workflows with validation, release, monitoring, and rollback paths. * Build and improve UI workflows for training triggers, model refreshes, validation outcomes, model status, and operational troubleshooting. * Enhance model dashboards that make model health, score changes, data quality, refresh status, and production issues understandable to internal users and customers. * Build or modify the APIs, backend services, data contracts, and orchestration workflows behind those experiences. * Automate model retraining, validation, promotion, and deployment workflows for customer engagements. * Create safeguards for data quality, score distributions, threshold changes, and edge cases before model changes reach production. * Monitor models and services for drift, data shifts, reliability issues, and operational regressions. **Productize for everyone** * Turn repeatable customer solutions into reusable product and platform capabilities with Product, Data Science, and Platform Engineering. * Build deployment templates, reusable workflow components, and configuration\-driven interfaces that support many customers without one\-off operational work. * Create self\-service or assisted tools for teams to initiate training, monitor refreshes, review validation results, and troubleshoot model issues safely. * Improve the MLOps platform where needed, including Kubernetes workloads, compute, pipelines, CI/CD, deployment tooling, and observability. * Establish clear runbooks, release checklists, audit trails, and support processes for model operations. * Identify recurring customer pain points and convert them into product requirements, platform improvements, or durable operational tooling. **What You'll Bring** * 6\+ years of experience in MLOps, ML platform engineering, backend engineering, full\-stack engineering, or related production engineering roles. * Experience owning machine\-learning systems in production, including training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and incident response. * Strong Python and SQL skills, including APIs, backend services, asynchronous workflows, testing, CI/CD, and observability. * Experience building or materially contributing to internal tools, operational dashboards, or customer\-facing product workflows. * Comfortable debugging across the stack: UI, APIs, workflows, data pipelines, model artifacts, and production infrastructure. * Experience releasing changes safely across multiple customers or production environments, including staged rollout, impact checks, and rollback. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure. * Strong communication and judgment when balancing customer urgency, usability, reliability, and long\-term maintainability. * Nice to have: Fast API and Frontend experience. * Airflow, Spark, MLflow, model registries, feature pipelines, or workflow orchestration. * AWS, S3, Hive, distributed compute, and multi\-tenant SaaS experience. * Forward\-deployed, consulting, solutions, implementation, or customer\-facing engineering experience. * B2B SaaS, go\-to\-market data, or predictive modeling experience. **What Success Looks Like** **Within 3 months** * Understand the predictive\-model lifecycle and improve at least one meaningful deployment, support, or visibility bottleneck. * Bring clear release, monitoring, and support plans to active customer model engagements. **Within 6 months** * Common training, refresh, validation, and deployment workflows are materially more automated. * Model dashboards or internal workflows provide clear visibility into model status, health, and refresh progress. * Customer model changes move to production faster, with stronger operational controls. **Within 12 months** * At least one customer\-specific solution has become a reusable product or platform capability. * The team can reliably deliver and operate customer\-tailored models without fragile manual processes or overnight handoffs. **Why this role is different:** You won't only maintain ML infrastructure. You'll build the product experiences and production systems that make predictive models easier to launch, understand, refresh, and trust—then turn what works for one customer into something that benefits many. Base Salary Range: $191,475\.00 \- $260,830\.00 . The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense's total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense's board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self\-care days, and paid time off (PTO). \#Li\-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy **Our Benefits:** Full\-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time\-off and holidays, quarterly self\-care days off, and stock options. We'll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well\-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG\-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com. *We are aware of recruiting impersonation* *attempts* *that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way.* *A**ll email communications from* *6sense* *will originate from* *the @6sense.com domain**.* *We will* *not initially contact you via text message and will* *never request payments**.* *If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to* *jobs@**6sense.com*

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer

jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in electrical engineering and an interest in developing expertise in complex, high\-performance facilities. **AECOM** is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. jobs.title: Agentic Application Developer
jobs.description: AGRILAND FS is a fast\-growing energy company delivering diesel, gasoline, propane, and other petroleum products to customers nationwide, with a full agronomy business alongside. Our small technical team builds and runs the ELEVATE application suite and the ATLAS data platform, using AI as a core part of our daily workflow rather than an occasional shortcut. We are looking for a developer early in their career who is ready to build modern, AI\-accelerated, cloud\-native applications. This is not a role where you spend years on boilerplate before touching anything real. We do not put team members in isolated boxes. Your center of gravity is our AWS serverless platform, where we build the custom applications in the ELEVATE suite. You will also touch the commercial platforms our business runs on today, Salesforce among them, but this is a cloud developer role, not a platform\-specific one. As you master the fundamentals, your role will have the opportunity to expand into owning the full path to production and, eventually, whole applications. **What You'll Do** **Phase 1: Core Development (Day 1 Focus)** * **AWS Applications:** Build, test, and deploy custom applications on our AWS serverless stack (Lambda, S3 and CloudFront, DynamoDB, API Gateway) as the core of the ELEVATE suite. * **Commercial Platforms:** Contribute to the systems the business runs on today where code is needed, including Lightning Web Components in Salesforce, without making any single vendor's platform your identity. * **AI\-Accelerated Workflow:** Use AI assistants to prototype quickly, generate and critically review code, write test suites, and document components as you go. * **Bug Resolution:** Troubleshoot and resolve bugs in existing components and applications, learning the codebase by fixing it. **Phase 2: Delivery Ownership (Ramping around Month 6\+)** * **Path to Production:** Own the road from working code to production: Git\-based version control, code review, deployment pipelines, and closing out the last 10% that gets nearly finished work over the finish line. * **Requirements Translation:** Partner with stakeholders to translate operational pain points into structured user stories, technical requirements, and working solutions. * Release Discipline: Help formalize and enforce our review\-and\-deploy process as more people across the company gain build access. * Reusable Foundations: Contribute to a growing library of reusable components and patterns across the ELEVATE suite, so the next build is faster than the last. Phase 3: Expanding the Stack (Growing into the Platform) * **Data Engineering:** Go deeper on ATLAS: pipelines, warehousing, and the analytics layer that runs the business. * **Platform Engineering:** Take on infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, and the deployment machinery itself. * **Agentic Development:** Push past code assistance into agents, automation, and AI\-native ways of working, and bring what you learn back to the team. **Where This Role Grows** We build our own applications, and we view early\-career development as the launching pad for long\-term technical and professional growth. As you advance past your first year, your trajectory can evolve into: * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Owning an application from roadmap through stakeholders, build, deployment, and user adoption, not just tickets. * **Delivery Leadership:** Becoming the team's authority on how software ships: pipelines, environments, and release standards for everything we build. * **Specialized Career Tracks:** Deep\-diving further into serverless application architecture, data platform engineering on ATLAS, or front\-end craft and user experience across the ELEVATE suite. **What We're Looking For** * **Development Foundation:** Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, plus exposure to Python or Apex. Coursework, personal projects, and professional experience all count. * **Cloud\-Native Mindset:** Curiosity about consumption\-based cloud platforms and how serverless applications are designed, built, and paid for. Exposure to any commercial platform (Salesforce or comparable) is helpful but not required; we would rather teach a platform than unteach config\-only habits. * **AI Fluency:** Comfort using AI coding assistants in a real development workflow: prompting effectively, reviewing generated code critically, and iterating rather than accepting output blindly. * **Finisher's Instinct:** Energy for the unglamorous last mile: testing, deployment, documentation, and follow\-through until users are actually using the thing. * **Strong Communication:** Ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders and build trust across the business. * **Range:** A refusal to be boxed into one discipline; you are curious about how the whole system fits together, not just your corner of it. **Why This Role Is Different** Most early\-career development jobs lock you into one vendor's ecosystem for years. This role starts with real code shipped early on a modern serverless stack, then gives you a direct path to own delivery end to end and grow into data, infrastructure, or product ownership. Because we build our own applications, the skills you develop are portable: cloud architecture, AI\-accelerated development, and delivery discipline travel anywhere. Backed by an AI\-first workflow and a small, collaborative team, you will get to know the whole business and build a career without boundaries. **What we offer our team:** * Paid, in\-house training and certification for DOT License and Endorsements for a Class A CDL with tanker and hazmat endorsements * Work with updated and modern equipment * Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, and more * Paid time off, sick pay, and paid holidays * Solid retirement future with a 100% company\-funded Pension Plan at no cost to you, ***plus*** an additional 401k with company match * Recognition and pay incentives for good job performance **Are you a good match to join the AGRILAND FS Team? Apply now!** *AGRILAND FS is an equal opportunity employer*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: **About Ande** We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use. **About the Role** You will own the intelligence behind the Ande Agent. That's the concierge and its team of subagents that take a request from one sentence ("dinner for 12 with the Acme team next Thursday, somewhere private") to a confirmed, paid, on\-policy booking. Along the way they source venues, compare options, email the venue and negotiate terms, and handle every change after that. This is not a chatbot or a demo. The agent acts on real money, on behalf of real executives, with real venues on the other end of the thread. It runs in production today for reservations and private dining. Our strategy depends on carrying more of the work with every request: more kinds of entertainment, more cities, more of the workflow, without growing headcount to match. You will set how we get there. **What You'll Do** * Own the agent system. Ande runs on a root concierge agent with specialist subagents for sourcing, comparison, and venue coordination, on a self\-hosted agent harness behind queued turn workers. You’ll own its architecture, model choices, and upgrade path, and make sure it holds up under latency budgets, provider failover, and real\-world load. * Build tools the agent can trust. The agent has about 75 typed capabilities that let it search, hold, book, pay, and message. Each one runs as the acting user and respects who they’re acting for, such as an assistant booking on behalf of an executive. Consequential actions become proposals that the booker confirms. You’ll decide what the agent is allowed to do, and how to make it safe. * Make evals the gate for every change. You’ll build scenario suites, graders, and LLM judges calibrated against human labels. They replay from recorded runs on every PR and run in full nightly. Your goal is evals trustworthy enough that a model upgrade or prompt change can ship on the strength of the number alone, and cheap enough to run all the time. * Power venue correspondence. Our agent negotiates with venues over email. It reads replies, pulls out offers, minimums, deadlines, and payment requests, and knows when to push, when to wait, and when to hand off to a person. You’ll make sure all of it is resistant to anything a third party writes into a thread. * Build memory and the supply learning loop. You’ll shape what the agent remembers about a company, its people, and its venues, with clear rules on what’s shared and what stays private. You’ll also build the loop that turns every venue conversation into structured supply data, like which room actually fits 14 or what a venue will do on a Tuesday, so each recommendation is better than the last. * Ship fast, reliable judgments. You’ll build typed classifiers for consent, triage, ranking, and urgency. Each has labeled thresholds, a timeout, and a fallback, and each rolls out from shadow mode to live. * Set the bar for building with AI. You’ll define how Ande builds with AI: agent behavior as versioned config, product teammates proposing changes through evals, and AI coding agents as the default way the team ships. You’ll mentor engineers and partner closely with our AI product manager. **What We’re Looking For** * Education and experience: a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. You have 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM agents to real customers (tool use, multi\-step planning, structured outputs, long\-running conversations). * Production evals: you’ve owned evals in production, from writing them to finding failure modes in real traffic and improving quality turn by turn. * Systems engineering: strong TypeScript and backend skills, including queues, concurrency, idempotency, and how distributed systems fail. * Sound judgment: you know where a model belongs and where deterministic code does, and you have the discipline to make agent actions safe, auditable, and reversible. * AI\-native workflow: you use AI coding agents every day. Our codebase is built to be worked on by them, and we expect you to raise that bar. * Clear communication: you can explain agent behavior and trade\-offs to product, operations, and customers. **Bonus Points** * You've been a founding or early engineer and know how to balance craft, ownership and speed. * You've built agent harnesses, orchestration layers or tool brokers, not just prompts. * Experience with search, ranking or recommendation systems. * Experience with marketplaces, booking or payments, where a wrong action costs money. * Experience defending agents against prompt injection from untrusted content. **Why This Role Matters** The Ande Agent is how we scale. Every request it handles end to end is work we don’t have to hire for, so how far it can take us depends on the person who owns its intelligence. The stakes are real. The agent moves real money for executives and negotiates directly with venues, so a mistake costs customers money and costs us venue relationships. Every venue conversation also makes the agent smarter. That learning loop is an advantage competitors can’t easily copy. This isn’t an AI feature bolted onto a product. The agent is the product, and you’ll own how it thinks. **This is an in\-office position (4 days/week) in New York City** **Equal Employment Opportunity** *Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status* Compensation Range: $210K \- $280K

jobs.title: Motion Controls & Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.** At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world. Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives. **Job Description** The Motion Controls \& Robotics Software Engineer contributes to the research, planning, design, implementation, and verification of software that controls critical electro\-mechanical and robotic motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance of Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This is a software\-forward motion control role for early\-career candidates with foundational experience or strong demonstrated capability developing software that interfaces with physical hardware. The role supports high\-level architecture, detailed implementation, integration, and verification of these motion devices while building cross\-functional experience across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering to solve complex engineering problems. **Essential duties and responsibilities:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT * Object\-oriented software development and hands\-on hardware integration for Accuray’s control systems, including robotic manipulators, precision positioning systems, thermal and pneumatic control systems. Detailed analysis reports (design reviews, control system models, DFMEA, etc.), debugging, reliability cycling, system integration, and formal software/hardware testing are key components of the development activities. * Researches, analyzes, plans, and implements the control system design in accordance with product requirements as established from various sources including marketing, manufacturing, reliability, and customer specification documents. Supports the distillation of system\-level requirements into sub\-system and component\-level requirements. * Develops and executes comprehensive test plans, including manual, automated, unit, integration, and system\-level tests, to rigorously verify developed software and hardware against defined requirements and specifications. * Hands\-on, data driven problem solving – commonly working directly with motion hardware to move development efforts forward. Assists with hardware prototype builds and troubleshooting as needed. * Documents, implements and tests applicable design requirements for production. This includes supporting the transfer of relevant design output documents, recommended assembly and test instructions, and service troubleshooting support. * Collaborates closely and frequently with Embedded Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, and test teams throughout the software development and product development lifecycle. * Provides subject matter expert input and guidance for field service escalations into engineering. * Supports the Mechanical Systems Manager in establishing or updating project and departmental deliverables. COLLABORATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT * Works collaboratively within project teams and Product Development, seeking input from senior engineers and cross\-functional partners as appropriate. * Communicates technical progress, risks, and roadblocks clearly, and incorporates feedback into design, implementation, and verification of work. * Follows applicable quality processes on projects and within the Mechanical Systems group. * Contributes to process improvement activities as experience grows. SAFETY AND QUALITY * Supports the effective implementation of safety and quality considerations and requirements in product design. * Supports timely investigation, communication, and resolution of safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff. * Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following applicable procedures and documentation practices. **Qualifications** Required * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field, with coursework or experience in software development for physical systems. * **Software experience:** Professional software development experience is preferred, but strong candidates with substantial internship, co\-op, academic project, research, or personal project experience developing software for physical systems will be considered. Relevant experience should demonstrate hands\-on software developm nd/or Python, including class design, interfaces/abstractions, modular code structure, debugging, and unit/integration testing. * **Software development practices:** Experience using professional software development practices such as version control, code review, issue tracking, build/release workflows, and automated testing. * **Product development exposure:** Exposure to software development, testing, or release activities for products, prototypes, lab systems, or hardware\-integrated software. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to effectively present technical concepts to individuals that are not subject matter experts and assist as needed. Preferred or Desired * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Internship, co\-op, research, academic project, or early professional experience in a regulated, safety\-critical, medical device, robotics, automation, or high\-reliability engineering environment. * Demonstrated ability to test and verify developed hardware and software against requirements. * Ability to develop system\-level requirements for motion control systems and effectively integrate both individual components into a system and sub\-systems into a larger system. * Experience or strong academic/project exposure working with automated or robotic systems and their components (motor controllers, drive electronics, sensors, etc.), including low\-level firmware, mid\-level software interfaces/device drivers, APIs, and robot controls middleware. * Experience developing robotics, motion control, or embedded software in regulated, safety\-critical, or high\-reliability environments. * Experience programming digital motion controllers, including configuration and utilization of digital I/O for motion control applications. * Self\-starter who can make progress independently while seeking guidance appropriately, collaborating with peers and management as needed. * Demonstrated experience developing, building, debugging, or deploying software in Linux\-based environments. * Exposure to 3D CAD modeling software (SolidWorks preferred) and virtualization tools for robotics applications. * Exposure to Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and parallel computing concepts. * Proficiency with linear algebra, rigid transformations, coordinate frames, and/or robotics software for serial\-link manipulators. * Proficiency in working with databases, including querying, data manipulation, and schema design. * Strong foundational knowledge in control theory combined with hands\-on experience developing data\-driven control strategies. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted tools to enhance productivity, accelerate problem solving, and strengthen software development workflows while maintaining engineering judgment, verification discipline, and ownership of the final work product. * Understands fundamental machine learning and reinforcement learning concepts and their potential utility in advancing robotic capabilities. * Formal product reliability qualification and testing background. \#LI\-BB1 **To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.** **EEO Statement** At Accuray, our commitment to patient\-first outcomes drives an inclusive and collaborative work environment where the best ideas rise to the top — and everyone works to push them further. We value diversity in both the professional and personal backgrounds of our employees, as this variety adds rich energy to every team, every project and every work day. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin – including individuals with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Platform Engineering and Operations Lead (Palantir)
jobs.description: The Platform Engineer \& Operations Lead is the hands\-on internal technical owner of Acosta Group’s enterprise Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) ecosystem within the AI Center of Excellence. This role engineers and operates a secure, reliable, governed, reusable, and cost\-effective platform while supporting product, program, and project teams from solution design and build through deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing production support. The role owns platform administration, DevSecOps, identity and access management, observability, enterprise integration, ontology governance, and FinOps. It provides technical direction to vendor engineers, sets engineering standards and priorities, reviews deliverables, manages escalations, and retains critical platform knowledge and decision\-making within the enterprise. * **Platform engineering:** Own Foundry and AIP administration, configuration, environment strategy, releases, upgrades, capacity, and operational health. Engineer shared services, automation, and reusable patterns for AIP applications, agents, workflows, and model/tool integration. * **Solution delivery:** Partner with delivery teams on architecture, hands\-on build, integration, testing, deployment, go\-live readiness, and stabilization. Coordinate environments, access, release windows, cutover, and post\-production support ownership. * **Production reliability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, service levels, runbooks, incident response, problem management, and escalation paths. Lead complex incidents, root\-cause analysis, service restoration, and continuous improvement; define and test recovery and continuity practices. * **DevSecOps:** Establish repeatable development, testing, promotion, and deployment practices for code, configuration, data products, ontology changes, and AIP capabilities. Implement quality gates, traceability, segregation of duties, rollback plans, and production\-readiness controls. * **Security and access:** Own identity and access management (IAM) and role\-based access control (RBAC), including least privilege, privileged access, approvals, periodic reviews, and auditable permissions. Partner with Cyber and enterprise teams on vulnerability management, policy compliance, and control remediation. * **Ontology governance:** Define design standards, stewardship, lifecycle management, documentation, and controlled change for shared objects, relationships, actions, interfaces, and business concepts. Promote reuse and assess downstream impacts, lineage, data quality, security, testing, and versioning. * **Enterprise integration:** Establish secure, resilient, observable integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, identity services, analytics tools, and cloud services. Partner with data engineering on pipeline reliability, orchestration, performance, and cross\-platform issue resolution. * **FinOps:** Establish consumption and cost visibility, allocation, forecasting, budgeting inputs, and optimization reviews where data is available. Translate cost drivers into architecture, processing, scheduling, retention, and configuration improvements; support vendor/SOW and renewal decisions. * **Vendor technical leadership:** Set vendor engineering priorities, capacity, service expectations, quality standards, and escalation procedures. Review designs, code, configuration, operational changes, and incident analysis; ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, coverage, and internal technical ownership. * **Enablement and partnership:** Create onboarding guidance, reference implementations, templates, and engineering playbooks. Partner with Palantir, product teams, Cyber, Infrastructure, Data Governance, Finance, and business stakeholders to balance delivery speed, reliability, reuse, governance, and cost. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in software, data, platform, or cloud engineering; DevSecOps; site reliability engineering (SRE); enterprise integration; or related technical domains. * 5\+ years building or operating enterprise data, analytics, AI, developer, or cloud platforms in production. * Demonstrated hands\-on Foundry platform engineering or administration and AIP solution delivery or operations experience, including production support—not solely application development, architecture advisory, or vendor contract management. * Experience supporting multiple delivery teams through build, deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing operations in environments requiring security, reliability, governance, auditability, and cost management. * Experience technically leading vendor engineers, managed\-service teams, consultants, or distributed engineering resources. * Deep technical capability in Foundry administration, AIP enablement, ontology design and governance, data pipelines, applications, actions, and integrations. * Proficiency in DevSecOps, CI/CD, release controls, environment promotion, IAM/RBAC, least\-privilege design, and enterprise security practices. * Strong troubleshooting and production engineering skills, including observability, SLAs/SLOs, incident response, resilience, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. * Understanding of APIs, enterprise integration, data movement, cloud services, and cross\-platform ownership and support. * Ability to connect platform consumption and solution design to allocation, forecasting, optimization, and cost\-to\-serve. * Hands\-on technical leadership, sound prioritization, and the ability to direct vendor teams while balancing delivery, reliability, security, governance, and cost. * Strong stakeholder partnership and written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical risks and investment needs into business decisions, clear documentation, and executive\-ready updates. * Adaptability in an evolving, multi\-team environment. Experience with shared enterprise Palantir environments, Palantir partner organizations, major cloud/identity/data integrations, and reusable platform services is advantageous.
