jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The Opportunity Adobe Workfront is the work management platform that enterprises rely on to plan, run, and measure work across thousands of people, projects, and approvals. Behind it are engineering teams who understand both the platform and the complex, often regulated environments where customers use it. The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You will be embedded with Workfront's most strategic customers, working directly with their teams to solve hard platform challenges, design scalable integrations, and build what is needed to unblock adoption and expansion. **You will work in a cross\-functional Customer Pod:** a small, autonomous team with end\-to\-end ownership. As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for your accounts, mentor other builders, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers. What You'll Do Partner with strategic customers to understand their workflows, systems, security requirements, and business goals. Turn complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes. Build and ship custom integrations and extensions across Workfront Workflow, Workfront Planning, Workfront Fusion, APIs, and adjacent Adobe and third\-party systems. Investigate and resolve production issues, from data and permissions models to automation, reporting, and performance. Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep dives that earn customer trust. Prototype and iterate quickly, using AI\-assisted tools as a standard part of how you work. Feed field patterns back to product and engineering to shape the Workfront roadmap. Mentor engineers in the pod and set practices for how the team documents decisions and learnings. Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through go\-live and expansion. What Success Looks Like We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates show: Customer empathy. You meet customers on their terms and understand their constraints and definition of success. Ownership at senior level. You find problems before they are assigned and drive them to resolution without waiting for permission. Clear communication. You explain complex ideas to technical and executive audiences in workshops, architecture reviews, and briefings. Business acumen. You understand the use case before choosing the technology. Software craft. You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your designs reflect implementation reality. Data and integration judgment. You weigh trade\-offs in data models, API design, and system integration. Growth mindset and AI fluency. You use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to design, prototype, and deliver, and you build toward agentic capabilities. **Typical background:** 8 to 12 years in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer\-facing engineering. What matters is what that experience produced, not the title or the number of years. Your Domain **Work management platforms:** Workfront or comparable tools (project, portfolio, resource, planning, proofing, and approval workflows). **Integration and automation:** REST APIs, webhooks, event\-driven patterns, and low\-code or workflow orchestration tools such as Workfront Fusion. **Enterprise architecture:** Multi\-system integration, SSO and identity, data flows, and API design across complex landscapes. **Application development:** Strong skills in a modern language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python. **Cloud and data:** AWS or Azure, plus reporting and analytics pipelines. **Security and compliance:** Enterprise permissions, data privacy, and regulated\-industry constraints. Nice to Have Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or Creative Cloud products, including Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Workfront Planning, or Adobe GenStudio. Background in SaaS work management, PPM, or marketing operations platforms. Experience building agentic or LLM\-powered workflows in enterprise settings. Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government. Track record of driving architecture decisions at team or organization level. **How You'll Work:** Pod\-Based Execution You operate within a small, cross\-functional Customer Pod embedded with specific strategic accounts. Each pod has a customer representative for feedback and validation, a product manager for prioritization, engineers and builders for implementation and experimentation, and an account team with enterprise architects for alignment and strategy. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the technical execution backbone of the pod: customer\-facing, hands\-on, and focused on rapid end\-to\-end delivery. We run small, time\-boxed experiments, keep tight customer feedback loops, prototype before fully b zed customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. Let’s Adobe together At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Company Overview** AIS, a division of 1HMX, is a global leader in Human Machine eXperience (HMX) solutions, delivering innovative, high\-performance products that power the future of human interaction with technology. Our portfolio includes electro\-mechanical assemblies and immersive technologies, such as augmented/virtual reality systems, wearable electronics, telerobotic controls, night\-vision equipment, EV and marine interfaces, infection control solutions, medical and industrial display/control panels, and touchscreen products. **Position Summary** The Manufacturing Engineering Manager leads the people, processes, and technical systems that connect product design to reliable, efficient production. This role is responsible for the Manufacturing Engineering team and provides leadership oversight for Bench Technicians and Electro\-Mechanical Assemblers. The manager aligns process engineering, production test and equipment support, and hands\-on assembly resources to support new product introduction (NPI), sustaining production, and continuous improvement. As a hands\-on leader, this individual sets priorities, develops team capability, and ensures that products move from prototype and pilot builds into production with appropriate processes, documentation, tooling, test systems, and training. The manager partners closely with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, Program Management, and other 1HMX teams to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost. **Key Responsibilities** **Team Leadership \& Resource Management** * Lead, coach, and develop Manufacturing Engineers, Bench Technicians, and Electro\-Mechanical Assemblers; establish clear expectations, accountability, and development goals appropriate to each function. * Oversee day\-to\-day priorities and resource allocation across NPI, sustaining engineering, production troubleshooting, test\-system support, assembly needs, and continuous improvement projects. * Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, performance reviews, and career\-development conversations; provide timely feedback and identify training or staffing needs. * Build a collaborative, customer\-focused team culture that emphasizes safe work practices, quality, technical ownership, problem\-solving, and continuous learning. * Coordinate workload and escalation paths so production issues receive timely technical support while longer\-term engineering and process\-development work continues to progress. * Support hiring, onboarding, cross\-training, and succession planning for the teams under this role. **Manufacturing Engineering \& New Product Introduction (NPI)** * Lead Manufacturing Engineering activities for NPI, ensuring products enter production with mature and validated processes, complete documentation, appropriate tooling, and demonstrated readiness. * Partner with Design Engineering early in development to improve design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA), testability, reliability, and production scalability. * Oversee development and maintenance of manufacturing processes, assembly procedures, work instructions, routings, tooling requirements, and other production documentation. * Coordinate prototype builds, pilot runs, process validation, operator training, and handoff to full\-rate production. * Ensure Manufacturing Engineering resources support both new programs and released products, including production changes, troubleshooting, Continuous Improvement, and process optimization. * Review and approve critical process documentation, including PFMEAs, control plans, validation reports, and tooling or fixture specifications, as appropriate. **Bench Technician, Test \& Equipment Support** * Oversee Bench Technician support for production test systems, fixtures, tooling, and equipment, including triage, troubleshooting, repair, upgrades, and preventative maintenance. * Ensure production test systems and fixtures are built, deployed, calibrated, maintained, and validated using applicable schematics, drawings, procedures, and technical requirements. * Coordinate technical support for product performance testing, design verification testing (DVT), and related test planning, procedures, reporting, and data analysis. * Ensure production teams have a clear escalation path for equipment, fixture, test\-system, and product issues; coordinate with engineering teams when issues require additional expertise. * Support improvement of test methods, automation, fixtures, and production support equipment, including appropriate use of tools such as LabVIEW or related test software where applicable. **Electro\-Mechanical Assembly Oversight** * Provide leadership and operational coordination for the Electro\-Mechanical Assembly team to support production priorities, quality requirements, and program schedules. * Ensure assemblers have current work instructions, appropriate tools and fixtures, required training, and access to timely technical support. * Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and rations and Supply Chain to address material, tooling, capacity, and equipment constraints that affect production. **Cross\-Functional \& Organizational Leadership** * Represent Manufacturing Engineering and its supporting production technical teams in site leadership discussions, program reviews, and planning activities. * Partner with Design Engineering, Quality, Operations, Program Management, and Supply Chain to resolve issues and align priorities. * Support customer and third\-party technical audits and communicate manufacturing\-process capabilities, risks, and corrective actions clearly. * Coordinate with 1HMX global engineering teams to share best practices, transfer processes, and align standards across sites. **Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a closely related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * 8\+ years of progressive manufacturing engineering or related manufacturing technical experience, including at least 2–3 years in a formal people\-management role. * Demonstrated experience leading teams or coordinating work across engineering, technical support, and production functions. * Experience supporting NPI, CI, and production readiness in a precision, high\-mix manufacturing environment. * Experience in electromechanical, pneumatics, electronics, HMI, or related product manufacturing strongly preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Broad understanding of manufacturing processes relevant to HMX products, including electromechanical assembly, PCBA processing and rework, Screen printing, Laser cutting/marking, wiring and harness fabrication, and production test. * Ability to lead technical troubleshooting across electrical, mechanical, electronic, and mechatronic systems, including production fixtures and test equipment. * Knowledge of DFM/DFA, Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma concepts, PFMEA, SPC, GD\&T, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methods. * Familiarity with CAD tools such as SolidWorks and with eCAD tools; experience specifying or qualifying automated manufacturing and test equipment is beneficial. * Familiarity with test instruments and systems, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and test software such as LabVIEW, programming language such as Python, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with ERP/MES systems in a production environment; Syteline experience is a plus. * Strong organizational, communication, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage concurrent programs and translate technical issues for non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to develop employees, set expectations, manage performance, and lead cross\-functional teams. **Preferred** * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification, or equivalent continuous\-improvement experience. * Exposure to AS9100, ISO 13485, or other sector\-specific quality management systems. * Experience with robotics, motion control, haptics, wearables, AR/VR, or display integration technologies. * Experience with automated test, pneumatics, production automation, or test platforms such as LabVIEW. * Experience supporting multi\-site or global manufacturing engineering initiatives. **Working Conditions** * Combination of office and production\-floor work. * Frequent interaction with production teams and equipment in a manufacturing environment; adherence to applicable ESD and safety protocols is required. * May require occasional extended hours to support 1 staff. * Troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex hardware, software, application, network, identity, and cloud\-related problems. * Perform advanced user and identity management using Active guides, and internal knowledge bases. * Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution and appropriate documentation in accordance with service standards. * Collaborate with infrastructure, network, cloud, and security teams to resolve cross\-functional technical issues. * Participate in root cause analysis and provide feedback on recurring incidents or process gaps. * Pr ct\-based technical rollouts, migrations, or Microsoft 365/Azure initiatives. * Ability to analyze support metrics and recurring incidents and recommend process improvements. ***Candidates should have a practical understanding of:*** * **Microsoft Entra ID:** Users, groups, authentication, MFA, enterprise applications, and basic identity troubleshooting. * **Azure Portal:** Ability to navigate the portal, locate resources, review basic configuration and status information, and understand subscriptions and resource groups at a conceptual level. * **Identity \& Access:** Basic understanding of Azure RBAC, least privilege, authentication versus authorization, and Conditional Access concepts. * **Microsoft 365 Integration:** Understanding of the relationship between Microsoft 365, Entra ID, licensing, authentication, and user access. * **Hybrid Identity:** Basic understanding of the relationship between on\-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including the concept of directory synchronization. * **Intune / Endpoint Management:** Basic familiarity with device enrollment, compliance, configuration profiles, application deployment, and common endpoint troubleshooting. * **Networking:** Basic understanding of how DNS, IP addressing, VPN connectivity, and cloud networking can affect access to Azure or Microsoft 365 resources. * **Security:** Awareness of MFA, privileged access, security groups, least privilege, and the importance of following established security procedures. * **Troubleshooting:** Ability to distinguish among endpoint, network, identity, permissions, Microsoft 365, and Azure service issues before escalating. **Key Traits for Success** * **Analytical:** Uses a methodical diagnostic approach and identifies likely root causes rather than relying solely on scripted fixes. * **Process\-Driven:** Follows established support, security, escalation, and change\-management workflows and helps improve them. * **Customer\-Focused:** Provides clear, professional, and empathetic communication and follows issues through resolution. * **Mentor\-Oriented:** Provides technical guidance to Level One technicians and helps develop their troubleshooting skills. * **Security\-Conscious:** Understands the impact of identity, access, and administrative changes and follows least\-privilege principles. * **Team\-Aligned:** Works effectively across support, infrastructure, cloud, network, security, and operations teams. * **Flexible:** Comfortably shifts between technical troubleshooting and front\-office responsibilities while keeping priorities and service levels on track. ### **ANA’s Core Values:** * Root Cause Problem Solving * Be Creative with Solutions * Build open and honest relationships * Build a positive team and family spirit * Be inclusive * Look for better ways * Be humble * Urgency ### **Benefits \& Perks:** * Competitive pay * 401k with company contribution * Medical, Dental, \& Vision * Life Insurance * Voluntary Accident Insurance * Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Employee Appreciation Programs The hourly rate for this role is$28\.50 – $31\.73 per hour, which serves as a guide for pay decisions. jobs.description: **Ally and Your Career** Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do \- and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people \- with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work\-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too? **Work Schedule** **:** Ally designates roles as (1\) fully on\-site, (2\) hybrid, or (3\) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need. **The Opportunity** At Ally, you get a startup feel, with the benefits of a company that has worked out the kinks and is fulfilling its purpose. We are always evolving, and we see that as a good thing. From owning our work to seeing its impact in the real world, our team is relentless in finding new ways technology can help make experiences better and help people. We are problem solvers, we value diverse thinking, we support one another, and we challenge ourselves to think bigger in the journey to deliver customer\-obsessed tech solutions. To read more about what our tech team does, be sure to visit our tech blog at ally.tech We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, and support dealer\-facing applications that power critical business interactions and digital experiences. This role will contribute to secure, scalable, and high\-performing platforms across front\-end, back\-end, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on usability, reliability, integration, maintainability, and production excellence. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will partner with product, architecture, business, and engineering teams to translate requirements into high\-quality technical solutions, participate in release and production support activities, and help continuously improve dealer experience and platform stability. You will also contribute to engineering standards, perform code reviews, and support a culture of collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement. At this time, Ally will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. **The Work Itself** ### **The Work Itself** * Full\-Stack Engineering. Design, develop, test, and support full\-stack capabilities across front\-end, back\-end, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure for dealer\-facing applications, with a focus on usability, performance, resiliency, security, and maintainability. * Backend Engineering. Build secure, performant REST APIs and microservices using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript; apply sound API design, asynchronous processing, error handling, enterprise integration patterns, and relational database practices using platforms such as Postgres or Oracle. * AWS Backend Stack. Develop and support cloud\-native solutions using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3, and CloudFront; use Terraform, IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, and CloudWatch to support secure configuration, repeatable provisioning, monitoring, alerting, and production observability. * Frontend Engineering. Build performant, responsive, and accessible dealer\-facing user interfaces using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS practices; integrate APIs and apply usability\-focused implementation, DevOps practices, and AWS deployment patterns. * Frontend Architecture. Contribute to micro frontend architecture, module federation, reusable component design, and client/server state management using tools such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand. * **Architecture, Delivery \& Operations** * Collaborate with architects, product partners, and cross\-functional teams to define technical approaches, integration patterns, and scalable solution components that improve dealer workflows and experience. * Translate business and dealer workflow requirements into technical designs, implementation tasks, and high\-quality application changes. * Support release management activities for dealer\-facing applications, including deployment readiness, dependency coordination, production validation, rollback planning, and post\-release support. * Identify technical risks related to scalability, security, production stability, and dealer impact, and recommend practical mitigation options. * Participate in sprint planning, technical estimation, dependency management, support prioritization, and delivery commitments with clear  . * Proven ability to contribute to end\-to\-end engineering for dealer\-facing applications with strong focus on usability, reliability, performance, and business impact. * Mentor junior developers through technical guidance, code reviews, troubleshooting support, and hands\-on collaboration. **How We'll Have Your Back** Ally's compensation program offers market\-competitive base pay and pay\-for\-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry\-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including: **Time Away:** Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part\-time status and management level). **Planning for the Future:** plan for the near and long term with an industry\-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access. **Supporting your Health \& Well\-being:** flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability, pre\-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident \& hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well\-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially. **Building a Family:** adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, Dependent Day Care FSA back\-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts. **Work\-Life Integration:** other benefits including Mentally Fit Employee Assistance Program, subsidized and discounted Weight Watchers® program and other employee discount programs. **Other Compensations:** depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity. To view more detailed information about Ally’s Total Rewards, please visit this link: https://www.ally.com/content/dam/pdf/corporate/ally\-total\-rewards\-snapshot.pdf **Who We Are** **:** Ally Financial is a customer\-centric, leading digital financial services company with passionate customer service and innovative financial solutions. We are relentlessly focused on "Doing it Right" and being a trusted financial\-services provider to our consumer, commercial, and corporate customers. For more information, visit www.ally.com . Ally is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy status, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic disposition or any other reason protected by law. In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if after review of the position expectations, you believe that you may need a medical accommodation to fulfill the duties of this role, please email hrpolicy@ally.com with details of your accommodation request. **Base Pay Range** $85,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 An individual's position in the range is determined by the specific role, the scope and responsibilities of the role, work experience, education, certification(s), training, and additional qualifications. We review internal pay, the competitive market, and business environment prior to extending an offer. **Incentive Compensation:** This position is eligible to participate in our annual incentive plan.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy? Who are we? Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We build the chips, the systems, and the software that power some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world. What do we do? We build the software that provisions, operates, updates, and monitors the servers behind AWS's largest AI training workloads, built on Trainium, Graviton, and the AWS Nitro system. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system. Why it's high\-impact? The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day. What's the challenge? There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast\-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup\-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love. What you will do? You own a service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics, depending on where the team needs you. You take it from design to production, you work backward from what the operator needs, and you build on the interfaces the hardware teams expose. Who would succeed in this role? An engineer who likes building and operating a service in production and takes it the whole way. You read logs and reason across process and system boundaries, you ship in small verifiable steps, and you turn requirements into a service other people rely on. Key job responsibilities * Own the design and implementation of a large component or service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics. * Make the application\-level trade\-offs on your component, and seek direction on the calls that reach beyond it. * Automate and simplify the team's development, test, and operations work, and mentor peers as you grow. * work backward from customer requirements and deliver solutions that are simple. A day in the life You design and build the provisioning and management surface over standard interfaces like Redfish, and the boot flow operator tools drive. You build the offline software\-update service and prove the signed bundle applies and recovers cleanly. You design each system against the interfaces the platform exposes and turn architecture decisions into APIs and tools a customer runs without you in the loop. About the team Our team builds the software suite for provisioning, monitoring, software delivery, and the diagnostics of Trainium systems, and we build all of it on open, standard interfaces. We serve the engineers and operators who run large\-scale AI training and need to provision, monitor, update, and troubleshoot it on their own terms. We own it end to end. We're a small team with a large charter. You own real systems on day one. There are no layers between you and the problem. You build it, you ship it, you operate it, you improve it.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 3\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 3\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 2\+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 4\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers * Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems * Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing * Knowledge of professional software engineering \& best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer, AI Business Automation, Prime Video
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies, TV shows, and live sports, offering a vast library of content to a global audience. We are constantly innovating to enhance the customer experience, from how content is discovered and consumed to how we produce and deliver it at scale. Our mission is to be the premier entertainment destination, and we achieve this through a relentless focus on the customer, a passion for storytelling, and a commitment to technical excellence. We are forming a new organization within Prime Video to redefine our operational landscape through the power of artificial intelligence. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will play a key role in building the next generation of business automation. You will collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and scientists to design, develop, and deploy the agentic AI solutions that will power this transformation. This is an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a new initiative, work with complex distributed systems, and see your contributions directly improve how Prime Video operates for our customers worldwide. For this team we are hiring, we are building an AI\-powered creative production platform for one of the world's largest entertainment studios — a browser\-based tool where creative professionals compose marketing key art using 50\+ layers, AI\-generated characters, dynamic lighting, and real\-time image manipulation. The product is a professional\-grade, canvas\-based creative editor — closer to Photoshop or Figma in complexity than a web application with forms and tables. Key job responsibilities * Design and build a high\-performance, browser\-based creative editor with multi\-layer canvas compositing, real\-time image manipulation, and GPU\-accelerated rendering for professional\-grade creative workflows. * Architect and optimize rendering pipelines for complex layer stacks, handling high\-resolution assets, blend modes, masking, and non\-destructive editing with fluid performance. * Integrate AI/ML model outputs into interactive UI workflows, enabling users to generate, edit, and compose visual content through intuitive creative controls. * Implement production file export capabilities (including PSD with preserved layer structure) and asset management features that serve downstream creative teams. * Collaborate with backend engineers, applied scientists, and product managers to deliver on our product roadmap and solve customer problems across the full creative production pipeline. * Own performance, reliability, and quality of the frontend platform — profiling, measuring, and optimizing to ensure the application feels responsive under demanding workloads. * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, and architectural decisions that will define the platform's technical foundation. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Product Knowledge Store
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on innovative, scalable services technology in a team environment? Do you like working on industry\-defining projects that move the needle? At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. The Software Development Engineers (SDEs) on the Product Knowledge Store team use the latest AWS technologies, graph databases, and Ontology standards to re\-envision how we codify and serve knowledge about customer\-facing products. We exemplify the highest engineering standards in order to serve the Amazon product catalog schema with high throughput and low latency. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon. While the majority of our SDE roles are based in the greater Seattle/Bellevue, WA area, by applying to this position your application will be considered for all locations we hire in the United States. This includes, but is not limited to Nashville, TN; Austin, TX; Greater Bay Area, CA; DC Metro Area; Denver, CO; Detroit, MI; Greater Boston Area, MA; Greater Denver Area, CO; Greater Los Angeles Area, CA; Greater New York Area; Irvine, CA; Madison, WI; Minneapolis, MN; Phoenix, AZ; Portland, OR; San Diego, CA. To qualify, applicants should have earned a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within the last six months or be on track to earn their Bachelor’s or Master’s degree prior to the role start date. Key job responsibilities * Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market. * Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. * Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. * Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. * Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. * Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software. jobs.title: Research & Development Scientist / Engineer O
jobs.description: **Company:** Ambilabs LLC **Location:** Warren, Rhode Island **Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site **Experience:** 7\+ Years **About Ambilabs** Ambilabs LLC is a growing environmental technology company specializing in advanced ambient air quality monitoring instrumentation, custom monitoring systems, and innovative environmental measurement solutions. We serve government agencies, research institutions, and industrial customers throughout North America and internationally. Our Research \& Development team focuses on designing and developing the next generation of environmental monitoring technologies, with an emphasis on measurement accuracy, reliability, and practical real\-world applications. **Position Overview** Ambilabs is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Senior Research \& Development Scientist / Engineer to join our team in Warren, Rhode Island. This position will play a critical role in the research, design, development, and commercialization of new environmental monitoring instruments, with a particular emphasis on optical measurement technologies, light scattering, and absorption. The ideal candidate possesses a strong theoretical understanding of optics and advanced mathematics, physics, combined with the hands\-on engineering experience necessary to design, build, test, and troubleshoot complex instrumentation. Experience with nephelometry, aerosol measurement, or optical particle detection is a significant advantage. We welcome experienced professionals from a range of engineering and scientific disciplines, including optical engineering, electrical engineering, physics, applied sciences, and related technical fields. This is an opportunity for an experienced technical professional who enjoys solving challenging engineering problems, developing innovative technologies, and transforming scientific concepts into commercially viable products. **Key Responsibilities** **Research \& Product Development** * Research and development activities for new environmental monitoring instruments and measurement technologies. * Design, develop, and optimize optical measurement systems, particularly those utilizing light scattering, and absorption principles. * Evaluate new technologies, measurement techniques, and components for potential integration into commercial products. * Drive product development from initial concept and feasibility studies through prototyping, validation, and production readiness. * Identify and implement improvements to existing instrument designs, measurement accuracy, reliability, and performance. **Optical Systems \& Analytical Engineering** * Apply advanced optical principles, light scattering theory, light absorption theory, and mathematical modeling to instrument design and development. * Develop and solve complex mathematical equations related to optical measurements, signal processing, and instrument performance. * Design and evaluate optical configurations, light sources, detectors, and associated measurement electronics. * Develop calibration methods, measurement algorithms, and performance verification procedures. * Analyze experimental data to identify measurement limitations, sources of error, and opportunities for improvement. **Hands\-On Engineering \& Prototyping** * Independently design, assemble, modify, and troubleshoot electronic and optical prototypes. * Work directly with electronic circuits, sensors, optical components, and laboratory instrumentation. * Utilize hand tools, electronic test equipment, and specialized laboratory equipment to build and evaluate experimental systems. * Diagnose complex mechanical, electrical, and optical problems and develop effective solutions. * Conduct laboratory testing, validation experiments, and instrument performance evaluations. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical direction and expertise throughout the product development process. * Collaborate with engineering, technical service, and other departments to ensure successful product development and commercialization. * Establish testing procedures, technical specifications, and performance requirements. * Prepare detailed technical documentation, research findings, design records, and test reports. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced team members as needed. * Independently manage technical priorities and development milestones while maintaining project schedules. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of professional experience in research and development, instrumentation engineering, optical systems, or related technical product development. * Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, applied sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience. * Strong understanding of optics, including light scattering principles and their applications in measurement technologies. * Advanced mathematical and analytical capabilities, including the ability to derive, manipulate, and solve complex equations. * Demonstrated experience designing, developing, testing, or improving scientific or industrial instrumentation. * Extensive hands\-on experience working with electronics, electronic components, and laboratory test equipment. * Proficiency using hand tools to assemble, modify, troubleshoot, and repair electronic and mechanical systems. * Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex technical and engineering challenges. * Experience with experimental design, data analysis, measurement uncertainty, and instrument performance evaluation. * Demonstrated ability to take technical concepts from initial design through functional prototype development. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document and explain complex technical concepts. **Preferred Qualifications** The following qualifications are highly desirable but are not required: * Experience with nephelometry, including the design, development, calibration, or operation of nephelometric measurement systems. * Knowledge of aerosol science, atmospheric optics, or particulate matter measurement technologies. * Experience with Mie scattering, Rayleigh scattering, or related optical measurement principles. * Experience designing optical detection systems utilizing LEDs, lasers, photodiodes, or photomultiplier tubes. * Experience with analog and digital electronics, signal conditioning, and low\-noise measurement circuits. * Familiarity with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and instrument control technologies. * Experience with scientific programming, numerical analysis, or mathematical modeling using tools such as Python, MATLAB, or similar software. * Experience with optical simulation, mechanical design, or CAD software. * Knowledge of environmental monitoring instrumentation, air quality measurement methods, or analytical instruments. * Experience developing commercial products, including design verification, validation, and transition to manufacturing. * Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant technical or scientific field. **Ideal Candidate** The successful candidate will be someone who: * Enjoys combining advanced scientific theory with practical, hands\-on engineering. * Can understand the physics and mathematics behind a measurement technique and translate that knowledge into a functional instrument. * Is comfortable working at a laboratory bench, assembling electronics, using tools, and troubleshooting prototypes. * Approaches complex problems analytically and develops practical, innovative solutions. * Takes ownership of technical challenges and works independently to achieve results. * Is creative, detail\-oriented, and motivated by developing new technologies. * Thrives in a collaborative environment where ideas can move quickly from concept to prototype and commercial product. **Compensation \& Benefits** Ambilabs offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including: * 3 weeks of paid time off (PTO) * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Life insurance * Free gym membership * Opportunities for professional growth and technical leadership * Direct involvement in innovative environmental monitoring product development * Collaborative, hands\-on research and engineering environment **Work Location** This is a full\-time, on\-site position at Ambilabs LLC in Warren, Rhode Island. The position requires regular laboratory work, hands\-on prototype development, instrument testing, and direct collaboration with our engineering and technical teams. **Ambilabs LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description: American Pride Bank was founded in 2007 by first\-generation Americans and entrepreneurs to ensure everyone has fair access to financial products and services needed to achieve their American Dream. Through it all, we offer responsive, flexible, and tailored banking services that allow our customers to make money, build wealth, and secure a long\-term legacy of financial well\-being. **About the role** The Desktop Support Engineer II / IT Specialist is the first point of contact for employees who need technical help, resolving Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues quickly and escalating advanced problems to the right third\-party provider or internal team. The role covers user access and account management, network and VPN connectivity, and end\-user hardware and software support. This is a hybrid role for Middle Georgia, Tampa, FL, or Sarasota, FL. **What you'll do** **Tier 1 Help Desk Support** * Serve as the first point of contact for employees by phone, email, chat, walk\-up, and ticketing portal. * Log, categorize, prioritize, and track every request in the ticketing system (e.g., Happy Fox, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management). * Diagnose and resolve common issues such as slow performance, application errors, printer faults, peripheral problems, and email or calendar sync. * Provide remote support using tools such as Microsoft Teams, TeamViewer, Quick Assist, or ConnectWise. * Escalate unresolved or complex incidents to the appropriate third\-party provider or internal team with clear notes and steps already taken, and follow up until closure. * Meet service level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution times. **Access and Account Management** * Create, modify, disable, and delete user accounts in Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) according to onboarding and offboarding procedures. * Reset passwords, unlock accounts, and verify user identity before granting access. * Assign and remove access to shared drives, security groups, distribution lists, applications, and licenses (e.g., Microsoft 365\). * Support multi\-factor authentication (MFA) enrollment and troubleshooting, and single sign\-on (SSO) issues. * Process access requests following least\-privilege principles and approval workflows, and maintain an audit trail. * Assist with periodic access reviews and compliance requests. **Networking and Connectivity** * Troubleshoot wired and wireless connectivity problems on user devices and in the office. * Diagnose issues involving IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and basic routing using tools such as ping, tracert, nslookup, and ipconfig. * Check the status of switches, access points, patch panels, and network ports, and coordinate with the network team on faults. * Support network printers, VoIP phones, and other networked peripherals. * Document network issues and escalate suspected outages or infrastructure faults. **VPN and Remote Access** * Install, configure, and troubleshoot VPN clients (e.g., Cisco AnyConnect, GlobalProtect, FortiClient, or the company\-standard solution) on Windows and macOS devices. * Resolve VPN issues such as failed authentication, certificate errors, split\-tunneling problems, and dropped connections. * Support remote and hybrid employees with secure access to internal resources, virtual desktops, and cloud applications. * Coordinate with the network and security teams on VPN profile changes, access policies, and incidents. **Hardware, Software, and Endpoint Management** * Set up, configure, deploy, and image laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, and mobile devices. * Install, update, and troubleshoot operating systems (Windows, macOS) and business applications. * Manage endpoints with tools such as Microsoft Intune, SCCM/Configuration Manager, or Jamf, including patching and software deployment. * Handle hardware diagnostics, repairs, warranty claims, and vendor coordination. * Maintain IT asset inventory, including tracking of assignments, returns, and disposals. * Confirm that endpoint security tools (antivirus/EDR, disk encryption) are installed and working. **Documentation and Continuous Improvement** * Write and update knowledge base articles, how\-to guides, and standard operating procedures. * Identify recurring issues and recommend fixes or user training to reduce ticket volume. * Support IT projects such as OS upgrades, office moves, and new system rollouts. * Follow company security, data protection, and change management  and report suspected policy violations or conflicts of interest. **Escalation and Handoff** * Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues in\-house; escalate advanced remediation (such as network infrastructure faults, server or cloud platform issues, and complex software or security problems) to the responsible third\-party provider. * Know which provider owns each system, service, and site, how to contact them, and what their support hours and SLAs are. * Before escalating, confirm the issue, gather logs and screenshots, record the steps already tried, and state the business impact and priority. * Open the vendor case, record the case number in the internal ticket, and stay the point of contact for the user until the issue is resolved. * Escalate to IT management when a provider misses an SLA, an outage affects many users, or a security or business continuity risk is involved. * Use the Tier 3 / provider handoff to learn from each fix, and add the resolution to the knowledge base so similar issues can be handled in\-house next time. **Qualifications** **Experience and Education** * 2 to 4 years of experience in a help desk or desktop support role, including Tier 2 troubleshooting and working with outside service providers. * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Technical Skills** * Windows 10/11 and macOS support, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. * Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID user and group administration. * Microsoft 365 administration basics (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing). * Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi, and common network troubleshooting tools. * Experience supporting VPN clients and remote\-access solutions. * Familiarity with MFA and SSO tools (e.g., Microsoft Authenticator, Okta, Duo). * Experience with a ticketing / ITSM platform and remote support tools. * Working knowledge of printers, peripherals, mobile devices, and common business applications. * Basic understanding of cybersecurity practices, including phishing awareness, patching, and endpoint protection. **Architecture, Continuity, and Governance Knowledge** * Understanding of IT architecture concepts, including how identity, network, endpoint, and cloud layers fit together. * Familiarity with business continuity and disaster recovery concepts such as backups, RTO/RPO, failover, and incident response. * Working knowledge of separation of duties, least privilege, change management, and approval workflows. * Awareness of common compliance and security frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, HIPAA, or PCI DSS, as relevant to the organization). **Preferred Qualifications and Certifications** ----------------------------------------------- * CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+ * Microsoft certifications such as MS\-900 or SC\-900 * ITIL 4 Foundation or HDI Support Center Analyst * Experience with Intune, Jamf, or SCCM for endpoint management * Experience in a regulated environment (e.g., healthcare, finance) with compliance requirements **Core Competencies and Soft Skills** ------------------------------------- * **Customer service:** Patient, courteous, and able to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users. * **Problem solving:** Methodical troubleshooting, with the judgment to know when to escalate. * **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication, including accurate ticket notes and documentation. * **Time management:** Able to prioritize competing requests and meet SLAs in a fast\-paced environment. * **Reliability and integrity:** Handles sensitive account and access information with discretion. * **Teamwork:** Works well with other IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders. * **Adaptability:** Willing to learn new tools and technologies and to take on new responsibilities. l candidate **The pay range for this role is:** 55,000 \- 68,000 USD per year(Log Cabin Branch)

In order to be considered for this position, information to support your answers must be included in your application. A resume attachment is optional and cannot be used in place of this application. Applications must be received by the closing deadline of 11:59pm on 11/02/2026 in order to be considered. **Position Description** The Anoka County Information Technology Department’s mission is to align and deliver cost\-effective technology strategies and services in partnership with County divisions, departments and offices, other local jurisdictions, and the public. The department has an immediate opening for a Lead End User Support Engineer. We're looking for a hands\-on engineer who identifies gaps in our endpoint environment, initiates the work to close them, and leads new technology initiatives that reach every user and device across a co\-managed fleet of approximately 2,500 Windows devices, plus Mac and mobile devices. Some of the critical responsibilities of this position include engineering and administering the County’s Windows endpoint platform; supporting domain, directory, and authentication services; administering Microsoft 365 client applications and services; and providing escalated support for virtual desktop infrastructure. This is a full\-time, exempt, hybrid position. Interviews will take place the week of November 9th, 2026, for those selected to move forward in the hiring process. **Pay \& Benefits** * Anoka County Salary Schedule Grade 35: $79,788\.80 to $111,696\.00 annually ($38\.36 to $53\.70 per hour). * 24 days of paid flexible time off and up to 12\.5 paid holidays. * Comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, flex benefits and more at https://www.anokacountymn.gov/benefits * Medical and dental clinic exclusive to employees, located at the Anoka County Government Center. * Pension plan and other retirement investment options. * Advancement/professional development opportunities. **Work Location** * This position will work at Anoka County Government Center, located at 2100 3rd Ave, Anoka, MN 55303\. * This position may be eligible for flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work, with some days working remotely and some days working in the office. * Business hours are Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. * This position participates in a rotating on\-call schedule, approximately one week every 5 weeks, providing after\-hours and weekend support for critical county end user systems. **Job Duties and Responsibilities** *These examples are not all inclusive and are intended to be illustrative of primary responsibilities of an Anoka County Lead End User Support Engineer.* * Lead processes to ensure all enterprise desktop engineering systems perform reliably, efficiently, and securely. * Research and recommend emerging enterprise level technologies that support end user needs. * Lead technical discussions regarding existing and new solutions. Recommend strategies to meet future end user technology needs. * Procure, design, develop, implement, and administer enterprise level end user technology. * Lead enterprise project initiatives and meet deliverables, including project plans and schedules with resource estimates, defined acceptance criteria, and completion through handoff to operations. * Proactively identify gaps and risks in the endpoint environment, and initiate and lead the work to close them. * Establish policies, procedures, processes and documentation for computers, mobile devices, operating systems, end user productivity applications, auditing, configuration management, anti\-malware, third\-party patching, mobile device management and virtual desktop technologies. * Determine standards to ensure all systems remain functional, reliable and secure. * Act as an escalation point for the most complex technology issues partnering closely with network and systems engineers. * Ensure routine maintenance is provided on hardware and software. jobs.title: Anthropic Research Resident
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed\-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full\-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a **professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff\-level engineer** and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required. **What to expect** ------------------ * A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers * Access to Claude models and GPU compute * Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community **Interview process** --------------------- The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check. Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027\. **You may be a good fit if you** -------------------------------- * Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole * Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full\-time * Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff\-level engineer) * Thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative environments * Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly **Strong candidates may also** ------------------------------ * Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety * Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases **Mentors and research areas** ------------------------------ Potential Anthropic mentors include: * Sara Price: leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science * Ethan Perez: leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning * Evan Hubinger: leads the Alignment Stress\-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) * Samuel Marks: leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics * Elana Simon: researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics * Belinda Li: researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT) * Jack Lindsey: leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience * Nicholas Carlini: researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain * Jascha Sohl\-Dickstein: works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include: AI safety \& alignment * Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human\-level intelligence in various domains. * Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios. * Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise. * Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures. * Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment. * AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations. AI security \& frontier red\-teaming * Stress\-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography. ML systems \& reinforcement learning * Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines. For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our Recommendation  from a country where Anthropic can hire. Applicants may also be considered for the Anthropic Fellows Program. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $350,000 \- $500,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer, Data & AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Arctiq is a global, intelligence\-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking \& Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data \& AI, Autonomous Operations \& Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer\-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries. **Position Overview:** **The Solution Engineer, Data \& AI** is a hands\-on builder who designs, delivers, and operates production\-grade data and AI solutions. You will join a team of engineers who bring real software engineering discipline to data work — version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability are how we work, not afterthoughts. We also expect our engineers to embrace agentic engineering, using tools like Claude Code to dramatically accelerate how software gets built without compromising quality. Depending on business need and your strengths, you will be aligned to one of two paths: **Path 1 — Client Delivery:** Support delivery of fixed\-price, outcome\-based data and AI projects for clients across a wide range of industries and problem domains, on Azure, AWS, and GCP. In a fixed\-price model, engineering quality and delivering within agreed scope directly affect client outcomes and project margin. **Path 2 — Internal Data \& Analytics:** Bring order to our internal data on Azure Databricks — integrating, cleaning, and modelling data from our business systems so the organization has trusted analytics and reporting and helping automate core business processes such as quote\-to\-cash. Both paths share the same technical foundation, and engineers may move between paths over time as priorities and interests evolve. **Responsibilities:** * **Data Pipeline Engineering** * Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads * Apply proven lakehouse architecture patterns, with clear data contracts and well\-managed schema evolution * Build data quality checks, testing, and monitoring into every pipeline from day one * **Data Modelling \& Analysis** * Design analytical data models that reflect business requirements and perform at scale * Profile, explore, and analyze data to validate assumptions, surface quality issues, and share meaningful insights with stakeholders * Apply sound data governance practices so data assets are secure, traceable, and discoverable * **AI \& Machine Learning Engineering** * Build, train, and evaluate machine learning and generative AI solutions — from classical ML to LLM\-based and agentic applications * Establish rigorous evaluation approaches tied to clear, business\-aligned success criteria * Take models from experimentation to production, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and maintainable * **MLOps \& DevOps** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for code, data, and models * Manage cloud and platform resources through infrastructure as code * Implement full model lifecycle management — versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining * Champion engineering best practices across the team: code reviews, branching strategies, automated testing, and documentation * **Agentic Engineering** * Use agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, documentation, and refactoring * Provide AI agents with effective context through clear specifications, project instructions, and reusable workflows * Apply rigorous review, testing, and validation to AI\-generated code — you own the quality of what ships, regardless of who or what wrote it * Share effective agentic workflows with the team and help codify them into repeatable practices and accelerators * **Path 1 — Client Delivery** * Deliver engineering workstreams on fixed\-price client engagements, from technical discovery through outcome acceptance * Work across client environments on Azure, AWS, and GCP, adapting patterns to each client’s cloud, security model, and constraints * Partner with Architects and your Engineering Manager to deliver solutions within agreed scope, timeline, and commercial constraints * Participate in client workshops, demos, and technical working sessions, building credibility with client technical teams * Identify scope creep, technical risks, and blockers early — and raise them promptly and constructively * Leave clients better off: document solutions clearly, transfer knowledge, and help build client\-side capability * Contribute to reusable accelerators, templates, and patterns that make future engagements more predictable * **Path 2 — Internal Data \& Analytics** * Integrate data from our core business systems (e.g., CRM, PSA, finance/ERP, HR) into our Azure Databricks environment * Clean, reconcile, and standardize messy internal data — resolving duplicates, aligning definitions across systems, and establishing a single source of truth for key entities such as customers, projects, contracts, and revenue * Coordinate with internal teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve data quality issues at the source, and put processes in place to prevent them from recurring * Build trusted, well\-documented data models that power internal analytics, KPIs, and executive and operational reporting * Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and leadership to understand reporting needs and translate them into reliable data products * Help design and automate quote\-to\-cash workflows, connecting data and handoffs from opportunity through quote, contract, delivery, invoicing, and collections **Qualifications:** * 4\+ years in software and platform engineering, including meaningful time on a collaborative software development team * Hands\-on experience building production data and ML solutions in the cloud * Strong, demonstrable experience with the Databricks platform in production environments * Practical experience using agentic coding tools to accelerate software development — with examples of how it has changed the way you work * **Technical Skills** * **Software Engineering \& DevOps** * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL * Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git workflows, code review, unit and integration testing, modular design * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure as code * Comfortable with containerization, environment management, and automated deployment * **Cloud Platforms** * Working knowledge of all three major clouds — Azure, AWS, and GCP — with deep hands\-on experience in at least one * Understanding of how data platforms are deployed and integrated on each cloud, including storage, identity, networking, and security * Familiarity with each cloud’s native data and AI services and when to use them alongside Databricks * **Databricks** * Deep, hands\-on experience across the Databricks platform, including data engineering, governance, and ML/AI capabilities * Experience deploying and managing Databricks solutions using software engineering and DevOps best practices * **Data Engineering \& Modelling** * Proven ability to design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines * Strong data modelling skills across dimensional and modern lakehouse patterns * Experience with data quality frameworks, testing, and observability * **AI / ML \& MLOps** * Practical experience building, evaluating, and deploying ML models to production * Experience with generative AI patterns such as retrieval\-augmented generation, agents, and LLM evaluation * Strong MLOps practices across the full model lifecycle * **Agentic Engineering** * Hands\-on proficiency with agentic development tools such as Claude Code * Ability to decompose work, write clear specifications, and manage context so agents produce high\-quality results * Sound judgment on where AI\-assisted development adds leverage and where it introduces risk, with a disciplined approach to reviewing and testing its output Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. *We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.*
