You’ll work directly with customers’ clinical operations, data, and IT teams, and with our Product and Engineering teams, to turn customer needs into working solutions. You’ll stay close to products in development and translate their requirements into delivery approaches. Our product space is new, so this role suits someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, is energized by emerging technology, and is happy to roll up their sleeves to deliver digital health solutions at scale. **What You’ll Do** **Lead customer data conversations** * Lead discovery with customers on data requirements, identifying the right datasets, data owners, and multi\-functional partners for each data type. * Advise customers on data standards and on how their data maps to Evinova’s out\-of\-the\-box offerings. * Develop deep expertise in Evinova’s data landscape and in customer data architectures, providing technical guidance during implementation and configuration. * Present clearly and confidently to technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior customer collaborators. **Technical implementation** * Guide customers through collecting source data specifications, preparing datasets, and mapping and transforming data to Evinova standards where needed. * Support customer onboarding to ingest sponsor\-specific data sources. * Build and prepare data work hands\-on where needed, and load them into customer environments. * Review customer\-provided data for quality and completeness, and resolve issues before load. * Validate loaded data in customer environments and reconcile it against source. * Manage defects and issues through to resolution in partnership with Product and Engineering, and lead root\-cause analysis and remediation. * Navigate formal change control and environment promotion, coordinating approvals, dependencies, and timelines. * Champion change initiatives using change\-management guidelines, aligning delivery with strategic goals, product releases, and multi\-functional needs during complex transitions. * Track and communicate implementation progress across customers and internal partners, working independently across multiple engagements and proactively identifying and mitigating risks. **Integrations** * Lead all aspects of end\-to\-end customer data integration, including collecting requirements, configuring, testing, and maintaining integrations, and fix connectivity issues. * Manage configuration as code and coordinate reviews and approvals with Platform and Security partners. * Support system\-upgrade impact assessments and update integrations after implementation. * Ensure data exchange meets applicable data privacy and regulatory requirements **Be the product SME** * Answer post\-implementation technical and data questions and serve as a customer concern point for data\-related issues. * Support pre\-sales with technical and data questions, such as feasibility and prioritization. * Act as a key liaison between customers, internal teams, vendors, and our Product and Engineering teams, and work with Product to build solutions and feed customer insights back into the roadmap. * Establish and document guidelines for data exchange, including monitoring and to fix, and develop and optimize delivery playbooks, templates, and checklists that make use of Evinova’s automated tools. * Train internal teams and customers on data exchange procedures and standards. * Keep a commercial approach, making sure integration and delivery work brings value for customers and for Evinova. **Essential Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience * Bachelor's Degree * Demonstrated experience in clinical operations, clinical data management, clinical trial planning, or a related technical field where data informs study decisions. * Strong working knowledge of clinical trial data structures, terminologies, and standards, including USDM and CDISC. * Hands\-on familiarity with clinical trial operational, study design, cost and rate, and feasibility data, ideally including both clinical operational data and cost or finance data. * Good background in the technical implementation of customer\-facing data integrations across organizations, ideally for enterprise SaaS customers. * Strong working skills with structured data formats and secure file transfer. * Comfort with configuration in version control, command\-line tools, and basic cloud concepts (for example, AWS). * Experience with work\-tracking and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence. * Demonstrated ability to analyze data flows, identify discrepancies, and solve complex data issues. * Ability to manage high\-visibility, technical customer engagements, work independently across multiple engagements, and own problems end to end. * Executive presence and good communication, with the ability to translate technical topics for non\-technical audiences and collaborate across diverse teams. * Highly organized and passionate about finding effective approaches. Shows resilience and adaptability in a fast\-paced, newly emerging product space. Has a passion for improving healthcare through technology. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting or implementing healthcare technology, digital health solutions, or data\-heavy SaaS platforms. * Knowledge of data privacy and compliance requirements and standards for clinical data. * Experience working within formal change management in a regulated environment. * Experience supporting pre\-sales or solution scoping. * Familiarity with integration monitoring tools, automation, and customer delivery playbooks. * Practical experience applying AI\-driven tools or frameworks to accelerate data integration and validation (for example, reducing manual mapping). When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. **That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office.** But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. **Why Evinova (AstraZeneca)?** ------------------------------ Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers. Together, we accelerate the delivery of life\-changing medicines, improve the design and delivery of clinical trials for better patient experiences and outcomes, and think more holistically about patient care before, during, and after treatment. Evinova represents an outstanding opportunity to deliver meaningful outcomes with digital and AI to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards for the sector. We work a minimum of three days per week from the office to maintain the pace, connection, and creative friction that builds great products, while respecting individual flexibility. Join us on our journey of building a new kind of health tech business to reset expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. This means opening new ways to work, pioneering ground breaking methods, and bringing unexpected teams together. Interested? Come and join our journey. **Date Posted** 28\-Oct\-2026 **Closing Date** 10\-Nov\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. codes, and vendor drawing requirements. * Prepare engineering sketches, perform engineering calculations and develop analysis models for complex project assignments. * Review and/or approve vendor drawings for compliance with project specifications. * Interact and communicate effectively with clients, subcontractors, vendors and other consultants. * Set realistic expectations and ensure assigned projects are completed according to schedule and within budget. * Adhere to company quality standards and follow engineering checking and approval procedures. * Comply with all company and client health, safety, security and environmental (HSSE) standards as well as federal and local HSSE regulations. * Actively participate in company and client hazard identification and observation programs, and immediately report any unsafe acts, conditions or incidents to your supervisor. * Interact with drafting/design group to develop and review engineering drawings. * Visit job\-sites to evaluate site, project requirements, and conditions. * Visit vendor facilities to inspect equipment for compliance with requirements/specifications. * Prepare inquiry and purchase requisitions as well as bid tabulations associated with equipment purchases. * Perform checking of engineering drawings and mathematical calculations. * Adhere to safe design practices, while focusing on identifying cost saving opportunities. * Plan and manage workload, budgets and project resources, requesting assistance as necessary. * Develop, review and/or approve conceptual and detailed engineering design packages. * Assist in the development of internal design guidelines, specifications, and design control procedures. * Assess feasibility of projects by assessing materials, costs and time jobs.description: **Job Description** **Test Solutions Software Section Lead (Player/Coach)** In Precision Strike \& Sensing Solutions, we design, develop, and manufacture state‑of‑the‑art systems that enable our customers to execute their missions. Our manufacturing lines support critical programs where **build, test, and diagnostic software** are foundational to production throughput, yield, and quality. We’re creating a dedicated **Test Solutions Software Section** to bring technical harmony to how we develop, deploy, and sustain test software across programs—reducing downtime, accelerating change, and developing the next generation of factory\-focused engineers. **Your Impact** * **Technical Stewardship at Scale:** Serve as the subject‑matter authority for the **software powering manufacturing and automated test equipment**. Establish a common, reusable architecture that keeps high‑volume production seamless and efficient across multiple programs/sites. * **Production Problem Solving:** Lead rapid diagnosis and resolution of factory floor software issues. When the line stops, you own the recovery—coordinating across Test Engineering, Manufacturing, Hardware, and Quality to restore flow. * **Player/Coach Leadership:** Split your time between **hands‑on contributions** (architecture, code reviews, integration, troubleshooting) and **front‑line leadership** (hiring, performance management, coaching, career development, roadmap stewardship). **The Challenge** You will stand up and lead a cross‑program team of software engineers responsible for the **full lifecycle** of manufacturing test solutions—requirements, architecture, coding, integration on hardware, verification, deployment, and sustainment. Today, engineers are distributed under different leaders and embedded within program teams. You will: * Consolidate and **realign reporting** for test‑focused engineers into a single section. * Define and execute a **technical roadmap** that standardizes platforms, patterns, and processes across programs. * Build **cross‑training** plans to increase bench strength and eliminate single‑points‑of‑failure. * Partner with Program Engineering Managers and factory leadership to meet schedule/cost objectives **without sacrificing reliability**. **Roles \& Responsibilities** **Leadership \& People** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of test solutions software engineers; establish growth plans, skill matrices, and cross‑training rotations. * Perform staff management including performance reviews, coaching, career development, salary planning, rewards/recognition, and performance management. * Hire to a balanced skill profile (factory support, software craftsmanship, data/diagnostics), emphasizing **player/coach** potential. **Technical Execution** * Own the section’s **reference architecture** for ATE and manufacturing test software: driver abstraction layers, hardware‑interface modules, test sequence orchestration, data logging/traceability, and deployment hardening. * Lead teams through design, implementation, integration on hardware, and verification—**on the bench and on the floor**. * Introduce and enforce standards for code quality, documentation, configuration management, versioning, and release practices for regulated manufacturing environments. * Champion **CI/CD for test software** (build, static analysis, automated tests, staged deployments) appropriate for hardware‑in‑the‑loop systems. * Integrate test software with factory systems (e.g., build records, serialization, calibration data, analytics dashboards) in partnership with Manufacturing/Quality. **Operational Excellence** * Establish on‑call rotations and escalation paths; track and improve MTTR for production software incidents. * Define KPIs and report routinely (e.g., uptime, first‑pass yield, release cadence, defect density, common‑platform adoption, audit findings). * Plan and manage the necessary **staff, facilities, and equipment** for successful execution (licenses, benches, instruments, emulators, labs). * Ensure schedules are planned, resourced, and executed to cost/schedule objectives; manage risk and drive corrective actions. * Support pursuit activities—bids and proposals—by scoping test software work, estimating, and articulating reuse strategies. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field **and 10\+ years** of relevant experience (or equivalent experience). * Experience deploying and sustaining software in constrained or regulated factory environments: **configuration management**, **release governance**, change control, and audit readiness. * Demonstrated success in **factory or production support** environments—owning incident response, root cause, and corrective actions for software issues. * Strong written and verbal communication; effective interface with Discipline Leads, Section Leads, Program Engineering Managers, Program Managers, Manufacturing/Test Engineering, and Quality. * Proven experience leading projects to successful execution (on time/on budget), including risk management and stakeholder alignment. **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * **4\+ years** leading a software team (embedded or test solutions) through full lifecycle delivery on hardware. * Hands‑on experience with manufacturing test software: + Languages/Frameworks: **C\#/.NET**, **Python**, **C/C\+\+**, **LabVIEW**, **NI TestStand** (or equivalent), shell/Powershell scripting. + Hardware/Interfaces: DAQ, PXI/VXI, SCPI instruments, GPIB/USB/Ethernet, SPI/I²C/UART, CAN, RS‑422/485\. + OS/Platforms: Windows and/or Linux; experience with **RTOS** (VxWorks, FreeRTOS) or bare‑metal drivers is a plus. * Familiarity with Agile workflows, **CI/CD pipelines**, static code analysis, automated testing, and **software observability** (logging/metrics). * Knowledge of **signal processing**, guidance \& control, or hardware‑in‑the‑loop test techniques. * Experience configuring and deploying embedded OSs and integrating with production testers. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $132962 \- $226035 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

library, and compliance calendar. * Direct attestation and certification programs such as SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and ISO/IEC 42001, and own audit compliance posture. * Govern third\-party and vendor risk, from due diligence and contract terms through ongoing monitoring. * Act as the primary point of accountability to Internal Audit, external auditors, and regulators for information security and IT compliance. **Security architecture and operations** * Direct security for the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, Defender XDR, Purview data protection and DLP, and Sentinel. * Direct security for the AWS environment, including multi\-account governance (Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs), IAM and least privilege, network security, encryption and key management, logging and detection (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub), and cloud security posture management. * Direct security for the broader SaaS discovery, and secure SaaS\-to\-SaaS integrations. * Advance a Zero Trust architecture across identity, endpoints, networks, data, applications, and cloud workloads. * Oversee security operations, threat detection, vulnerability management, and penetration testing. * Lead incident response and crisis management, including tabletop exercises, leadership and client communications, regulatory notifications, and coordination with Legal, insurers, and law enforcement. * Embed secure\-by\-design practices into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines in partnership with engineering and product leaders. * Align business continuity and disaster recovery programs with IT and business leaders. **AI governance and security** * Establish and co\-lead the company's AI governance program with Legal, Privacy, Data, and Engineering, covering acceptable use, AI risk assessments, an approved tool and model inventory, and AI vendor oversight. * Secure enterprise and client\-facing AI, including Microsoft 365 Copilot data governance, Amazon Bedrock and other AWS AI services, and defenses against prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and shadow AI. **Client trust and culture** * Represent BI WORLDWIDE in client security and compliance reviews, RFPs, contract negotiations, and leadership briefings, and position security as a competitive differentiator. * Build a culture of security and compliance through engaging training, phishing simulations, and clear, approachable communicat record of building or maturing an enterprise security and compliance program, with measurable gains in risk posture and program maturity. * A track record of achieving and sustaining SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, ISO/IEC 42001, or comparable attestations and certifications. * Experience presenting to executives, customers, and audit and risk committees and translating technical risk into business impact. * Experience managing a security and compliance budget, a multidisciplinary team, and strategic MSSP/MDR partners. **Deep technical foundation** * Current, hands\-on depth securing Microsoft 365: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, Defender XDR, Purview, and Sentinel. * Current, hands\-on depth securing AWS at scale: multi\-account architecture, IAM, network controls, encryption/KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and infrastructure\-as\-code guardrails. * Experience securing enterprise AI, including Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness (permissions, sensitivity labels, DLP), AWS AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, and the AI threats that the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS describe. * Strong command of identity and access management, Zero Trust, endpoint and network security, data protection, application security, and detection and response. * Experience leading incidents from detection through recovery, regulatory notification, and post\-incident review. **Governance, risk, and compliance** * Deep knowledge of NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and SOC 1 and SOC 2\. * Working knowledge of global privacy regulation, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and U.S. state privacy laws, and experience partnering with Legal and Privacy on compliance. * Experience building an AI governance program, with knowledge of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, and U.S. state AI laws. * Experience implementing a GRC platform and continuous control monitoring. * Experience leading external audits and client security assessments, including client questions about how the company uses AI with their data. **Leadership presence and communication** * Credibility with the executives, leadership, employees at every level, and customers. * The ability to distill complex security and regulatory topics into clear decisions for technical and non\-technical audiences. * A business\-enabling mindset that finds the secure, compliant path to yes. * Experience representing security and compliance directly to clients in sales cycles, contract negotiations, and leadership briefings. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, or a related field, or equivalent experience. A master's degree (MS, MBA) is a plus. **Preferred Experience** Experience in one or more of the following areas strengthens a candidacy: Security and audit certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, AWS Certified Security * \- Specialty, or Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\). * Privacy and AI governance credentials such as CIPP/US, CIPM, or the IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP). * Security and compliance leadership in a client\-services, marketing, incentives, or SaaS company that handles client and consumer data. * Securing multi\-tenant, client\-facing platforms and payment\-related workflows. * Service on an enterprise AI or risk steering committee. * DevSecOps, CI/CD pipeline security, and container and Kubernetes security. * Data and analytics platform security, such as Databricks. * Cyber insurance, regulatory reporting, and crisis communications. jobs.title: AI Deployment Lead, Financial Services
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. **About Brain Co.** =================== Brain Co. builds AI\-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. **Why Now** =========== Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. **About the role** ================== Brain Co. builds applied AI products for enterprises. We’re building our AI Deployment team in San Francisco, with a focus on financial\-services clients across the U.S. You’ll work at the intersection of AI product delivery and client engagement, helping define, shape, and deliver solutions for asset managers, investors, lenders and other financial institutions. You’ll own the end\-to\-end delivery of your engagements: leading the team, building client relationships, and turning deployed AI into adopted, durable workflows. You’ll be accountable for program execution and measurable customer value, and help grow each account by earning trust and identifying the next valuable problem to solve. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and senior client stakeholders to translate complex business needs into working products. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you’ll stay close to users, make scope decisions, and use AI tools and prototypes to move the work forward. **Core responsibilities** ========================= * **Lead end\-to\-end delivery:** coordinate the cross\-functional team from discovery through production and sustained use. Set priorities, run delivery cycles, manage dependencies and risks, and keep the client and team aligned on commitments. * **Define what to build:** work with practitioners and sponsors to understand the workflow, prioritize valuable problems, and translate requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Decide what to build, defer, or stop. * **Drive adoption and change:** build relationships with users, win over skeptical stakeholders, and lead the people\-and\-process changes required for new ways of working to take hold. Use direct feedback to improve the product and verify sustained use. * **Deliver measurable value:** agree outcomes and a baseline with the client. Track whether the deployment improves the work, surface risks early, and address quality or adoption problems after launch. * **Grow the account:** own the day\-to\-day client relationship, communicate with senior sponsors, and connect delivered results to new opportunities. Partner with commercial colleagues on expansion proposals and commitments. * **Improve the next deployment:** build or adapt prototypes, test consequential AI output, and work with engineers on technical trade\-offs. Partner with product managers to turn recurring customer needs into reusable capabilities and implementation practices. **What you’ll bring** ===================== * **Delivery ownership:** a track record of owning complex enterprise programs through production and adoption, with clear examples of your own decisions and results. * **Team and client leadership:** experience leading cross\-functional teams, coordinating multiple workstreams, and building trusted relationships with senior clients and the people doing the work. * **Hands\-on AI fluency:** you use AI in your work, understand its limitations, and can discuss data flows, evaluation, human review, and technical trade\-offs with engineers. * **Product and commercial judgment:** you can turn an ambiguous problem into a useful first release, make scope trade\-offs, and connect delivery to customer value and account growth. * **Change management:** experience driving behavioral and process change in large organizations, aligning competing incentives, and earning adoption without direct authority. * **Communication and initiative:** clear written and verbal communication, a willingness to learn an unfamiliar domain, and the drive to resolve gaps yourself. Financial\-services experience is a strong plus. We also welcome commercially minded operators from consulting, enterprise software, and other complex industries who can show how they learned a domain and delivered lasting results. **Location and travel** ======================= This role is based in San Francisco. Regular travel to customer sites is expected, particularly during discovery, launch, and adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. Beacon Biosignals is seeking a fully remote Senior Software Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners. This role emphasizes the design and scaling of backend systems for data infrastructure: PostgreSQL data models, Kafka\-driven event pipelines, and a GraphQL API that enables scientific and clinical data use \- distinct from frontend development or end\-user product surfaces. You will lead the design and integration of new services and components for data and event processing, own the pipelines that deliver dataset snapshots into our warehouse, and collaborate with platform and application teams to implement APIs that unlock new workflows in Beacon's expanding portfolio of clinical studies and digital health products. You should expect to write SQL by hand, and to reason about schema design, indexes, and query behavior as a matter of course. This role is 100% remote working anywhere in the US. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York, and Paris. **What success looks like** * You partner with product managers, scientific and clinical stakeholders, internal stakeholders, and other development and support teams to translate their requirements into new integrations, services, and solutions for scaling Beacon's data platform * You implement features with attention to detail, demonstrating product awareness and high standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability across the lifespan of the system * You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input, and helping your team align on a set of decisions to guide development * You hold a high bar for correctness when data moves between systems: completeness, idempotency, and predictable behavior under partial failure * You leverage feedback from internal stakeholders and external partners to improve operational robustness and ease of use of the Datastore and its services via new documentation, tools, and dashboards **What you will bring** * 5\+ years of backend development experience, including at least 2 years focused on data platforms and backend infrastructure for data\-centric applications \- transactional systems, event pipelines, and the APIs that serve them * Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL as an application database; you write and tune queries by hand and are comfortable reasoning about schema design, indexes, and query plans * Hands\-on experience with data streaming and event processing, using Kafka (our event bus) or an equivalent such as RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud\-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis * Proficiency in Julia or Python + Experience with Julia is a strong plus, but not required \- we welcome candidates eager to learn it! * Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm * Experience with GraphQL and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js); GraphQL is the Datastore's primary interface * A collaborative mindset \- you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote\-friendly environments * A self\-directed approach, with a track record of thriving in hybrid or fully remote teams We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we'd love to hear from you! The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000\. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location.The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (AI Products)
jobs.description: **About BizzyCar** BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines. We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. BizzyCar is a fast\-paced, results\-driven company with an experienced leadership team skilled in building high\-value businesses. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture. **About the role** As BizzyCar’s founding Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE), you will help our customers implement, adopt, and maximize our most cutting edge solutions. We're hiring a curious professional to own product launches on the ground: configuring the product to each dealership's systems and operations, training their staff, and being the calm, credible presence in the building when a brand\-new AI product starts automating processes at the dealership. In this role, you will be assigned to and become a subject matter expert on a specific product being rolled out to dealerships. Your training will make you comfortable with the automotive retail industry, customer processes, BizzyCar, frontier AI technology, application layer AI technology. You will be expected to use your knowledge and skills to make your implemented solutions maximally impactful to our customers and achieve loyalty from customers through delight. This is a net\-new, customer\-facing field role which is slated to expand and re\-invent how BizzyCar goes to market which means you will have a hand in shaping the playbook everyone after you follows. **(\*Please Note: This role is Hybrid requiring being in office a few days a month as well as 50\-70% travel to client dealerships.)** **What you'll do*** Own dealer implementations end\-to\-end — from kickoff through go\-live and early hypercare * Configure solutions to each rooftop: translate a dealer's actual service\-drive workflow and tech stack into product configuration through structured discovery and engineering team collaboration * Validate that customer, availability, recall, and RO data flow correctly across systems before go\-live * Train non\-technical dealership staff to full adoption, and manage the change along the way * Run the implementation like a project — own the timeline, the stakeholders, and the go\-live date * Troubleshoot live: reproduce issues, read logs, tell a configuration problem from a product bug, and write clean repro steps * Know what to fix yourself versus what to escalate, and package escalations cleanly for engineering * Write the runbooks and SOPs that let this be repeatable — for the next dealer, and for the support team that eventually takes over steady\-state * Be the feedback loop — route what you learn on\-site back to product, reliably and specifically **What You'll Need****Required*** **Hands\-on integration \& configuration experience** — you've wired a product to external systems via APIs, webhooks, or config tools and validated it end\-to\-end * Troubleshooting \& log diagnosis — comfortable reproducing issues, reading logs, and isolating a config problem from a product bug * Experience delivering customer training or enablement, ideally to non\-technical audiences * Implementation or deployment project management — you've run a kickoff\-to\-go\-live timeline and owned the stakeholders in it * Comfort validating and verifying data across systems (e.g., confirming records, statuses, or availability sync correctly) **Preferred** * Discovery and workflow\-mapping experience — translating a customer's process into product configuration * Issue triage and escalation experience in a customer\-facing technical role * Light scripting or SQL — enough to query data or script a quick validation (a plus, not a requirement) * Experience writing runbooks, SOPs, or setup documentation for handoff to a support team **Helpful Background** *You don't need deep expertise in all of these on day one, but familiarity with several will help you ramp fast:* * SaaS implementation and deployment methodology — onboarding lifecycle, go\-live, hypercare * APIs and integration patterns — REST, webhooks, authentication, and how systems talk to each other * Automotive retail or fixed\-ops experience — the service drive, repair orders, recalls, and the dealership's daily rhythm * The DMS and scheduling ecosystem — e.g., CDK, Reynolds, Tekion, Xtime, myKaarma * Data structure and validation concepts * Support and escalation processes — tiers, SLAs, and clean handoffs * Change management or adoption principles * Security and compliance basics — PII handling, call\-recording consent **Who You Are*** **Ownership** — you see things through to go\-live, not just to the end of your task list * Bias to action and resourcefulness — you unblock yourself on\-site instead of waiting on someone else * Learning agility — you can ramp fast on a product that's still being built and changing under you * Adaptability — you're comfortable with ambiguity; this is an early product, there's no playbook yet, and things will break * Structured and detail\-oriented — implementations are checklists, and a missed step can cause a go\-live to fail * A calm troubleshooting temperament — you can debug live in front of a customer without losing the room * Empathetic change management — you can move skeptical service staff toward trusting an AI to take their calls * Feedback\-loop discipline — you reliably route what you learn in the field back to product * Low\-ego collaboration — you work easily across engineering, support, GTM, and our partner team **Benefits*** **Competitive base salary** $80,000\-$110,000 plus commission renewals and expansion revenue (OTE $150,000\) * **Comprehensive health benefits** — medical, dental, and vision coverage * **401(k) plan** and equity * **Paid time off**, including vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays * **Career growth opportunities** within a growing Sales and Customer Success organization * **Ongoing training and development**, including access to sales enablement tools and enterprise account strategy resources * **Supportive, collaborative team culture** with cross\-functional partnerships *BizzyCar, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits.* *At this time, the company does not provide sponsorship for U.S. visas or immigration benefits, and does not provide financial, legal, or administrative support for employment\-based U.S. immigration benefits. In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, all employees must complete Form I\-9 and present unexpired documents showing they are legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States.*

One year of experience as an active SCCM and/or Intune administrator including automating software installs \& mobile device management along with Active Directory, Azure and Microsoft 365 cloud experience. **Position Summary:** Working with members of the Endpoint team, the Endpoint Systems Engineer will assist in the configuration, maintenance, application packaging and management of enterprise devices via Microsoft Intune, following industry best practices. Helps in the daily management, imaging and builds of endpoint systems working from a ticketing system. This position will support endpoint strategies ensuring alignment between enterprise architecture, security, and the company’s endpoint environment including monitoring \& patching. **Primary Job investigate and diagnose issues, calling in additional vendor support or software developers to resolve issues **Job Functions** * Assists in helping manage infrastructure major incidents related to endpoints. * Assists with design discussions within platform and cross\-functional teams. * Develops automation and efficiencies to service customers more affectively. * Trains IT staff on endpoint platforms and creates endpoint documentation/knowledge base articles for standard working task. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. BlinkRx is the world's first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can't afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn't have the medication in stock. We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us! **The Opportunity:** BlinkRx is opening its first Bay Area engineering office, and we are building the founding team now. This is not a lateral move into an established org. This is a chance to be one of the engineers who was there at the beginning, setting technical standards, shaping how AI gets embedded into an engineering culture from day one, and writing code that ships to production fast and reaches real patients immediately. We are looking for Full Stack Engineers who build with AI as a way of working, not as a feature. Engineers who experiment relentlessly, integrate it into everything they touch, and are done waiting for permission to do their best work. The founding team sets the culture and the trajectory. That opportunity does not come around often, and it is rarer still when the company is already proven at scale. **Responsibilities:** * Lead architecture and execution for complex features or systems across multiple teams or domains, with an emphasis on AI\-integrated solutions. * Design and evolve backend and frontend architecture for scalable, high\-performance systems. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and lead code reviews that raise the bar for the entire team. * Actively integrate AI tooling into your development workflow and help establish that standard across the engineering organization. * Investigate and resolve complex performance and reliability issues end\-to\-end. * Drive the release of new features with testing, documentation, and monitoring from day one. * Partner cross\-functionally with product, design, data, and operations to shape roadmaps and accelerate impact. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate with a learning mindset and a bias for action. * Communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with increasing scope and impact. * Proven experience owning significant systems or product areas from design through launch. * Strong expertise in at least one modern language such as Python, JavaScript, or Go. * Active, hands\-on use of AI tools as a core part of your engineering workflow. * Experience in distributed systems, API design, and performance optimization. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. **Why Join Us:** It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Governance & Management Platforms
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ Bloomberg runs on data. Within the Data Management \& Analytics Engineering department, the Data Services team builds platforms, services, and data products that help the firm understand, govern, protect, improve, and use data at scale. Data Services spans Data Governance Services, Data Integrity Services, Common Data Products, and Usage Data Products. The team's capabilities include data discovery, cataloging, classification, lineage, data quality, observability, reference and enrichment services, master data, common data, and usage data with cross\-cutting responsibilities across stewardship, metadata, semantics, privacy, controls, and architecture standards. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are seeking a high\-caliber Staff Software Engineer to serve as a technical lead and architect for our future\-state Data Services platform. This role requires an engineer who possesses strong core computer science fundamentals—excelling in algorithmic problem\-solving, hands\-on coding, and system design—while bringing deep domain experience in data governance and data management. In this role, you will bridge domain\-specific data management requirements (cataloging, lineage, quality, observability, control frameworks) and high\-performance software engineering patterns. You will operate with Tech Lead / Staff\-level scope: driving architecture, setting standards, building prototypes, and guiding engineering teams across the department. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Drive Technical Leadership \& Architecture:** Define future\-state architecture patterns and engineering standards for metadata capture, lineage, data quality, observability, data contracts, and semantic modeling. * **Translate Data Concepts to Scalable Code:** Transform data governance and data management capabilities into production\-ready software patterns, reusable APIs, metadata flows, and platform workflows. * **Hands\-On Development \& Prototyping:** Actively write clean, optimized code, construct prototypes, bootstrap critical modules, and validate technical implementations to de\-risk complex platform updates. * **Unify Data Services Capabilities:** Partner across Data Governance Services, Data Integrity Services, Common Data Products, and Usage Data Products to connect disparate services into a seamless, cohesive platform. * **Provide Cross\-Team Technical Enablement:** Collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, data stewards, and data engineers to reduce duplication, enforce standards, and elevate engineering quality. * **Evaluate \& Innovate:** Stay current with modern enterprise data management tooling and industry trends; evaluate build vs. buy choices and import proven patterns from mature data organizations. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * **Strong Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Deep proficiency in software architecture, and problem\-solving, with proven hands\-on coding capabilities in languages such as Python, C\+\+, Java, Scala, or Go. * **7\+ Years of Industry Experience:** Track record in software engineering, data management, data governance, metadata platforms, or enterprise data architecture. * **Data Governance \& Management Mastery:** Comprehensive understanding of core data governance concepts including data cataloging, metadata management, lineage tracking, data quality frameworks, observability, stewardship, and semantic layers. * **Platform \& System Design Expertise:** Demonstrated success architecting distributed systems, data pipelines, metadata integration workflows, and API\-driven data platforms. * **Hands\-On Experience with Data Tools:** Exposure to or experience implementing mature enterprise data platforms (e.g., DataHub, OpenMetadata, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Purview) or custom internal equivalents. * **Technical Influence \& Communication:** Proven ability to lead architectural discussions, communicate complex technical topics to diverse stakeholders, and mentor engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * **Semantic Technologies \& Knowledge Graphs:** Experience with semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, ontologies, and master/reference data management. * **AI/ML Integration:** Familiarity with AI/ML\-driven data governance automation (e.g., automated data classification, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, automated lineage inference). * **Leadership Track Record:** Background serving as a Manager, Tech Lead, Platform Architect, or Principal SME in an enterprise\-scale data ecosystem. We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia\-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. We may share your information with a third party provider of accommodations services who may use this information to reach out to you for the purposes of accommodating your application. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Bloomberg is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. jobs.title: Software Release Engineer
jobs.description: **About Blueprint** Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. **Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.** **In This Role** You will support the release management process for widely used productivity applications, with a focus on release notes, pre\-Patch Tuesday preparation, and Mac and iOS releases. You will coordinate technical documentation, track release activities, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to help ensure updates are delivered on schedule and within scope. This remote opportunity offers the chance to deepen your knowledge of enterprise software release systems while contributing to a collaborative technical team. **Responsibilities** ### **Responsibilities** * Manage release notes and technical documentation for external software releases. * Coordinate pre\-Patch Tuesday activities, including release preparation, task tracking, and readiness checks. * Support desktop and mobile application release processes, including Mac and iOS releases. * Review release requirements, enhancement requests, and technical specifications to jobs.title: Infrastructure Operations Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re looking for an experienced Infrastructure Operations Engineer to help keep CFC’s global infrastructure reliable, secure and resilient. With a particular focus on Microsoft Azure, you’ll use your infrastructure support experience to operate and improve our cloud and hybrid services across compute, storage and networking. You’ll take ownership of complex technical issues, help reduce operational risk and make sure the services our teams rely on are performing at their best. This is a hands\-on role where you’ll have the opportunity to solve challenging problems and make improvements that stick. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Technology, Information Security and engineering, bringing your expertise while continuing to build your own. At CFC, we trust people to take ownership, welcome ideas from every level and encourage people to make things better, making this a great environment for someone who enjoys combining technical depth with initiative### **About the role** * Manage and support our Microsoft Azure infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, monitoring and identity integrations. * Take ownership of infrastructure incidents, problems and service requests across cloud and hybrid environments, seeing them through to resolution. * Monitor availability, capacity, performance and security, spotting potential risks early and implementing sustainable improvements. * Deliver infrastructure changes, upgrades, patching and lifecycle activities in line with change management and operational controls. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Azure, Windows Server, storage, backup, DNS, routing, VPNs and firewalls. * Support backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements, helping ensure critical services are recoverable and regularly validated. * Partner with Technology, Information Security and engineering colleagues to automate, standardise and document secure, scalable infrastructure services. * Provide desktop support to the Austin team during planned holidays and periods of sickness. ### **About you** You’ll bring substantial hands\-on experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or infrastructure engineering within a complex organisation, alongside experience supporting business\-critical services. You’ll be confident working across Azure and hybrid environments and comfortable taking ownership when high\-impact infrastructure incidents arise. Technically, you’ll bring:* Strong Microsoft Azure knowledge across virtual machines, storage, virtual networking, monitoring and Entra ID integrations. * Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, enterprise storage and backup. * A solid grounding in networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls and routing. * Working knowledge of infrastructure security, access management, audit evidence, change control and incident management. * A disciplined approach to risk, documentation and operational controls, with the judgement to escalate when needed. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously, prioritise competing demands and communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience with **PowerShell or infrastructure automation would be a bonus**, rather than essential. ### **About CFC**

The incumbent collaborates with business and technical stakeholders to define analytical objectives, develop research frameworks, and gather, integrate, and analyze complex structured and unstructured data. High * Experience building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models in production environments, including familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management. High * Experience with cloud\-based data platforms and services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, and data engineering technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, or similar platforms preferred. High * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data visualization skills, including experience with Tableau, Power BI, or comparable tools. High * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts and analytical findings into actionable recommendations for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. High **Experience** * Minimum of five (5\) years of progressively responsible experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise data engineering and AI/ML solutions, including data pipelines, cloud\-based data platforms, predictive modeling, and production AI/ML systems. Required * Experience working in cloud environments and supporting enterprise analytics and data\-driven decision\-making Required **Education** * Required Bachelor's Degree Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related quantitative field * Preferred Master's Degree master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related field **Licenses \& Certifications** * TWIC \- Transportation Worker Identification Credential Required * Driver's License \- Valid state driver's license Required Note: This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, job requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. engineering practices including automation, observability, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and AI Operations (AIOps). **Required Experience, Education and Ski Ops practices including model jobs.title: AI Engineer - GenAI
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** We’re building a world of health around every individual, shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold us accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. We are seeking an AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy GenAI/agentic solutions that support enterprise business needs. In this hands\-on role, you will develop agentic frameworks, data pipelines, and retrieval\-augmented and agent\-based applications as part of an engineering team, working under the guidance of senior and staff engineers. You will develop well\-defined features and components from conception through production support, while growing your depth in ML engineering, cloud platforms, and responsible AI practices. Key Responsibilities: * Build GenAI and agentic AI components, including RAG pipelines, tool\-calling agents, agent memory, and multi\-agent workflows, using vector databases and graph retrieval patterns. * Develop and maintain data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and feature preparation using Python, SQL, and PySpark across BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch. * Implement computer vision solutions such as object detection and tracking using OpenCV, Roboflow, including dataset preparation and annotation workflows. * Apply statistical and unsupervised techniques to support analytics, segmentation, and causal\-impact use cases. * Build workflow automations and integrations on cloud services. * Write clean, tested, and well\-documented code; participate in code reviews and follow established CI/CD, security, and compliance standards. * Monitor model and agent performance in production, and help troubleshoot issues such as data drift, retrieval quality, latency, and failures. * Support evaluation of model and agent quality using defined metrics, test sets, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Collaborate with product owners, data engineers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into technical tasks, and communicate progress, blockers, and risks clearly. * Contribute to team knowledge\-sharing and stay current with emerging AI/ML tools and techniques, including AI\-assisted development. Position will be onsite 2 days / week in our Farmers Branch, TX or Scottsdale, AZ CVS office. **Required Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and deploying machine learning or AI applications. * 2\+ years of experience with Python, including building production\-quality code and APIs (e.g., FastAPI or Flask). * 2\+ years of experience with SQL and experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras). * 2\+ years of experience working with core AI/ML concepts, including model training, validation, evaluation metrics, and feature engineering. * 1\+ year of hands\-on experience building or contributing to GenAI solutions, including RAG and LLM integration (e.g., prompt design, tool calling, embeddings). * 1\+ year of experience with a vector database (e.g., Pinecone or Qdrant) or a comparable search/retrieval technology. * 1\+ year of experience working on a cloud platform (GCP/Azure preferred; AWS acceptable), including storage, compute, and basic IAM concepts. * 1\+ year of experience with Git and collaborative development workflows (pull requests, code reviews). * 1\+ year of experience working in an Agile team environment. * 1\+ year of experience demonstrating the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with cross\-functional partners. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with multi\-agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain) and agent memory patterns. * Experience with graph\-based retrieval (GraphRAG) or HydraDB. * Experience with workflow automation tools. * Experience with NLP techniques (text classification, entity extraction, embeddings, semantic search). * Experience with distributed data processing using PySpark and analytics on BigQuery. * Experience with Elasticsearch, MongoDB (Atlas preferred), or PostgreSQL beyond basic usage. * Experience with Docker and containerized deployments; exposure to Kubernetes (GKE) or Cloud Run. * Exposure to CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo) * Working knowledge of Java, C\+\+, or R for specific modeling, integration, or performance needs. * Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including data privacy, bias awareness, and handling of sensitive data in regulated environments. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) for code analysis, refactoring, or agentic workflows. **Education:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience (High School diploma plus 4 years of relevant work experience). * Master’s degree is strongly preferred. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $72,100\.00 \- $144,200\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. jobs.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer who brings deep proficiency across both frontend and backend technology. As a high\-agency operator who seamlessly bridges Angular micro\-frontends with Java Spring and Python microservices on GCP, you will partner with product leadership to build complete 0\-to\-1 experiences and drive end\-to\-end execution for millions of users. If you are a true jack\-of\-all\-trades who naturally operates as the ultimate escape hatch when execution speed matters most, we want to talk to you. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A True Full\-Stack Engineer:** Jack\-of\-all\-trades and master of them too. You operate comfortably across the entire technology stack—from deep backend architecture in Java Spring and Python to fluid micro\-frontends in Angular, seamlessly switching context where others see boundaries. * **Unapologetically High\-Agency:** You don't wait for rigid handoffs or endless alignment meetings. If a feature needs a new API endpoint, a microservices update on GCP, and an intuitive UI component, you take full ownership and ship it end\-to\-end. * **Obsessed with End\-to\-End Craft:** You care just as much about the micro\-interactions and responsiveness of a web application as you do about the throughput, resilience, and latency of the microservices powering it. * **The Ultimate Escape Hatch:** When time is critical and something needs to be built or shipped *right now*, you are the engineer we call. You cut through red tape, figure out a path forward, and deliver under pressure without missing a beat. * **Mission\-Driven \& Relentless:** You embrace nimble, fast\-moving environments. You seek to eliminate unnecessary friction, navigate complex systems effortlessly, and take pride in building software that directly impacts millions of people. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Staff Individual Contributor driving end\-to\-end technical execution across our consumer health products. You will be equipped with modern tools, given clear ownership, and empowered to build complete user experiences from the database layer to the frontend UI. In this role, you will: * **Build End\-to\-End Solutions:** Architect, write, and deploy complete product slices—building scalable Java Spring / Python backend services on GCP and crafting white\-labeled micro\-frontends in Angular. * **Drive Rapid POCs \& Prototyping:** Partner directly with Product Managers to take raw 0\-to\-1 ideas and rapidly transform them into polished, production\-ready experiences. * **Elevate Engineering Standards:** Raise the bar for code quality, deployment speed, and system architecture across both frontend and backend domains. * **Optimize Full\-Stack Performance:** Bridge the gap between server response times and client\-side rendering to create ultra\-fast, seamless consumer experiences for millions of users. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Experience:** 8\+ years of software engineering experience spanning both frontend and backend software development at scale. * **Backend Mastery:** Strong expertise in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and/or Python, with a track record of building resilient, high\-throughput RESTful microservices on GCP. * **Frontend Mastery:** Deep expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks (Angular preferred, but React/Vue expertise welcomed) with experience building scalable micro\-frontends or design systems. * **Full\-Stack Ownership:** Proven capability to take complete ownership of complex features, delivering both backend endpoints and UI components end\-to\-end. * **Systems \& Architecture:** Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (GCP), CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments, and micro\-frontend architectures. * **Communication:** Exceptional ability to articulate end\-to\-end architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and product requirements across both technical and non\-technical teams. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and benefits package. * **Unmatched Autonomy:** Full freedom to operate across the entire stack with minimal bureaucracy and zero context\-switching friction. * **High\-Visibility Impact:** Direct ownership over key consumer features that scale to millions of healthcare users. * **Work That Matters:** Build technology where seamless user experience and backend efficiency directly enable people to access the healthcare they need. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. As an AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize advanced AI interactions to power production\-grade software applications. You will move beyond basic prompt drafting to build robust, scalable, and reliable AI systems utilizing state\-of\-the\-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Your role is critical in orchestrating autonomous AI agents, implementing **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines, and establishing **rigorous testing and observability frameworks**. You will bridge the gap between complex business logic and machine intelligence, ensuring high\-quality, safe, and deterministic AI behaviors. **What You Will Do:** **Prompt Architecture \& Tuning** * **Design Advanced Prompts:** Architect, version, and refine highly effective system, contextual, and dynamic prompts using advanced techniques (e.g., Chain\-of\-Thought, Tree\-of\-Thoughts, ReAct, Few\-Shot learning). * **Mitigate Risks:** Minimize model hallucinations, jailbreaking, and prompt injections through programmatic guardrails and robust adversarial prompting strategies. * **Model Agnostic Tuning:** Adapt, benchmark, and fine\-tune prompt structures across diverse open\-source and proprietary frontier models. **Agentic Workflows \& RAG Systems** * **Build AI Agents:** Design and orchestrate multi\-agent systems and multi\-step reasoning workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain. * **Optimize RAG Pipelines:** Integrate and fine\-tune Retrieval\-Augmented Generation architectures, managing semantic search, chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database queries. * **Tool Execution:** Implement precise function\-calling and tool\-use prompts enabling LLMs to interact reliably with external APIs, databases, and legacy codebases. **Testing, Evaluation \& Observability** * Build automated testing suites using RAGAS and **Evals** frameworks to assess RAG accuracy and enable continuous validation and benchmarking of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation outputs across datasets and Models . * **Agent Testing:** Build automated regression testing suites and CI/CD pipelines to validate prompt stability, agent trajectory correctness, and tool\-calling accuracy. * **Implement LLM Observability:** Set up production monitoring and observability systems using platforms like Azure Application insights, Microsoft Foundry. * **Monitor Metrics:** Track, analyze, and optimize production runtime metrics including semantic drift, token usage, cost efficiencies, and end\-to\-end latency. **Collaboration \& Continuous Innovation** * **Cross\-Functional Delivery:** Work alongside Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to translate commercial requirements into deterministic AI capabilities. * **Technology Scouting:** Keep pace with rapid weekly advancements in LLM capabilities, evaluation frameworks, and orchestration libraries to sustain a competitive edge. **What You Have:** * Core Prompt Engineering: Expert\-level mastery of structured prompt formats (XML, JSON wrappers), system\-level steering, and context\-window optimization. * Production Programming: High proficiency in Python or TypeScript for constructing backend AI logic, processing asynchronous data streams, and handling API integrations. * Orchestration Frameworks: Hands\-on experience building apps using LangChain, LangGraph, native SDKs. * Vector Infrastructure: Solid experience working with vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, AWS Open Search) and hybrid search retrieval methods. * Data \& ML Fundamentals: Strong capabilities in data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), data cleaning, token handling, and foundational understanding of NLP transformers. **Top Candidates Will Have** * **AI Observability Stacks:** Prior implementation of Application Insights, OpenLLMetry, or custom evaluation/guardrail layers. * **Machine Learning Systems:** Knowledge of deep learning architectures, fine\-tuning frameworks (QLoRA, PEFT), and platforms like Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience deploying containerized AI microservices using Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP. * **Education:** Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, Mathematics, or a highly technical discipline. * **Experience:** 2\+ years of dedicated professional experience developing production software integrated with GenAI/LLM pipelines. * **Track Record:** Proven portfolio demonstrating successfully deployed RAG systems or operational AI agents in commercial environments. **Additional Info**: * The required location for this role is East Peoria\-IL, Irving\-TX **About Caterpillar –** For more than a century, Caterpillar has helped build a better, more sustainable world. jobs.description: **About Chartmetric** Chartmetric is one of the music industry’s leading data analytics platforms, trusted by more than 8,000 customers, including major labels such as Universal, Sony, Warner, and Apple Music, management firms, and music professionals around the world. You’ll have room to improve an established platform while helping the team build what comes next, and benefiting from the following and more:* Competitive salary and equity package * Stipends for health \& wellness, streaming services, live music events, and more * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Real ownership of pipelines that customers use every day * Access to cutting\-edge tools and technologies **Team Culture** We believe that great developer experiences lead to better products and happier teams.
