jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: **About Circleback** -------------------- Circleback is building the source of truth for everything said at a company–starting with best\-in\-class AI meeting notes, action items, and search. Every company runs on conversations — meetings, calls, emails — but almost none of that context is usable after the fact. We’re building the platform that captures, organizes, and acts on all of it, so teams can actually use what they know. We're a small team backed by Y Combinator. Profitable, growing virally, and thousands of paying customers including PostHog, Browserbase, Gumloop, and more. **Why join** ------------ * We ship fast with a high bar for quality. * Small team, large problem: the category we're building didn't exist a few years ago. * Profitable and growing virally through word of mouth, not paid acquisition. * Build software people actually love and use every day. * Free lunch and dinners, competitive salary and equity. * Flexible health coverage and 401K matching. **The Role** ------------ Circleback grows through the product itself. People get notes from a meeting with someone already using it, like what they see, and try it. Then it spreads inside their company. You'll be our first growth hire. You'll own growth engineering from day one, decide what we build and test, and have plenty of room to grow your scope as the company grows. You'll focus on what happens inside the product, working closely with the founders and our Founding Marketer, who owns channels and brand. You'll ship across the stack as part of a small team. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Improve every step of the product\-led loop: the notes a non\-user receives after a meeting, signup, onboarding, and activation. * Figure out why Circleback spreads to the whole team at some companies and stays with a few people at others, and build the product changes that close that gap. * Build and maintain our analytics and experimentation foundation: event instrumentation, attribution, dashboards, and A/B tests the whole team trusts. * Improve retention by learning what keeps people using Circleback long term and getting more people there. * Ship in\-product growth surfaces like upgrade flows, referral tools, and integrations. You'll work in web (React, Next.js, Prisma, SWR), desktop (Electron, Swift), and mobile (React Native). * Work with the Founding Marketer on what to test, and share what you learn. **You might be a good fit if** ------------------------------ * You've shipped production software, including growth experiments, and you've instrumented a funnel yourself (signup conversion, activation, or retention). * You're comfortable digging into data yourself, whether that's writing queries or reading a funnel, and you're as happy doing that as shipping a feature. * You care about users as much as implementation. * You have strong product judgment and care about experiments that move signup, activation, or retention. * You're low ego, direct, and comfortable operating without much process. People who've thrived here have often been former founders, early startup engineers, or engineers who've owned features end\-to\-end. You don't need that exact background. We care much more about how you think and what you've built. **Interview Process** --------------------- * Recruiter screen * Hiring manager conversation, including a walkthrough of a growth experiment you've shipped * Technical interview * Paid two\-day work trial in San Francisco Compensation Range: $150K \- $220K

using Python, FastAPI, and modern software engineering practices. * Lead the technical implementation of stateful, multi\-step agentic workflows using LangGraph and LangChain v1\. * Implement graph state management, conditional routing, checkpointing, retries, recovery, idempotency, and controlled execution. * Build enterprise RAG architectures incorporating ingestion, chunking, embeddings, Azure AI Search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, and source\-grounded generation. * Integrate Azure OpenAI, enterprise APIs, document repositories, databases, and internal systems monitoring, and production troubleshooting. * Experience building secure APIs and integrating enterprise systems. * Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, data protection, and auditability. **Preferred qualifications** * Production experience implementing MCP servers and secure enterprise tools. * Experience with Azure Container Apps and Azure Kubernetes Service. * Experience with PostgreSQL or Azure Database for PostgreSQL, persistent workflow state, and object storage. * Experience with enterprise document processing and financial data extraction. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, AI observability, latency optimization, and token\-cost management. * Banking or other regulated\-industry experience, especially credit, lending, fraud, or risk workflows. * Experience with model governance, explainability, human oversight, and responsible AI practices. jobs.title: Software Engineer, PowerClerk
jobs.description: ### **Who Are We?** Looking for a job that makes a real difference in our world today and one that you’ll be proud of when you look back in 20, 30 or 40 years? This is it. Clean Power Research® is advancing the energy transformation through cloud software that informs, streamlines and values energy\-related decisions and processes for utilities, energy professionals and consumers. We’re a growing company that counts 10 of the top 10 Fortune 500 utilities and many of the largest renewable energy companies in the U.S. as our customers. We’re focused on expanding our market reach and impact with new software technologies that help solve the energy industry’s hardest problems. At Clean Power Research, every employee has a seat at the table and an important role. ### **Why Work Here?** * Go from building solutions to being part of the solution * Join a growing team of software and energy veterans from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle, General Electric and Pacific Gas \& Electric * Bring your passion and ideas to the table * Use your creativity to solve hard problems and make tough decisions * Work in a start\-up like environment coupled with the stability and customer base of an established, profitable company * Realize work\-life balance; we like to see our families, friends and pets at night! * Join a growing company that expects you to grow with us and invests in your growth Clean Power Research offers competitive compensation and benefits to full\-time employees including medical/dental/vision, paid vacation, paid holidays, a bonus plan and 401(k) plan with matching. ### **What You’ll Be Doing as a Software Engineer** Our Engineering Team develops Software\-as\-a\-Service (Saas) solutions hosted in the cloud using sophisticated development tools and cutting\-edge cloud infrastructure. As a software engineer, you’ll be learning and contributing to the development of highly scalable, reliable, performant and secure software products. One of the interesting and fun challenge you’ll face here is: **Energy resource workflow automation** On the PowerClerk® team, you’ll work on the leading software service for utility program automation. PowerClerk powers the rollout and adoption of distributed energy resources (e.g., solar, batteries/storage and electric vehicles) at some of the largest utilities in the U.S. by digitizing utility programs through intuitive, self\-service interfaces that enable extensive process automation as well as utility back\-end system integration. You’ll be writing code used by hundreds of thousands of utility employees, utility customers and energy industry professionals that helps these energy technologies get installed and have an impact. This is a full\-stack position where you’ll design, build, and own features end\-to\-end. You’ll be using C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, JavaScript frameworks and SQL in a cloud\-hosted (AWS) environment. You’ll be part of an agile, empowered and high\-performing team. You’ll have exposure to customers and the business, and be an important participant in product, design and technology decisions. ### **Duties and Responsibilities** * Deliver high\-quality code and features with a high\-degree of ownership * Participate in writing test automation (unit tests and integration tests) and be part of a combined engineering team * Collaborate with other team members to define the product and make it great * Participate in release testing, monitoring of performance and functionality of the service in production * Effectively use modern AI\-assisted development tools to support software development activities including writing and understanding code, troubleshooting issues, developing tests, and improving developer productivity ### **Who You Are** * 1\+ years of professional software development experience * Someone who has strong aptitude for problem solving and consistently delivers high quality code * BA/BS or MS degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline * Experience in building web applications/services using C\#/ASP.NET/SQL and running in a cloud\-hosted environment is a plus * Some experience with AI\-assisted development tools and a strong interest and willingness to learn, adopt, and become proficient with AI tools as part of the software development process * Passion for renewables and for advancing the energy transition to clean energy ### **Pay Range and Benefits** * Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 annual depending on experience * Benefits: Performance\-Based Bonus, Company Equity Plan * Benefits: Paid Time Off, Sick Time, Holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision/Life and Disability Insurance, 401(k), Parental Leave, Commuter Benefits ### **How To Apply** Click the link below to submit your resume. Please include a cover letter detailing your interest in this position and the renewable energy space along with your resume. Due to the large number of applicants for our positions, we regret that we can only respond to candidates who meet our requirements. Clean Power Research is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. The company’s employment decisions are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

jobs.title: Associate AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Description: CleanSlate Technology Group (CSTG) is a modern technology consulting firm transforming how organizations use Data, AI, and Cloud Modernization to fuel innovation. As a top\-tier cloud partner, we design and deliver AI solutions and modern data platforms that unlock the power of data, accelerate transformation, and enable businesses to build what's next. We help clients accelerate their AI journey with security and governance built on a strong data foundation. With an operational mindset, we break through legacy limitations, simplify complexity, and create future\-ready technology foundations that inspire new possibilities. At CSTG, you'll be part of a team that empowers organizations to innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and compete boldly in a rapidly evolving digital world. Through our Data and AI Practice, we partner with clients to build scalable, reliable data foundations across AWS and Azure. Our focus is on modern data engineering, developing data platforms and pipelines that enable analytics, machine learning, and AI in real world production environments. We believe strong data engineering is critical to making AI useful, trustworthy, and sustainable. CSTG consultants combine proven engineering practices with a hands\-on consulting mindset, helping clients move from strategy to implementation while delivering solutions aligned to real business needs. **What does your team look like:** Our teams bring together CSTG consultants and client stakeholders to solve complex data and AI challenges. As an Associate AI/ML Engineer, you will collaborate with AI/ML, data, and application engineers, developing your primary skills in AI and machine learning while learning how data platforms and applications support reliable, production\-ready solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem\-solving, and a willingness to learn from others. **What does your role look like:** As an Associate AI/ML Engineer in CSTG’s Data and AI Practice, you will support client delivery by completing well\-defined development, testing, and documentation tasks with guidance from experienced engineers. Your work will contribute to AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent\-based use cases, that become part of client production systems. Associate AI/ML Engineers apply established techniques and learn AI and ML engineering best practices through assigned project work, code reviews, and feedback from experienced team members. You will communicate progress, ask questions, and raise blockers within the delivery team. As you build familiarity with the work, you will participate in client discussions with support from more experienced consultants. Success in this role means completing assigned work with increasing independence, incorporating feedback, documenting results, and building sound engineering habits. Your focus will be on reliable contributions to team delivery while developing experience with real\-world AI solutions. **Responsibilities:** * Development and integration: Complete assigned development tasks for client AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent\-based capabilities, using established approaches and guidance from experienced engineers. * Build and test defined components of AI workflows, services, and integrations alongside data and application platforms, following team designs and review processes. * Apply established AI techniques, patterns, and tools to solve well\-defined problems. * Testing and evaluation: Run established tests and evaluation procedures, document results and model limitations, and raise unexpected outputs or data quality concerns for review. * Participate in design discussions, reviews, and team feedback sessions. * Production delivery support: Collaborate with data and application engineers on assigned tasks that help prepare AI solutions for production, following established testing, deployment, and review procedures. * Responsible AI: Follow project guidance for data usage, bias, transparency, and privacy. Document concerns and seek guidance before using data or sharing outputs when requirements are unclear. * Code quality and documentation: Write clear, maintainable code for assigned tasks, participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and document implementation details and test results. * Continue developing skills in AI, machine learning, and production delivery practices. Requirements: * Foundational hands\-on experience building or supporting AI or machine learning solutions through professional work, internships, coursework, research, or personal projects. * Foundational Python skills, including the ability to write, read, and debug simple code for data preparation or AI and machine learning tasks; experience may come from work, coursework, or projects. * Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, or agent\-based approaches. * Foundational experience preparing or working with structured or unstructured data for AI use cases, including checking data quality; coursework and project experience are welcome. * Foundational understanding of version control and tooling such as Git * Exposure to deploying solutions across multistage environments (development, test, and production) * Familiarity with AWS, Databricks, or Azure services. * Understanding of foundational data engineering concepts, such as data pipelines and data quality. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly within a team and with client stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to LLM platforms or tools such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or similar. * Agentic tooling like AWS Quick/Claude/Copilot/OpenClaw/Dots/Grok Bot. * Exposure to Agentic development with tooling like Claude Code/Kiro/Cursor. * Exposure to MLOps practices, including model versioning or monitoring. * Experience working alongside data engineering teams on shared solutions. * AWS, Azure, or entry\-level AI/ML certifications. * Databricks or Snowflake certifications or willingness to obtain them. * Claude certifications or a willingness to obtain them.

jobs.title: Senior Smart Contract Engineer
jobs.description: **About CoinList** CoinList is building the distribution network for onchain capital markets. Through its Passage platform, CoinList provides the infrastructure that lets any wallet, app, or platform embed access to tokenized assets, from equities and funds to token sales and other real\-world assets, through a single integration. With a network of over 12M investors and more than $1\.2B in transactions, CoinList connects asset issuers with the platforms and investors who want access to them. Today, CoinList is scaling two core businesses: * Passage (B2B Infrastructure) (passage.coinlist.co): "Onchain Infrastructure for Capital Markets." Passage allows issuers to run compliant raises on our platform or embed CoinList’s deal flow into their own products via APIs and SDKs. * The Consumer Marketplace (coinlist.co): The world's leading destination to invest in token sales, pre\-IPO stocks, tokenized equities, and on\-chain funds. Through its token sale platform, CoinList has launched many of the leading crypto protocols including Solana, Near, USD.AI, and Ondo. **About This Role** We have a strong engineering team with deep expertise in infrastructure, blockchain, and specialized domains. We are looking for a smart contract engineer who can **build smart contracts** to integrate with different asset providers (Ondo, Centrifuge, etc.). Those smart contracts act as a proxy between our users and the underlying assets. They offer a common interface so we can build similar products on top of them. You'd be joining a small engineering team and directly reporting to the CTO in a greenfield\-heavy environment where your work directly affects velocity, company direction, and revenue. **What You'll Do** * **You’ll ship contracts to mainnet.** We are investing in Solidity on EVM chains. This is where most of your work will live, reviewed by external auditors, deployed, and holding user funds. We move fast while keeping the technical bar as high as possible. * **You’ll design contract systems, not just functions.** As a senior engineer, we expect you to design systems from the ground up, including boundaries, interfaces, storage layout, upgrade strategy, access control, and emergency paths. You’ll also help decide what even belongs onchain at all. * **You’ll be an owner.** As part of a small team, everyone owns meaningful work, whether it’s the contracts behind a critical token sale or leading our onchain work on a new product. * **You’ll treat security as the job.** Adversarial review of your colleagues’ contracts and of external audit findings, fuzzing and invariant tests, deployment rehearsals on testnets, and monitoring and incident response are all expected. * **You’ll rapidly grow and improve.** You’ll be working with incredibly smart engineers who love to learn and teach each other. And if you want to extend your craft to Rust and the Solana runtime, we’ll invest in that with you. **Requirements** **What We're Looking For** * You bring over 7 years of professional working experience, including at least 2 years of writing Solidity that reached production. * You know the EVM from the inside. Storage layout and packing, gas mechanics, memory versus calldata versus storage, ABI encoding, events and indexing, contract size limits, and the tradeoffs hiding inside each one. * You know the modern Solidity patterns. Proxies and upgradeability, role\-based access control, signature verification and replay protection (EIP\-712\), reentrancy and oracle or price\-manipulation defenses. * You have real tooling and testing discipline. Foundry (preferred) or Hardhat, fork tests, fuzzing and invariants, and a testing workflow you can justify from first principles rather than because it’s what the tutorial did. * You think like an attacker before you ship. You ask what a flash loan, an MEV bot, or a malicious token does to your code, and you write down what you find. * You like to ship high\-quality code. You make deadlines for yourself, and you move fast. You focus on the things that matter and push back on things that don’t. People know they can count on you to get things done. **How You Work** * You're AI\-fluent. You integrate AI tools into your daily workflow naturally (not for token\-burning, just for moving faster). * You're product\-minded. You care about what you're building and why, not just how. * You're independent but collaborative. You can move fast on your own and know when to loop others in. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need perfect requirements to start building. * You have strong written communication, which is especially important in a distributed, remote\-first team. **Other Preferred Qualifications** * Rust and Anchor, or Solana programs in production: SPL tokens, program\-derived addresses, token extensions, compute\-unit optimization. * DeFi protocol depth: lending, AMMs, vaults (ERC\-4626\), staking and reward accounting. * Account abstraction (ERC\-4337\): smart accounts, paymasters, bundlers. **Benefits** Remote Work \& Time Zones * Fully remote, U.S. based * We're primarily based on the US East and West Coasts, but you should be comfortable overlapping some hours with non\-US time zones to work with employees abroad. Compensation \& Benefits * Base Salary: $170,000 – $190,000 (based on experience and jurisdiction) * Equity: CoinList is a high\-growth startup, and equity is a significant part of your total compensation. * Benefits: * + Medical, dental, and vision at no monthly cost (US only) + Unlimited PTO + Monthly AI tool budget At CoinList, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Research
jobs.description: **See yourself at Dataminr** As a Senior AI Engineer at Dataminr, you’ll work alongside Research Scientists and Data Scientists to train, adapt, and deploy state\-of\-the\-art LLMs and agents across Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI. You’ll tackle multimodal data, including text, images, video, audio, and sensor data, on a platform that processes billions of inputs every day, helping organizations act on critical events as they unfold. Expect plenty of room to keep growing in both AI and software engineering. This is a hybrid role with two in\-office days each week in our New York City or Arlington, VA office. **AI Innovation at Dataminr** Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold. **Regenerative AI** **:** our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real\-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here . **Agentic AI** **:** we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real\-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here **Multimodal AI:** our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here . **The opportunity** * Work with groups of Research Scientists, Engineers, and Data Scientists in the AI Platform organization and beyond, to deploy, build, adapt, optimize, and deploy LLM models in production at very large scale. * Own the technical design and implementation of robust API services, libraries, and container strategies that define and support our end\-to\-end LLMOps lifecycle. * Optimize DL/LLM training and inference performance (speed/cost) on specialized hardware. Drive the full lifecycle of complex AI problems: from initial research and literature review to hands\-on data exploration, implementation of novel, in\-house methods, and successful productization. * **What you bring** At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed. * M.S. in Computer science or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of experience as a Research or Machine Learning Engineer. * MLOps/LLMOps Experience: building, optimizing, deploying and operating Deep Learning models using PyTorch, including Transformers and LLMs, not just using APIs. * Experience working with Research Scientists, reading technical research papers, and implementing state\-of\-the\-art methods in Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Knowledge Representation and Management, Vector Databases and Generative AI. * Expertise in Python. Experience with Containers, Kubernetes, AWS, Databricks, and Agentic infra such as LangGraph, LangFuse, and vector stores * \#LI\-BM \#LI\-Hybrid **About Dataminr** At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real\-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI\-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two\-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150\+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts. Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real\-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe. As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefits **here** . We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more. Then let's talk. **Job Description:** **Why Engineering at Datasite** Datasite's engineering organization builds the software the world's dealmakers depend on to find, evaluate, negotiate, and close transactions: secure virtual data rooms and AI\-assisted diligence, AI\-native deal sourcing and relationship intelligence, and private\-company search and market data. ownership of what ships. **Locatio**n: We are hiring in **New York City** and **Minneapolis.** Datasite is a hybrid company, with in\-office collaboration on **Mondays, Tuesdays,** and **Thursdays.** time. * Set the architecture for scalable APIs, services, data platforms, and event\-driven systems across team boundaries, and lead the most complex performance, scalability, and reliability work. * and communicate high\-leverage technical decisions with organization\-wide impact across architecture, security, performance, cost, and scalability — anticipating risk and designing safeguards before they become incidents. * Partner with Product, Design, Machine Learning, Client Success, and engineering leadership to shape strategy, translate ambiguous business goals into multi\-quarter technical plans, and align teams on execution. * Define how the organization adopts AI\-assisted and agentic development \- setting guardrails for verification, security, and human ownership of production decisions \- and measure the leverage they actually create. * Mentor and grow senior engineers, influence technical direction across the organization, lead architecture reviews, and stay hands\-on in the highest\-impact work. **What You Bring** * Seasoned software engineer with experience building, scaling, and operating production systems, and a track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams. * Deep expertise in backend, platform, distributed systems, or full\-stack product engineering, with a demonstrated ability to design systems that scale with product and organizational growth. * Expert programming ability in Python, Java, TypeScript, Kotlin, or a comparable modern language, with the ability to work effectively in Python\-based systems and set language and framework direction for teams. * Extensive experience architecting and operating production APIs, services, data platforms, distributed workflows, and event\-driven architectures at enterprise scale, including leading responses to complex incidents. * Deep fluency with AI\-assisted development tools and agentic coding workflows, with experience defining how teams adopt them safely and effectively. * Excellent product sense and technical judgment, with a track record of shaping technical strategy, influencing product roadmaps, and defending decisions under scrutiny from senior stakeholders. * Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders, write clear technical strategy documents, and align teams on decisions and trade\-offs. **Nice to Have** * Experience with M\&A, virtual data rooms, private\-market intelligence, financial services, enterprise SaaS, regulated data environments, legal technology, or other jobs.title: Data Engineer - Philadelphia
jobs.description: The Data Engineer will join the Enterprise Data \& Analytics team to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and integrations that support reporting, analytics, and business operations. Alongside hands\-on engineering, this role will help strengthen the firm’s data management and governance practices through improved data quality, clear documentation, and consistent standards. Working with colleagues across IT and business teams, you’ll translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and help ensure data is accurate, accessible, and well\-managed. You’ll support the existing data environment while contributing to efforts to modernize integrations, evaluate new technologies, and improve how data is delivered across the firm. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and integrations using SQL, SSIS, Python, and Boomi as appropriate, connecting databases, applications, APIs, and file\-based sources. * Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and warehouse data structures to deliver consistent, well\-documented datasets for reporting and analytics. * Develop and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to deploy, schedule, and monitor Python\-based data processes and automation. * Build and maintain a reusable data quality framework, including data profiling, automated validation rules, reconciliation, monitoring, alerts, and quality metrics. * Partner with business data owners and stewards to define quality rules and thresholds, investigate root causes, and track data issues through remediation. * Support data governance initiatives by documenting metadata, lineage, source\-to\-target mappings, and critical data elements, and implementing standards and controls agreed with business owners. * Contribute to the SSIS\-to\-Boomi migration, including inventorying existing processes and dependencies, documenting transformation logic, rebuilding integrations, testing and reconciling results, and supporting production cutover. * Monitor and troubleshoot production pipelines, improving performance and reliability through logging, error handling, alerting, and recovery procedures. * Support data platform evaluation and potential migration activities, including assessing existing workloads, adapting pipelines, validating data, and maintaining continuity for downstream users. * Maintain technical documentation, testing procedures, and operational runbooks; communicate progress, dependencies, and issues clearly to technical and business stakeholders. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Strong proficiency in SQL and SQL Server, including complex joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization. * Hands\-on experience developing and supporting production SSIS packages, ETL processes, and data integrations. * Practical experience implementing data profiling, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and issue resolution * Understanding of data management and governance concepts, including metadata, lineage, data ownership, stewardship, and critical data elements. * Hands\-on Boomi integration development experience is preferred; experience migrating SSIS or other legacy integration processes to Boomi is a plus. * Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake experience is a plus, including familiarity with data ingestion, pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse workloads, and notebooks. * Working knowledge of Python for data processing, validation, and automation. * Familiarity with API and file\-based integrations, version control, testing, and controlled deployment practices; experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and releases is preferred. * Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to data accuracy, production reliability, and documentation. * Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, learn new technologies, and explain technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). * 3–5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data integration, or data management roles. * Experience supporting integration modernization or data platform migrations is a plus. * Understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas. * Experience in a law firm, professional services organization, or with financial systems is a plus.

jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience in product management or a related role. * Experience as a Product Manager managing 0\-to\-1 recommendation systems, ML personalization platforms, or feed/discovery ranking products. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Deep technical fluency with modern ML architectures, feature store infrastructure, offline/online training workflows, and low\-latency real\-time serving constraints. * Exceptional cross\-functional leadership skills across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Legal/Privacy, and partner product organizations. * Proven track record driving core growth and engagement metrics (DAU, CTR, session quality) through rigorous A/B experimentation and causal modeling. **About the job** ----------------- As the Product Manager for Gemini Relevance Platform, you will define and execute the product strategy for the machine learning engine powering discovery, personalization, and proactive engagement across the Gemini App. You will lead a high\-caliber team of ML engineers and data scientists tasked with turning Gemini into an indispensable daily habit for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of applied machine learning, systems architecture, and core product UX. You will own the roadmap transitioning Gemini from heuristic, random zero\-state discovery into deeply personalized, intent\-aware experiences across both in\-app entry points and proactive out\-of\-app notifications. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $240000 \- $333000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define the multi\-quarter strategy and roadmap to evolve Gemini’s recommendation engine from rules\-based ranking into sophisticated deep ranking and retrieval models. * Lead product development for zero\-state prompt discovery, contextual suggestions, session resume modules ("Pick Up Where You Left Off"), and proactive daily routines. * Partner with Growth and Notification Platform teams to build ML\-driven targeting, personalized delivery windows, and lifecycle campaigns that drive incremental daily active users (DAU). * Collaborate with cross\-Google teams (Search, YouTube, Workspace) to safely and privacy\-compliantly leverage rich ecosystem signals, knowledge graph entities, and semantic embeddings. * Establish the metrics hierarchy balancing short\-term click engagement (CTR) with downstream conversation depth, response quality, and long\-term user persistence. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Turn ideas into physical products across code, circuits, and mechanical design.** =================================================================================== **About Us** ------------ We are a product design company with a small team, focused on transit systems and cities. Our flagship product, Metroboard, is a walnut and aluminum art piece that shows live train movement through the city. We are especially rooted in New York, where most of our community and customers are, but the work is about cities broadly. We focus on form through function and the curiosity, recognition, and wonder of seeing something familiar reframed. We are in an early scaling phase with strong traction in New York and growing presence in other major cities, looking to build durable cultural and commercial systems around the brand, partnerships, and community. **Role overview** ----------------- This is a multidisciplinary product engineering role spanning electrical, software, firmware, and mechanical design. You will turn product ideas into finished objects, moving between disciplines as the work requires. You might design a circuit, write firmware, build a software tool, or work through how an assembly fits together and gets manufactured. The product is the focus, rather than any one engineering discipline. This role is ideal for someone who loves making things and wants to own them end to end. You do not need to be an expert in everything, but you should be able to learn whatever a product needs and take ownership of how the whole thing works, from first prototype to production. This is a self\-directed, high\-ownership role. You will define the questions, decide what needs to be learned, and move projects forward without waiting for every step to be laid out. You will work closely with the engineering team to decide what to build next and how to build it. **What you will do** -------------------- * You will lead products from early research and prototypes through to production. * You will work across electronics, firmware, software, and mechanical design, following the needs of the product rather than staying inside a fixed discipline. * You will design and test circuits, write code, and develop physical parts and assemblies. * You will connect the pieces into complete products and make sure they work reliably together. * You will work with manufacturers and suppliers to get products made well and at scale. * You will improve our existing products, including Metroboard, through testing, debugging, and iteration. * You will investigate unfamiliar tools, materials, and technical approaches, building the knowledge needed to make decisions and keep moving. * You will document decisions, experiments, and technical knowledge so they are useful to the whole team. * You will contribute to the product design of upcoming products, balancing function, form, and how something is made. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * Experience taking products from idea to working hardware, through professional work or substantial personal projects. * Comfort moving between code, electronics, and physical design. * Familiarity with designing for manufacturing, or a strong desire to learn it. * Strong curiosity across engineering disciplines and a desire to understand how things work. * Ability to work independently, ask good questions, and create structure without needing every step defined. * Strong initiative and willingness to own a problem from the first question through production. * Sensitivity to how technical decisions affect the form and experience of a product. * Interest in objects, cities, infrastructure, and physical design. * Ability to move quickly, experiment, and learn from things that do not work. **Application instructions** ---------------------------- No need for a formal cover letter! Instead, please include: * A portfolio or examples of things you have built (code, circuits, CAD, prototypes, shipped products, anything relevant) * A short note on a project you took ownership of, what you had to learn, and how you worked through it. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We've got the basics and then some! * Fully covered Gold\-tier health, vision, and dental insurance (PPO). * Monthly MTA transit subsidy (we cover your subway fare!) * Paid domestic and international work travel * Flexible work structure \& unlimited PTO Compensation Range: $80K \- $120K

jobs.title: Sr Director - AI Engineering, Discovery and Co-Design
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** At Dexcom, we are reimagining how innovation happens across engineering, science, and product development through the power of Artificial Intelligence. The AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design team is responsible for building the platforms, tools, and capabilities that accelerate knowledge discovery, engineering excellence, scientific investigation, and cross\-functional collaboration throughout our R\&D organization. As the Sr. Director, AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design, you will define and execute the vision for AI\-enabled innovation across engineering and scientific disciplines. You will build and scale a world\-class team focused on creating reusable AI capabilities that help engineers and scientists solve complex problems faster, make better decisions, and unlock new opportunities for innovation. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of how Dexcom discovers, designs, and develops life\-changing technologies. **Where you come in:** * You define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and vision for AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design capabilities across Dexcom's R\&D organization. * You lead the development of AI\-powered platforms, engineering workflows, knowledge systems, and scientific reasoning capabilities that accelerate innovation and engineering effectiveness. * You establish scalable co\-design environments that enable collaboration across sensor, hardware, firmware, algorithm, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering teams. * You partner with Engineering, Research, Systems Engineering, Product Development, Data \& Analytics, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, IT, and Executive Leadership teams to identify and deliver high\-impact AI solutions. * You evaluate emerging technologies and drive build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner decisions that maximize business value and competitive advantage. * You build, lead, and develop a high\-performing organization of AI engineers, research engineers, architects, scientists, and technical leaders. * You establish strategic relationships with universities, research institutions, and technology communities to strengthen innovation pipelines and attract exceptional talent. You foster a culture of experimentation, technical excellence, continuous learning, and responsible innovation while delivering measurable business outcomes. * **What makes you successful:** * You bring deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, scientific computing, engineering platforms, or related technology domains. * You have a proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing technical organizations and developing future leaders. * You demonstrate success translating emerging technologies into practical, enterprise\-scale capabilities that generate measurable business impact. * You have strong experience evaluating technology investments and making strategic decisions related to internal development, commercial solutions, and external partnerships. * You excel at influencing executive stakeholders and driving organizational transformation through vision, data, and execution excellence. * You possess outstanding communication and collaboration skills and can effectively convey complex technical concepts to technical, scientific, business, and executive audiences. * You have experience recruiting and retaining exceptional talent from industry, startups, research institutions, and academic environments. * You have experience building AI\-enabled environments that support engineering innovation, scientific discovery, simulation, optimization, knowledge management, or collaborative design workflows. * You maintain credibility as a hands\-on technology leader with a passion for innovation and continuous advancement of AI capabilities. Your experience establishing external partnerships, participating in industry communities, and contributing to thought leadership is highly valued. * **What you’ll get:** · A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . · A full and comprehensive benefits program. · Growth opportunities on a global scale. · Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. · An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. **Travel Required:** 5\-15% * **Experience and Education Requirements:** * Typically requires a Bachelors degree in a technical discipline with 17\+ years of industry experience. 13\+ years of years of successful leadership experience in relevant industry. * **Remote Workplace:** Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). *If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Didero, we’re building the autonomous supply chain, starting with agentic supplier management. Global trade has never been more complex or more critical. Teams are underwater, reacting to a flood of challenges — from geopolitical risk to tariffs. Didero helps by automating time\-intensive workflows with AI agents, deploying cutting\-edge technology into one of the world’s most vital domains. We’re backed by some of the world’s best venture funds and leading figures across AI, supply chain, and enterprise software. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for a technically strong, customer\-facing engineer who can understand complex customer operations, question requirements, design scalable solutions, and build the systems needed to deploy Didero successfully. You will work directly with customers to understand their end\-to\-end procurement and operations workflows including ERP integrations, data pipelines, workflow automation, supplier communication flows, reporting, and custom deployment needs. You will translate messy real\-world processes into reliable, maintainable technical systems. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will build backend systems, integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and workflow automations using the best technical approach for the problem. While our core platform is built with Django, we care more about solving customer problems than using any single technology. You'll use the right tools and technologies for each integration or deployment. You will work with systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Business Central, Zip, and other procurement, ERP, finance, and operational platforms. You will also partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Forward Deployed teams to ensure customer deployments are scalable and aligned with our product direction. We are looking for someone who is not just an implementer. The right person is a systems thinker who asks why, challenges assumptions, pushes back on unclear requirements, and helps customers arrive at better solutions. **Please Note:** This is a hybrid role based in NYC and may involve occasional on\-site work with customers, approximately 1\-2 per month, to support discovery sessions, technical workshops, and deployment phases. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Work directly with customers to understand their procurement, finance, ERP, and operational workflows. * Question and clarify customer requirements, identifying the underlying business need rather than blindly implementing requests. * Design and build integrations with ERP, procurement, finance, and operational systems. * Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, workflow automations, and customer\-specific technical solutions. * Translate ambiguous customer processes into structured, scalable system designs. * Partner with Product and Engineering to identify repeatable patterns that should become part of the core platform. * Debug complex integration issues across customer systems, third\-party APIs, data models, and internal services. * Support customer discovery, deployment planning, and technical implementation. * Help define best practices for forward\-deployed engineering, customer pipelines, and integration architecture. **You’ll be successful in this role if you…** --------------------------------------------- * Thrive in ambiguity and make steady progress without perfectly defined requirements. * Think in systems, connecting customer workflows, data, and software into scalable solutions. * Partner directly with customers to uncover root problems rather than simply implementing requests. * Challenge assumptions and refine requirements before writing code. * Exercise strong engineering judgment, knowing when to build custom solutions, create reusable abstractions, or push back. * Balance customer\-specific needs with long\-term product thinking by identifying repeatable patterns. * Debug complex integration and distributed systems problems methodically. * Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong backend expertise. * Strong experience building backend services using Python and/or Django (or comparable backend technologies). * Experience designing and building integrations with external systems, APIs, enterprise software, or data pipelines. * Experience working directly with customers or cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, API design, debugging, and systems architecture. * Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills. **Bonus Points For:** --------------------- * Experience working in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Implementation Engineering. * Prior experience integrating multiple ERP systems. * Familiarity with SAP OData services, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteScript, Microsoft Business Central APIs. * Experience with async processing (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ) for large data sync jobs. * Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP). * Knowledge of financial/accounting workflows and supply chain processes. **Tech Stack** -------------- Django · Python · React · TypeScript **What we value at Didero** --------------------------- * **We go beyond OTIF.** We’re obsessed with our customers and go above and beyond to ensure we’re their top supplier. We work hard to earn and maintain their trust. * **Own it.** We own what we do. We stand behind the quality of our work and do the right thing, especially when it costs us. * **Move fast. Learn faster.** We have a strong bias to action and shorten the cycle by following our curiosity to improve as we go. * **Be relentless.** When one route closes, we find another. * **Disagree, then commit.** This is an open contest of ideas. We’re direct, but with respect. We’re decisive, and everyone commits because we win together. **What We Offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and equity * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody * Unlimited PTO — we trust you to take the time you need * Monthly wellness stipend via ClassPass * Tech equipment for your setup * Catered lunches (for those in the office) Compensation Range: $180K \- $300K

jobs.title: Principal Structures Engineer
jobs.description: Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies. Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built. **Purpose** ----------- Divergent aims to revolutionize industrial manufacturing in the aerospace and defense industries through our DAPS (Divergent Adaptive Production System) technology. Our patented production system incorporates Nodes™ – 3D\-printed metal connectors – with lightweight materials to create strong and efficient complex structures. Divergent's technology eliminates tooling and drives radical innovation, capital reduction, and sustainability in vehicle manufacturing. Divergent is seeking a skilled and motivated engineer to support the next generation of industry\-leading aerospace vehicle development. We're committed to transforming vehicles' structural systems away from traditional manufacturing by using new materials and new technologies. To do this, we need a forward\-looking and innovative engineer who will help shape the future of automotive structures. As a Principal Structures Engineer, you will lead structural engineering strategy across multiple aerospace programs, driving advanced product development, technical direction, and cross\-functional execution. Acts as a technical authority influencing engineering standards, long\-term product strategy, and customer\-facing technical decisions. **The Role** ------------ * Lead structural design and analysis activities across programs. * Develop CAD, FEA, and BOM structures for aerospace applications. * Guide structural optimization, validation, and product development activities. * Lead cross\-functional technical efforts with manufacturing, test, and design teams. * Mentor engineers and support continuous improvement initiatives. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * BS/MS in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. * 12\+ years of structural engineering experience. * Advanced CAD and FEA experience. * Strong understanding of aerospace structures, loads, and materials. * Experience leading technical programs or complex development efforts. **Work Environment** -------------------- * Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards. **Compensation** ---------------- At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E03 \- E07 as evaluated through our interview process. * Engineer / E03: $100,980 \- $138,820 * Engineer / E04: $116,600 \- $160,325 * Senior Engineer / E05: $134,640 \- $185,130 * Lead Engineer / E06: $155,540 \- 213,840 * Principal Engineer / E07: $179,630 \- 247,005 **What We Offer:** * **Holistic Compensation Package:** Enjoy a world\-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results\-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions. * **Wellness and Time Off:** Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year\-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time. * **Comprehensive Health and Wellness:** Prioritize your well\-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company\-sponsored life insurance and short and long\-term disability coverage for peace of mind. * **Investment in Growth:** We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance. * **Collaborative and High\-Performing Environment:** Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high\-performing team within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint. ***Equal Employment Opportunity*** *Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.* *EEO Poster* *In order to adjust to changes in our business, it may become necessary to add, remove or modify certain duties and responsibilities, or to reassign you to another job position. From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.* ***E\-Verify: Right to Work*** *Our company participates in* *E\-Verify**. E\-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate's eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I\-9\). jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an infrastructure engineer with broad experience across various technologies to work in a complex and growing environment with a talented Infrastructure team. The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the support and organization of the Tier 3 Service Desk queue, as well as backup subject matter support in a number of technology areas depending on experience, including telephony, physical and cloud networking, Linux/Windows engineering, AWS and Azure administration. Reporting to the Sr. Director Infrastructure, this role helps ensure that various Excelsior platforms are secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with institutional business objectives. The position provides engineering expertise, helps define and implement governance standards, supports automation initiatives, and partners with departments to modernize business processes. This role is focused on platform engineering, solution architecture, operational excellence, and user enablement within a complex enterprise environment. This position is based out of the university’s home office in Albany, NY with the option of considering remote candidates. Remote employees will have mandatory occasional travel for meetings, conferences, and professional development opportunities. Remote employees are expected to be available during work hours 8:30am – 5:00pm Eastern time. The University will supply necessary equipment to perform the essential functions of this job (e.g., laptop, docking station). Employees are responsible for having a workspace where they can participate in virtual meetings without multiple interruptions and noise. Duties and Responsibilities: * Operate and improve cloud and hybrid infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, telephony, identity, databases, backups, and monitoring. Apply sound administration practices across relevant Windows and Linux systems, virtualization platforms, and cloud services. * Provision and maintain infrastructure through repeatable automation and infrastructure as code. Develop or maintain scripts, integrations, and event\-driven workflows that reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and support safe change. * Own complex Tier 3 incidents and escalations from triage through resolution. * Analyze service desk and infrastructure trends to identify recurring incidents, emerging risks, capacity constraints, and noisy alerts. * Maintain practical runbooks, knowledge articles, diagrams, configuration records, and change documentation. Improve incident, problem, and change workflows in alignment with ITIL/ITSM practices. * Protect infrastructure through least\-privilege access, secure configuration, patching, vulnerability remediation, backup and recovery practices, and audit\-ready change records. Participate in risk reviews and continuity planning. * Partner with service desk, application, infrastructure/security, and business teams to translate operational pain points into service improvements. Explain technical issues in clear language and share knowledge that raises the effectiveness of other support tiers. Qualifications: *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered., or equivalent work experience. * 3\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud operations, or a closely related support engineering role; equivalent practical experience may substitute for a degree. * Experience with a broad range of technologies with operational responsibility in an educational or enterprise environment. Experience should include (but not limited to) the following. + Hands\-on experience administering cloud or hybrid infrastructure and troubleshooting production services across compute, network, identity, storage, telephony, and monitoring layers. + Experience handling complex escalations in a structured service desk or ITSM environment, including incident documentation, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-through on recurring problems. + Practical scripting or automation experience using a language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Go; ability to read APIs and work with version control. + Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) tools, single sign\-on, and other related technologies. + Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, DNS, TCP/IP, access control, system logs, and security practices such as least privilege and change control. + Strong written communication, sound incident judgment, and the ability to coordinate work across technical teams. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform; Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code tools; containers or Kubernetes; and CI/CD automation. * Experience with observability platforms, log search, alerting, dashboards, and service desk analytics; familiarity with reducing MTTR and alert noise. * Experience with Helix or comparable ITSM and ticketing platforms, including workflow or reporting improvements. * Exposure to virtualization, endpoint and asset management, backup/disaster recovery, network security, or regulated environments. jobs.title: Security Engineer Attack Surface Platforms (Hybrid)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== The Security Engineer – Attack Surface Platforms operates and improves the organization’s cloud native application protection platform (CNAPP) and related attack surface capabilities. The role reviews and triages findings, validates risk and ownership, coordinates remediation with cloud and application teams, and maintains the quality of the platform’s policies, integrations, workflows, and reporting. It also delivers tested, incremental enhancements that help teams identify and address cloud security exposure. This role is suited to internal candidates with a security or technology foundation and an interest in developing cloud security skills.**Essential Functions** * Monitor CNAPP queues, dashboards, alerts, and platform health. Review new and aging findings, identify duplicates or data quality issues, and route actionable items to the appropriate cloud, platform, application, or security owner. * Triage cloud misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, exposed assets, excessive permissions, and workload or container risks. Use asset context, exploitability, business criticality, and available threat information to validate severity and recommend an appropriate response. * Investigate findings by reviewing cloud configurations, resource relationships, platform evidence, and available logs or metadata. Document the technical basis, affected resources, recommended remediation, and any applicable exception or compensating control. * Coordinate remediation with engineering and service teams. Track progress against agreed service targets, follow up on overdue or recurring issues, validate fixes in the CNAPP platform, and escalate material or time\-sensitive exposure through established processes. * Administer and support CNAPP capabilities, including user and role access, cloud account and subscription onboarding, integrations, asset inventory, notification routes, policy configuration, and platform settings. * Improve platform coverage and signal quality by tuning existing policies, adjusting thresholds, testing new or changed detections, and reviewing false positives, missed coverage, and recurring finding patterns with the relevant security and engineering partners. * Build and test modest platform enhancements such as custom policies, dashboards, reports, API\-based utilities, workflow changes, or integrations. Maintain clear change notes and supporting procedures, and follow the organization’s change and release practices. * Prepare operational reporting on exposure trends, remediation status, platform coverage, finding quality, and service health. Explain notable changes and data limitations so teams can act on the results. * Contribute to security risk assessments, cloud security reviews, incident investigations, and audit evidence requests involving CNAPP data or cloud attack surface exposure. * Maintain runbooks and knowledge articles for recurring operational tasks. Share platform guidance with users and help improve support handoffs and repeatable triage practices. **Working Relationships** Partners with Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, application teams, Security Operations, Security Architecture, and other technology groups to resolve exposure and maintain effective CNAPP operations. Communicates clearly with technical and business stakeholders and works with platform vendors when troubleshooting or evaluating product capabilities. **Knowledge and Skills** * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, including its core services and terminology; experience across multiple cloud platforms is useful. * Understanding of CNAPP capabilities and related areas such as cloud security posture management (CSPM), cloud workload protection (CWPP), cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM), vulnerability management, and container security. * Ability to interpret cloud assets, identities and permissions, network exposure, vulnerabilities, and configuration findings, then explain risk and remediation steps to engineering teams. * Experience with security operations practices such as alert or finding triage, ticket ownership, prioritization, escalation, remediation tracking, and evidence\-based closure. * Ability to troubleshoot SaaS security platforms, integrations, data ingestion, policy behavior, access, and reporting issues in partnership with platform or cloud administrators. * Basic scripting or API experience in a language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support investigation, data checks, or small platform enhancements. Infrastructure as Code experience is useful but is not the primary focus of this role. * Strong written and verbal communication, attention to detail, sound judgment when handling security findings, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities. **Typical Education** Generally requires a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Typical Range of Experience** Typically requires 2–3 years of experience in information security, cloud security, security operations, cloud engineering, or a related technical role. Experience supporting a CNAPP or comparable cloud security platform is preferred. **Required Certification** Candidates must hold an introductory cloud or cloud security certification at the time of selection. Accepted certifications include AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, Google Cloud Digital Leader, or the Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK) from the Cloud Security Alliance. An equivalent foundational certification may be accepted with manager approval. Pay Range: $97,700\.00 \- $130,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== The Senior Security Engineer – Attack Surface Platforms serves as the subject matter expert for the organization’s external attack surface management (EASM) capability. This role leads platform operations, asset discovery coverage, exposure analysis, and remediation workflows for internet\-facing assets. The engineer works across security and technology teams to validate findings, direct risk reduction, improve platform quality, and develop repeatable processes and targeted enhancements.**Essential Functions** * Serve as the technical subject matter expert for our EASM platform. Administer platform configuration, access, integrations, workflows, reporting, and operational health. * Maintain reliable discovery and inventory of internet\-facing assets, including domains, IP addresses, hosts, and services.
