jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Project Manager
jobs.description: **Job Overview** ---------------- The Manufacturing Engineering Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating strategic manufacturing projects across multiple Industrial SBU facilities in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The primary focus of the position is ensuring that each facility has the manufacturing capacity, equipment, processes, and infrastructure required to deliver the annual operating plan while supporting the SBU’s longer\-term, five\-year manufacturing strategy. This position leads a portfolio of approximately five to ten active projects at any given time. Projects will typically include capital equipment and automation investments, capacity expansions, product transfers between facilities, manufacturing process improvements, facility and infrastructure projects, and support for new product development and industrialization. Individual capital projects will generally exceed $500,000, although the portfolio may also include strategically important product transfers or capacity initiatives with limited direct capital investment. The Manufacturing Engineering Project Manager leads projects from concept and business justification through design, funding approval, procurement, implementation, qualification, start\-up, and operational handoff. The role partners closely with manufacturing operations, engineering, finance, sourcing, supply chain, quality, EHS, maintenance, facilities, product management, and external suppliers. This is an individual\-contributor position with significant project and matrix leadership responsibility. The position does not have direct reports but provides direction, coordination, and accountability to cross\-functional project teams across multiple locations. **A Day In The Life** --------------------- Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by: **Capacity and Manufacturing Strategy** * Working with SBU and plant leadership to identify capacity requirements necessary to deliver the annual operating plan. * Developing and maintaining a five\-year manufacturing capacity roadmap aligned with expected demand, product strategy, manufacturing footprint, and business growth. **Project and Portfolio Leadership** * Leading a portfolio of approximately five to ten active manufacturing projects across multiple facilities. * Managing capital equipment and automation projects that will typically exceed $500,000 in total project cost. * Leading strategically important product\-transfer and capacity\-expansion projects, including projects with limited capital investment but significant operational complexity or business impact. * Establishing clear project charters that define the business need, scope, objectives, deliverables, financial justification, schedule, assumptions, risks, and required resources. **Capital and Financial Management** * Developing capital expenditure requests and AFEs for manufacturing equipment, automation, tooling, capacity expansion, and facility\-related investments. * Preparing project financial justifications, including capacity requirements, cost estimates, labor impact, productivity improvements, savings, margin contribution, payback, return on investment, and implementation costs. * Managing approved project budgets, purchase commitments, invoice approvals, cash\-flow timing, capital forecasts, and project closeout. **Equipment, Automation, and Supplier Management** * Developing equipment and process specifications based on required capacity, quality, safety, reliability, maintainability, and operating\-cost expectations. * Coordinating technical and commercial evaluations of equipment, automation, tooling, and supplier proposals. * Working with sourcing to select suppliers based on technical capability, quality, delivery performance, total installed cost, lifecycle support, and commercial value. * Leading supplier design reviews and monitoring supplier performance against agreed milestones and deliverables. **Product Transfers and Industrialization** * Leading product transfers between Industrial SBU manufacturing facilities. * Developing transfer plans that address equipment, tooling, routing, capacity, labor, training, inventory, quality, customer approvals, supplier readiness, and production cutover. **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Providing indirect leadership to engineers, technicians, plant personnel, contractors, suppliers, and other project resources. * Building alignment among manufacturing, operations, engineering, finance, sourcing, supply chain, quality, EHS, maintenance, facilities, product management, and commercial stakeholders. **Operational Readiness and Handoff** * Ensuring that safety reviews, equipment documentation, drawings, operating procedures, maintenance plans, spare\-parts requirements, training, process controls, and validation activities are completed before operational handoff. * Confirming that new capacity is operational, sustainable, and capable of supporting the required production rate. **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Industrial (required) * 10\-15 years prior experience in Manufacturing Engineering with proven leadership and management abilities (required) * Proficiency in using Solid Edge CAD software required (required) * Advanced Knowledge of business administration, project management, lean, Six Sigma, operational excellence preferred * Ability to read and interpret drawing requirements and specifications is required. * Excellent teamwork, interpersonal, and oral/written communication skills are required. * Demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple priorities simultaneously and meet critical deadlines. **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Electrical Solutions** Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. HES provides the critical components that allow operators of buildings, factories and other industrial infrastructure to connect, protect, wire and manage power. Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class. The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

jobs.description: **Design Engineer – Metal Fabrication** ======================================= **Location:** Gastonia, North Carolina **Job Type:** Full\-time **Company:** IFAB ### **About IFAB** At **IFAB**, we are a leading provider of custom metal fabrication services, dedicated to delivering precision engineering and superior manufacturing solutions. We take pride in building high\-quality, innovative metal products for diverse industrial applications. ### **Job Overview** We are seeking a skilled, detail\-oriented, and motivated **Design Engineer** to join our engineering team in **Gastonia, NC**. In this role, you will design and develop high\-performance metal components, structural assemblies, and sheet metal products tailored to customer specifications and manufacturing capacities. You will work in close collaboration with our shop floor production team to ensure every design is feasible, cost\-effective, durable, and strictly compliant with quality standards. ### **Key Responsibilities** #### **Product Design \& Development** * Design, 3D model, and prototype custom metal products using CAD software (*SolidWorks, AutoCAD*). * Develop detailed engineering drawings, complete with technical specifications, tolerances, and material requirements. * Create accurate 3D models and simulations to assess functional performance, manufacturability, and cost\-efficiency. #### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner closely with manufacturing and production teams to ensure design practicality and seamless execution on the shop floor. * Liaise directly with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to gather engineering requirements and clarify design specifications. * Provide real\-time engineering support to shop floor operators during fabrication, troubleshooting design challenges or applying required modifications. #### **Materials \& Manufacturing Process Selection** * Select and recommend optimal materials and fabrication methods (*welding, cutting, stamping, bending, CNC machining*) based on structural requirements and budget. * Collaborate with the broader engineering team to refine manufacturing workflows, minimizing unit costs while maintaining superior product quality. #### **Design Validation \& Testing** * Conduct formal design reviews, simulations, and empirical testing to validate structural integrity, performance, and functionality. * Identify and address design limitations or flaws, making adjustments to maximize ease of manufacturing and cost savings. #### **Documentation \& Technical Reporting** * Prepare, organize, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including CAD design files, engineering drawings, and revision histories. * Deliver regular progress reports and project status updates to executive leadership and project managers. #### **Continuous Improvement \& Innovation** * Identify and implement engineering enhancements to optimize production efficiency, reduce raw material scrap, and extend product lifespan. * Stay current on emerging metal fabrication technologies, tooling, and materials to integrate innovative solutions into future product designs. ### **Candidate Qualifications \& Requirements** #### **Required Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering field. * **Experience:** **3 to 5 years** of hands\-on design engineering experience within a **metal fabrication or manufacturing environment**. * **CAD Expertise:** Proven, high\-level proficiency in **SolidWorks** and **AutoCAD** (or equivalent 3D CAD platforms). * **Metal Fabrication Knowledge:** Deep understanding of sheet metal parts, stamping, machining, bending, cutting, and welding processes, as well as tooling and fixture design. * **Technical Standards:** Strong mastery of blueprint reading, interpreting technical specifications, quality standards, and **GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing)** notes. * **Product Lifecycle:** Direct experience managing the complete product design lifecycle—from initial concept through prototyping, shop floor testing, and full production. * **Engineering Principles:** Solid foundation in structural engineering concepts and manufacturing constraints. * **Soft Skills:** Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving abilities, paired with strong verbal/written communication and teamwork skills. #### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with **Finite Element Analysis (FEA)** for stress testing, load simulation, and design validation. * Familiarity with **ERP** (Enterprise Resource Planning) and **PLM** (Product Lifecycle Management) systems. * Practical working knowledge of industry welding codes and standards (*e.g., AWS, ASME*). ### **Working Conditions \& Environment** * Dynamic work environment split between office space and the manufacturing floor in Gastonia, NC. * Occasional site visits and domestic travel may be required. * Flexible working schedule based on active project deadlines and operational needs. dFQo32pj2F

You will be embedded in a cross\-functional team of analysts, product managers, and testing staff, collectively striving to quickly deliver high\-quality, high\-value software. However, your most important responsibility will be building a team that emphasizes a culture of excellence, high performance, and continuous improvement. We are looking for someone who wants to grow other people's careers, drive technical change instead of waiting for it, bring new patterns into a mature codebase, and help our engineering organization embrace AI to deliver business value. **Responsibilities** * Guide and mentor a team of software engineers. Hold regular forward\-looking, big picture conversations with direct reports to facilitate career growth, give feedback, provide professional development opportunities, and help each person align their career goals with organizational objectives. * Provide strategic leadership for a product team, fostering team morale and soft\-skills development and collecting feedback from peers. * Grow the next lead and invest in junior engineers and interns. Avoidance is not an option. * Drive the hiring and onboarding of new software engineers. * Maintain the technical competence of at least a senior software engineer, continuing to design, code, review, test, and ship. As a lead, your leverage moves from volume of code to the hardest problems and the most consequential decisions. * Drive the architecture and technical direction of your product. Follow and help shape IGS patterns and standards, keep tech debt low, and push new patterns and technology when they solve real problems. * Ensure that quality standards and project milestones are met by the engineering team. * Own your monitoring and production support. The position combines business\-facing consulting with hands\-on engineering, with a significant focus on designing, developing, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting AI solutions. The AI Engineer uses Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure, APIs, connectors, code, and other approved enterprise technologies, and treats AI solutions as production software by applying established software engineering and SDLC practices throughout their lifecycle. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Interested in being a part of a team that values growth, development, and making a positive difference. Apply today! Why Work for Inframark? Our dedication to sustainability and community impact drives us to ensure clean, safe water for future generations. Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for advancement, Inframark offers purpose\-driven work and opportunities for growth. We offer an attractive salary package, including a generous benefits package with health, dental, and life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off, sick leave, holidays, and wellness plan. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Receive project requirements and direction from HMI Application Engineering Supervisor and Project Manager (PM), including review of contract documents. * Keep PMs informed of status of tasks and project milestones; maintain awareness of project budgets and notify PMs of issues impacting budgets. * Produce timely and accurate project documentation such as timesheets and trip reports. * Follow established Best Practices and Development Standards and Procedures. * Set up project system servers, workstations, operating systems, networks, and peripheral equipment at job sites. * Develop HMI application software per contract documents and System Control Narrative using software such as System Platform w/ OMI, InTouch, Ignition, VTScada, iFix, and FactoryTalk View SE. * Install all developed application and vendor software, verifying proper execution. * Interface equipment to third\-party vendor systems via industrial communication protocols. * Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). * Demonstrate system functionality to Owner/Engineer/Contractor, including hardware/network operation, SCADA monitoring/control, alarms, and reporting. * Develop custom Operational and State Reports per Customer requirements. * Provide training to operators, supervisors, and administrative personnel. * Generate and gather all required final project documentation. * Provide technical assistance to customers. Organizational Relationships * Reports to HMI Application Engineering Supervisor or HMI Department Manager. * Receives direction from HMI Supervisor, Department Manager, and Project Managers. * Works closely with Project Team members. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering preferred. * Minimum 2 years of HMI/SCADA programming experience, preferably in Water \& Wastewater industry. * Knowledge and experience with Microsoft operating systems, networks, and HMI software (System Platform w/ OMI, InTouch, Ignition, VTScada, iFix, FactoryTalk View SE). * Strong communication and teamwork skills. Physical Demands * Ability to communicate orally with management and co\-workers. * Regular use of telephone, email, and digital tools. * Extended periods of sitting and computer work. * Adequate vision and hearing required. * Ability to lift servers, workstations, and peripherals. * Manual dexterity for setting up computer equipment and cables. Travel * Regular travel required for startup, testing, and demonstration of SCADA systems. An Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Sr. AI Software Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department, and has no direct reports. Be a part of a growing team that is directly impacting the way our business operates. In this role you embed with business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering. You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier agent systems where an orchestration layer routes to specialized agents with scoped tools, defined boundaries, and a clean handoff to a human. * Integrate with business systems through approved connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $100,200\- $140,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed; we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application. *Our office locations are designed to bring people together, foster collaboration, and build meaningful connections. While some roles are aligned to a specific office location, work arrangements and role locations may change over time to support business and team needs. Relocation assistance is not provided, whether for the initial move or for future changes in work location or role.* **Remote Eligibility:** At the time of hire, candidates for remote positions must reside in one of the following states: AL, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NJ, NV, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Data Engineer - Hybrid (Acton, MA or San Diego, CA)
jobs.description: Job Summary Are you passionate about turning data and AI into real\-world business impact? At Insulet, this is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise transformation, partnering directly with business leaders to design, build, and scale AI\-powered data solutions that drive smarter decisions, accelerate innovation, and create measurable outcomes. As a Forward Deployed Data Engineer, you will lead the delivery and adoption of cutting\-edge data and AI products across the organization. You'll bridge the gap between complex business challenges and scalable, production\-grade solutions, helping teams unlock greater speed, automation, reliability, and performance through modern data platforms and AI\-enabled capabilities. As a key member of the Enterprise AI \& Data organization, you'll combine deep technical expertise with product thinking, architectural leadership, and strong business partnership. This role is ideal for a hands\-on builder and strategic thinker who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving high\-impact problems, and can guide initiatives from concept to enterprise\-wide adoption. You will play a pivotal role in transforming ideas into measurable business value, ensuring solutions are embedded into day\-to\-day operations, supported by trusted data, reusable architecture, strong governance, and modern engineering practices. If you're energized by the opportunity to shape the future of AI and data at scale, drive visible business impact, and work alongside talented teams solving meaningful challenges, we'd love to connect with you.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; The Forward Deployed Data Engineer will lead the design, delivery, and adoption of AI\-enabled data engineering solutions across Insulet. This role will translate complex opportunities into scalable, production\-grade data products that improve decision quality, speed, automation, reliability, and enterprise performance. As part of the Enterprise AI and Data organization, this role requires deep data engineering expertise, AI\-native development practices, product thinking, platform architecture, business partnership, and delivery leadership. The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on technical leader who can operate at both strategic and engineering levels. This leader will be accountable for moving data and AI use cases from ambiguous business need to measurable impact, ensuring solutions are embedded into operational workflows and supported by trusted data, reusable architecture, strong controls, and modern platforms. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Forward Deployed Engineering and Business Partnership** * Collaborate with priority business, product, analytics, and AI teams to understand decisions, workflows, constraints, and value opportunities at the point of use. * Translate ambiguous business challenges into data product charters, architecture hypotheses, rapid experiments, MVPs, and scalable delivery plans. * Build thin vertical slices that connect source data to trusted decisions, then harden successful prototypes into secure, supportable, and reusable enterprise products. * Partner with senior business and technology leaders to define outcomes, adoption measures, value cases, roadmaps, and delivery priorities. Act as the technical bridge across data owners, model builders, application engineers, platform teams, Security, Privacy, Quality, and Compliance to remove delivery friction. * **2\. AI\-Native Data Product Development and Integration** * Design and deliver AI\-ready data foundations for predictive models, generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge systems, copilots, and autonomous or semi\-autonomous agents. * Use AI coding copilots and engineering agents to accelerate requirements discovery, data profiling, code generation, testing, documentation, lineage, migration, incident triage, and performance optimization. * Create governed agentic workflows that can discover data, propose transformations, validate quality, monitor pipelines, and recommend remediation with explicit human review and approval controls. * Engineer context layers that combine structured data, documents, metadata, semantic models, vector representations, and business rules so AI systems can reason from trusted enterprise knowledge. * Lead multidisciplinary teams through the full data product lifecycle from discovery and architecture to production deployment, adoption, observability, and continuous improvement. Ensure data products and AI\-enabled services are actionable and embedded into business applications, analytics experiences, operational processes, and decision workflows. * **3\. Modern Architecture, Trust, and Engineering Excellence** * Architect composable data products using domain\-oriented ownership, clear interfaces, reusable services, data contracts, semantic standards, and lifecycle accountability. * Design batch, streaming, event\-driven, API\-based, and change\-data\-capture patterns suited to the latency, scale, resilience, and deci systems, or a related technical field. * 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture, including leadership of complex enterprise delivery. * Demonstrated ability to design, code, test, deploy, and operate cloud\-scale data products using modern engineering practices. * Strong experience with distributed data processing, data modeling, orchestration, APIs, event streaming, DevOps, DataOps, observability, and infrastructure as code. * Practical understanding of generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, AI agents, model integration, and AI\-assisted software development. Demonstrated ability to lead data products from discovery through MVP, production deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, medical devices, life sciences, diabetes care, digital health, or regulated industries. * Experience with platforms such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, dbt, Spark, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub, or similar enterprise technology ecosystems. * Experience establishing data product operating models, data contracts, semantic layers, real\-time architectures, or self\-service engineering platforms. * Experience modernizing legacy data estates and integrating ERP, CRM, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, commercial, clinical, or connected\-device data. Familiarity with privacy, security, validation, responsible AI, auditability, and enterprise governance requirements for data and AI solutions. * NOTE: This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements (requires on\-site work from an Insulet office). \#LI\-Hybrid Additional Information: \&\#xa;\&\#xa;Compensation \& Benefits:\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For U.S.\-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $143,700\.00 \- $215,550\.00\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:\&\#xa;• Medical, dental, and vision insurance\&\#xa;• 401(k) with company match\&\#xa;• Paid time off (PTO)\&\#xa;• And additional employee wellness programs\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Application Details:\&\#xa;This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.\&\#xa;To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education. Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non\-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non\-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com. We are looking for highly motivated, performance\-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it! At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.title: Senior Data and AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview:** We're hiring a senior engineer to build the data foundation and the governed AI services that run on top of it. You will own pipelines from source to model in Python and dbt, ship them on Docker and Kubernetes in AWS, and expose trusted data to agents through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. This is a hands\-on role with broad reach. You will move between traditional data engineering and applied AI work, and partner directly with business teams to turn requests into working solutions that people rely on. **What you'll do:** **Data engineering** * Design, build, and operate batch and incremental pipelines in Python, with dbt for transformation, testing, and documentation, and fix issues at the source. * Containerize workloads with Docker and run them on Kubernetes, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD to ship safely and often. * Build on AWS services for storage, compute, orchestration, and security, and tune for cost and performance. **AI and agentic engineering** * Design and build MCP servers and connectors that give agents governed access to enterprise data and tools. * Deploy and operate agentic workflows in production, including tool use, orchestration, evaluation, observability, and guardrails. * Set patterns for authentication, access control, and auditability, and test new AI techniques so only the ones that matter reach production. **Team and business impact** * Work with stakeholders to define the problem, agree on the outcome, and deliver in small, visible steps. * Review code and mentor engineers, raising the team's standards for design, testing, and documentation. **What you'll need:** * 8 or more years of professional data engineering experience, with a record of owning production systems end to end. * Strong Python for data processing, automation, and services, plus hands\-on dbt: models, tests, macros, and deployment. * Working experience with Docker and Kubernetes to deploy, scale, and troubleshoot data workloads, with Git, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. * Solid AWS experience across core services for storage, compute, networking, and security. * Advanced SQL and a sound grasp of data modeling, warehousing, and performance tuning. * Practical knowledge of Model Context Protocol: you have built, deployed, or integrated MCP servers or similar tool interfaces for LLMs. * Experience building or deploying agentic workflows, including orchestration, tool calling, evaluation, and monitoring, and the judgment to separate useful AI patterns from hype. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to have:** * Orchestration experience with Airflow or a comparable tool. * Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery. * Familiarity with enterprise source systems such as CRM, ERP, and finance platforms, and the data quirks that come with them. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks. **What you will gain:** At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well\-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork. Here, you will have the opportunity to: * **Expand Your Skills:** Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career. * **Enjoy Where You Work:** Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day. * **Support What Matters Most:** Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family\-formation benefits and support during your family\-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. jobs.title: Communications Data Specialist
jobs.description: **Communications Data Specialist** The UAW has taken an all\-new approach to bargaining and striking. During the 2023 negotiations with Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis, our union ran a contract campaign for the first time, initiated strikes against all three companies at the same time, and brought a whole new level of transparency to bargaining. The result was record\-breaking contracts. From our Stand Up Strike to the recently announced new organizing drive across 13 non\-union automakers, the UAW is at the forefront of rebuilding a fighting labor movement. Our union is seeking a Communications Data Specialist to join our powerhouse Communications team in assisting strategic campaigns across the country. The Communications Data Specialist will help build, maintain, and improve the data, communications, and technology infrastructure that powers the UAW's strategic campaigns. The ideal candidate is a technically strong, self\-motivated problem solver who can work across the full technology stack—from user\-facing web tools and dashboards to server\-side applications, databases, APIs, integrations, and automated communications systems. This position also requires exceptional people and customer service skills. The successful candidate will be highly responsive to colleagues and campaign partners, able to translate technical problems into practical solutions, and comfortable working with stakeholders across departments and levels of the organization. The ideal candidate understands that getting things done in a large organization requires both technical expertise and the ability to navigate organizational structures, competing priorities, hierarchy, and bureaucracy while maintaining momentum toward strategic goals. Candidates must be comfortable working in a high\-intensity, high\-velocity environment and be willing to work long and irregular hours, along with travel, including overnight stays. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Strategic Campaign \& Cross\-Department Collaboration** * Work with the Communications Director and staff across departments to leverage data, member lists, communications platforms, and technology in support of strategic campaign objectives. * Translate the needs of communications and campaign staff into practical, user\-friendly technical solutions. * Navigate organizational hierarchy, competing priorities, and bureaucracy with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skills while finding ways to move projects forward. * Identify opportunities to improve technology, data practices, and workflows and proactively implement solutions. **2\. Full\-Stack Web Development \& Technical Systems** * Design, build, maintain, and improve full\-stack web applications and internal tools using TypeScript and related technologies, including frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and databases. * Develop responsive, accessible, and intuitive web experiences and data\-driven tools for staff and campaign use. * Assess, troubleshoot, document, and improve websites, web applications, databases, communications platforms, and other technical systems. * Diagnose technical problems independently and communicate clearly about solutions, risks, timelines, and technical needs. **3\. Data, Systems Integration \& Automation** * Analyze large communications datasets to generate strategic insights, improve targeting, and support campaign planning and decision\-making. * Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows, and integrations between Solidarity Tech, CRMs, databases, websites, communications platforms, and other systems. * Maintain a strong working knowledge of Solidarity Tech and its integration with the UAW's broader technology and data ecosystem. * Improve data quality, system interoperability, automation, and the reliability and accessibility of campaign information. **4\. Staff Support, Training \& Customer Service** * Provide highly responsive technical and customer support to Communications staff and other stakeholders, following issues through to resolution and prioritizing urgent campaign needs. * Provide ongoing training and support for Solidarity Tech, communications platforms, data systems, dashboards, and other technology tools. * Develop documentation, training materials, and processes that enable staff to effectively use systems and reduce dependence on individual technical staff. * Build strong relationships with technical and non\-technical users and serve as a trusted, solutions\-oriented resource. **5\. Project Management \& Execution** * Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting campaign deadlines. * Take ownership of technical projects and problems from identification through implementation, testing, training, and ongoing support. * Balance urgent campaign needs with longer\-term technology, data, and infrastructure improvements. * Work independently, proactively identify problems and opportunities, and foll ervice orientation and responsiveness, with the ability to provide ongoing technical support, training, and guidance to staff with varying levels of technical expertise. * **Self\-direction, collaboration \& execution:** Highly self\-motivated, organized, and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders; independently identify problems, research solutions, and follow work through to completion. * **Judgment, adaptability \& organizational navigation:** Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work effectively within a complex organization with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, established hierarchies, and bureaucracy. Must be persistent, solutions\-oriented, adaptable, and able to build relationships while finding practical ways to get things done. Basic understanding of labor unions and strategic communications, eagerness to learn about the sectors represented by the UAW, and commitment to the mission of the UAW. Successful candidates will exhibit discerning judgment, exemplary people skills, adept writing capabilities, and a strong commitment to service. The ideal candidate is both a team player who can collaborate with an enthusiastic staff and a self\-driven individual who can independently identify problems, develop solutions, manage competing priorities, and follow projects through to completion. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, communications, data, and organizing. They will be able to move fluidly between writing code, analyzing data, troubleshooting a communications platform, answering a colleague's urgent technical question, and working with senior stakeholders to determine the best path forward. **Salary and Benefits** This is a full\-time, exempt position, represented by News Guild, with a remote workplace. The UAW offers a salary of $118,566\.76, along with best\-in\-class health, retirement, and paid time off benefits. **How to Apply** To be considered for this position, please apply through Indeed and provide the following: * A current resume reflecting qualifications for this position, including months and years of employment. * A short letter of application (500 words or less) which specifically explains how your experiences and accomplishments have prepared you to work with the UAW's aggressive and bold Communications Department. * An example work product—such as a web application, web asset, dashboard, database, data analysis, API integration, mass communications system, or other technical project—that demonstrates your ability, along with a short written explanation of your role and the technology used. If you have any issues with attaching the required documents to your Indeed application please email them to recruiting@uaw.net. *The UAW is dedicated to promoting a diverse and inclusive work environment. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Workforce Security - Identity, Access and Authorization
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Are you passionate about security engineering, identity, and the cloud? Come join the Enterprise Identity \& Access Management team as a Senior Security Engineer. We build and operate the systems that decide who can access what across Intuit's cloud footprint, and we are rebuilding them for a world where access decisions need to be fine\-grained, real\-time, and provable. This is a hands\-on building role. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in system design, not in coordination. You will own cloud access management, meaning how humans and workloads get, use, and give up access to AWS and GCP, and fine\-grained access controls: policy\-as\-code, authorization services, and entitlement models that replace coarse role checks with decisions we can actually reason about and prove. You will also help us stand up authentication for workforce agentic identity, an area where the industry does not yet have settled answers and you will help define ours. The work is full\-stack. You will design and build the back\-end services and policy engines that make authorization decisions, and the front\-end experiences that let engineers, access approvers, and auditors understand and act on them. What makes this a security engineering role rather than a general platform role is that the control is the product: correctness, blast radius, and evidence are the requirements, not afterthoughts. **Responsibilities** **Design and build** * Lead design and delivery of complex cloud access management and fine\-grained authorization services, owning the outcome independently. * Build back\-end services, APIs, and policy evaluation paths in Java and Spring, with Python for automation and agent work, and React front\-ends. * Design authorization models that hold up in practice: ABAC, relationship\-based access control, policy\-as\-code, just\-in\-time and time\-bound access, workload identity, and true least privilege. * Integrate deeply with AWS IAM/STS, GCP IAM, cross\-account access, and SAML, OIDC, and OAuth 2\.0\. * Lead security technology evaluations with long\-term implications, and make the internal case for approaches worth adopting. **Own the security outcome** * Find root causes of complex security risks rather than patching symptoms. * Evaluate, report, and remediate access control gaps, and define remediation guidance other teams follow. Pair data with a clear narrative. * Threat model what you build: privilege escalation, confused deputy, token replay, policy bypass, and dependency compromise. * Automate control testing and continuous evidence collection for SOX logical access and other regulatory controls. Manual evidence gathering is a bug. * Own observability, alerting, and monitoring after release, not just at launch. **Use AI as part of the craft** * Integrate GenAI tooling and orchestrate agents across design, development, validation, and operations, holding their output to the same review and testing bar as your own. * Apply the same security rigor to AI systems, particularly as we build the identity and authorization layer agents will run on. **Execute and lead** * Provide reliable estimates that account for technical risk and team capacity, balancing speed to learn against long\-term system health. * Eliminate systemic roadblocks through cross\-functional influence and shape practices that keep quality consistent. * Own delivery of major projects, managing risks and updating stakeholders before they ask. * Partner with Product, Design, and internal customers to co\-define requirements from inception. * Define success upfront, track adoption and impact after launch, and drive follow\-up iterations. **Elevate the team** * Give actionable feedback on security practices, design, and collaboration, and contribute to teammates’ learning plans. * Provide clarity amid ambiguity, resolving technical constraints by grounding discussion in customer problems, security principles, and established patterns. * Surface unresolved challenges to Staff\-plus engineers and management early enough to act. **Qualifications** Qualifications * 5\+ years of professional experience building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on security\-relevant systems. * Full\-stack development experience: + Back end: Java and Spring, plus Python for automation, tooling, and AI/agent work + Front end: React (Angular acceptable) * Deep hands\-on experience with AWS or GCP, including its identity and access primitives, and a working understanding of how cloud permission models fail in practice. * Production experience with identity and access management: RBAC or ABAC, SSO, federation (SAML), OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, and token and credential lifecycle. * Demonstrated ability to root\-cause complex security issues through in\-depth analysis rather than pattern matching. * Strong automation instincts, including experience automating control testing, evidence collection, or compliance workflows. * Datastore and database experience, including schema and query design under real scale and latency constraints. * Experience using AI developer tools and agents in your engineering workflow, including validating their output before it ships. * Strong written and verbal communication. You will be explaining authorization decisions and security trade\-offs to people who did not design the system, including non\-engineers. * BS/MS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Strongly Preferred Experience** --------------------------------- * Fine\-grained authorization at scale: policy\-as\-code with OPA and Rego, AWS Cedar, Zanzibar\-style relationship\-based authorization, XACML, or a purpose\-built decision service. * Cloud entitlement management: AWS IAM policy analysis, permission boundaries, GCP IAM conditions, workload identity federation, and secrets or credential brokering. * Identity governance: access certification, separation of duties, privileged access management, and least\-privilege analysis over real entitlement data. * SOX or other regulatory logical access controls, including audit evidence automation and continuous control monitoring. * Threat modeling and secure design review as a regular practice, not an occasional exercise. * Machine and non\-human identity: service accounts, workload identity, and the emerging problem of giving AI agents scoped, revocable, auditable access. * Building AI\-native applications or applying LLMs and agent frameworks to real production problems. * Agile, Scrum, or Extreme Programming experience. * A GitHub portfolio or open source contributions you are proud to share. jobs.title: Agentic AI Analyst
jobs.description: **About Invoca:** We built the category that made conversations measurable. Now we're building the AI agents orchestrating those engagements. Invoca is the revenue infrastructure connecting marketing, commerce, and contact center teams — turning every buyer conversation into revenue, and attributing it all the way back to the media spend that drove it. Our multimodal AI agents operate at the moment of decision: engaging buyers across the journey with personalized interactions at scale for life's most considered purchases — without losing the empathy, explainability, and trust those decisions demand. Every engagement is transparent and attributable — brands see not just what converted, but why, and what marketing dollar earned it. Come work on the layer where AI agents and real revenue meet. **The Opportunity** As an Agentic AI Analyst at Invoca, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and refining the emerging category of agentic AI applications. Within our Product organization, you'll collaborate closely with a cross\-functional team, including Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Customer Success, to identify, evaluate, and operationalize agentic use cases that directly improve customer outcomes and advance Invoca's strategic AI vision. A core focus of this role is **the integration layer that makes agents useful in the real world:** designing and validating the tools agents call (via MCP and similar protocols), authoring the skills that shape agent behavior, building the evaluation harnesses that measure whether agents actually work, and running simulations that stress\-test agents before customers ever touch them. This is an opportunity to grow your product skillset at the intersection of customer needs, agentic AI system design, and real\-world AI performance. You will contribute to building new features, evaluating agent performance in production, and distilling insights from field engagements and system data to inform product priorities. You should bring strong problem\-solving ability, curiosity around emerging AI capabilities, and confidence working across stakeholders to translate ambiguity into clarity and execution. **What You'll Do** * **Design and Validate Agentic Integrations (MCP Tools):** Define the tools our agents use to read and act on customer data. Author tool specifications (names, descriptions, input/output schemas, error behavior), prototype MCP servers and tool integrations, and validate that agents select and invoke tools correctly across realistic scenarios. Partner with Engineering on tool ergonomics that reduce hallucinated calls and improve task completion. * **Author and Maintain Agent Skills:** Design, write, and maintain reusable skills: structured instructions, workflows, and domain knowledge that govern how agents approach specific jobs. Test skill triggering accuracy, iterate on instructions based on eval results, and manage a versioned library of skills for reuse across products and customers. * **Build and Run Agent Evals:** Design evaluation frameworks for agentic behaviors, including golden datasets, task\-level success criteria, grading rubrics, and LLM\-as\-judge pipelines. Run evals across model, prompt, tool, and skill changes to catch regressions, quantify improvements, and inform release decisions. Report results in a way that both Engineering and GTM can act on. * **Simulate Agent Behavior Before Production:** Build and operate simulation environments (synthetic callers, mock tool backends, adversarial and edge\-case scenarios) to exercise multi\-step agent workflows at scale. Use simulation results to uncover failure modes, calibrate human\-in\-the\-loop handoff points, and establish confidence thresholds before beta and GA. * **Design End\-to\-End Agent Behavior:** Own how an agent reasons through a task from start to finish, including planning logic, state management across steps, escalation and human\-in\-the\-loop decision points, and fallback behavior when tools or data are unavailable. * **Validate Use Cases with Customers and GTM:** Work with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and customers to surface high\-value problems, and mine call transcripts, usage data, and tool\-call traces to identify where agents can deliver measurable outcomes. Translate those findings into scoped, experiment\-ready proposals. * **Monitor Agent Performance in Production:** Track and interpret key metrics, such as task completion rates, tool\-call success rates, fallback frequency, and customer feedback, to assess agent efficacy and prioritize improvements. * **Optimize Retrieval and Model Behavior:** Partner with Engineering and ML teams to tune the components behind agent quality, including retrieval and RAG strategies, context management, and model selection, using eval and production data to guide changes. * **Triage Production Issues and Regressions:** Own the process for capturing, reproducing, and documenting unintended agent behaviors reported from pro  Familiarity with agent\-to\-agent (A2A) protocols or multi\-agent orchestration patterns. * Experience designing for long\-running or stateful agent sessions (context persistence, session resumption, drift over time). **Strong Plus** * Working comfort with Python, JSON/JSON Schema, and reading API documentation, enough to prototype and inspect tool calls and traces. * Prior experience building or managing integrations between SaaS platforms (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, contact center, or data platforms) via APIs, webhooks, or iPaaS tools. * Experience in marketing or advertising technology, such as paid media, call tracking, attribution, marketing analytics, or ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, etc.). Compensation, Benefits \& Perks: At Invoca, we believe great work starts with taking care of our people. That's why we offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support your health, your family, your growth, and your life outside of work. For teammates in the U.S., health benefits begin on your first day of employment. ***Location: This is a remote\-first role. We are currently hiring in the following locations with a preference for talent located in the SF Bay Area:*** ***United States:*** *Greater Los Angeles Area (including Santa Barbara and San Diego) · SF Bay Area · Denver Metro · Austin Metro · Chicago Metro · Greater NYC Area · Seattle Metro* ***Candidates must be based within \~2 hour drive of these areas. Occasional business travel may be required.*** Compensation * Base Salary: $94,000–$134,000\* * Variable Compensation: Bonus and/or commission eligibility, where applicable. * Equity: All employees are invited to share in Invoca's success through our stock option program. *\*Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, skills, and location.* Benefits \& Perks Health \& Wellbeing * Day\-One Health Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage begins on your first day of employment for U.S.\-based teammates. * Mental Wellbeing – Access to mental wellbeing support and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). * Wellness Subsidy – Reimbursement that can be applied toward gym memberships, fitness classes, and more. jobs.title: Principal SSD Debug Engineer - 2282
jobs.description: **Company Description** *No Relocation Assistance Provided.* KIOXIA America, Inc. is the U.S.\-based subsidiary of KIOXIA Corporation, a leading worldwide supplier of flash memory and solid state drives (SSDs). From the invention of flash memory to today’s breakthrough BiCS FLASH™ 3D flash memory technology, KIOXIA continues to pioneer innovative memory, SSD and software solutions that enrich people's lives and expand society's horizons. The company's innovative BiCS FLASH™ 3D flash memory technology is shaping the future of storage in high\-density applications, including advanced smartphones, PCs, SSDs, automotive, and data centers. **Job Description** We are seeking a highly skilled and technically driven Principal SSD Debug Engineer to lead complex failure investigations involving enterprise and data center SSDs deployed in hyperscale server environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in server hardware architecture, operating system storage stacks, NVMe/PCIe protocols, and SSD firmware internals. This role requires strong hands\-on debugging capabilities across the complete storage subsystem, from host applications and operating system drivers through PCIe interfaces to SSD controller firmware and NAND media. The candidate must be capable of independently reproducing complex system\-level failures, isolating root causes between host platforms and SSDs, analyzing and modifying embedded firmware, and driving cross\-functional engineering teams toward technically sound and sustainable resolutions. Primary Responsibilities: * Troubleshoot failures across the complete server storage stack, including applications, file systems, block layers, operating system storage drivers, hypervisors, PCIe subsystem, and SSDs, to isolate host, platform, and SSD level issues. * Investigate interactions between SSDs and server components, including CPUs, PCIe root complexes, chipsets, BMCs, BIOS, and system firmware. * Investigate storage failures in multiple controller configurations, including resource contention, concurrency, thermal behavior, PLP, heterogeneous driver interactions through virtualization, and platform\-specific interactions. * Analyze Linux and Windows host logs, kernel crash dumps, PCIe protocol traces, BMC event logs, and system telemetry to identify failure mechanisms. * Drive cross\-functional debug with SSD firmware, platform, and customer teams, define reproducible test cases and drive corrective actions to closure. * Collaborate across globally distributed engineering teams, driving technical issue resolution across time zones. * Analyze host and SSD telemetry logs, corelate failures with firmware source code and hardware behavior, and drive root cause to closure. * Work on development of debug firmware in C programming across the SSD firmware stack to accelerate the root cause analysis. * Work on troubleshooting SSD performance issues and reduce tail latencies and improve IOPS and throughput. * Perform required lab work to replicate the reported issues * Create 8D/failure analysis reports and explain to the customer * Write product use\-case technical white papers as needed **Qualifications** **BS degree in computer engineering or equivalent field with minimum 10 years of experience in a technical related field or MS degree in computer engineering or equivalent field with minimum 8 years of experience in a technical related field.** * Strong hands\-on C programming and debugging experience in embedded firmware or low\-level systems software. * Ability to read, understand, modify, and debug complex embedded firmware codebases * Strong knowledge of firmware concurrency, mutexes, semaphores, interrupts, atomic operations, race conditions, and deadlocks. * Experience debugging memory corruption, pointer errors, stack overflows, timing\-sensitive failures, and hardware/software interactions. * Working knowledge of BMC functionality, IPMI/Redfish interfaces, server management logs, BIOS/UEFI, and platform initialization * Proficiency in Linux storage debugging tools such as dmesg, journalctl, nvme\-cli, fio, lspci, perf, and kernel crash analysis tools. * In\-depth understanding of NVMe and PCIe specifications, with proven experience debugging protocol\-level failures. * Ability to interpret specification requirements and validate observed firmware behavior against defined protocol standards. * Solid understanding of SSD architecture, including controller SoCs, NAND flash, FTL, garbage collection, wear leveling, and error handling. * Familiarity with SoC architecture, memory\-mapped registers, register\-level programming, and firmware debugging interfaces such as JTAG. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to formulate technical hypotheses, design targeted experiments, and validate root causes using measurable evidence. * Strong written and verbal technical communication skills, with experience collaborating across globally distributed engineering teams * SSD Firmware architecture and/or validation/test experience * Able to travel when and where needed – both domestic and international **Additional Information** **Req\#2282; \#LI\-JV1** The expected salary for this position is $155,420\.00 \- 259,030\.00\. **At KIOXIA, we value the following:** * Investment in you + Offering opportunities for career growth and personal development training * Open\-minded management + Empowering employees by listening and responding to ideas, issues, and approaches * Flexible work\-life balance + Offering a generous PTO allotment, holiday shutdown, and flexible work options * Variety of cultures, perspectives, backgrounds and experiences of all our team members + Through our opportunity, belonging and respect initiatives, our focus is to strengthen our company culture to create an environment of belonging for all * Benefits for our team members + Excellent medical and non\-medical benefits, 401(k) matching, pet insurance KIOXIA America, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.description: **WE HAVE CREATED A WORLD WHERE ART AND SCIENCE ARE BEST FRIENDS** Known is a modern marketing company engineered for the unprecedented opportunities and challenges facing marketers today. We are about 200\+ people strong, pairing PhD data scientists with award\-winning creatives, strategists, engineers and expert research teams to produce some of the most innovative and cutting\-edge creative work in culture. We believe that when creative truly collaborates with science, strategy, and technology, amazing things can happen. *Ad Age* touted that "Known may be the ultimate example of a full\-service agency," and honored us with two prestigious recognitions this year: \#3 on *The A\-List* as one of the top agencies in the world, and *Ad Age's* Data \& Insights Agency of the year for the second year in a row. Without our incredible partnerships with our clients, spanning across the leading brands in finance, technology, entertainment, media, CPG, real estate, and many other categories, honors like this could not be possible, and also have helped us earn additional awards and recognitions over the years like: *Emmys, Clios Entertainment and Sports Awards, Effies, Cannes Lions Awards, ProMax Agency of the Year,* and *Digiday's Most Innovative Media Agency* to name a few. SKEPTIC™, Known's proprietary AI analytics and optimization platform, powers our full service agency and has received industry\-wide recognition for innovation in marketing technology and analytics. In 2025, SKEPTIC was recognized by Fast Company as one of the *Next Big Things in Tech*. Additionally, Digiday recognized SKEPTIC as *Best Marketing Analytics Platform* (2023\) and the *Best AI Platform* (2025\). Together, these honors underscore SKEPTIC's evolution into an award\-winning platform now being licensed to enterprise marketers. We couldn't create this award\-winning work without seeking out and hiring the best talent. What does it mean to be a Knowner? We are curious innovators, knowledge\-hunters who are constantly challenging ourselves to do better and be better for our clients, for our team and for our world at large. Our offices around the U.S. are open and while most of our people work in a hybrid setting, we are a distributed workforce with a number of Knowners working remotely. **BUT ENOUGH ABOUT US, LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU** About the role: Known's Media Science team uses advanced analytics, machine learning, statistics, and algorithms to plan and optimize advertising dollars. We partner with our clients to translate their business goals into meaningful metrics, and buy media across all channels to drive those target outcomes. We are looking for a Manager, Data \& Media Science to join the team and work alongside strategists, analysts, data scientists, and software engineers. In this role, you will lead the data science arm of our media campaigns, owning the relationship with the client when it comes to optimization and data. You will be in a primarily client\-facing position with heavy project ownership and emphasis on communicating with executive stakeholders. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Serve as the primary client point of contact on campaign optimization and data * Delight our clients with meaningful analyses, compelling stories, and beautiful slides * Own analytics, science, and optimization for our media campaigns * Work with other data analysts \& scientists to deliver rigorous measurement, consistent campaign performance, and insightful reporting * Consult with agency and client leadership to set measurement frameworks, design experiments (A/B, incrementality, geo\-testing), and evaluate campaign lift and ROI across channels * Stay current on industry trends in digital media, analytics, and privacy regulations Seniority is flexible and subject to experience. **WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVE** * A degree from a well\-regarded college or university, preferably a Masters or PhD. STEM degrees are also preferred. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience doing quantitative analysis, modeling, optimization and/or statistics. Experience using Python and SQL. * 2\+ years of experience directly communicating with senior stakeholders, managing relationships, and presenting decks to a variety of audiences, all on technical subjects related to the analytics, science, and application of data A desire to work on advertising challenges that require flexibility in approach * \- everything from data strategy, on\-the\-fly analytics, statistics, machine learning, and algorithms * An ability to strategically translate business challenges into quantitative problems, and solve them by whatever means are most appropriate and effective, which may not always be strict machine learning * An eagerness to learn foundational knowledge and skills rapidly * A commitment to managing the quality \& accuracy of analytics, ensuring high standards with your and others' work * Experience across multiple digital (e.g., social, programmatic) and/or traditional (e.g., linear TV, OOH) media channels * Familiarity with major ad serving platforms (ex: Google Ad Manager, DV360, The Trade Desk) * Competence with campaign setup parameters, including: targeting, audience segmentation, tracking, attribution methodologies (multi\-touch, last\-click), and key digital metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions, viewability, etc.) * Experience with analytics and reporting platforms (ex: Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics), attribution and measurement systems (ex: CM360, Videoamp), and deriving actionable insights for optimization * Experience with local marketing or retail media is a plus **SOME OF OUR PERKS** * Unlimited paid time off * 401k with company matching and no vesting period * Annual bonuses * Generous medical plan * Paid parental leave **ONE LAST THING TO ASK YOURSELF** All this might sound great, but you're probably still wondering, "Would I be a good fit for Known?" or "Would Known be a good fit for me?" Our culture is propped up by four values that we aspire to every day: We are one team. We see the good. We never stop learning. There's always a better way.
