This role interprets customer and contractual requirements, develops and coordinates customer submittals, prepares complete design\-input packages, and ensures engineering deliverables remain aligned with approved project requirements. The Project Engineer serves as a primary technical interface among customers, consulting engineers, utilities, sales, project management, electrical and mechanical engineering, supply chain, and other internal stakeholders. **ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITES** **PROJECT INTAKE AND SCOPE DEFINITION** * Partner with Sales during project intake to confirm that customer requirements, quoted scope, approved exceptions, and purchase\-order requirements are aligned before engineering execution begins. * Identify scope gaps, conflicting requirements, technical risks, deviations, and missing information during project intake. * Identify and document applicable product standards, customer specifications, utility requirements, and project\-specific compliance obligations. * Establish and maintain project request for information, action\-item, technical decision, and open\-item logs. * Coordinate technical questions with customers, consulting engineers, utilities, sales representatives, suppliers, and internal stakeholders. **CUSTOMER SUBMITTALS AND COMPONENT COORDINATION** * Own the preparation, coordination, revision, comment incorporation, and approval tracking of customer submittal packages. * Prepare or coordinate submittal\-level one\-line diagrams, preliminary equipment layouts, overall dimensions, equipment ratings, major component selections, open items, and other required technical information. * Identify comments or requests that may represent a change in contractual scope and provide technical input to the change\-order process. * Obtain documented customer approval before release to detailed design unless otherwise authorized. * Identify long\-lead, customer\-specified, and project\-critical components during the submittal and design phases. **DESIGN COORDINATION** * Complete engineering input packages in coordination with electrical and mechanical design teams. * Conduct project handoff meetings to verify engineering outputs against the customer purchase order, approved quotation, specifications, approved submittals, and documented exceptions to ensure the final design is complete, accurate, and consistent with contractual requirements. * Support the technical evaluation of component substitutions, supplier deviations, and alternate manufacturers to confirm compliance with project requirements and applicable standards. * Ensure required technical information, customer decisions, approvals, and open\-item dispositions are complete or clearly identified before release to detailed design. **CHANGE MANAGEMENT AND PROJECT CLOSEOUT** * Evaluate proposed customer, supplier, and design changes for technical feasibility and compliance, and identify high\-level impacts to project cost, schedule, materials, and documentation. * Maintain engineering project milestones, approvals, open items, and revision status within company ERP and document\-control systems. * Coordinate and maintain project closeout documentation, including as\-built drawings, bills of material, equipment labels, and other required engineering records. * Participate in continuous\-improvement, root\-cause analysis, lessons\-learned, and standardization initiatives. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, engineering technology, manufacturing engineering technology, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered. * Three or more years of experience in project engineering, applications engineering, electrical or mechanical design, or technical project execution within an engineered\-to\-order environment. * Experience reviewing customer specifications, purchase orders, quotations, drawings, and other technical contract documents. * Ability to read and interpret one\-line diagrams, electrical schematics, bills of material, equipment layouts, and mechanical drawings. * Demonstrated ability to review and interpret drawings produced using 2D or 3D CAD software. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to organize and manage multiple projects, open items, deadlines, and changing priorities. * Strong attention to detail, follow\-through, and document\-control discipline. * Ability to collaborate effectively with customers and cross\-functional teams. * Experience using ERP or MRP systems; SAP experience preferred. * Experience with AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, Inventor, or similar CAD platforms. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with UL 891 switchboards, UL 508A industrial control panels, UL 1008 transfer\-switch equipment, or metal\-clad medium\-voltage switchgear. * Working knowledge of UL 891 and familiarity with other applicable UL standards. * Familiarity with NEC, ANSI, IEEE, and utility requirements. * Experience preparing and managing customer submittal packages. * Familiarity with medium\-voltage power distribution, protection, controls, and switchgear construction. * Demonstrated systems\-thinking and continuous\-improvement capabilities. **ADDITIONAL NOTES** Kratos Industries started in 2020 and we are looking to breed not jobs.title: AVP, IAM AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. **Job Overview:** We are looking for an AVP, IAM AI Engineer to design, operationalize, and automate the identity controls that govern both human and non\-human actors across our environment — with a specific focus on AI agents and the emerging class of agentic and non\-human identities (NHI). This is a hands\-on engineering and technical leadership role: you will build the runtime controls, secrets workflows, and governance guardrails that let the organization adopt AI safely, while standing up and growing a team to sustain and scale that work. You will be embedded in new AI application development from the earliest design stages, ensuring identity, authentication, and authorization are built in rather than bolted on. **Responsibilities**: * **Identity runtime controls.** Operationalize and automate identity runtime controls across human and non\-human identities, including real\-time authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement. * **NHI \& agentic governance.** Design, build, and automate governance controls for AI agents and non\-human identities — covering the full lifecycle: provisioning, entitlement, rotation, certification/attestation, and deprovisioning. * **Secrets management for AI.** Develop and automate secrets\-manager workflows for AI systems and agents, including secret rotation, just\-in\-time and ephemeral credentials, and secure secret delivery to workloads. * **Least privilege \& policy\-as\-code.** Define and enforce fine\-grained, least\-privilege authorization models for agents and workloads, expressed as policy\-as\-code wherever possible. * **Reference architecture \& standards.** Establish standards and reference patterns for how identity flows through agentic systems — user\-to\-agent, agent\-to\-agent (A2A), and workload\-to\-service authentication and authorization. * **Embedded in AI development.** Partner with engineering and data science teams on all new AI application development, ensuring identity, AuthN/AuthZ, and secrets handling are designed in from the start. * **End\-user IAM deployment.** Support the deployment and adoption of IAM controls for end users where required. * **Monitoring \& response.** Integrate identity telemetry with SIEM/SOC tooling; build monitoring and anomaly detection for NHI/agent behavior; support incident response for compromised or misused credentials. * **Governance, risk \& compliance.** Partner with GRC, risk, and audit stakeholders to ensure controls satisfy regulatory and internal requirements, and to produce audit evidence. * **Team building \& leadership.** Recruit, build, mentor, and lead a team to support these workstreams; set technical direction and roadmap for NHI and agentic IAM. **What are we looking for?** We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness, act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work. **Requirements:** * 5\+ years in identity \& access management or information security, including hands\-on engineering. * Demonstrated experience building and/or leading technical teams. * 5\+ years with Ping Identity (PingFederate / PingOne / PingAccess) or a comparable access\-management / federation platform. * 5\+ years with SailPoint (IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud) or a comparable identity governance \& administration (IGA) platform. * 3\+ years with Idira (CyberArk, formerly Conjur) / HashiCorp Vault or a comparable secrets\-management platform. **Core Competencies:** * Working knowledge of identity and authorization for both users and agents: user\-to\-agent and agent\-to\-agent (A2A) patterns, OIDC and OAuth 2\.0/2\.1 tokens, and API keys, across both authentication (AuthN) and authorization (AuthZ). * Strong automation and engineering skills: proficiency in a scripting/programming language (e.g., Python), infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and REST API integration. * Experience applying IAM in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and in containerized / Kubernetes workloads. **Preferences:** * Familiarity with workload\-identity and machine\-identity standards: SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth token exchange (RFC 8693\), mTLS, and cloud workload\-identity federation. * Working understanding of AI/agentic systems: LLMs, agent frameworks, tool\-calling, and emerging authentication patterns such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, etc.) and with associated compliance regimes. * Relevant certifications, e.g., CISSP, CyberArk (Defender/Sentry), SailPoint, Ping, or a major cloud security certification. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. \#LI\-Hybrid **Pay Range:** $122,570\.00 \- $204,249\.00### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! **Company Overview:** LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE. **Information on Interviews:** LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an **@lplfinancial.com** email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855\) 575\-6947\. EAC 5\.19\.26

jobs.title: Product Partnership Engineer
jobs.description: **TL;DR:** We’re hiring a Product Partnership Engineer to build and scale Lovable’s most strategic product partnerships. You’ll work directly with enterprise partners to design and ship high\-impact integrations, reading their stack, prototyping solutions yourself, and shaping both our roadmap and theirs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and enterprise relationships, and will directly accelerate Lovable’s ecosystem growth and enterprise adoption. **Why Lovable?** Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024\. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent\-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low\-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest\-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. **What we’re looking for** * 5\+ years in Partner Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or as a technical founder/CTO \- in high\-velocity environments. * Fluent in modern frontend (React/TypeScript) and/or backend (Golang, Rust) development. * Track record of structuring and executing product\-centric partnerships that involve real technical depth. * Genuinely technical; comfortable reading technical documentation, understanding cloud architectures, and forming independent views on integration feasibility. * Strong enterprise and commercial instincts: comfortable navigating senior stakeholders in negotiating, building relationships and managing complex deals while maintaining technical credibility. * High agency and bias for action; you prototype first and refine later than waiting for full specs. **What you’ll do** * Own and deepen relationships with Lovable’s most strategic product and enterprise partners — driving urgency, alignment, and executive\-level momentum. * Independently assess partner architectures, APIs, and other integration points to identify high\-impact integration opportunities, validate feasibility, and proactively surface risks or blockers. * Prototype and spike early integrations yourself to shape requirements, accelerate decision\-making, and reduce engineering lift. * Scope and, where appropriate, ship production\-ready integrations that deliver measurable value to Lovable users and our partners. * Develop compelling business cases for integrations that clearly demonstrate long\-term value creation for partners, Lovable, and end customers with a strong focus on measurable impact. * Feed technical and market insights back into Lovable’s product organization, while collaborating cross\-functionally (Engineering, Product, Marketing, Growth) and leading workshops to drive alignment and successful go\-to\-market execution. **About your application** Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally \- if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal. Compensation Range: $199K \- $271K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **Magic (makers of Loyalist) · New York, NY · In\-office 5 days/week · $150k\-$200k \+ equity** Hi! I’m Niky, a founding engineer. Before joining Magic, I was working at a clinical data AI startup while reading every hospitality book I could find. The half\-formed product in my head turned out to already exist: Magic, which Maggie was building. Exhilarated, I jumped at the opportunity. A year down the line, we’re yet again looking for a foundational piece of our team (…you?) **What we’re building** ----------------------- Loyalist is the operating system that powers how our favorite restaurants remember you. We ingest live data from \~30 third\-party systems during service (reservations, POS, reviews, private events, marketing, e\-commerce). We turn that data into guest profiles and automated actions: a server hands a VIP a comped glass of wine because the system flagged that she’s been posting five\-star reviews over the last year. A marketing manager sends a happy\-birthday offer to 2,000 guests at once, each message referencing the specific dish that guest ordered last time. A sommelier gets a heads\-up that a two\-top walking in tonight are repeat 2018 Barolo drinkers. We’re also actively moving beyond restaurants into the full span of hospitality: hotels, casinos, spas, and more, so that Loyalist becomes a full‑fledged system for hospitality service everywhere. 1,000\+ restaurants run on Loyalist today, from neighborhood favorites to Carbone, Momofuku, Le Bernardin, and Daniel Boulud’s group. Some of the biggest have 5\-10 million guests each and hundreds of millions of visits and orders going back 15 years, and we process more than 10 million guest interactions every year. **What the role looks like** ---------------------------- You’d be a fullstack engineer shipping end\-to\-end features for restaurants. Engineers own the full arc here: talking to the customer, scoping the work, and shipping it. An example feature I shipped recently is Journeys, our system for designing multi\-step guest experiences across multiple venues and integrations. Operators define what should happen across a guest’s lifecycle (welcome, post\-visit, lapsed\-regular, anniversary), and Loyalist orchestrates it across reservations, POS, marketing, and reviews. The biggest strategic direction right now is moving onboarding from engineer\-led to operator\-led. We’ve historically configured each customer’s Loyalist instance by hand (which is how I learned the industry). We want operators to drive most of that themselves. That’s a lot of UI work with real consequences, and much of it is what you’d be working on. **Who’ll thrive here** ---------------------- **You’ll probably do well if:** * **You like the gap between customer problem and development to be small.** This involves an intimate understanding of the customer side of the company. * **You’ve shipped production code for long enough to have opinions about it.** Experience matters more than name, and we prioritize building 0 1\. * **You’re solid across some of our stack.** TypeScript and Python, React, Django, SQL, and solid database design intuition as to when to use what. You probably won’t thrive here if you want direction to come from above. Here it comes from you and the customer, and the failures of last Saturday's dinner service. Also if you’re not curious about restaurants, hospitality, or the physical\-world data layer. **About the team** ------------------ We’re 20 people, roughly half from restaurant and hospitality backgrounds and half from tech. * **Maggie** is our founder. She cold\-staged in Atelier Crenn’s kitchen in high school, did dining room ops at Eleven Madison Park, strategy at Momofuku, co\-founded a restaurant media company at Wharton, and wrote her honors thesis on grit in Michelin\-star restaurants. * **Chris** has been owning our infrastructure end\-to\-end (Kubernetes, ETL, background job orchestration) and has a rare ability to make the trade\-off call quickly. He also plays jazz and classical bass, sometimes in the office before a gig. * **Will** leads our zero\-to\-one work in hotels and members clubs. He’s the person thinking hardest about what the data model looks like when a “guest” means something different than it does in a restaurant. He also goes to DJ sets and DJs for fun. * **Abby** is on accounts and wrote the only academic paper in existence on food pop\-ups * **Dylan**, our founding partnerships lead, flew himself to Chicago on a Saturday to stage at Alinea. He spent the day folding napkins and serving arctic char off a bourbon stave. * **Julie**, our head of growth, has a tradition of visiting Monet’s water lilies at the MoMA every year on her birthday. A restaurant partner noticed, and earlier this year mailed her three Monet prints with a handwritten note. **A few things about how we work:** * Every team member does a *stage* at a customer restaurant: it’s an industry practice where you shadow or work behind the scenes during a service. I did mine at Rezdôra. Dylan did his at Alinea. It’s framed as a requirement, but it’s really a perk, and it’ll change how you build. * Lunch is from a different NYC restaurant every day. New hires pick the first week’s rotation. * We’re in\-office five days a week in SoHo. Everyone goes to dinner together more than is probably normal. * We use AI aggressively. Claude for most of the coding, AI code reviewers, AI for investigation and planning. Nothing is off\-limits. I know joining a 20\-person company in a niche industry is a real bet. I thought about it hard before I joined. What sold me was the specific combination of a team I’d learn from, problems that stretch me technically, and an industry I was already obsessed with. A year in the bet has paid off in ways I didn’t expect. I’ve shipped more production code here than I did in three years at my last job. I’ve designed and owned systems end\-to\-end instead of contributing to someone else’s design. I talk to chefs and operators I used to read about, and they use features I built for them. If any of that sounds like the bet you want to make, I’d love to meet. **The offer** ------------- * Salary $150k\-$200k \+ equity * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents (HSA plans available) * Flexible PTO * Daily NYC lunch (see above) * Access to coveted reservations in NYC * Niky Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real\-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast\-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **Summary of role:** All of Mercor’s AI work, from training and serving models to building agents, runs on GPUs. Your job is to make that compute fast, fault\-tolerant and fully utilized. You’ll own the accelerator platform end to end. That means the clusters and schedulers across AWS, GCP, neoclouds and on\-prem, the training and LLM serving on top, and the observability and cost data that show where every GPU\-hour goes. This is a software engineering role, not an ops role. You’ll write production code every day, own systems from design through on\-call, and build the platform that sets how fast Mercor can move. **Representative projects** * Stand up a multi\-cloud GPU fleet spanning hyperscalers, neoclouds and on\-prem, orchestrated through custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators so researchers never have to think about where their job lands. * Build a scheduling layer with gang scheduling, bin\-packing and fair\-share quotas that measurably raises accelerator utilization across teams. * Ship a high\-throughput vLLM serving stack with prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload and FP8/FP4 quantization. Back it with a benchmarking and traffic\-replay harness that tracks TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles against per\-config baselines. * Build a self\-healing health\-check and remediation system that rides out fault storms across hardware, network and software without paging a human. * Build an end\-to\-end cost\-attribution pipeline. It ingests utilization, occupancy and billing data into the warehouse, attributes every GPU\-hour to a team and workload, and drives capacity planning. * Build internal tools and dashboards that researchers and non\-engineers use every day. **Responsibilities:** * Design, deploy and operate GPU clusters across AWS, GCP, and other hyperscalers/neoclouds/on\-premise data centers, including custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators and the metadata services behind them. * Build scheduling that keeps accelerators busy: gang scheduling for distributed jobs, bin\-packing to reduce fragmentation, and quotas and fair share for multi\-tenant teams. * Run distributed training infrastructure on PyTorch Distributed, Ray, or Megatron, with fast checkpointing and model loading. * Deploy and tune high\-throughput LLM serving with vLLM or similar: tensor and model/expert parallelism, prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload, FP8/FP4 quantization. * Build benchmarking and traffic\-replay tools that measure TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles, and set per\-config performance baselines. * Build health checks across hardware, network and software layers, and automated remediation that handles fault storms without human intervention. * Instrument fleet utilization with DCGM, Prometheus and Grafana. Write recording rules and alerts that teams rely on. * Ingest utilization, occupancy and billing data into a warehouse, attribute spend to teams and workloads, and support capacity planning. * Drive autoscaling, rightsizing and idle\-capacity recovery programs with measurable cost results. * Write clear runbooks and documentation, and explain infrastructure tradeoffs to researchers, finance and leadership. * Build internal tools or dashboards that researchers and non\-engineers use daily. **You may be a good fit if you** * Have 5\+ years building and operating production distributed systems or ML infrastructure * Write production\-quality Python plus Go or C\+\+, and are fluent in shell scripting for system administration. * Have deep hands\-on Kubernetes and container experience, plus working knowledge of Slurm or another HPC resource manager. * Have run GPU workloads at scale, including scheduling, orchestration and troubleshooting. * Have hands\-on experience with at least one distributed training or serving stack: PyTorch Distributed, Ray, vLLM or Megatron\-LM. * Have deep experience with at least one major cloud provider. * Know observability tools like DataDog, Prometheus, PromQL and Grafana, and are comfortable on\-call for critical systems. * Own projects end to end and gather your own requirements with little direction. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (or a strong desire to learn deeply)** * LLM inference optimization: KV cache systems, disaggregated serving, quantization, speculative decoding * High\-performance networking: RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, NVLink * GPU profiling with Nsight or similar, and CUDA or Triton kernel work * Accelerators beyond NVIDIA: AMD MI\-series, TPU, Trainium * Capacity planning, billing normalization or cost attribution across providers * Automated fault diagnosis, log mining or AIOps at fleet scale * Configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and secure or air\-gapped deployments **Benefits** * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: Freelancer Senior Value Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: **1\. Background and Objectives** --------------------------------- MJV Technology \& Innovation is seeking a Senior Value Engineering Consultant to support the transformation of its commercial approach to selling technology services and solutions. Traditionally, a significant portion of the technology services market relies on engagement models based on resource allocation, billable hours, or estimated effort (Time \& Materials). With the rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence, automation, and technology delivery models, MJV aims to develop commercial approaches that prioritize the actual business value delivered to clients, including productivity improvements, operational efficiency, cost reduction, risk mitigation, and measurable business outcomes. The primary objective of this engagement is to develop and implement a commercial methodology that enables MJV to structure, price, and sell technology projects based on the value and business outcomes delivered to clients, reducing its dependence on traditional effort\-based pricing models. **2\. Key Responsibilities** ---------------------------- ### **Value Engineering Strategy** * Assess MJV’s current commercial model and identify opportunities to transition toward value\-driven engagement models. * Develop a structured methodology for identifying, quantifying, and communicating the economic and strategic value of technology solutions. * Translate technical benefits into financial and operational indicators relevant to clients. * Identify the categories of projects and services best suited for value\-based and outcome\-based commercial models. ### **Financial Modeling and Pricing** * Develop methodologies and financial models for calculating ROI, TCO, payback periods, and economic benefits. * Define Value\-Based Pricing and Outcome\-Based Pricing approaches applicable to technology services and solutions. * Evaluate alternative commercial structures, including value\-based fixed pricing, outcome\-based compensation, gainsharing arrangements, and hybrid models. * Establish guidelines for financial risk assessment, margin protection, and long\-term commercial sustainability. ### **Business Outcome Measurement** * Define methodologies for establishing performance indicators, baselines, and measurable business targets. * Develop mechanisms to measure, validate, and demonstrate the business benefits delivered by technology projects. * Identify client dependencies and external factors that may affect outcome measurement or attribution. * Support the definition of commercial acceptance criteria and mechanisms for validating achieved results. ### **Commercial Enablement** * Develop reusable tools and templates for building business cases and value\-driven commercial proposals. * Support the evolution of MJV’s commercial narrative, shifting discussions from resource allocation and effort estimation toward measurable business benefits. * Participate in structuring pilot commercial proposals using the newly developed methodology. * Transfer knowledge and methodologies to MJV’s sales and technical teams. **3\. Required Experience and Qualifications** ---------------------------------------------- ### **Essential Requirements** * Proven experience in Value Engineering, Value Consulting, Value\-Based Selling, or Outcome\-Based Pricing strategies. * Professional background in technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise software, or complex B2B technology services. * Hands\-on experience developing business cases and financial models to justify technology investments. * Strong understanding of pricing strategies for technology services and solutions. * Demonstrated ability to translate operational improvements and productivity gains into measurable economic value. * Experience designing or transforming commercial models, preferably including transitions from Time \& Materials to value\-based or outcome\-based engagements. * Ability to engage effectively with executive stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and Technology. * Experience developing reusable methodologies, frameworks, tools, and commercial processes. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience with global technology consulting firms or enterprise software companies. * Understanding of how Generative AI and automation are transforming technology service delivery and pricing models. * Experience with process automation, software engineering, digital transformation, or AI agent solutions. * Familiarity with commercial negotiations involving shared risks, performance\-based compensation, and gainsharing arrangements. * Knowledge of Value Realization methodologies and post\-implementation business outcome measurement. **4\. Expected Deliverables** ----------------------------- Considering an initial engagement of approximately 80 hours over two months, the consultant is expected to deliver the following: ### **Deliverable 1 — Assessment and Strategic Direction** Assessment of MJV’s current commercial model, identifying key opportunities for adopting value\-based approaches and prioritizing offerings with the highest implementation potential. ### **Deliverable 2 — Value Engineering Framework** Development of a structured, reusable methodology for identifying, quantifying, communicating, and measuring the business value generated by technology projects. ### **Deliverable 3 — Commercial and Pricing Models** Definition of alternative commercial structures applicable to different types of projects, including pricing methodologies, outcome measurement criteria, gainsharing mechanisms, and guidelines for managing financial risks and protecting margins. ### **Deliverable 4 — Commercial Enablement Tools** Development of practical tools and templates, including ROI financial models, business case frameworks, and value\-driven proposal structures. ### **Deliverable 5 — Practical Implementation** Application of the methodology to up to two real MJV commercial opportunities, supporting the development of concrete proposals using the new approach. ### **Deliverable 6 — Knowledge Transfer** Delivery of training and knowledge\-transfer sessions to relevant teams, ensuring that MJV can independently apply and evolve the methodology after the consulting engagement. **5\. Professional Profile** ---------------------------- We are looking for a business\-oriented professional with strong analytical capabilities and a hands\-on approach to execution. The ideal candidate should be comfortable navigating financial, commercial, and technological discussions, with a clear understanding of how technology solutions translate into measurable business outcomes. Strong consulting skills, executive communication abilities, pragmatism, and the capacity to develop methodologies that can be effectively applied within the organization are essential. We are not looking for a purely theoretical or academic consultant. Proven hands\-on experience designing and implementing value\-based commercial models is essential. **6\. Engagement Model** ------------------------ The initial engagement will consist of approximately 80 hours of specialized consulting services, to be consumed flexibly over an estimated two\-month period. The consultant will collaborate closely with representatives from MJV’s Sales, Technology, and Operations teams. The expected outcome is a set of practical, reusable methodologies, frameworks, and tools that will enable MJV to progressively incorporate value\-based and outcome\-based approaches into its commercial processes. **7\. Candidate Evaluation Criteria** ------------------------------------- Candidates should be able to present at least one real\-world example in which they actively participated in designing or implementing a value\-based or outcome\-based commercial model. The example should demonstrate: * How the business value was identified and quantified. * How the pricing model was structured. * How business outcomes and success criteria were established. * How commercial and financial risks were allocated between the service provider and the client. * What measurable results were achieved.

jobs.description: **Build the processes that build the product** ---------------------------------------------- At Magna Engineered Glass, we turn ideas into scalable, sustainable manufacturing. As our Industrialization Engineer, you will industrialize new programs, elevate existing production, and ensure every change respects quality, safety, and the environment. ### **Mission** Lead process development, production start\-up, and production support—implementing engineering changes and process improvements while ensuring environmental aspects of production are considered. ### **How you’ll contribute** * Architect process flows and define operations for new part quotes and program launches. * Drive PFMEA with cross\-functional partners to anticipate failure modes and controls. * Specify, purchase, and commission new equipment; manage rollout to the manufacturing floor. * Develop Standardized Work, Job Element Sheets, and documentation to sustain stable operations. * Serve as primary project contact, coordinating timelines, trials, and handoffs. * Research emerging technologies; lead approved continuous improvement and development projects. * Keep plant layout drawings current in partnership with operations, maintenance, and quality. * Create in\-process prints and production tools, including GD\&T stack\-ups, CAD updates, and signoffs. * Influence product design with Sales and customers to achieve manufacturable, cost\-effective solutions. * Communicate major engineering updates and corrective actions to leadership; maintain records and contribute to standards. * Benchmark internally and externally (sister plants, suppliers, customers, competitors) to capture best practices. * Promote MAFACT, lean manufacturing, standardized work, and a culture of continuous improvement. * Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and safety regulations including MIOSHA/OSHA and Lockout/Tagout. * Submit/drive CI and safety ideas; share lessons learned; train teams on newly rolled\-out processes. * Manage multiple projects while exemplifying Magna’s Employee Charter and values; perform additional duties as assigned. ### **Qualifications** * Engineering bachelor’s degree, or 3–5 years of relevant experience/training and/or equivalent education. * Demonstrated ability to produce Manufacturing Process Prints, Standard Work Instructions, and Job Element Sheets. * Automotive engineering experience required; preferred background in injection molding, bonding, soldering, assembly, and/or stamping. * Hands\-on with machinery; strong mechanical/electrical/pneumatic aptitude and troubleshooting capability. * Proficient in GD\&T; comfortable with tolerance stacks. * Analytical problem\-solver using 5 Why and root cause analysis; makes sound, timely decisions. * Ability to interpret written/oral instructions, diagrams, and schedules; capable with non\-standard problems. * Fluent in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and SolidWorks; adept at building spreadsheets. * Highly organized; able to prioritize, meet deadlines, and work extended hours when necessary. * Proactive change agent with excellent written and verbal communication; English required, Spanish preferred. * Committed to continuing education and strong in applied mathematics (probability, statistical inference, geometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, rates, graphs). ### **Work environment** * Approx. 40% office and 60% plant. * Extended sitting/standing; frequent keyboard and mouse use (\~6 hours/day). * Vision requirements include near/far/depth/color; substantial computer work. * Plant exposure to machinery, moving equipment/material, moderate noise, airborne particles/fumes, and temperature variation. * Role is primarily onsite in a manufacturing facility; occasional travel may be required. If you’re motivated by launching robust processes, coaching teams, and continuously improving how work gets done, you’ll thrive here.

jobs.title: AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** We are seeking an AI Operations Specialist to help business and product teams use AI to take on review and quality work. You will map how work gets done today, build AI\-driven workflows, and test them until the results can be trusted. You will also help product teams decide whether an AI feature is ready to launch. This is a hands\-on role: you help build the workflow, ship it, and stay on to make sure it keeps working. The scope is expected to grow as AI capabilities evolve. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Help prioritize projects by business impact and make the case for the ones worth pursuing. * Partner with process owners to map current workflows, then define where AI can do the work and where people step in on hard cases. * Build AI workflows: write prompts, set up pipelines, maintain agreed quality levels, and monitor for drift after launch. * Build test sets, measure accuracy, and calibrate LLM judges against human reviewers. * Help product teams define launch\-readiness criteria for AI features and provide evidence for go/no\-go decisions. * Turn unclear policy into criteria reviewers can apply consistently, working with product, legal, and policy partners. * Work with subject matter experts to write labeling guidelines and produce human\-verified labels on real data. * Run labeling at scale with vendor agents, and validate their work using agreement metrics and spot checks. * Make solutions reusable and document learnings so future teams reach production faster. * Keep methods current as models, tools, and vendor agents change, and retire what no longer works. * Own assigned workstreams end to end, from setup through quality checks. ### **Qualifications** **Required** * 5\-7 years in operations, program management, analytics, consulting, or applied AI, with accountability for results. * Daily AI user who has built something with AI that delivered measurable impact, such as a workflow, an automation, or an analysis. * Comfortable with metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and sampling. * Experience taking a messy process and making it measurable. * Quality experience in some form, such as review guidelines, QA, or audits. * Clear writer, able to work with business leads, product managers, and engineers. * Self\-directed and comfortable working with limited direction. * A technical background is not required. Prior experience designing evaluations or calibrating LLM judges is not required; training is provided. **Preferred** * Hands\-on SQL, Python, or API experience. * Trust and safety, content moderation, annotation operations, or other human\-in\-the\-loop work at scale. * Experience fine\-tuning models or calibrating LLM judges. * Background in a two\-sided marketplace, travel, or another operations\-heavy business. * Experience setting up intake and prioritization for a new team. ### **Key Details** * Start date: November 23, 2026 * Duration: 12 months * Location: Remote (within the U.S.) * Work schedule: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) * Pay rate range: $65\-$75/hour \+ benefits * Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. * Engagement: W\-2 Contract

jobs.title: Software Developer – ColdFusion
jobs.description: **Project Overview** We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to design and develop a voice\-activated data entry program. The system will allow field staff to speak into their mobile phones or desktop computers to automatically populate specific fields in our legacy database and trigger automatic notifications. **Technical Environment** * **Database:** Adobe ColdFusion (CFML) / associated relational database (e.g., MS SQL Server / MySQL) * **Notifications:** Custom SMS infrastructure is already built into our software platform and accessible via API/endpoints. * **Target Interface:** Mobile phone web application or dedicated mobile interface. **Scope of Work \& Key Deliverables** **1\. Voice\-to\-Data Processing Pipeline (AI Front\-End)** * Integrate a modern Conversational AI or Speech\-to\-Text API (such as OpenAI Realtime API, Vapi, Retell AI, or AWS Transcribe) capable of natural language understanding. * The system must not just transcribe text, but dynamically extract structured entities out of unstructured speech (e.g., identifying a location, description of an incident, and names from a single spoken phrase). **2\. ColdFusion Database Integration (The Backend)** * Develop secure backend handlers (ColdFusion Components / CFCs) or custom APIs to receive the structured data payloads from the voice interface. * Map and securely insert the extracted voice data into our existing database schemas. * **Target Workflows to Implement:** * **CMMS Work Orders:** Creating maintenance requests, mapping fields like *Location*, *Asset ID*, and *Issue Description*. * **Emergency Incidents:** Quick\-logging critical safety hazards or active emergencies. * **Safety Reports:** Formulating structured records for reporting injuries, site accidents, or sudden worker illnesses. **3\. Automated Notification Dispatch** * Program automated system triggers upon successful database insertion. * Hook into our existing, platform\-native SMS capabilities to send instant alerts. * Configure conditional routing logic: * *Internal routing:* Auto\-dispatching incident summaries via SMS to the internal **Safety Officer**. * *External routing:* Auto\-dispatching urgent details to designated **outside agencies** depending on the severity and type of incident reported. **Required Developer Qualifications** * **ColdFusion Expertise:** Strong, proven experience working with legacy and modern Adobe ColdFusion (CFML) environments, database connections, and CFCs. * **Speech Recognition \& AI Integration:** Experience working with Speech\-to\-Text APIs, Large Language Models (LLMs) for entity extraction, or AI voice platforms. * **API \& Webhook Development:** Proficient in building and consuming RESTful APIs, JSON parsing, and handling webhook events securely. * **Mobile Web Optimization:** Experience formatting user interfaces that operate reliably on field mobile browsers (iOS \& Android). **Project Timeline \& Milestones (To Be Finalized upon Hire)** * **Milestone 1:** Architecture Design \& Choice of Voice Extraction Pipeline * **Milestone 2:** ColdFusion API Endpoint Creation \& Successful Database Insertion Tests * **Milestone 3:** Core Workflow Deployment (CMMS, Emergencies, Safety Reporting) * **Milestone 4:** SMS Notification Testing, Edge\-Case Debugging, and Final Handover **What We're Looking For** We are looking for someone who can **step into an existing software environment, quickly understand how it works, and contribute immediately**. This is not simply a greenfield development position. The ability to work with established ColdFusion applications, troubleshoot existing functionality, and build reliable integrations is particularly important. **Position:** Software Developer – ColdFusion **Employment Type:** Contract **Location:** Remote **Compensation:** Per Project **To Apply:** Please submit a résumé highlighting your ColdFusion development experience, and examples of relevant software projects. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer (Full\-Stack, AI\-Native)** ====================================================== **Marvin** · Denver/Los Angeles \- Hybrid 2\-day in office · Full\-time · $160k\-190k **About Marvin** ---------------- Marvin helps people navigate their mental health and wellbeing. We partner with employers and health plans to give their members one place to understand their coverage, find care, and get support, including an AI coach built into the product. We're a small team shipping a production healthcare application, which means every engineer touches things that matter and owns them end to end. **The role** ------------ We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer who has made AI a core part of how they build software, not a novelty. This is not a machine learning research role. You won't train models or tune GPUs. You will ship product in a modern TypeScript/Next.js stack, and you'll do it with AI woven into both the product and your own workflow. Two things distinguish this role from a standard senior web position: * **You build with AI.** You've moved well past autocomplete. You direct agentic coding tools to do real, multi\-step work, you know exactly where they break, and you own every line they produce. * **You build AI into the product.** You've shipped LLM\-backed features to real users and lived with them in production: prompts, tool calls, evals, tracing, cost, latency, and failure modes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features end to end across our Next.js/React/TypeScript app, Prisma/Postgres backend, and AWS infrastructure. * Extend our AI coach and build new LLM\-powered member experiences: retrieval over benefits data, structured extraction, guided flows, and agentic tool use against our own APIs. * Design evaluation and observability for AI features so we know when they get worse, not just when they crash. * Push our AI\-assisted development practice forward: agent instructions, reusable skills, hooks, MCP integrations, and review practices that keep quality high as velocity climbs. * Handle sensitive health data responsibly. PHI boundaries, redaction, audit trails, and vendor data agreements are part of the design, not an afterthought. * Review code, whether written by a human or an agent, with a critical eye. Mentor teammates and raise the bar on testing and reliability. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **Core engineering** * 5\+ years building production web applications, with deep TypeScript, React, and Node experience. Next.js is a strong plus. * Comfort across the stack: relational data modeling (we use Prisma and Postgres), auth flows, caching, background jobs, and cloud deployment (AWS, Docker, Terraform or similar). * A real testing habit at every layer: unit, component, and end\-to\-end. We use Vitest, Storybook, Cypress, and Playwright. * Strong product judgment and the ability to work directly with design, clinical, and partner\-facing teammates. **AI fluency (the part that sets you apart)** * Daily, expert use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. You write project instructions and reusable skills for your agents, hand them multi\-step tasks, and review the output like a senior reviewer, not a rubber stamp. * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM features: prompt design and versioning, structured outputs, tool/function calling, streaming UIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, and multi\-turn conversation state. * You've run evals and traced production LLM traffic (LangSmith, Braintrust, Langfuse, or homegrown), and you can explain what changed the last time a model version bumped underneath you. * You understand the cost, latency, and quality triangle and have made real trade\-offs: model selection, caching, prompt compression, and fallback strategies. * Clear\-eyed about limits. You know when an LLM is the wrong tool, how to constrain one when it's the right tool, and how to keep a hallucination from ever reaching a member. **Nice to have** * Healthcare, benefits, or other regulated\-data experience (HIPAA, SOC 2\). * Building MCP servers or internal agent tooling for a team. * Experience with Clerk, Stripe, or Sentry. * Contributions to AI developer tooling, open source or internal. **How we work** --------------- AI is part of our engineering culture, not a side experiment. Our repository ships with agent configuration, we maintain shared skills for code review and security checks, and we expect engineers to spend more of their time on judgment and less on typing. We also expect the opposite discipline: no unreviewed AI\-generated code lands, and "the agent wrote it" is never an explanation for a bug. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- 160\-190k base salary · Equity · Health, dental, and vision · \[401(k)] · Unlimited PTO · Hybrid 2 days/wk in office (LA or Denver) Marvin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Compensation Range: $160K \- $190K

jobs.description: Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** Mass General Brigham Digital supports the clinical, operational, research, and academic missions through secure, reliable, and user\-centered technology services. Digital Research Operations provides specialized platforms, infrastructure, and support services that enable investigators, research staff, trainees, and collaborators to conduct data\-intensive biomedical research across Mass General Brigham. Join our scientific computing team and help researchers unlock the potential of a new, world\-class high\-performance computing platform. By enabling researchers to move from idea to analysis, discovery, validation, and translation more efficiently, the platform supports larger and more complex datasets, more ambitious scientific questions, reproducible and collaborative science, and faster progress toward research findings that can ultimately improve care for our patients. The Senior Manager, HPC Engineering leads the engineering, architecture, reliability, operations, technical roadmap, and ongoing evolution of our high\-performance computing environment. This role is accountable for the technical health of the environment, including compute hardware, high\-speed networking, storage, operating systems, configuration management, scientific software stacks, researcher\-facing applications, automation, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness. The Senior Manager serves as the senior technical owner for HPC and partners closely with the Senior Manager, HPC Researcher Experience to ensure the environment is reliable, scalable, secure, well\-documented, and aligned with current and future researcher needs. This includes maturing core services while advancing new capabilities such as data adjacency, enclave computing, advanced data movement, benchmarking, and emerging scientific computing workflows. The role also manages the Managed Services partner relationship, setting operational expectations and ensuring effective day\-to\-day operations, vendor coordination, maintenance execution, incident response, escalation management, and continuous service improvement Principal Duties and Responsibilities * Own the technical strategy, operating model, reliability, and continuous improvement of the HPC platform, including compute, storage, networking, operating systems, configuration, software, automation, monitoring, and operational standards. * Own the HPC platform architecture and technical roadmap, ensuring that compute, storage, networking, software, automation, security, data adjacency, enclave capabilities, and operational capabilities evolve to meet current and future research needs. * Lead engineering activities for HPC hardware, GPU and CPU compute nodes, high\-speed interconnects, storage systems, network connectivity, operating system images, firmware, drivers, configuration management, and platform lifecycle management. * Own the scientific computing software environment, including schedulers, modules, containers, compilers, libraries, researcher practices, including workload profiling, bottleneck analysis, system tuning, baseline benchmark development, vendor performance validation, and evaluation of emerging technologies to improve platform performance and researcher productivity. * Lead capacity planning and platform lifecycle planning, including utilization forecasting, hardware refresh planning, storage growth analysis, procurement input, and recommendations for future platform investments. * Own change, release, and configuration management practices for the HPC platform, ensuring that system updates, software deployments, security patches, configuration changes, and maintenance activities are planned, tested, documented, and communicated. * Establish engineering practices for platform resilience and operational provisioning, storage provisioning, access controls, environment configuratio r tools, researcher applications, and software lifecycle practices in multi\-user scientific computing environments. * Experience managing managed services providers, vendors, consultants, service\-level expectations, incident coordination, maintenance planning, performance reviews, and escalations in complex technical environments. * Demonstrated ability to lead platform operations, improve reliability, manage incidents, analyze root causes, plan capacity, reduce operational risk, and mature engineering practices using metrics and operational data. * Knowledge of security, HIPAA and privacy principles, compliance, identity and access management, and risk management practices relevant to healthcare or academic research environments preferred. * Familiarity within an Agile/SCRUM process. **Working Model:** * 1\-4 days per week onsite at Assembly Row in Somerville, MA, with an average of at least four days on\-site per month. * A quiet, secure, compliant workspace is required for remote workdays, and will be viewed and confirmed via Microsoft Teams Video on day 1 for all remote and/or hybrid hires * MGB will ensure that candidates have a HIPAA\-compliant workspace **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** **Remote Type** Hybrid **Work Location** 399 Revolution Drive **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 **Employee Type** Regular **Work Shift** Day (United States of America) **Pay Range** $117,707\.20 \- $171,204\.80/Annual **Grade** 8 At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Menlo** Menlo Research is an Applied R\&D lab building Asimov, an open\-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open\-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. **The Role** Asimov is leaving the lab. Teams are buying fleets, commissioning custom builds, and wiring their own agents into a humanoid body. Every one of those deployments needs someone who can make it work on site. That’s you. As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Deployment team, you’ll embed with Menlo’s enterprise customers and own their Asimov deployments end to end, from a scoped use case to a robot doing real work in their environment. You’ll write the integration code, configure the platform, debug the robot on the floor, and bring back what you learn so the next deployment goes faster than the last. You’ll partner with our Enterprise Lead on the customer side, and with Brain, Platform, and Hardware on everything behind it. **What You’ll Do** * Own customer deployments end to end, taking each one from a scoped use case to Asimov running reliably in the customer’s environment * Build integrations that connect customer agents, software, and workflows to Asimov through the Menlo Platform’s Python SDK, control plane APIs, and Agent Platform * Package customer agents for deployment and configure their permissions and safety envelopes, including velocity limits, workspace boundaries, and force constraints, for each site * Prototype and validate tasks in Digital Asimov and simulation before they touch hardware, then bring them up on real robots on site * Stand up deployments on Menlo Cloud or in customer on\-prem environments, working through networking, auth, and real\-time connectivity on the ground * Diagnose problems across the full stack, from actuators and firmware to perception, policies, and agent behavior, using telemetry and logs to fix them or hand them off with a clean repro * Be the customer’s technical point of contact: run onboarding, train their engineers, and set honest expectations on what the robot can and can’t do today * Turn field learnings into product by feeding bugs, missing capabilities, and deployment data back to Platform and Brain, and write the playbooks and tooling that make every future deployment faster * Travel to customer sites whenever a deployment needs hands on the robot **What We Look For** * You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions, or field engineering role, ideally on physical systems like robotics, autonomy, or industrial automation * You write production\-quality Python, live comfortably in Linux, and can read C\+\+ when that’s where the bug lives * You know your way around ROS 2, Docker, and networking, because robots on customer Wi\-Fi are their own adventure * You’ve debugged systems in the field where the problem could be software, hardware, network, or the environment itself, and you found it * You can explain a policy failure to a customer’s operations lead and walk our engineers through a stack trace in the same afternoon * You take ownership: you’d rather unblock the customer tonight and ship the clean fix tomorrow than wait for perfect * You use AI as a real collaborator in your day to day work **Nice to Have** * Experience connecting LLM agents or agent frameworks to physical systems * Hands\-on time with humanoids, legged robots, or manipulators * Familiarity with simulation tools like Isaac Sim or MuJoCo, and the realities of sim\-to\-real * Comfort with embedded and hardware debugging: motor drivers, CAN, sensors, power * Experience with WebRTC or real\-time media infrastructure such as LiveKit * Experience with enterprise on\-prem deployments, security reviews, or IT integration * Time as one of the first customer\-facing engineers at an early\-stage startup **Why Join Menlo** You’ll sit where every Menlo system meets the real world: the agent platform, simulation, policy training, the Asimov hardware, and the data engine. Deployments are where the robot gets tested for real, and what you learn on site directly shapes what we build next. Small team, real robots, open source by default, and customers who are betting on us early. If you want to be the person who makes humanoid labor work outside the lab, come build it with us. **A Note on AI** You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. **Equal Opportunity and Accommodations** We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.
