jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Enterprise Apps & Architecture
jobs.description: **About NovaSource** NovaSource Power Services is the world’s \#1\-ranked solar operations and maintenance (O\&M) provider and insight\-driven total asset optimization partner for renewables asset owners ready to fuel smart growth. With over 20 years of operating experience and a presence on 5 continents, NovaSource has the global reach and strategic capabilities to achieve our clients’ renewables goals around the world. NovaSource’s comprehensive approach to total asset optimization in addition to O\&M services includes value engineering, performance analysis, strategic supply chain management, and advanced monitoring systems. The company operates in key global markets managing over 30GW of solar power plants. NovaSource’s expertise extends beyond solar and includes battery energy storage systems (BESS), offering a complete suite of services for the evolving renewable energy landscape. **About the role** ================== NovaSource Power Services is looking for a Senior Manager to lead our Enterprise Applications team and own enterprise architecture governance across the company. You will be accountable for the application platforms that run our business, including ServiceMax, Dynamics 365 Business Central, the Azure integration layer, Zoho and our Microsoft low\-code estate, and for the team that runs them as products. You will chair our Architecture Review Board, set the standards that every new design must meet, and own the vendor relationships that deliver and support the stack. You will also lead our order to cash transformation program, which is moving billing from spreadsheet\-driven processes to system\-governed automation, and shape the application roadmap that follows it. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will make architecture and scope decisions, hold vendors to their commitments, develop your team, and report program value to executive leadership. **What you will do** ==================== **Lead the platforms** ---------------------- * Own the health, cost and roadmap of the enterprise application stack, and set the platform strategy and sequencing of program phases. * Run the platforms as products, with business product owners prioritizing what is built and technical product owners approving production releases. * Manage the Azure run cost for the integration layer and the licensing position for each platform, with budget alerts and a quarterly review. **Govern the architecture** --------------------------- * Chair the Architecture Review Board, maintain the architecture decision records and integration standard, and decide which designs proceed to build. * Define and maintain use\-case tiers and control sets for automation and AI, so approval effort is proportionate to risk. * Personally review integration designs, data ownership decisions and platform choices, and challenge vendor designs before build rather than after. * Own the target state for the application landscape and keep the current\-state inventory accurate. **Deliver through vendors** --------------------------- * Own statements of work for the stack, including authoring scope, negotiating commercials, holding vendors to milestones and acceptance criteria, and managing change control. * Accept or reject vendor deliverables against defined acceptance criteria, and escalate early when milestones are at risk. * Own the transition of every delivered component into support, including documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer. **Run operations and support** ------------------------------ * Own the application support service, including its scope, service levels and the quarterly review with the provider. * Set and enforce the release management process and change record across the team and vendors. No production change happens outside the record. * Ensure every integration has a named owner, monitoring, alerting and a replay procedure. **Build the team** ------------------ * Manage the technical product owners and analysts. Set objectives, develop capability and plan succession for each platform. * Establish the Business Central technical function, which does not exist today, around the new product owner. **Deliver value** ----------------- * Report program value to leadership against baseline measures, including credit memo reduction, manual touch count and unbilled aging. * Maintain the business case for each program phase and bring the next phase to leadership with scope, cost and expected return. **Decision rights** =================== **You decide** Architecture and integration standards. Vendor scope and acceptance. The operating model, release process and change record. What the Architecture Review Board approves. Platform roadmap sequencing within approved budget. **You recommend** Program investment and phasing. Platform licensing and tooling spend. Team structure and hiring. **Others decide** Business priorities and contract interpretation stay with the business product owners. Individual production releases ar e Architecture Review Board before build. * Credit memo reduction is tracked against baseline and reported to leadership quarterly. * Business Central technical ownership is established and the configuration of record is current for both platforms. * Future phases are scoped, priced and approved. **What you will bring** ======================= **Required** ------------ * Ten or more years in enterprise applications, including at least three years leading a team that owns platforms rather than projects. * Experience chairing or running an architecture governance forum and maintaining its decision records. * A track record of owning vendor\-delivered programs end to end, including authoring scope, negotiating fixed\-price statements of work and managing acceptance. * The ability to read an integration design, a data model and a statement of work and identify the problems in each. * Experience running a release management process with a change record across more than one platform. * Experience managing an application support provider against service levels. **Preferred** ------------- * Salesforce or ServiceMax, and Dynamics 365 Business Central. * Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Service Bus) and Power Platform governance. * Background in field service, energy or asset management. * Experience establishing governance for AI and automation use cases, including human review controls for agents that write to systems of record. * Order to cash or billing process experience. **Who you are** =============== * Decisive. You make architecture and scope decisions with incomplete information and document your reasoning. * Firm. You hold vendors and your team to process and acceptance criteria when schedules are under pressure. * A clear writer. Your scope documents, decision records and executive reports are plain enough for non\-technical readers to act on. * A translator. You move comfortably between billing analysts, field operations, finance and engineers. * A developer of people. You grow technical product owners into platform leaders. **Location and travel** ======================= This role is based in Chandler, AZ or Houston, TX. We will consider remote candidates with travel to Chandler as the work requires, typically one week a month during program delivery, plus occasional site visits. The role works with offshore delivery teams, so some early morning availability is expected. **Office Physical Requirements:** All positions in our office require interaction with people and technology while either standing or sitting. In order to best service our customers, internal and external, all associates must be able to communicate face\-to\-face and on the phone with or without reasonable accommodation. NovaSource is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship. *Potential candidates will meet the education and experience requirements provided on the above job description and excel in completing the listed responsibilities for this role.* **US: Diversity Statement – Equal Employment Opportunity** It is NovaSource’s policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees. NovaSource disapproves of, and will not tolerate, unlawful discrimination against any applicant or employee because of race, color, national origin or ancestry, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, age, religion, disability, family care status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal laws.

jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing
jobs.description: Post\-training \- San Francisco **About the Team** The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Personal AGI organization. Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long\-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT. Our recent work includes Beneficial RL, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations. **About the Role** We’re looking for an exceptional, hands\-on researcher to turn difficult\-to\-define signals of long\-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship. We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post\-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required. **In this role, you will** * Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long\-term goals. * Lead high\-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard\-to\-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models. * Build RL environments for difficult\-to\-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings. * Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss. * Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long\-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training. * Build new 0 1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test\-time compute. * Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements. * Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users. **You might thrive in this role if you** * Care deeply about helping AI improve people’s lives, and feel this is a responsibility that comes with increasingly capable models. * Have an unusually strong research record in pretraining or RL / post\-training research, especially in a hard\-to\-verify area; or combine strong LLM research skills with deep expertise in education, mental health, or a related field of human benefit. * Are a hands\-on builder who can turn ideas into rigorous experiments, write and debug code, and work directly with data and training infrastructure. * Have the taste to choose consequential problems and actionable steps on the path to solving those problems. * Take ownership of ambiguous problems and choose methods based on the impact they can deliver, including when the most useful work is unglamorous. * Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world—not just whether it can be shown in a paper or prototype. * Work well across disciplines and can grok the most important bottlenecks to scaling our impact in a multidisciplinary problem. If you’re excited about ensuring AI systems advance human flourishing, we’d love to hear from you. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. **Compensation** $380K – $500K \+ Offers Equity The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance\-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre\-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non\-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non\-exempt employees * 13\+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer\-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided. More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process. This role is at\-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Platforms That Healthcare Depends On Behind every dependable healthcare application is infrastructure that has to work. Oracle Health’s Core Platform Operations (CPO) team supports the core platforms that help run Millennium, spanning Linux infrastructure, Application Tier, WebSphere, Distributed File Systems, Business Objects, and Citrix. Our mission is to keep these platforms reliable, secure, and ready for the healthcare organizations that depend on them, while making them easier to maintain and improve. Our work connects Linux engineering with the behavior of the services running above it. You might trace a performance issue through a server and its middleware dependencies, improve a health check, or turn a repeated maintenance task into reusable automation. Across the team, we use rolling maintenance and canary environments to introduce changes with care. Current initiatives also include developing maintenance orchestration to reduce manual effort and human error. You’ll collaborate with application, networking, security, and infrastructure partners, learn how the pieces fit together, and help turn difficult operational problems into better engineering. Your Role As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll manage, maintain, and enhance physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments. You’ll bring deep technical judgment to system configuration, performance tuning, security patching, capacity planning, and complex troubleshooting, while helping shape the standards and tools the team uses every day. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities. You’ll guide engineering decisions, mentor colleagues, and turn operational findings into lasting improvements. You’ll also participate in on\-call support and serve as an escalation resource for the services within your scope. Why This Work Is Worth Doing If you enjoy following a problem from an application symptom down to the Linux processes, network connections, or resource constraints behind it, there is plenty to explore here. You’ll have opportunities to build useful tools, influence how infrastructure is operated, and see your improvements make daily work better for other engineers. Bring your curiosity, share what you learn, and help us solve the next problem more effectively than the last. What You Will Do * Engineer and operate Linux infrastructure. Configure, update, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments, with a focus on availability, performance, stability, and security. * Guide reliable design. Evaluate infrastructure configurations and service dependencies, identify failure points, and recommend practical improvements to reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Understand and improve performance. Analyze CPU, memory, storage, filesystem, process, and network behavior. Forecast resource needs, investigate bottlenecks, and tune systems using measured results. * Strengthen monitoring. Improve metrics, logging, health checks, and actionable alerts. Use service trends and service\-level objectives to identify degradation and prioritize engineering work. * Resolve complex incidents. Apply a methodical approach to diagnosis across operating systems, applications, networking, storage, and related dependencies. Coordinate with partner teams to restore service and communicate findings clearly. * Prevent recurring failures. Perform root cause analysis and post\-incident reviews. Translate findings into corrective actions, better diagnostics, runbooks, and engineering improvements. * Maintain secure systems. Apply security patches and updates, remediate vulnerabilities, strengthen configurations and access controls, and maintain compliance with applicable security standards and policies. * Make production changes safely. Plan maintenance, assess dependencies and risk, prepare rollback procedures, and validate system and application behavior after changes. * Automate repeatable work. Develop, test, document, and maintain Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable automation for configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and recovery. Use version control and peer review to keep changes traceable and maintainable. * Support application delivery. Partner with developers, network engineers, security teams, and other IT staff on deployments, environment readiness, connectivity, and server\-related requirements. * Improve resilience and recovery. Help validate backup, restore, and recovery procedures for assigned systems, and address gaps that could delay service restoration. * Build team capability. Maintain architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and change records. Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and communicate technical risks and recommendations to stakeholders. * Contribute to dependable support coverage. Participate in on\-call rotations and planned maintenance, provide escalation support for assigned services, and improve the documentation and tooling that make support more effective. What You Will Bring * Extensive hands\-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems in production, including physical and virtual server environments. * Strong knowledge of Linux internals, system services, processes, permissions, filesystems, logs, and resource utilization, with the ability to investigate performance and stability issues. * Practical scripting and automation experience with Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable tools, including testing, troubleshooting, and maintaining reusable solutions. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ports, certificates, and connectivity troubleshooting across application and infrastructure dependencies. * Experience with security patching, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, access controls, and production change management. * Experience monitoring system health, responding to incidents, investigating root causes, and implementing improvements that reduce recurring problems. * Demonstrated technical leadership through sound engineering decisions, cross\-team collaboration, mentoring, and clear documentation. * A curious, methodical approach to problem solving and the ability to explain findings, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps to technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience That Would Help You Get Started * Experience supporting Oracle Health, Millennium, Cerner applications, or other healthcare or regulated production environments. * Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or other cloud platforms, hybrid environments, and infrastructure modernization. * Familiarity with middleware and application hosting, including WebSphere or WebLogic, and the Linux infrastructure those services depend on. * Experience with configuration management, infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, REST APIs, observability, or resilience and recovery testing.

This position is focused on structural evaluation, repair engineering, and long\-term asset management planning. In this role, you will serve as Orbital's engineering resource to validate our inspector's findings and translate inspection findings into sound engineering solutions to support the client in making informed, risk\-based decisions about their structural assets. Essential Functions Structural Engineering \& Assessment * Serve as the primary engineering resource for structural asset evaluations, applying engineering judgment to assess condition, identify deficiencies, and prioritize corrective actions. * Review , interpret and validate structural inspection findings generated by the program's inspection team, translating field data into engineering evaluations and recommendations. * Verify conditions, gather supplemental information, and inform engineering decisions. * Prepare engineering reports, condition assessments, and technical recommendations for review by the client and Orbital's project team. * Rank and prioritize the criticality of necessary repairs based on client standards. Repair Engineering \& Design * Develop repair scopes and capital recommendations based on engineering evaluations, condition assessments, and client priorities. * Prepare calculations, designs, and repair drawings in support of identified repair and improvement projects. * Coordinate with Orbital's office engineering team to ensure repair solutions are technically sound, code\-compliant, and aligned with client requirements. * Provide engineering support during repair execution as needed — answering RFIs, reviewing submittals, and resolving field conditions. Asset Management \& Planning * Support long\-term asset management planning by contributing engineering expertise to condition assessments, maintenance strategies, and capital planning initiatives. * Maintain accurate records of engineering evaluations, calculations, and repair histories to support Asset Management databases and long\-term tracking. * Identify recurring deficiency patterns and develop proactive engineering recommendations to support the client's long\-term asset reliability goals. * Contribute to the continued growth and improvement of Orbital's Asset Management and Repair Services capabilities. Safety, Quality \& Compliance * Comply with all Orbital, client, OSHA, MSHA, and site\-specific safety requirements. * Complete all work in accordance with applicable codes, standards, and Orbital's Quality Management System (QMS). * Participate in pre\-job planning, job hazard analyses (JHAs), and safety meetings as required. * Promote consistency, repeatability, and continuous improvement in engineering execution and documentation quality. Team \& Client Coordination * Serve as the structural engineering point of contact for the client's operations, maintenance, and engineering teams. * Maintain strong working relationships with client personnel and Orbital's field\- and office\-based project leadership. * Communicate engineering findings, recommendations, and project status clearly to both engineering and non\-engineering audiences. * Support proposal development, estimating, and scope definition as needed. Other Duties Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities required of this position. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice. Qualifications Minimum Requirements * Bachelor of Science in Civil or Structural Engineering from an accredited college or university. * Minimum five (5\) years of professional structural engineering experience in industrial environments. * Experience with structural steel, reinforced concrete, masonry, and/or foundation systems. * Experience in asset\-intensive industries such as power generation, oil and gas, refining, chemical processing, manufacturing, steel, mining, or materials processing. * Demonstrated ability to independently develop engineering evaluations, repair designs, and capital recommendations from inspection and condition assessment data. * Ability to work independently while maintaining effective communication with an office\-based support team. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to prepare clear calculations, technical reports, and recommendations for varied audiences. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and engineering software; experience with STAAD or equivalent structural analysis software a plus. Preferred Qualifications * Professional Engineer (PE) license, or ability and intent to obtain licensure. * Experience supporting Asset Management, Asset Integrity, Mechanical Integrity (MI), or Risk\-Based Inspection (RBI) programs. * Familiarity with digital inspection platforms and asset management systems. * Experience providing engineering support during repair and construction execution. Location Note This is a remote work role. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's qualifications and experience. Salary Range $90,000\-140,000 annually (based on experience, qualifications, and location) Benefits A commitment to excellence and hard work will be rewarded with a competitive salary, career advancement opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work\-life balance. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)\-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company\-paid life and AD\&D insurance, company\-paid short\-term disability coverage, company\-paid maternity and bonding leave, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally. About Orbital Powered by People, Driven by Solutions Since 1969, Orbital has been specializing in project development, project execution, and asset management for the heavy industrial sectors and utilities. Our regional offices, hands\-on mentality, and world\-wide integrated teams provide an ability to leverage subject matter experts and industry best practices wherever a project may lie geographically. Our focus steadfastly remains on finding and delivering the best solution, regardless of where that team sits across our organization. At Orbital, our power is our people. Equal Opportunity Statement We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. STRUC002551 \#LI\-CV1

jobs.title: Expert Grid Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: Requisition ID \# 175242 **Job Category:** Engineering / Science **Job Level:** Individual Contributor **Business Unit:** Strategy \& Growth **Work Type:** Hybrid **Job Location:** Oakland Department Overview At PG\&E we’re reimagining the future of energy—and we need passionate, purpose\-driven professionals to help us get there. As part of Grid Research Innovation \& Development (GRID) team, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming California’s electric system to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving energy landscape. In 2022, PG\&E launched its True North Strategy (TNS) , a bold 10\-year vision to advance our breakthrough commitments to people, climate, and prosperity. Innovation on our high voltage electric transmission system is a critical component of reaching our TNS vision, with the sharp rise of interconnection requests from large\-load customers, especially data centers , creating significant opportunities to reduce rates through beneficial load growth. The GRID department is focused on bringing technologies and solutions that support the implementation of TNS from conception to reality. The Innovation Framework \& Execution (IF\&E) team plays a critical role within GRID by enhancing PG\&E’s capacity to assess, test, and deploy novel solutions and technologies. The team is comprised of experienced innovation practitioners that are directly embedded into some of our highest priority R\&D initiatives, including transmission innovation, to drive successful outcomes and accelerate new technologies’ paths to scaling. Position Summary We’re seeking a curious, tenacious professional to support cross\-departmental innovation efforts on PG\&E’s electric transmission grid. This role is ideal for someone who has built a strong foundation in electric power systems and has developed a product\-oriented mind\- and skill set. In this position you’ll have a unique opportunity to influence how California's transmission grid evolves to support electrification, data center growth, and emerging energy technologies. Successful solutions developed in this role may influence future transmission planning and operational practices within PG\&E and across the utility industry. The successful candidate will begin their assignment with a six\-month rotation in Transmission Planning to deepen their understanding of PG\&E's planning processes, tools, and interconnection challenges before transitioning into the Grid Innovation role to apply those insights to transmission innovation initiatives. This is a highly collaborative role that requires empathy, technical fluency, and a systems\-thinking approach. You’ll be a connector breaking complex challenges into actionable solutions, bridging transmission planning with real\-time operations, and technical ingenuity with customer needs. This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location is in Oakland, CA. The team has an expectation of working from Oakland office up to several days per month. Also, the role will require up to 20% travel throughout PG\&E’s service territory. PG\&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs. **Bay Area Minimum:** $140,000\.00 **Bay Area Midpoint:** $189,000\.00 **Bay Area Maximum:** $238,000\.00 Reporting Relationship This position will have a matrixed reporting structure. You will primarily report to the Manager of Innovation Framework \& Execution, with additional reporting responsibilities to leaders within Transmission Planning and Large Load Development teams. You will collaborate closely with Transmission Operations and Local Customer Engagement teams. Job Responsibilities Lead innovation for transmission grid transformation Drive the assessment and development of new technologies and processes to expand grid capacity and flexibility Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, and vendors to evaluate and iterate on innovative new solutions Benchmark industry best\-practices for large\-load interconnections, especially data centers Keep the customer experience at the center of every solution Develop business plans that articulate the expected benefits and costs of innovative solutions, with a close eye on rate and systems impacts Translate technical findings into compelling executive summaries that inform enterprise decision\-making Pilot, learn, and scale novel transmission solutions Stand up cross\-functional teams and project governance to pilot novel technology pilots with real impacts on large\-load customers Translate complex discussions with inherent uncertainty into tactical checklists of clear next steps, following PG\&E’s Lean Operating System Facilitate cross\-functional evaluations of pilot outcomes and develop recommendations for scaling successful solutions Evaluate solution feasibility, operational readiness, and scalability, and develop implementation roadmaps from concept through deployment Support broader transmission innovation initiatives Flexibly jump in to support emerging relevant priorities across GRID Act as transmission innovation subject matter expert during PG\&E\-hosted events such as Pitch Fest Qualifications **Minimum:** Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or equivalent experience Experience with grid modeling software (e.g. CYMDIST, PSLF, TARA, Aspen, or similar tools) 7 years of electric utility related experience **Desired:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering 8\+ years of electric utility, transmission planning, transmission operations, or related power systems experience Previous experience in power flow, short circuit, and transient studies Previous experience with writing code using Python and EPCL Familiarity with NERC TPL\-001\-05, MOD\-26, and MOD\-32 standards Experience with grid digital twins, AI/ML applications, and advanced analytics Experience evaluating DERMS, EMS, ADMS, or grid flexibility management platforms Experience supporting large\-load, hyperscale, or data center interconnections Experience evaluating emerging technologies, startups, or conducting technical due diligence Technology innovation, R\&D, or pilot deployment experience Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering or related field preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Ability to lead and influence cross\-functional technical teams and project stakeholders Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, actionable insights for audiences at all levels. Ability to adapt to change and quickly pivot, with a strong bias for action and results Ability to be creative, versatile, efficient, and productive in the face of ambiguity and change Ability to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives that impact multiple business functions Ability to rigorously define and enforce prioritization of feature development, defeating scope creep and delivering the most impactful iterative results

**Cross\-Functional Influence:** Partner with Product, Security, and Cloud Architecture teams to align technology roadmaps with long\-term business goals. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 9\+ years of software engineering experience with 4\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and delivering production\-grade AI/LLM features, RAG platforms, and agentic architectures. * **GCP \& Cloud Native:** Extensive hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Vertex AI, BigQuery, DataFlow, BigTable, and GKE. * **Agentic Orchestration \& AI Frameworks:** Deep expertise with modern agentic architectures (multi\-agent orchestration, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, task planning, state management, long\-term memory systems) using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or custom agent engines. * **Data Engineering \& Vector Search:** Proven background in data engineering, building streaming/batch pipelines (DataFlow, Apache Beam, Spark), and fine\-tuning vector search architectures (Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, PGVector, Milvus). * **Core Languages:** Mastery in Python and Java/Scala with a strong focus on high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive, and fault\-tolerant system design. * **Streaming \& Messaging:** Expert knowledge of distributed event streaming platforms (Google Pub/Sub, Kafka) and asynchronous event\-driven system architecture. * **DevOps, MLOps \& CI/CD:** Hands\-on experience with MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, continuous evaluation CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Vertex AI Pipelines), model monitoring, tracing (LangSmith, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry), and deployment patterns. * **Security \& Governance:** Deep understanding of data privacy, prompt injection prevention, access control, encryption, and governance in enterprise cloud AI environments. * **Containerization:** Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE), service meshes, and microservices architecture. * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Accounts
jobs.description: PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America's leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them. We're always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting\-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it's through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we're excited to push the boundaries of what's possible. These state\-of\-the\-art platforms are powered by proprietary in\-house technology, a key component of PENN's omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy. When you join PENN Entertainment's digital team, you'll not only work on these cutting\-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you'll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We're committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities. With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you. **About the Team** As part of the Accounts team, you will be working with a group of talented and friendly individuals. Our goal is to deliver and maintain the performant, resilient, accurate, best\-in\-class software platform to drive player registration and authentication, identity verification (KYC), fraud and AML checks, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming enforcement, regulatory enforcement, and player communications (push, email, SMS) that is at the core of everything we do as a company. As a result, our stakeholders span the entire range of the business, and we must support them with whatever they are required to deliver without sacrificing the quality and performance we strive to maintain. This will include building a lot of cross\-service integrations, with internal and external stakeholders. We are also hyper\-vigilant about software performance, resilience, reliability, and accuracy, constantly tracking risks and regressions on all fronts, and proposing improvements where opportunities exist. The systems we own are among the most business\-critical at PENN: every player signup, login, identity check, and responsible gaming decision runs through them, and getting them right is a regulatory obligation, not just an engineering goal. **About the Work** * Design, scale, and performance\-tune REST APIs, low\-latency gRPC services, and SQL queries powering player registration and authentication (OAuth2, MFA, biometrics), identity verification, fraud and AML screening, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming and self\-exclusion enforcement, regulatory reporting, and player notifications, among other things. * Own technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, drafting proposals and presenting them to leadership and partner teams for feedback * Design, architect, and deliver new features end\-to\-end in a collaborative agile/scrum environment * Identify bottlenecks and areas of risk in production, and drive the changes that make the platform more scalable * Set up and refine monitoring and alerting in Datadog for the systems you own * Mentor engineers on the team and across teams that ship into our codebase, through specs, pairing, and code review * Interact with multiple stakeholders across a wide variety of business domains to deliver best in class products, operational improvements, and cost efficiency optimizations. * Be comfortable with bridging the gap between internal, third party (identity verification, fraud, geolocation, and messaging vendors), legacy, and modern systems; and excel at doing what this entails, including, data migrations, intermediate data translation, the building and stewardship of additional supporting infrastructure as required, etc. * Other duties as required. **About You** * You possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in Software engineering * A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, distributed systems, algorithms, and software design * Strong grasp of production systems at scale, and experience identifying areas of improvement in a production environment through load testing and tracing * Experience investigating and remediating production performance regressions, including CPU, I/O, and memory hotspots as well as latency regressions in high\-throughput services * Experience with on\-call rotations for a production service, including owning release cycles end\-to\-end * Passionate about clean code architecture and software craftsmanship * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring tech specs, runbooks, and cross\-team design docs that stand up to scrutiny * Experience with modern web frameworks and API development (Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, Laravel, Node) * A strong grasp of relational databases, including PostgreSQL and MySQL. Additionally, a strong understanding of relational database theory, including, but not limited to, normalization and denormalization, particularly from a flexibility vs performance mindset, is a major asset. * Experience with Kubernetes and comfort operating services in a containerized environment * Comfortable working in the terminal, with Git and GitHub or similar, and in an editor of your choice * Experience with testing frameworks such as ExUnit, RSpec, Jest, pytest, or equivalent * Experience with background job processing (Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery, Beanstalkd) * Experience with asynchronous event handling infrastructure (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Google Cloud Pub/Sub) * Experience with agentic software development tools, building and using agentic workflows, and validating quality of agentic outputs is a major asset. * Experience with building authentication, identity, or other regulated systems with strong security and auditability is paramount. * Strong understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, MFA) and secure handling of PII. * Experience integrating third\-party KYC, fraud, geolocation, or messaging providers (e.g., push, email, SMS) is an asset. NICE TO HAVE: * Experience building applications in Elixir, hexagonal architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, contribution to open source software, experience working at startups, passion for sports and/or esports * Experience with building financial, legal, and / or process accounting systems with strong correctness and auditability * Experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas for product surfaces used by multiple clients (iOS, Android, Web) is an asset. * Experience building and integrating multi\-client / white\-label platforms, including geo\-based routing and per\-jurisdiction configuration * Familiarity with gaming regulatory requirements across jurisdictions (e.g., AGCO, DGE) and responsible gaming controls is an asset. **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation package * Fun, relaxed work environment * Education and conference reimbursements. * Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others \#LI\-REMOTE *Penn Interactive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Penn Interactive provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non\-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Penn Interactive provides best\-in\-class benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That's why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.*

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines. Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work? * Entity: Corporate * Department: PennDnA Data Science * Location: 8hr Days * Hours: Remote based out of 3535 Market St. Philadelphia, PA **Summary:** Working with a team of data scientists and ML engineers, this Lead Machine Learning (ML) Software Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of cutting\-edge software for machine learning models and algorithms. The goal is to drive impactful insights and solutions across various healthcare domains, such as enhancing patient care, operational efficiency, and research endeavors. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software engineering, machine learning infrastructure, and a deep understanding of healthcare data. They will be recognized as a subject matter expert in domain(s), independently lead projects, build relationships with clients and senior leaders and mentor junior members of the team. **Responsibilities:** * Leadership \& Strategy: Contribute strategic direction and technical leadership for machine learning software engineering, including the development and execution of innovative software standards and solutions for ML initiatives. Help define and uphold the long\-term vision and technical standards for software engineering initiatives, aligning them with organizational objectives and industry best practices. Contribute to the creation of technical standards for Penn Medicine’s AI governance and review of both vendor and internal capabilities. * Systems and Software Engineering: Leverage proprietary and open\-source tools and frameworks to develop ML systems and software applications. Design and implement scalable and modular software architectures, emphasizing maintainability and extensibility. Develop core capabilities for ML training, development, deployment and monitoring. Develop integrations with health system applications (e.g. Epic), systems and both on\-prem and cloud infrastructure. Responsible for continuous integration and continuous delivery of production code. Independently lead projects from concept to execution, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, as needed. * Model Deployment and Monitoring: Develop and enforce the technical standards for deployment of machine learning models for healthcare applications. Contribute to the deployment and monitoring of ML capabilities based on emerging technologies, trends and methodologies. Lead the design and development of tools for active monitoring of models and ML applications. Help maintain and optimize production models and applications. * Data Sourcing and Integration: Work with ML and data engineers to build robust and maintainable data pipelines for model development, validation, and deployment. Ensure seamless data integration and flow with health system applications that supports the scalability and efficiency of ML models and analytics platforms. * Collaboration: Build relationships with PennDnA and client stakeholders, including senior leaders. Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including data scientists, data and ML engineers, clinicians, administrators, and product managers, to define project requirements and develop solutions that meet organizational needs. This collaboration aims not only to advance healthcare technology but also to drive significant improvements in patient outcomes and operational efficiencies, demonstrating the tangible impact of our work. Provide subject matter expert review, guidance and consultation. * Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Stay current with emerging industry trends, best practices, and technologies in ML software engineering. Contribute to a culture of performance excellence. Actively seeks and applies feedback from others to strengthen capabilities. * Performs duties in accordance with Penn Medicine and entity values, policies, and procedures * Other duties as assigned to support the unit, department, entity, and health system organization * Other duties as assigned to support the unit, department, entity, and health system organization **Education or Equivalent Experience:** * Bachelor of Arts or Science Computer science or a related field with a focus on machine learning or data science (Required) * And 5\+ years Experience and expertise in software engineering and infrastructure to support development and deployment of machine learning models and applications. Proven track record of independently leading projects from concept to execution, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, as needed. (Required) * Master of Arts or Science Computer science or a related field with a focus on machine learning or data science (Preferred) * 1\+ years healthcare analytics (Preferred) We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives. Live Your Life's Work We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better\-aligned superintelligences. Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives. We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us. Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. **About the Role** ================== An RL environment is only useful once it runs reliably inside a lab's training stack. Every environment we build has to be packaged, sandboxed, run at scale, checked against each lab's requirements, and delivered in the format that lab's platform expects. Much of that work is still manual today, and it takes time away from the people designing environments. As an **MTS on our ML Platform team**, you will own the systems that take an environment from a builder's repo to a lab's training run. That includes Karotte, our open\-source framework for defining RL environments, the internal platform that builds, runs, and reviews environments on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and the integrations that deliver them to each lab we work with. This is a **senior ML platform engineering role** where you will ensure what our Capabilities team builds runs and ships cleanly. You'll join a small Platform team and work directly with environment builders and post\-training researchers. In your first six months, success looks like a delivery path to each partner lab that is mostly automated: tasks marked ready get built, validated against that lab's requirements, and packaged without hand work. Our needs change quickly, so you'll also pick up other platform and infrastructure work as priorities shift. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Own the integrations that deliver our environments to partner labs: build container images, match each lab's submission format, and automate the checks that confirm requirements are met before anything ships. Do the delivery work by hand where you have to, then automate it. * Build and maintain Karotte, our open\-source environment framework, from API design through releases and migrations that keep existing environments working. * Run and scale the infrastructure that builds, runs, and grades environments, including containerized rollouts and grading across CPU, GPU, and TPU, VM\-based sandboxing, and the resource limits and isolation that stop a model from gaming its own grader. * Build the internal tools environment builders use every day (CLI, docs, data catalog, access controls, and run monitoring) so they spend their time on environment design instead of infrastructure. * Partner with environment builders and post\-training researchers to turn recurring pain points into platform features, and ship quickly in response to their feedback. **What We are Looking For** =========================== * **5\+ years of experience** building and owning ML Platform Engineering, ideally AI related ML Platform Engineering * Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of building and operating production infrastructure or developer platforms that other engineers depend on. * Hands\-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) and at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or similar). * A working understanding of how to run untrusted code safely: isolation, resource limits, and what happens when a process fills the disk or refuses to exit. * You've owned something tedious end to end, such as a migration, a release process, or a delivery pipeline, and automated away as much of it as you could. * Extensive hands\-on use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and an intuition for where models cut corners. * Proficiency in Python, including writing libraries and APIs that other people build on. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building RL environments, eval harnesses, or agent benchmarks (Terminal\-Bench, SWE\-bench, or similar). * Familiarity with RL post\-training and inference stacks (verl, Ray, SkyPilot, vLLM, SGLang, or similar). **You may be a good fit if one of the following applies** ========================================================= * You've built sandbox or code\-execution infrastructure (microVMs such as Firecracker, gVisor, or similar) at an infrastructure startup or frontier lab. * You've been an early platform or infrastructure engineer at a startup and built the internal platform the rest of engineering relied on. * You've worked as a forward deployed or integrations engineer, getting your company's software running inside customers' own environments. * You've built developer tooling or internal platforms used by ML researchers, even outside a formal ML role. * You've maintained an open\-source developer framework with real external users. **What We Offer:** ================== * Competitive cash and equity compensation (\>90th percentile) * Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment * Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers * Health, vision, dental, benefits * 401K match * Lunch provided everyday onsite * Weekly snack orders * Visa sponsorship \& relocation support available **We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.** Compensation Range: $180K \- $350K

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Premier Global Links LLC is recruiting on behalf of a confidential, high\-growth AI technology company transforming the automotive repair industry. Its AI\-powered platform helps automotive repair professionals improve parts estimation, streamline workflows, and make more accurate decisions. We are seeking a customer\-focused **Product Engineer**with strong full\-stack development skills, backend expertise, and a product\-oriented mindset. This role offers the opportunity to build and launch products for the North American market, work directly with customers, and take ownership of features from initial concept through production. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and ship full\-stack product features from idea to production. * Build backend services and user\-facing applications, with a strong emphasis on backend engineering. * Work directly with collision repair shops, estimators, and parts managers to understand customer needs and workflow challenges. * Translate customer feedback into product improvements and practical technical solutions. * Build rapid prototypes and test new product ideas using AI\-assisted development tools and Python. * Help evolve successful prototypes into robust, production\-ready software. * Own product outcomes, adoption metrics, and the customer value delivered by your features. * Make informed trade\-offs between engineering complexity, development speed, and product impact. * Help users transition from manual workflows to AI\-assisted and supervised automation. * Collaborate with product and engineering teammates to build and scale solutions for the North American market. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software. * Strong full\-stack development experience, with backend engineering expertise preferred. * Demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end features, from concept and implementation through deployment and performance evaluation. * Strong product judgment and the ability to influence what gets built, not simply execute predefined specifications. * Experience building rapid prototypes using AI\-assisted development tools. * Interest in working **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience at an early\-stage or rapidly scaling startup, ideally alongside experience at an established engineering organization. * Experience building products for consumers or businesses outside the technology sector. * Familiarity with statically typed programming languages. * Production experience with Rust. * Experience with Python and AI\-assisted prototyping. * Hardware\-focused engineering experience or exposure to automotive, repair, or industrial workflows. * Founder or early\-engineering experience with a strong record of delivering grows. jobs.title: Director of Security
jobs.description: ### **About Prophecy** The leader in AI\-native data preparation and analysis, Prophecy is revolutionizing how the world's top enterprises turn data chaos into reliable insights. We introduce the AI\-native data lifecycle (generate, refine, deploy) where our industry\-leading AI agents and humans work hand\-in\-hand in visual and document interfaces to analyze, transform, and prepare data to ship trusted insights at enterprise scale. Join us as we build the next data revolution. ### **About The Role** Prophecy is entrusted by some of the world's largest organizations, including leading banks and telecoms, to handle sensitive, business\-critical data. We've built a strong security foundation to earn that trust, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II reports, and now we're hiring our first dedicated security leader to take it to the next level, especially as AI agents become central to how our customers work with their data. You'll own security end\-to\-end and lead a small team of security engineers and IT staff as a player\-coach: setting strategy while doing much of the hands\-on work yourself. You will be responsible for product and AI security, cloud and infrastructure security, compliance, and customer trust, along with the corporate security strategy that supports them. You'll partner closely with our engineering teams across the US and India, and with our go\-to\-market team as they sell into some of the world's most security\-conscious enterprises. This role reports directly to the CTO. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Security Strategy and Program** * Own Prophecy's security strategy and roadmap across product, cloud infrastructure, and corporate environments. * Build and scale the security program, including policies, controls, risk assessments, and a clear view of where to mitigate risk and where to accept it. **Product Security** * Partner with Engineering across the US and India to embed security into how we design, build, and ship our AI agents and data platform. * Own threat modeling for agentic systems, including tool and permission scoping, prompt injection defenses, credential handling, data isolation between customers, and runtime monitoring. * Lead AI governance for our agent platform, building on our alignment with the EU AI Act and NIST frameworks, including how customer data flows through models and third\-party LLM providers. * Lead application security practices across secure code review, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and secure\-by\-default engineering standards. * Secure our integrations with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, and other customer data platforms. #### **Internal AI Agent Security** * Set guardrails for the agents we run internally: least\-privilege access to data, systems, and MCP servers, short\-lived credentials, and human approval for high\-risk actions. * Review new internal agents and AI tools before they touch production or customer data, set policy for employee AI use, and extend logging and incident response to agent activity. * Build agents for the security team itself, such as questionnaire automation and alert triage. #### **Cloud and Infrastructure Security** * Own the security posture of our AWS and Kubernetes environments, including identity and access management, secrets management, logging, and detection. * Build and run incident response, from detection and triage through post\-incident review and remediation. #### **Compliance and Customer Trust** * Own and evolve our compliance programs, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022, SOC 1 Type II, and SOC 2 Type II, maintaining continuous audit readiness and expanding coverage as the business requires. * Own data privacy compliance across the regions where we operate, including GDPR, CCPA, and India's DPDP Act. * Lead security reviews, questionnaires, and trust documentation for enterprise and regulated\-industry customers. * Join customer calls with CISOs and security teams to answer hard questions directly and help close deals. #### **Corporate Security** * Partner with IT and People on access management, device security, vendor risk, and security awareness across the company. ### **Requirements** #### **Required** * 10\+ years in security, with at least 3 years in product, application, or cloud security at a software company. * Led a small security or IT team as a player\-coach. * Hands\-on experience securing AWS and Kubernetes environments. * Experience owning ISO/IEC 27001 and/or SOC 2 Type II programs, including audits and ongoing control management. * Experience supporting enterprise sales through security reviews, questionnaires, and customer CISO conversations. * Comfortable being both strategist and hands\-on practitioner as the first dedicated security leader at a fast\-growing startup. * Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical risk for executives and customers. #### **Preferred** * Experience securing AI/LLM\-powered products, including prompt injection, agent permissioning, and data handling with third\-party model providers. * Background at a data platform or data infrastructure company (Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, or similar). * Experience selling into regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or telecom. * Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones. #### **Benefits** **and Perks** * Prophecy covers 99% of employee health insurance premiums and 75% for dependents * Discretionary allowance for cell phone, wifi, gym memberships, wellness, and more * Flexible PTO * Professional development allowance * Company sponsored Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, FSA/HSA, dental, vision * Ability to have your fingerprint on an innovative product * End\-to\-end ownership of your projects * Benefits and perks may vary per country #### **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Prophecy, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Prophecy are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, and any other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.description: ### **About the role:** At Provectus, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. We’re an Anthropic and AWS Partner with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years\-to\-impact of a hundred\-thousand\-person firm. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, founder\-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. **Why Provectus** ----------------- * **Frontier access** — Anthropic Preferred Partner: newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff\-augmented. * **Autonomous.** You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy\-maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth** — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude\-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open\-source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **Requirements:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands\-on today and intend to stay that way. * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why. * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Cloud\-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits. * Pre\-sales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room. * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job. * Hands\-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses). ### **Nice to have** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production. * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform. * Open\-source contributions or public writing on applied AI. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive — and you are the one who builds it. * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously. * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare. * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice. ### **What We Offer:** * Full\-time. * On\-site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC 1/week * Unlimited Vacation policy. * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance. * 401(K) matching plan. * Base salary $180k–$200k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. * **No Visa sponsorship** ### **We’re real:** * **A person reads your application.** We filter out AI\-generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team. * **We may ask for a quick ID verification.** Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates. * **You’ll meet the people you’d work with.** We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We'd be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Co\-Founder \& CEO. ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** 4\. Soft skills interview. 5\. Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Inference Framework Engineer
jobs.description: Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real\-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co\-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co\-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21\. **The Opportunity** =================== Quadric's GPNPU runs both neural networks and C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. As a member of our AI Application team, you will make the GPNPU a first\-class backend in the frameworks developers already use, such as llama.cpp, PyTorch, and vLLM. That way, customers can move their applications from GPUs to Quadric with minimal changes. You'll own backend integration from memory and dispatch through serving features, working closely with our kernel, runtime and compiler teams. **What You'll Do** ================== Integrate GPNPU backend into AI compute frameworks (llama.cpp, PyTorch, vLLM, Optimum) * Implement framework backend interface, memory allocation, compute dispatch, registration and operators/kernels * Implement model compute pipelines including prefill, decode, batching, multi\-sequence and multi\-modal * Support important framework serving features including KV\-cache management, paged attention, continuous batching, speculative decoding Optimize framework performance and accuracy for GPNPU backend * Reduce host\-device dispatch overhead, implement graph capture/replay, integrate efficient kernels, minimize latency * Support quantization formats such as GGUF (Q4/Q8\), GPTQ/AWQ, int8/fp16 * Validate accuracy against reference backends (perplexity, task benchmarks) and drive improvements **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Within your first 6\-12 months, you’ll: * Bring up a new LLM/VLM family end to end on the GPNPU backend, with accuracy matching the reference * Deliver measurable tokens/s or latency gains on a frontier model * Ship one serving feature (e.g. paged KV cache) in a production release **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 3\+ years building or extending ML frameworks or inference runtimes * BS/MS in CS/CE or related fields * Strong C/C\+\+ and Python * Solid understanding of framework internals: tensor memory management, graph scheduling, operator dispatch * Solid understanding of AI compute performance analysis and optimization * Fluent with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), and interested in building agent\-driven workflows for backend and model bring\-up **Preferred** * Experience writing an accelerator backend (CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, Hexagon or another NPU) for an open\-source framework * Contribution to open\-source frameworks (PyTorch, llama.cpp, vLLM) * Understanding of low level AI compute pipelines, CPU/NPU, DMA * Understanding of graph compilers and kernel fusion **What We Offer** ================= The base salary range for this position is $160,000 to $195,000\. This range reflects the full span of levels and geographies at which Quadric hires for this role. The actual base salary offered will depend on a number of factors, including the specific level of the role, years and depth of relevant experience, technical skills and competencies, the criticality of the role to the business, internal equity, and work location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for equity and a discretionary annual performance bonus as applicable to the role and level.
