jobs.title: Founding Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About Raindrop** ================== Raindrop is the monitoring platform for AI agents. Engineering teams at Fortune 100s and the fastest\-growing AI companies (Vercel, Speak, Clay) use it to catch silent failures in production. When an agent misbehaves, Raindrop alerts the team, links to the trace, and surfaces the root cause so they can fix it fast. With Raindrop 2\.0 (Self\-Healing Agents), the loop closes itself: your coding agent fixes it, and the fix becomes an eval to prevent regressions. **Why It Matters** ================== AI agents fail constantly in ways both hilarious and terrifying. Regular software throws exceptions. But AI agents fail silently, leaving engineers with almost no visibility into how their agents are actually performing. The current status quo is sifting through millions of logs and trying to debug flaky evals that just aren't matching real world results. Evals are like unit tests, they confirm your model got specific test cases right. But in the real world agents call thousands of tools, run for hours, and encounter millions of unpredictable actions. That’s where Raindrop comes in. It learns the unique shape of each AI agent’s issues. Starting from presets like Laziness, Forgetting, or Task Failure, to automatically tuning itself to each agent and discovering unknown unknowns. With one click of a button, AI engineers start tracking issues or topics across 100% of their production data. They can see frequency over time, how many users are affected, relevant properties and more. In order to process hundreds of millions of events, we gradually train small, custom models, private to each company, that learn to uniquely understand how their product is used. As part of the early team, you’ll play a fundamental role in shaping the company \- from making strategy and product decisions, to helping scale the team, to shaping the future of AI agents. **Our Investors** ================= We've raised $50M total, led by CRV, with backing from Lightspeed, Figma Ventures, Vercel Ventures, and the founders of Replit (Amjad Masad, Michele Catasta), Cognition (Walden Yan), Framer (Koen Bok, Jorn van Dijk), Speak (Andrew Hsu), and Notion (Akshay Kothari). **About the role:** We’re looking for a founding Research Engineer to study how AI agents behave in production. You’ll join an early team, set the research agenda, and publish what we learn. **Your Focus:** * **Agent behavior**: Discover how agents fail and respond to different conditions in the real world, and what that means for monitoring and safety. * **Simulations**: Advance how we simulate agents and the situations they face before they reach users. * **Detection**: Develop new methods for finding issues no one has defined yet. * **Open questions**: High\-upside bets on questions about agents we haven’t thought to ask yet. **Your responsibilities:** * Set Raindrop’s research agenda and run the experiments behind it. * Design evaluations and metrics for problems where the ground truth is unclear. * Publish findings as papers, blog posts, and talks. * Prototype new methods, and bring the ones that work into the product when it makes sense. * Help define what research looks like at Raindrop as the team and product grows. **Ideal Candidate:** * You make complex ideas clear through strong written and communication skills. * Care about sharing your research through publications, open\-source work, or public write\-ups. * Deep expertise in an area such as interpretability, evals, AI safety, anomaly detection, or representation learning. * Good judgment about which experiments are worth running and when a result is real. * You ship experiments and build prototypes * Use and build AI agents and tools

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Texas based candidates only - ai automation SaaS healthcare
jobs.description: Please note: ONLY engineers currently living in Texas will be considered We are building a new billing platform from the ground up and need the senior engineer who owns its core: the engine that moves claims and payments through their lifecycles, the background job system that runs every automated step, and the integrations with payers, clearinghouses and banks. Backend engineering on a money system, TypeScript on PostgreSQL on Azure, working directly with the CTO on a team that stays at two to four engineers. The type of engineer we are seeking: A backend engineer who has shipped a transactional system (payments, claims, orders, ledgers, anything where a row posting twice is a real problem) in a typed language, and who has been the one who found out when it broke. Experience you must have: * Seven or more years of backend engineering in production, in a typed language: TypeScript or Node.js, C\#, Java, Go or Kotlin. TypeScript is what we use. A strong C\# or Java engineer who has not written much TypeScript is fine; a Python\-only engineer is not. * A relational database as their primary store for years. PostgreSQL preferred; SQL Server, DB2, Oracle or MySQL fine. They should be able to talk about transactions, locking and a deadlock they debugged. * Built and ran something with background workers, queues and retries. The tool does not matter (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus, Hangfire, Quartz, Sidekiq, Celery, a database table). The years running it do. * Can explain idempotency and "what happens if the process dies between these two writes" from a system they built. * Integration work against outside vendors: REST or SOAP APIs, SFTP file drops, fixed\-width or EDI files, vendors who change their output without warning. * Owned production. They found out their job broke before the business did and changed the design so it could not repeat. A formal on\-call rotation is evidence, not the requirement. Questions you will be asked: * "Tell me about a system you built where the same job must never run twice at the same time. How did you stop it?" * "Tell me about a production failure you owned where nothing errored and the data was just wrong or missing. What did you change afterward?" * "What is the most TypeScript you have written?" The pitch to candidates * Greenfield core of a real money system, with an architecture already written down and a CTO who will hand it over rather than hover. * Small team, no service fleet, no twelve microservices, one database to search when something goes wrong. * Every automated step earns trust on evidence (shadow, propose, auto). The engineer who builds that gets to decide how far it goes. * Decisions are written. They will read the ones that exist and write the next ones. * Texas based, remote within the state. No relocation. * Billing is unglamorous and sticky. The agencies are the customer, the money is real, and the problems are concrete. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About REP:** REP designs world\-class, innovative gym equipment that is sold around the world, and we are now expanding into apparel, supplements, athletes, and events. REP was established in 2012 by two brothers who shared a deep passion for fitness. From our humble beginnings of selling bumper plates out of a small garage, REP has experienced remarkable growth, now occupying over 300,000\+ square feet of office and distribution space in the USA and internationally. With a dedicated team of over 200\+ fitness enthusiasts, our vision is to be the \#1 Strength Brand in the World. Our commitment to innovation, customer service, and value sets us apart. We believe in building a culture centered around fitness, so we specialize in outfitting home gyms, commercial gyms, and strength and conditioning facilities. Our dedication to excellence has been recognized multiple times when we were featured in the Inc. 5000 fastest growing private companies in 2018 and 2021 and then voted the best home strength product launch in 2022 by Garage Gym Experiment. Our team works out together, and we regularly invite fitness superstars to join us. We organize fun challenges to test our limits \- and the limits of our equipment. At REP, we continue to grow and bring new opportunities for those who want to be a part of a winning team. We firmly believe that being surrounded by like\-minded individuals fuels creative energy and fosters a fun and collaborative work environment. This role is based in our state\-of\-the\-art headquarters with a bright, spacious, shared workspace; scenic views of the Rocky Mountains; and a kitchen always stocked with healthy snacks, protein powder, and coffee. We offer a hybrid work environment with a minimum of three days in the office, but there's flexibility about which days and hours. **Our Core Values:** * **Think Like a Customer** \- We empathize with our customers; understand the '*why'* behind every decision we make * **Progress not Perfection** \- We don't let perfect get in the way of *good*; we are better today than we were yesterday * **Positive Attitude** \- Be a *glass half\-full* kind of person and remember to have fun * **Teamwork without Ego** \- We put the *team* above ourselves; we only win together * **Take Initiative** \- We *drive* momentum; if there is an opportunity to make us better, we want to hear it **About This Role:** We have already decided to put AI in front of our data. This role decides whether we can trust what it says. REP's analytics direction is MCP\-first: our internal agents, ChatDash (internally built, conversational BI platform), and Claude now query our Microsoft Fabric data platform and other sources directly. Agents are only as accurate as the definitions underneath them. In addition to building pipelines to model data from sources into Fabric, the AI\-Native Analytics Engineer builds the semantic models and context layers that let both people and AI agents get accurate, grounded answers from REP's enterprise data. Where a traditional analytics engineer stops at clean models for dashboards, this role extends the work into the agentic control plane: the certified metric definitions, data skills, evaluation suites, and guardrails that AI depends on to query data and act without hallucinating. And you will do it the AI\-native way — using AI coding assistants to take new data from bronze to gold, with generated tests and automated reconciliation, compressing work that traditionally took a data engineer, a QA tester, and rounds of business UAT into one seat. What AI cannot do is the judgment: the spec, the review, and the call on whether the answer is correct. That is the job. Just as important: at REP, the business builds first. Our end users create working versions of the analytics they need on their own — in Claude or directly in ChatDash — often before certified data or clear semantics exist for that domain. You will not be writing requirements documents and building from scratch. The requirements are the thing the business has already built and is already using. Where certified data and semantics exist, your job is to make sure they are readily accessible through Claude, ChatDash, and other development approaches, so people build on trusted ground from the start. Where they do not, your job is to take the working version and figure out how to get its data flowing systemically, with clear semantics and guardrails, without breaking what the business made. This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You will own REP's metric definitions of record, develop data pipelines according to a medallion architecture, direct our external data engineering partner as the technical owner, and work alongside our AI Solutions Engineer — they build the agents and tools; you build the governed data those agents rely on. **Essential Functions:** Include the following. Other duties may be assigned. **Business\-Built Solutions (Harden)** * Treat working ver ault and holding the line without supervision. **Productionizing Business\-Built Work** – Turning working prototypes into governed, systemic data products while keeping the builder in the loop. **Partner Direction** – Specifying, reviewing, and accepting or rejecting vendor work as REP's technical owner. **What's in it for You:** Our commitment to quality and transparency applies not only to our products, but to our people. We are focused on creating a fun, exciting, collaborative space that's centered around health and well\-being. We empower everyone on our team to take control of their careers and balance their work and life in a modern, fast\-paced environment. We offer an ***exceptional*** compensation package which includes: **Compensation base range****:** $120,0000 \- $140,000 annually with bonus potential **Day One Benefits!** * Medical, Dental, Vision (Competitive Benefits Packages Available) * Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options * LTD/STD, Life and AD\&D (100% premiums covered by REP) * 401k and Roth options with employer match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) **Recharge Yourself!** * 4 weeks of PTO accrued during your first year * 48 hours of sick leave annually * 7 paid company holidays with an additional floating holiday * Paid Parental leave day 1 * Birthday \- Paid day off **Pumped\-up Perks!** * Unique bonus structure that rewards exceptional individual performance as well as company\-wide performance * Full access to employee gym * Employee discount on REP equipment, apparel and nutrition * Daily snacks and drinks provided by REP (for onsite employees) * 'Fitness' casual attire * Company and team building events * Professional growth and development within the organization * LIFE\-WORK balance **Physical Requirements:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to sit and use hands to operate the telephone, type and operate the computer and mouse. Physical effort may include stooping, kneeling, touching, feeling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. The employee is frequently required to talk, hear, and bend and twist their necks. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 00 pounds and rarely lift and/or move up to 00 pounds assisted. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. REP provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, REP complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. ***This specification is intended to indicate the kinds of tasks and levels of work difficulty that will be required of positions that will be given this title and shall not be construed as declaring what the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position shall be. The use of a particular expression or illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties not mentioned. jobs.title: Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon\-negative outcomes. Our Vision Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon\-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment. Our Business Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting\-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals. Our Value Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world. All that we’re missing is you. Apply today! **About the role** Reworld is seeking a hands\-on Plant Engineer to improve performance, efficiency, and equipment reliability at its waste\-to\-energy facility in West Wareham, Massachusetts. This position combines field troubleshooting and operations support with applied engineering, process optimization, equipment replacement, and project execution. The successful candidate can interpret operating trends, understand combustion and steam generation, and independently move problems from diagnosis to implemented solutions. * **Work arrangement:** Full\-time, on\-site * **Reports to:** Manager, Regional Engineering, working closely with the Facility Manager * **Annual Bonus Target:** 10% performance bonus opportunity * **Sign\-on bonus:** Eligible for a sign\-on bonus. At Reworld, engineers apply their technical expertise to an essential industry that converts waste into energy and supports more sustainable communities. The Plant Engineer partners with Operations, Maintenance, regional engineering, and corporate process engineering to improve plant output, address recurring equipment problems, and deliver practical engineering improvements. The role balances operations support and engineering with roughly equal emphasis. It requires someone comfortable investigating plant problems, performing engineering analysis, developing technical recommendations, and coordinating implementation. Plant performance and project execution are the primary focus; all work must support safe operation and applicable environmental requirements. The successful candidate must be able to analyze operating trends, determine why the plant is not achieving expected load or output, and implement practical corrective actions that improve reliability, efficiency, and performance. **Key Responsibilities** **Plant Performance and Process Troubleshooting** * Review daily plant performance metrics, equipment history, alarms, and operating trends to identify deviations from expected performance. * Investigate why the plant is not achieving expected load or output, identify contributing process and equipment limitations, and implement corrective actions. * Troubleshoot combustion, steam\-generation, process\-control, and equipment\-reliability issues using field observations, engineering calculations, operating data, and root cause analysis. * Optimize operating conditions and controls to improve combustion performance, efficiency, equipment availability, and reliable plant output. * Prepare performance reports, lead weekly production\-improvement discussions, and maintain the facility's Production Action Items list. * Present findings, recommendations, implementation needs, and measured results to facility and regional leadership. **Applied Mechanical and Process Engineering** * Perform engineering calculations, evaluate design alternatives, size equipment, and develop equipment specifications for plant modifications and replacements. * Support mechanical and process systems including boilers, pumps, piping, fuel handling, combustion equipment, grates, and spray dryer absorber (SDA) systems. * Apply engineering and maintenance recommendations. * Obtain required technical reviews and approvals before implementing operational, process, or equipment changes. **Engineering Projects, Outages, and Relevant USCG credentials and substantially equivalent operating experience are accepted qualification pathways and will be considered alongside demonstrated engineering capability. * Professional Engineer licensure, PMP certification, or an MBA. * Experience using AutoCAD, SketchUp, and/or SolidWorks. By connecting live business data, organizational context, and built\-in permissions, Rippling AI can answer complex questions and take action across systems while respecting each user’s access and required approvals. Rippling Data Cloud extends this foundation to third\-party business data, enabling customers to build AI workflows across their operations. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. jobs.description: **Join us in building the future of finance.** ---------------------------------------------- Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. **About the team \+ role** -------------------------- We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem\-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high\-performing, fast\-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The **Capacity \& Efficiency Engineering team** builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency\-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost\-effective. Our work carries CEO\-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood. As a **Senior Software Engineer** on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0\-to\-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill. This role is based in our **Bellevue, WA office**, with in\-person attendance expected at least **3 days per week**. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in\-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high\-performing teams. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build forecast\-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold * Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules * Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right\-sized as load changes * Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent\-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data * Take every recommendation to closed\-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling * Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together **What you bring** ------------------ * Deep hands\-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management * Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time\-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth * A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability * Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report * Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O\-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus * Experience with bursty, event\-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus **What we offer** * Challenging, high\-impact work to grow your career. * Performance\-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. * Employer\-paid life \& disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. * Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! * Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. jobs.title: Principal Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research
jobs.description: **Company Description** **We help the world run better** At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. **Job Description** **Teach AI how business actually works** AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re\-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission\-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough. SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7\.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data\-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge\-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP's AI workspace, accurate enough to trust. As Principal Data Scientist, you will define and lead our research toward that goal and work with product teams to ship the results. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics. **SAP Research \& Innovation North America** We are a team of scientists and engineers at SAP Labs in Palo Alto, minutes from Stanford. We look a few years ahead and scout emerging technologies, take the early, riskier bets that product teams can’t always take, and prove or drop them fast. SAP's product teams build and run SAP Knowledge Graph, we look beyond and find and prove methods that demonstrate improvement or paradigm shifts. Our job is to spot the opportunities that will matter most to SAP and our customers, and to get there early. We prototype with dedicated GPU compute on realistic business data and, in co\-innovation projects, on real data for training and evaluating models. We publish research, work with startups, universities and institutes including Stanford HAI and UC Irvine, and hand what works to SAP's product teams. We move like a small lab, with the reach of a company whose software runs finance, supply chain and HR for many of the world's largest companies. **What you will work on** * **A research agenda with a point of view.** Pick the two or three bets where SAP can lead in AI on business data, agree up front how we will know each one is working, and stop the ones that aren't. Closely collaborate with top universities and institutes such as Stanford HAI. * **What comes next.** Track emerging research, such as relational and graph foundation models, neuro\-symbolic agents and context graphs, test it on SAP data before the market settles, and make the case for the next bet. * **Business semantics that can be learned.** New methods to learn, align and evolve ontologies and knowledge graphs of business objects, rules and actions from SAP metadata, master data, documents and process data, combining LLM\-assisted ontology learning, schema matching and entity resolution with targeted expert review. * **Agents grounded in business semantics.** Graph\-grounded retrieval; semantic parsing into SQL, SPARQL and OData calls, including finding the right API, across very large schemas; and governed actions: checks that an agent's plan respects business rules and the user's authorizations before it runs. * **Models that combine structure and statistics.** Graph learning and relational foundation models (such as SAP\-RPT\-1\.6\), using knowledge\-graph structure to predict, explain and simulate business outcomes. * **The yardstick.** Benchmarks and simulation environments for agents on ERP data, where today's public benchmarks fall short, so SAP knows when AI is accurate and reliable enough to act on. * **Results that land.** Work directly with data teams and domain experts in co\-innovation projects, turning messy enterprise data problems into tractable ontology problems, and work with the teams behind SA ur own to adopt, fund or drop something. You are able to work through a design with skeptical engineers. **Preferred** * Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL/EMNLP, SIGMOD/VLDB, ISWC, WWW, or widely used open\-source software, datasets or semantic standards work. * LLM\-assisted ontology learning, neuro\-symbolic methods, agent memory, context graphs and decision traces, or reinforcement learning for tool\-using agents. * Process mining (including object\-centric event data), causal inference, forecasting, or privacy\-preserving and synthetic data. * Familiarity with how enterprises run (finance, supply chain, procurement, HR), and experience mentoring scientists or leading university collaborations. * SAP experience is a plus, not a requirement. If you recognize yourself here but do not match every line, apply. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business\-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience. jobs.description: **About Scale:** ================ For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science\-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding. Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands. We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact. Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company. If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Data Engineer to own the data infrastructure behind all of Scale Media's brands. You'll build and run the pipelines that bring together data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo, and Odoo, etc. and make sure the teams who rely on that data can trust it. You'll join our existing engineering team as its dedicated data specialist. That means real ownership: you'll set the direction for how we model, move, govern, and use data, with engineering teammates around you to build alongside. Most of your time will go to data engineering. You'll also be a thought partner on key cross\-functional projects, most notably Odoo, which our inventory team uses for inventory management. There, you'll help plan upgrades, design integrations, and keep its data flowing cleanly into the rest of our stack. This is a hands\-on builder role for someone who enjoys solving messy data problems and turning them into reliable systems. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Data Architecture \& Pipelines:** * Own and optimize the company's data architecture and ETL/ELT pipelines, including scheduling, orchestration, and monitoring with tools like Airflow and dbt. * Maintain, optimize, and expand our hosting infrastructure and scripts as data volume and use cases grow. * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across every source system, so reporting and decisions rest on numbers people trust. **Integrations \& Data Connectors:** * Maintain API integrations and data connectors with platforms including Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo, etc. * Scope and build new data integrations as the business adds tools, channels, and brands. **Odoo Partnership:** * Act as the go\-to technical partner for Odoo, supporting our inventory team on Odoo\-related initiatives. * Help plan and execute Odoo upgrades with minimal disruption to day\-to\-day inventory operations. * Design, build, and maintain integrations and ETL processes between Odoo and our other internal and external systems. **Data Governance \& Documentation:** * Oversee data governance, access controls, and security practices that protect our systems and customer data from breaches. * Document configurations, integrations, and data flows so the rest of the team can understand and build on them. * Act as a thought partner to analytics and marketing teams to define, standardize, and maintain business\-critical KPIs across all data models and reporting layers. **AI/ML \& Automation:** * Implement AI/ML\-driven solutions for data enrichment, anomaly detection, forecasting, and process automation. * Continuously review data workflows and performance, and find new ways to use data to make the business run more efficiently. * Ownership and setup of MCP connection to the data warehouse to allow users access to data through LLM **What You Bring** ------------------ * Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands\-on experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. * Experience with modern orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow and dbt, and with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar). * Hands\-on experience with Odoo, including working with its data model, building integrations, and supporting or executing version upgrades. * Experience working with Shopify data and APIs, and integrating ecommerce and marketing platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, or Klaviyo. * Comfort managing cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and the scripts and jobs that run on it. * A solid grasp of data governance, security, and access\-control practices. * Clear documentation habits and the ability to explain data systems to non\-technical teammates. * 3–5 years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role. Strong backgrounds include: * Data engineers at DTC or ecommerce brands who have owned the full stack from source to warehouse * ERP or Odoo developers who have grown into broader data engineering and pipeline work * Analytics engineers who have taken on infrastructure, orchestration, and integration ownership **Preferred, But Not Required** ------------------------------- * Experience in DTC, consumer subscription, supplements, or wellness. * Experience building custom Odoo modules in Python. * Hands\-on work applying AI/ML to forecasting, anomaly detection, or data enrichment. * Familiarity with inventory, supply chain, or demand\-planning data. **What Makes You a Fit** ------------------------ * **High Ownership:** As our dedicated data specialist, you treat the data stack as yours to improve, not a ticket queue to work through. * **Thought Partner:** You bring ideas to the table and help teams like inventory shape the right solution, not just implement the request. * **Detail\-Oriented:** You care about getting the numbers right, because the whole business makes decisions on them. * **Self\-Starter in a Remote Environment:** You're comfortable in a fully remote, fast\-paced environment and communicate clearly without needing to be in the same room. * **Curious Problem\-Solver:** You enjoy untangling messy data problems and keep an eye out for new ways data can make the business more efficient. **Reporting Structure** ----------------------- You will report directly to Uday Dorawala, Engineering Manager. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Salary: $130,000 \- $150,000 depending on experience * Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance * Fully remote, full\-time position * Monthly WFH stipend * Generous Paid Time Off program * Discounted Products * An amazing team to work alongside Applicant Privacy Policy Notice GZepjI5mRv

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Deployed
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. **About the team** ================== The **Agent Deployment** team is a customer\-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise\-grade features and products. Deployment Success Managers own each customer's long\-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go\-live. **Role Overview** ================= Deployed Software Engineers are customer\-facing software engineers: shipping features, building new capabilities, and expanding our product surface area inside some of the world’s most complex enterprises. You’ll work directly with customers to turn messy, high\-stakes workflows into reliable AI\-driven systems, shipping production code that influences both revenue and product direction. This role isn’t about building demos or prototypes; it’s about shipping enterprise\-grade features and products for our customers. If you're energized by building something that didn't exist before, with a direct line between your work and company growth, this is the role for you. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Ship core product:** architect and ship production\-grade systems that become part of Serval's core product, born from the real needs of our most complex customers. * **Build platform services:** design backend services, APIs, and integrations that extend Serval's AI agent platform across customers, with a focus on reliability, security, and long\-term maintainability. * **Turn workflows into product:** work directly with customers to turn messy, high\-stakes workflows into generalized, reusable product capabilities. * **Own the deployment lifecycle:** own key deployments from architecture through scaling and continuous improvement. **Example Recent Projects** =========================== * Productionize Serval's voice agent from alpha into a viable channel for enterprise users to reach the Serval AI agent, first at a Fortune 500 financial services company. * Upgrade our worker environment to communicate with on\-premise Active Directory and Microsoft platforms over LDAP and PowerShell, and ship self\-serve deployment so customers can stand up a Serval worker themselves. * Extend our workflow system to ingest knowledge from any source, making a customer's own systems searchable by the agent, a capability that won us the deal. **What You’ll Need** ==================== * Software engineering experience, ideally in a product\-focused or customer\-facing role * Strong coding and system design skills, with experience shipping production systems and building external integrations * High ownership in fast\-moving environments with limited structure, and a track record of taking ambiguous problems to shipped, measurable impact. * A clear communicator with both technical and business stakeholders. **Nice to Have** ================ * Startup experience as a founder or early engineer. * Background working with enterprise customers or supporting complex technical sales cycles. * Experience building or deploying AI/LLM\-powered features or agent\-based systems. * Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company. * **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company. * **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun. Compensation Range: $200K \- $325K

jobs.title: Controls Engineer - Data Center
jobs.description: SLS Consultants is one of the fastest growing real estate development and construction consulting firms in the industry today. We are embedded in the ever\-expanding Data Center market, as well as Advanced Manufacturing, Life Science, and Healthcare asset classes. As we enter the next phase of our growth journey, we are hyper focused on providing career opportunities for our employees, maintaining our quality and culture, and consistently delivering excellence for our clients. Join SLS to fast\-track your career, maximize your industry impact, and partner with iconic brands to build the digital infrastructure of tomorrow! Responsibilities: * Lead end\-to\-end DCOS commissioning, including FAT, SAT, PFT, FPT and IST, ensuring systems meet performance and handover requirements. * Develop and manage commissioning plans, test scripts, checklists and technical documentation throughout all project phases. * Validate DCOS hardware, network configurations, IP addressing, VLANs, redundancy, stress testing, alarms and data logging. * Execute DCOS\-to\-DCIM integration and onboarding, validating data points, alarm alignment, system hierarchies and interoperability. * Interpret single\-line drawings and verify system\-level calculations, including resiliency scripts, utility power, PUE, BCM and battery monitoring systems. * Apply advanced technical expertise across DDC, PLC, DCS, SCADA and BMS platforms to diagnose and troubleshoot complex controls systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve controls\-related issues across electrical, mechanical, HVAC and fire protection systems. * Develop and maintain standardised controls programming modules, sequences of operation, graphics and reporting tools. * Utilise data collection and monitoring platforms, including Kepware, Matrikon, TopView and OSIsoft PI, to support system diagnostics and performance analytics. * Oversee commissioning compliance, software factory acceptance testing, technical validation and final system handover, ensuring operational readiness and adherence to global standards. * Coordinate project activities across construction managers, general contractors, system integrators, design teams and equipment suppliers; maintain commissioning logs, track progress, report program metrics and oversee Software Factory Acceptance Testing and vendor accountability. Qualifications: * Extensive experience in data center commissioning, controls engineering, or building automation systems within mission\-critical environments. * Strong technical knowledge of DDC, PLC, DCS, SCADA and BMS architectures, including system integration and troubleshooting. * Proven experience delivering commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, PFT, FPT and IST, with a strong understanding of testing and validation procedures. * Experience integrating DCOS and DCIM platforms, including network configuration, data point validation, alarm configuration and system interoperability. * Proficiency with controls monitoring and data collection platforms such as Kepware, Matrikon, TopView, OSIsoft PI or equivalent systems. Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

jobs.title: Sr. Performance & Insights Engineer
jobs.description: The Performance \& Insights Engineer sits within SM Energy's Enterprise Performance \& Insights team, reporting into the Chief Operating Officer organization, and works at the intersection of petroleum engineering, data engineering, and executive decision support. This role translates complex subsurface, operational, and financial data into high\-impact analyses, models, and executive\-ready deliverables that inform Investor Relations (IR) and Board of Directors (BOD) communications and advance critical strategic initiatives. Combining a working command of operational and asset engineering fundamentals with full\-stack data wrangling and coding capability and modern AI\-assisted workflows, the engineer independently frames ambiguous business problems, builds scalable end\-to\-end analytical solutions, and communicates insights persuasively to senior leadership. Operates under limited review while handling assignments of broad scope and complex difficulty; may mentor less experienced analysts and engineers and supervise their technical work. **Essential Roles and Responsibilities** * Translate complex operational, development, and financial business problems into end\-to\-end analytical solutions — from data acquisition and pipeline through model, visualization, and executive\-ready deliverable. * Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, queries, and analytics data views across production, reservoir, financial, and capital\-planning domains using SQL and Python; design and test scripts, stored procedures, functions, and views. * Deliver executive and Board\-ready artifacts through an agentic, AI\-assisted workflow — directing tools such as Claude to build self\-contained HTML dashboards, branded decks, and models from a spec, then refining them while retaining judgment over accuracy and design. * Understanding of production and reservoir engineering fundamentals — decline curve analysis (DCA), rate/pressure transient analysis (RTA/PTA), volumetrics, EURs, artificial lift, and production optimization — to QA/QC data and pressure\-test analytical results for physical reasonableness. * Develop capital\-efficiency, production\-performance, operational KPIs, and economic metrics and models that support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic decision\-making across operating regions. * Design and produce executive\-facing reporting — BOD slides, IR materials, and interactive dashboards — built to SM Energy brand standards. * Leverage AI tools (e.g., large language model assistants such as Claude) to accelerate code development, data QA/QC, documentation, and analysis, applying sound engineering judgment to validate and stress\-test AI\-assisted output. * Develop correlations between geological, completion, operational, and financial variables and well\- and asset\-level performance. * Perform ad\-hoc analyses; troubleshoot data\-quality issues across the business; proactively identify potential issues and recommend solutions. * Serve as a liaison across Operations, Finance, IR, Reservoir/Asset teams, and IT/Data — bridging deeply technical work and business audiences. * Monitor production, capital, and financial data for discrepancies and opportunities; recommend operational and process improvements. * Contribute to data governance, code documentation, change\-release process, and best practices; educate others in support of a data\- and AI\-first culture. * Manage and engage in multiple initiatives simultaneously; independently prioritize tasks and eliminate roadblocks to meet target deadlines. * Conduct business with the highest ethical standards; demonstrate decision\-making that ensures the safety of all people associated with SM facilities. * Other duties as assigned. **Role\-Specific Technical Knowledge \& Skills** **Petroleum Engineering.** Working command of production operations, artificial\-lift applications, and fundamental reservoir engineering disciplines — decline curve analysis, rate/pressure transient analysis, volumetrics, recoveries, EURs, and recovery factors. Understanding of unconventional resource plays across multiple basins/operating regions and familiarity with reserves, economics, AFE, and capital\-planning workflows. Ability to identify limitations and ranges of certainty in a data set and to relate reservoir, completion, and operational characteristics to well performance. **Data Engineering \& Analytics.** Advanced ability to wrangle, pre\-process, and feature\-engineer data and to connect data from disparate sources to surface insights, data\-quality issues, and variable correlations. Sound applied\-statistics foundation; competence with machine\-learning concepts and frameworks a plus. End\-to\-end pipeline design that is cost\-effective and scalable; strong code documentation and change\-management discipline. **AI\-Augmented Delivery.** Ability to integrate AI tools into daily delivery to compress cycle time while retaining engineering ownership of correctness — treating AI output as a draft to be verified, not a final answer. Understands data\-security and data\-privacy implications of AI\-assisted and cloud\-based workflows and accounts for them appropriately. **Computer/Software Applications** * **Programming \& Analytics:** Advanced SQL and Python (pandas, numpy, and related data ecosystem); R or comparable a plus. * **Data Platforms \& Architecture:** Data virtualization via Denodo; Snowflake and/or Databricks; Palantir Foundry; relational database design; ETL/ELT (dbt, SSIS); cloud environments (Azure, AWS). * **Visualization \& Reporting:** Governed enterprise BI (Power BI, Spotfire, or Tableau) for refreshing dashboards, plus bespoke interactive tools built as self\-contained HTML dashboards (D3, Plotly, Recharts) that run anywhere without a license or server. Advanced PowerPoint and Excel for executive and Board deliverables, produced to SM Energy brand standards. * **Development Tools:** Git/GitHub, modern IDEs (VS Code, PyCharm), notebooks (Jupyter), and fast dependency/environment management (uv, Poetry, conda). Comfortable in the agentic developer loop — coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot working inside the IDE/terminal, not used only as a side chat. * **Agentic Delivery:** Fluent in AI\-assisted artifact creation — directing agentic tools (e.g., Claude) to build branded HTML dashboards, PowerPoint decks, and Excel models end to end from a specification, then refining them iteratively. Applies SM's visual standards programmatically ("brand\-as\-code") so output is board\-ready by default, and exercises judgment over layout, data integrity, and narrative clarity rather than accepting first\-pass output. * **AI\-Augmented Development:** Fluent in an AI\-native analytics workflow — uses LLM assistants (e.g., Claude) and agentic tools to accelerate development, QA/QC, refactoring, and documentation, always validating output against engineering judgment. Can leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents securely to enterprise data and tools (e.g., querying Denodo or Snowflake, drafting Office deliverables) and platform\-native AI such as Snowflake Cortex and Power BI Copilot, keeping data security and governance front of mind. * **Petroleum Engineering Software:** Aries, Wellview, and Spotfire; exposure to RTA/PTA and production\-analysis tools; reservoir simulation and frac models a plus. **Education** * Bachelor's degree required in Petroleum, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering; Data Science; Computer Science; Statistics; or a related quantitative field. * A dual foundation in engineering and computing/data is strongly preferred. * Advanced degree a plus. **Typical Experience** * Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience. * Experience should span both petroleum engineering (production/operations, and/or reservoir) and hands\-on data/analytics development. * Demonstrated delivery of executive\- or Board\-facing analytical work is strongly preferred. SM Energy offers competitive compensation and benefits programs which include, but are not limited to, variable pay, health care coverage, retirement plan, protection coverage, time off and leave programs, training and development opportunities and a range of allowances connected to specific work situations. Details are available at Careers :: SM Energy Company (SM) (sm\-energy.com). Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Network Support Tier 2 Level 1
jobs.description: Help shape the future of hospitality technology by solving complex networking challenges that keep hotels connected. We’re looking for a Network Support Tier 3 Level 1 Engineer who is ready to troubleshoot advanced network issues, support mission\-critical broadband environments, and deliver exceptional technical support to customers around the world. This is a technical support role based in our Sioux Falls office, where you will remotely troubleshoot and resolve customer technical issues. It is not a remote\-work position or a network engineering role. Candidates whose experience is primarily in network architecture, design, or senior\-level network engineering may find the position does not align with their experience level. **Schedule Requirements:** This position requires flexibility outside of standard business hours. Employees may regularly be scheduled for evening, overnight, and/or weekend shifts, depending on operational needs. Candidates should consider these scheduling requirements before applying. **What you'll do:** Reporting to the Manager of Technical Support, you’ll serve as an advanced technical resource within SONIFI’s Technical Assistance Center (TAC). You’ll provide expert support for broadband networks and managed services while working closely with customers, field technicians, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve complex networking issues. * Provide advanced technical support for SONIFI’s broadband products, managed Wi\-Fi services, and network infrastructure, serving as an escalation resource for internal teams, field technicians, service partners, hotels, and third\-party vendors. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex network, hardware, and software issues involving WAN, LAN, routing, switching, wireless networking, RF technologies, and broadband services. * Perform remote system maintenance, break\-fix support, upgrades, configuration changes, proactive network monitoring, root cause analysis, and customer issue resolution, ensuring timely communication throughout the support process. * Coordinate field dispatches, recommend replacement hardware, support system upgrades, maintain accurate customer records, and provide technical recommendations that improve service reliability and customer satisfaction. * Identify recurring issues and contribute to continuous improvement by maintaining knowledge base documentation, supporting multiple technology platforms, and expanding technical expertise through ongoing training and certification. **What you'll need:** We’re looking for a technically driven networking professional who enjoys solving challenging problems and thrives in a fast\-paced customer support environment. * Associate degree in a related technical field or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Experience supporting enterprise networking environments, broadband technologies, or managed network services, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and network infrastructure. * Strong knowledge of routing, switching, wireless networking, WAN/LAN technologies, Cisco networking equipment, the OSI model, and RF fundamentals. * Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple issues while delivering exceptional customer service. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with customers, field teams, engineering, and internal support organizations. * Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative, 24x7 technical support environment. **Preferred:** * One year of experience as a SONIFI Network Support Tier 2 or equivalent experience supporting enterprise networking or broadband technologies. * CCNA or another relevant networking certification. * Experience supporting hospitality, managed services, ISP, MSP, or enterprise networking environments. * Experience working in a technical support, NOC, or operations center environment. Together, we can build your future! SONIFI offers a competitive compensation package based on factors including location, experience, education, specialty, and training. This position is also eligible for PTO, holidays, health, dental, vision, retirement plans, pet insurance, on\-demand pay, and other benefits. SONIFI and SONIFI Health value diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any protected status. If you require assistance with the online application due to a disability, please contact Human Resources at 605\-988\-1000\. SONIFI participates in E\-Verify to confirm authorization to work in the United States. \#Technical

jobs.title: Cloud Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description SPR is seeking a skilled Cloud Software Engineer to help design, develop, deploy, and maintain cloud\-based software solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience with cloud infrastructure, software development, automation, and scalable application architecture. jobs.title: CMM Quality Technician
jobs.description: **Schunk Carbon Technology** **Job Title:** CMM Quality Technician **Department:** Quality **FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt **Reports to:** Quality Manager **POSITION SUMMARY** The CMM Quality Technician performs various complex quality\-related testing and inspection functions to support quality efforts throughout the company. This role focuses heavily on operating and programming Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) to verify part dimensions, ensuring alignment with strict engineering specifications. This position reports directly to the Quality Manager and has no direct reports. **QUALIFICATIONS** * **Education \& Experience:** Associate’s Degree from a two\-year college or technical school, or 3\+ years of equivalent work experience and/or training. * **Professional Certifications:** ASQ Certified Quality Technician (CQT) or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) is highly preferred. * **Quality Standards \& Systems:** Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 with practical experience performing internal audits. Experience utilizing QT9 QMS software is highly preferred. * **Blueprint Reading:** Strong proficiency in reading and interpreting complex part drawings, process specifications, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T) symbols. * **Mathematics:** Solid understanding of mathematical concepts such as probability, statistical inference, and the fundamentals of plane/solid geometry and trigonometry. * **Software \& Tools:** Experience utilizing Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Teams, Word) and modern Quality Management System (QMS) software platform applications. **CMM SPECIALIZATION \& SKILLS** * **CMM Programming:** Strong preference for candidates with a proven track record of writing and editing new CMM programs from 3D CAD models and blueprints, rather than just operating them. * **Equipment Preference:** Hands\-on experience with Zeiss CMM hardware and Zeiss software ecosystems is highly preferred. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** * **Dimensional Inspection:** Measure complex parts using surface plate layouts, traditional hand tools (calipers, micrometers, indicators), and Zeiss CMM programs. * **QMS Documentation:** Log and track corrective actions, non\-conformances, and calibration events within the QT9 QMS platform. * **Calibration \& M\&TE:** Maintain basic calibration knowledge. Select appropriate Measurement and Test Equipment (M\&TE) tools for various tasks, assess tool accuracy, and ensure standards traceability. * **Drawing Interpretation:** Read and interpret blueprints, demonstrating clear understanding of critical, major, and minor part characteristics. * **Non\-Conforming Material:** Identify, report, and isolate non\-conforming materials. Initiate resolutions when inspection errors or part deviations occur. * **CAPA \& Auditing:** Apply elements of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), including root cause analysis, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and internal quality audits. * **Traceability:** Understand and maintain complete product, material, and calibration traceability across all inspection stages using spreadsheet and word processing documentation. * **Sampling Plans:** Apply basic inspection and testing techniques, including various standardized sampling plans. **AMERICANS WITH DISABILITY SPECIFICATIONS** **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Frequently required to walk. * Occasionally required to stand, sit, and reach with hands and arms. * Use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls. * Ability to talk and hear clearly. * Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. **Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Work is performed indoors in areas that are generally well\-lit. * Temperature and humidity can vary greatly depending on the weather, ranging from 60°F to 100°F. * Regular work near moving mechanical parts with regular exposure to manufacturing vibration. * The noise level in the work environment is moderately loud. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. The employee will also perform other related job duties as assigned by the supervisor or other management.

The ideal candidate for this position is an engineering school graduate and a self\-motivated individual with practical real\-world experience in the renewable energy industry. This candidate has some engineering, design, cost estimating and project scheduling experience and will be capable of supporting a wide range of technical project tasks. The ideal candidate will have a passion for renewable energy and a strong desire to grow technically. This position requires the ability to manage multiple workloads in a fast\-paced environment. Your attention to detail and ability to concurrently drive multiple work streams forward on time and on budget will be key to your success. You must have the ability to work collaboratively in cross\-functional teams whose success depends on soliciting and integrating the technical expertise of every member. **Senior Project Engineer Responsibilities** * Prepare conceptual plant designs using GIS, CAD, and/or design software tools. * Prepare cost estimates for Development projects. * Prepare and update project schedules for Development projects. * Prepare and update risk registers for Development projects. * Conduct technical due diligence reviews of new project opportunities, including travelling to preconstruction project sites and preparing site visit reports. * Lead project coordination activities, such as managing work orders, design/proposal reviews, and other administrative tasks to support the Engineering and Preconstruction managers. * Support contractors with information as needed during the request for proposal bid process. * Manage engineering deliverables and other documentation in SharePoint. * Prepare and publish presentations for internal stakeholders. Other Responsibilities Scout is a dynamic and quickly growing organization. Based upon your skills and interests, your Manager will assign other tasks focused on improving Scout’s preconstruction and engineering discipline and your career. These may include: * Building business cases/protocols to support other areas of the company. * Process improvement and documentation. * Integration of commercially available software or development of internal software tools. **Requirements** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Related Field. * 4 \- 5 years of experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, or a related field. * Working knowledge of electric power systems, design and operation. * Experience with utility scale wind, solar or battery systems is preferred but not required. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills (some statistical analysis experience preferred). * Effective oral/written communication skills for working with customers. * Collaboration and team\-oriented, hands\-on field work and client\-focused. * Possess the ability to learn new programs and industry jargon. * Solid organizational skills, including multitasking and time management. Proficient with computers with strong working knowledge of the following: * MS Excel – Creation and debugging of spreadsheets for data analysis and cost estimating * SharePoint – Document management system for all project deliverables Ability to gain experience with the following programs: * Scheduling – MS Project or similar scheduling software * GIS – Google Earth, ArcGIS or GlobalMapper * Design – AutoCAD, Rated Power, Bluebeam Revu, and other electrical and civil design tools **Work Environment and Work Style:** Experience working with cross\-functional internal and external technical advisors and stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to work in a flat organization, successfully leveraging the expertise of multiple colleagues in different lines of reporting. Ability to multi\-task and arbitrate between conflicting priorities with clear target setting and follow\-through capability in a fast\-paced and rapidly changing work environment. **Additional Qualifications:** * Must have a valid current driver license, and able to travel and perform field work. * Authorized to work in the United States.
