jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Active Learning
jobs.description: **Senior Machine Learning Engineer \- Active Learning** ------------------------------------------------------- **About Sense** --------------- Sense is a climate tech company that turns electric signals in homes and on the grid into real\-time insight about energy use, devices, and faults. These insights help people lower their electric bills and use less electricity, and they help utilities prevent wildfires, among other applications. These insights come from load disaggregation and fault detection models that are running on meters today. The technology team at Sense researches, trains, deploys, and supports these models. We are looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer with expertise in active learning systems to help us scale our data operations so we can continue to improve our core production models and build the foundation model of electrical devices and energy. **The role** ------------ This Senior Machine Learning Engineer will own the loop from data to labels to improved models. You will use active learning and weak supervision methods to generate labels, decide what to label next, and turn errors we find in the field into new labels. This is a hands\-on role. You will be expected to write code, train models, analyze data, and document experiments. You will work with data scientists, annotators, product, and engineers to get labels and improve models. You will direct the development of annotation tools and the work of our annotators to speed up and scale labeling. Success in this role is measured by the reduction in cost per annotation (i.e., time per annotation), while keeping label quality at or above our targets. Responsibilities: * Design and run active learning to choose which homes, devices, and time periods to label next, based on where models are uncertain or wrong. * Turn bad detections, field accuracy results, and user corrections into new ground truth, and track whether retrained models improve. * Find rare events and hard cases in home data, such as uncommon or mislabeled devices, and add them to labeling and evaluation sets. * Own the ground truth plan: which data, how much, and in what order. * Direct a team of annotators: set priorities, track throughput, and provide guidance. Set data quality standards. * Direct development of our annotation tool. Add features that enhance our ability to collect new and better data, including features that rely on models. * Measure and improve label quality through metrics, outlier detection, human review, etc. * Work with data engineers and ML operations to version labels and track which labels trained which model. Keep evaluation sets separate from training data so offline results predict performance in the field. * Be a good teammate: review code, provide peer feedback on research and experiments, and contribute to shared documentation. Help mentor/coach less experienced team members. **Requirements** Qualifications: * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, including 2\+ years building or managing labeled datasets for ML. * Hands\-on experience applying active learning to real data, including choosing a sampling strategy and measuring whether it helped. * Experience finding rare or hard examples in large datasets, i.e., from model errors, uncertainty, or similarity search. * Experience training deep learning models, and with weak supervision or model\-assisted labeling. * Experience measuring label quality and fixing label errors. * Experience with Python, SQL, and data pipelines. * A track record of working with other teams, i.e., product, software, or hardware. Preferred qualifications: * Experience with time series, audio, sensor, or other signal data. * Experience leading an annotation team or directing development of annotation tools. * Experience using embeddings from large or foundation models for data analysis. Logistics: * Location: able to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 2 days per week. * Salary range: $165,000 to $185,000 * Work authorization: required. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Work From Home * Free Food \& Snacks * Wellness Resources * Stock Option Plan

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Purple AI
jobs.description: ### **Our Purpose** At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. ### **About Us** SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. ### **What Are We Looking For?** We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. We're looking for an AI\-native product manager to join SentinelOne's Purple AI team and lead the vision and execution for next\-generation agentic security features. Purple AI is how modern SOC teams detect earlier, respond faster, and stay ahead of attackers—and SentinelOne is embedding it platform\-wide to automate security operations while keeping human analysts fully in control and accountable. You'll own the roadmap for new agentic capabilities and drive the evolution of our conversational experience, continually redefining what modern AI in cybersecurity looks like. This is a high\-visibility, strategic role with direct exposure to executive leadership and close collaboration across engineering, sales, marketing, and pricing strategy. ### **What Will You Do?** Primary responsibilities include**:** * Define and champion the strategy and vision for Purple AI—the industry's first GenAI security analyst—along with new AI features driving SentinelOne's next phase of growth * Own the full product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and iteration, to deliver measurable customer and business impact * Synthesize quantitative and qualitative inputs—product metrics, user research, and market analysis—to shape the roadmap and build customer\-centric solutions * Make robust decisions amid incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous information, managing risk and rallying cross\-functional teams around a shared path forward * Refine online and offline evaluation metrics to track with customer\-perceived quality and value, and drive our data\-sourcing strategy to continuously improve model and pipeline performance * Partner with marketing, sales, and documentation to craft a compelling product narrative that drives adoption of our AI products ### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?** Ideal candidates will have: * 10\+ years in enterprise product management; cybersecurity product experience preferred * 6\+ years building AI/ML products * 4\+ years launching 0\-to\-1 enterprise software products * Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, data science, or related field (or equivalent experience) * Strong technical grasp of AI/ML technologies, including generative and agentic AI, natural language processing (NLP), and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) * Exceptional skill navigating ambiguity, framing trade\-offs, and making decisions that balance technical complexity, user experience, and business value * Ownership mentality: proven accountability, persistence, and a results\-driven mindset * Clear, efficient, and persuasive communication—written and verbal—across audiences from engineers to executives * Hands\-on experience using AI tools to accelerate the full PM workflow, improving both the speed and quality of decision\-making *Note: This position requires up to 15% travel to customer and SentinelOne locations worldwide.* ### **Why** **SentinelOne?** AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: **Equity \& Rewards** * Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) **Time Off \& Wellbeing** * Flexible time off * Paid company holidays and paid sick time * Gender\-neutral parental leave * Grandparent leave **Insurance \& Financial Security** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Life and disability insurance * Health and dependent care FSA * Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness) * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * ARAG pre\-paid legal * Nationwide pet insurance * Cancer Care program * Global business travel medical insurance **Work Perks \& Flexibility** * Home office allowance * Mobile phone reimbursement **Wellness \& Lifestyle** * Wellness coach * Wellness/gym reimbursement * Fertility coverage * Adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. SentinelOne participates in the E\-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

jobs.title: Data Products - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **About the Company** ===================== Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production. Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI\-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale. We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post\-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A\*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition. **About the Role** ================== As a Data Products \- Member of Technical Staff, you will build the systems that bring real human signal into Simile. Our simulations are only as good as the data behind them. The Data Products team owns how that data is collected, structured, secured, and made useful. That includes our in\-house AI interview platform, which runs real\-time, adaptive conversations with people at scale, as well as the infrastructure that lets the world's most security\-conscious organizations trust Simile with their data. We are looking for engineers who can bridge cutting\-edge AI and production\-grade enterprise data systems. You will design and scale products that handle sensitive, messy, real\-world data with rigor. Every system you build should be secure, auditable, and reliable by construction, while staying simple for the people who use it. **Your core responsibilities will include:** * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Own data products from initial architecture through backend services, APIs, and user\-facing workflows. Make the core design calls on storage, orchestration, and data modeling, including when to build and when to buy. * **Data Collection \& Processing:** Build and scale pipelines that gather data from diverse sources, normalize it into consistent formats, and make it available to our product and research teams at scale. * **Secure Data Handling:** Build systems that support the secure handling and processing of sensitive data. Implement PII redaction, tenant isolation, encryption at rest, and appropriate access controls so customers and participants can trust how their data is treated. * **Data Integration \& Reliability:** Design flexible paths to bring in structured and unstructured data from many sources and formats. Handle schema changes, partial failures, and edge cases without breaking downstream consumers. * **Customer \& Research Collaboration:** Partner closely with our researchers, product teams, and enterprise customers to turn ambiguous requirements into durable data capabilities. * **Pragmatic Shipping:** Balance long\-term architectural rigor with the need to ship incrementally and learn from real\-world usage. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must Haves** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of professional engineering experience (excluding internships) at tech and product\-driven companies, including ownership of production systems that customers depend on. * **Backend \& Data Proficiency:** Strong command of Python and/or TypeScript, plus solid SQL and data modeling fundamentals. Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * **Data Systems Experience:** Hands\-on experience building data pipelines or integrations, including batch and/or streaming processing, workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal), and schema evolution. * **Security Mindset:** Practical experience with authentication and authorization, encryption, secrets management, multi\-tenancy, and handling sensitive data in enterprise or regulated environments. * **Product Thinking:** A track record of balancing technical excellence with a pragmatic approach to shipping, always keeping the customer's problem at the center of the solution. * **Adaptability:** Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-growing environment by navigating loosely defined tasks and managing competing priorities effectively. ### **Nice to Haves** * **Data at Scale:** Experience working with terabyte or petabyte\-scale datasets and distributed data processing, using technologies such as ClickHouse, Flink, or BigQuery. * **Real\-Time Voice \& Media:** Experience with WebRTC, streaming speech\-to\-text and text\-to\-speech, or LLM\-powered conversational products. * **Enterprise Data Integrations:** Experience building customer\-facing connectors, data\-sharing workflows, APIs/SDKs, or developer platforms for enterprise customers. * **Compliance \& Privacy:** Experience working with sensitive customer data, including practical approaches to protecting, de\-identifying, and sharing it responsibly. Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, enterprise security reviews, or privacy\-enhancing techniques such as differential privacy. * **Human Behavior Interest:** Curiosity about social science, survey research, or how people think and make decisions. **Our Process** =============== We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations. **Reapplication Policy:** To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simile observes a **90\-day waiting period** before reconsidering candidates for the same role. **Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** ======================================== **Equal Opportunity:** Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically. **Accommodations:** If you require support or reasonable accommodations during the application process due to a disability, please let us know. We are happy to assist.

Responsibilities** **Mechanical Engineering** * **3D Modeling \& Drafting:** Create detailed SolidWorks 3D models and assembly/fabrication drawings adhering to industry standards (drafting standards, weld symbols, tolerances, and material specifications). * **Engineering Analysis:** Perform mechanical and machine design calculations and computer models to validate designs, including finite element jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Spam and Abuse
jobs.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for the Spam \& Abuse team at Snap! Spam \& Abuse protects the integrity of every Snapchat account. We keep spam, bot, and automated accounts off the platform, from the device and registration through everything those accounts do afterwards. We keep the rightful owner in control of their account by detecting and stopping account takeover and securing login, recovery, and sessions. We track how adversaries operate off\-platform and turn that into live defenses. And we run the shared detection and enforcement platform that makes real\-time decisions on accounts and publishes account risk that teams across Snap act on. Alongside this, our Secure Mobile Client team builds the client and backend mechanisms behind sensitive flows like registration, login, and recovery, as well as on\-device safety surfaces such as in\-app reporting and end\-to\-end encryption. As the team's technical lead, you'll work across all of these areas. What you'll do: * Set the technical vision and multi\-year architecture for Spam \& Abuse, spanning spam and bot detection, account takeover defense, the detection and enforcement platform, and secure jobs.title: Display Engineer :: Spring, TX
jobs.description: **MUST HAVE:** Practical troubleshooting. Hands\-on work with enterprise PCs, displays, docking, hardware validation, or related AV systems; able to explain a real issue investigated beyond replacing hardware or rebooting. * MUST HAVE: Independent problem solving. Defines the symptom, attempts reproduction, compares working versus failing setups, changes one variable at a time, and distinguishes evidence from a guess. * MUST HAVE: Curiosity and learning agility. Researches unfamiliar technology, asks productive questions, and can grow into specialized display engineering without needing step\-by\-step direction. Secondary Skills \- Nice to Haves * graphics drivers * Firmware * BIOS Job Description The Display Engineer is a hands\-on technical role focused on reproducing, isolating, validating, and resolving display and docking issues in enterprise endpoint environments. Work spans monitors, notebooks, workstations, docks, cables, graphics drivers, firmware, operating systems, and integrated peripherals. The engineer builds representative test setups, compares known\-good and failing conditions, changes variables systematically, and documents findings that engineering teams can act on. We welcome candidates from enterprise endpoint troubleshooting, display or AV integration, docking support, hardware validation, and technical escalation backgrounds. Deep knowledge of every display standard is not a prerequisite. What matters is a demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar problems independently, learn quickly, reproduce symptoms, isolate causes, and verify results rather than relying on part swaps or routine update/reboot steps. * Lead complex display investigations. Own end\-to\-end troubleshooting of issues such as intermittent black screens, signal loss or cutouts, delayed display detection, wake/resume failures, resolution or scaling problems, refresh\-rate limitations, multi\-monitor instability, input switching, and dock\-to\-display behavior. * Reproduce enterprise environments. Build representative test configurations that mirror the reported endpoint, monitor, dock, cable/adapter path, operating system, firmware, graphics driver, display settings, and connected peripherals so that testing reflects the actual environment rather than a simplified lab scenario. * Use disciplined root\-cause isolation. Perform controlled A/B testing, known\-good versus known\-bad comparisons, and structured test matrices. Change one variable at a time and distinguish correlation, common denominators, hypotheses, and confirmed root cause. * Troubleshoot the complete display path. Investigate DisplayPort, HDMI, USB\-C video, Thunderbolt/USB4, cables, docks, bandwidth constraints, and display detection. Build deeper expertise in link training, EDID, MST/SST, DSC, and related protocols as needed. * Validate multi\-display and high\-demand topologies. Test single\- and multi\-monitor configurations, daisy chains, docking paths, high\-resolution or high\-refresh configurations, scaling behavior, GPU\-to\-display workloads, and combinations that place greater demand on link bandwidth or topology management. * Separate video from integrated peripheral paths. Troubleshoot monitors that also function as hubs or conferencing devices by independently validating display, USB, webcam, microphone, speaker/audio, Ethernet, hub enumeration, and power\-delivery paths rather than treating a one\-cable monitor as a single subsystem. * Perform firmware, driver, BIOS, and OS regression validation. Compare behavior before and after monitor or dock firmware, graphics\-driver, BIOS, and operating\-system changes. Determine whether an update introduces, resolves, or exposes an interoperability issue and confirm results through repeatable testing. * Develop repeatable validation plans. Create test cases for cold boot, restart, sleep/wake, reconnect, input changes, firmware updates, topology changes, and repeated cycles. Record reproduction rate and expected\-versus\-actual behavior so results can be compared over time. * Collect engineering\-quality evidence. Capture exact hardware topology, firmware and driver versions, OS build, reproduction steps and rate, logs, screenshots/video, timing data, and known\-good/known\-bad combinations. Produce concise evidence packages that another engineering team can act on without repeating basic troubleshooting. * Partner with product and R\&D engineering. Escalate well\-isolated issues with a clear technical question, supporting evidence, and a working hypothesis. Collaborate with firmware, graphics, docking, platform, and display teams to verify fixes or practical workarounds. * Support deployment and readiness decisions. Validate proposed fixes, firmware and driver releases, configuration changes, and new display combinations before broader deployment. Identify residual risk and provide clear pass/fail findings and rollout considerations. * Communicate technical findings clearly. Translate complex troubleshooting results into concise updates for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. State what is confirmed, what has been ruled out, what remains under investigation, and what should happen next without overstating the evidence. * Improve the engineering method. Document reusable test procedures, troubleshooting patterns, evidence templates, and opportunities for automation so recurring display investigations become faster, more consistent, and easier to scale.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Thermoforming
jobs.description: Description: Sportech is a rapidly growing company in Elk River, MN. We are looking for talented people who wish to join a values\-based company that desires to help our people and customers win. We design, manufacture, and assemble cab components and systems for the powersports, golf and turf, industrial and agricultural end markets. Our design and engineering capabilities allow us to provide complex components and assemblies to our original equipment manufacturer customers. We are always *on the gas* and seeking dynamic, enthusiastic, and motivated individuals to join our extraordinary team. Sportech offers eligible full\-time employees a robust and competitive benefits package, which includes: * Medical, dental, and vision plan options, including flexible spending accounts (HSA, FSA, and DCA) * Short\-term and long\-term disability benefits * Basic life insurance and voluntary life insurance * Hospital indemnity plans, pet insurance, and legal/identity theft services * 401k plan with up to a 4% employer match * Paid company holidays, paid vacation, and paid volunteer time * Sportech Learning Academy (SLA) with courses offered onsite quarterly, focusing on personal and professional growth and development for employees, and tuition reimbursement options for courses completed outside of Sportech Further benefits information is provided as part of the offer process for any offer extended by Sportech. Pay varies by position and is based on multiple factors including labor market data and, depending on position, may include education, work experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, and/or certifications. Additionally, Sportech takes into account the internal equity of current employees when considering compensation. Sportech’s reasonable and good\-faith estimate for the range of new hire compensation at the time of posting for this position is between $88,000 \- $98,000 annually. Pay may also include variable compensation from time to time such as overtime for non\-exempt positions, shift differential for specific shifts, and/or bonus targets (subject to plan eligibility and other requirements). **Job Summary** The Manufacturing Engineer specialized in Vacuum Thermoforming will have a “process improvement and ownership attitude” to provide process leadership and support of overall plant objectives. This individual will have input in numerous areas of the business including prototype support through production assembly of plastic vacuum thermoformed products. * Ongoing recommendations, support, and implementation of plans for improved safety, quality, delivery and cost. * Assist in improving manufacturing processes by utilizing continuous improvement tools and methodologies. * Work with NPD on best practices for cost and manufacturability are applied during product design and to help insure seamless transition from design through pre\-production to fully implemented manufacturing. **Essential Job Functions** * Aid in production transfers from NPD to manufacturing focusing on vacuum thermoformed products. * Develop process documentation including Process Flow and FEMA, Operator instructions, standardized work, and preventive maintenance recommendations. * Develop new tooling and gauging to better plastic thermoformed parts and processing. Support tooling design reviews and improvements. * Accurately enter and maintain Method of Manufacture (MOM) operations within ERP system. * Develop, evaluate, and drive improvements to manufacturing methods, utilizing knowledge of product design, materials and parts, fabrication processes, tooling and production equipment capabilities, assembly methods, and quality control standards within the vacuum thermoforming process. * Support production floor during all phases of product development (prototype through improvements to existing products.) * Improve manufacturing efficiency by analyzing and planning workflow, space requirements, and equipment layout. * Troubleshoot manufacturing problems and related tooling, equipment or process issues. * Recommend, support and implement improvements, modifications, or additions that will improve work processes. * Take the lead in analyzing the need for new process development and to meet company needs including specifying, ordering and installing new equipment or processes. * Contribute to the definition, development and implementation of LEAN manufacturing initiatives. * Identify, implement and track cost savings ideas. Requirements: * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Materials, or Plastic Engineering (equivalent work experience may be considered) * 5\+ years manufacturing plastic forming experience required. * Must have general understanding of multiple manufacturing processes including machining and assembly practices, tools and fixturing in plastic forming and processing. * Proficiency in 3D CAD Software (preferably Solidworks). In addition to fixture design, must be able to open, view and manipulate assemblies. * Demonstrated ability to implement change in a way that positively impacts overall department and company performance. * Must be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Must excel at working in a team environment with a high level of people/interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to cross functionally drive results. * Knowledge of ERP software preferred but not required. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to move parts and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Ability to safely and effectively use hand and power tools. * Ability to consistently wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). * Ability to work in a production facility with fluctuating temperatures, humidity, and noise levels. * Ability to perform precision work requiring manual dexterity and fine motor control without damaging molds, tooling, or other equipment. * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods. * Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach as needed. * Ability to safely work around manufacturing machinery and equipment.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Platform Core Services
jobs.description: **Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.** ------------------------------------------------------------ Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage. Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners. As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission. Reporting to Senior Engineering Manager, Platform Core Services, you will help build and maintain the shared platform services that our client engineering teams use to deliver solutions for their customers and end users. The Platform Core Services team owns foundational capabilities such as Auth, User Sync, Composer, and other shared services. This is high\-leverage work: when we get an abstraction right and manage it in one place, we lower the cost of software delivery, make systems more stable, and keep security consistent for every team that depends on it. Please note that this is a **hybrid role based in Seattle**, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 255 S King St location. Candidates must be based in the Seattle metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on\-sites. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Write, review, and deliver production\-ready code with a focus on correctness, clarity, and maintainability. * Participate actively in code reviews—giving constructive feedback and leveraging review comments as a learning opportunity. * Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to explore implementation approaches, accelerate development, generate documentation, and augment code reviews—providing sufficient context to get high\-quality, system\-aware outputs, and always critically reviewing AI\-generated code before shipping. * Contribute to architectural discussions and tech debt prioritization within your team. * Proactively clarify requirements to remove ambiguity; identify and mitigate risks before they become blockers. * Deliver features independently on well\-scoped work; support larger multi\-person projects with consistent execution. * Collaborate with product managers and designers to break down complex requirements into manageable, shippable units. * Advocate for high engineering standards including test coverage, documentation, and observability. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support system reliability and respond to production issues. * Identify and resolve root causes across code domains; add logging, alerting, and monitoring as a standard part of your work. * Build and evolve shared services (Auth, User Sync, Composer) and the infrastructure and APIs beneath them, so client teams integrate instead of rebuilding. * Own shared systems that fall between teams: learn, document, and stabilize them, and roll out changes safely through versioning, backward compatibility, and deprecation paths. * Partner with client teams to turn repeated patterns into shared components with clear contracts, and measure adoption to guide what we evolve next. **What success looks like in this role** ---------------------------------------- * **Delivery \& Quality –** Deliver projects on time, within scope, and with high stakeholder satisfaction. Maintain high system uptime and low defect rates through strong testing and observability practices. * **Independent Execution –** Complete well\-scoped tasks independently, resolve issues proactively, and accurately track your own work. Estimates are improving in accuracy sprint over sprint. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering –** Regularly use AI to assist with features, debugging, documentation, and test creation—iterating on prompts to improve output quality, and always validating results against team standards. * **Collaboration –** Partner effectively with product, design, data, and engineering teammates, contributing meaningfully to team goals and alignment. * **Engineering Excellence –** Contribute to improved team velocity through planning, estimation, and delivery best practices. Continuously seek out new techniques—including AI capabilities—to improve engineering outcomes. * **Code Quality –** Write code that is tested, secure, and easy for others to understand and maintain. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 3–5 years of professional software development experience * Proficiency with Ruby on Rails or Python, Postgres, GraphQL, React, and TypeScript, Datadog, RSpec Framework, * Experience building full stack applications * Actively uses AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to assist with features, debugging, and test creation—iterates on prompts to improve output quality and critically reviews all AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and standards compliance * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment * Experience working in cross\-functional Agile teams * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on clean, maintainable code and attention to detail * Embraces writing well\-designed tests that accompany all code **Note**: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in\-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria. * Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to **One Medical**accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type. * Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning * A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents. * We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays. * At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Access to **Noom****,** a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals. * Access to fertility care support through **Carrot**, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses. * Access to**Wellhub**, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription * Access to **BrightHorizons**, which provides sponsored child care, back\-up care, and elder care * Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year. * $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes. **Not sure if you meet every requirement?** Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly\-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. ***Our privacy policy:*** ***https://springhealth.com/privacy\-policy/*** *Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $153K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **The Team** ------------ The Data team builds and runs the systems that make Stability AI's data usable, both to operate the business and to train our models. We're a small, collaborative team that works closely with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research. We focus on outcomes rather than hours, and you'll have deep technical access and the freedom to build. **Our stack:** AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, EMR, Step Functions, EventBridge), Iceberg, dbt, Postgres, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, QuickSight, Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, Customer.io, PostHog, OpenTelemetry and SLURM — or similar. We care about the judgement more than the logo. **The Work** ------------ You'll own our company data platform end to end: the AWS data lake, the transformation layer, the integrations between our business systems, and the Kubernetes\-based infrastructure they run on. The data that runs the business (billing, usage telemetry, identity, CRM, ERP, cloud cost) lives in a dozen systems that were never wired together. You'll be the engineer who connects them and keeps them reliable. You'll also be the data engineer for our research teams across audio, video, image and 3D, building the pipelines that turn raw media into training\-ready datasets. This is a hands\-on role with real ownership, not a data\-prep or analyst seat. * **Own** the company data platform end to end: the S3/Athena/Glue lake, the dbt project and its daily build, ingestion from Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, OpenTelemetry and product events, and the Postgres serving layer for dashboards and AI agents * **Build and operate** integrations between billing, CRM, ERP, identity and telemetry systems so revenue, usage, cost and customer identity reconcile automatically instead of through spreadsheets and tickets * **Design and maintain** the warehouse layer: dimensional models, data contracts with product engineering for event schemas, quality tests, lineage and a catalog * **Enforce** PII tiering (open vs. restricted schemas) through access grants, working with Security and Legal * **Process** data at scale: billions of telemetry rows, terabyte log streams, Iceberg tables, partitioning and cost control * **Own** orchestration and infrastructure: orchestration on EKS, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and join the business\-hours on\-call rotation for the daily pipelines * **Deliver** operational reporting for Finance and leadership: revenue by business line, credits and prepaid liability, and cloud cost by department * **Support** the research teams across every modality: source, license\-check, ingest and version large training datasets for audio, video, image and 3D * **Build** the generation, filtering, deduplication and captioning pipelines that turn raw or synthetic media into training\-ready shards, and run them at scale on our SLURM cluster and cloud object storage * **Keep** lineage, quality metrics and dataset documentation current so any researcher can reproduce a training set * **Lead** design reviews, mentor teammates and write the runbooks that remove single\-person dependencies * **Partner** with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research on company\-wide data initiatives **What You Bring** ------------------ We're looking for an engineer who pairs strong software engineering habits with warehouse. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering habits with warehouse modelling depth, and the judgement to say what a number means and what it does not. ### **Experience** * 6\+ years building and running production data platforms, including ownership of the architecture * Experience integrating SaaS business systems (Stripe, HubSpot, an ERP, an identity provider) into a warehouse * Production experience preparing large multimodal training datasets and running batch workloads on HPC or cloud schedulers (SLURM, Kubernetes or similar) * Comfort working independently in a small team with real ownership ### **Skills \& Expertise** * Expert SQL and Python, with strong software engineering habits: tests, code review and CI * Warehouse and lake experience with real modelling: Iceberg or Delta on S3, Athena/Trino, Snowflake or BigQuery, and dbt * An orchestrator in production (dbt, Airflow or Argo) and distributed processing (Spark or equivalent) * AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm and Terraform — you can debug a failing Glue job and a broken Helm release ### **Additional Strengths** * Prior 0\-to\-1 platform ownership at a startup * Experience working with research teams on generative models, or hands\-on exposure to audio, video, image or 3D data * FinOps and cloud cost reporting * Familiarity with SOC 2 or similar compliance requirements for data access **Benefits \& Compensation** ---------------------------- **Outside the United States** Compensation and benefits are set for each country's market and local practice. If you're applying from outside the U.S., your recruiter will share the details for your country early in the process. **United States** * A remote\-first company with teammates across multiple countries who bring diverse perspectives, and flexibility built into how we collaborate. * Health coverage for you and your family. Choose from PPO and HMO plans, including select plans where Stability AI covers 100% of premiums for you and your eligible dependents. * HSA and FSA accounts to set aside pre\-tax dollars for healthcare and other eligible expenses. * Company\-paid life insurance, with the option to add voluntary coverage for yourself, your spouse, and your children. * Short\- and long\-term disability coverage, to protect part of your income if illness or injury keeps you from working. * 401(k) with company match of up to 4%. * Paid parental leave to support you as your family grows. * Flexible paid time off, plus paid company holidays. * The equipment you need to do your best work, provided by Stability AI. At Stability AI, we aim to pay fairly and competitively, and we believe you should know what a role pays before you invest time in getting to know us. **The annual base salary range for this role is $175,500 \- $230,000 USD.** It reflects our good\-faith expectation for the role as posted and applies to candidates hired within the United States. Where you fall within that range depends on the depth and relevance of your experience, your skills, and how you perform in our interview process. Because great candidates don't always map neatly to a single level, we may also consider someone for a level above or below the one posted. If we do, the range will be adjusted to match, and we'll talk it through with you openly. Base salary is also just one part of your total compensation. Eligible employees take part in our equity program and receive the benefits described above. We'd rather talk about all of this early than leave you guessing, so your recruiter is happy to walk you through the range, how offers come together, and anything else that matters to you, at any point in the process. ### **Privacy Policy** To learn how we collect, use, and protect your information during the hiring process, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: IT Administrator (Part-Time)
jobs.description: **About Statusphere** Statusphere is an influencer\-marketing technology platform built for enterprise brands to make human\-generated content scalable, measurable and brand\-safe across social, retail and paid media channels. The platform uses AI to automate and orchestrate large\-scale creator programs, from sourcing and vetting influencers, to fulfillment, compliance, tracking and rights management. Brands including Express, Parlux, Kendo Brands, and LG H\&H use Statusphere to drive social SEO, improve product discoverability and generate measurable sales impact online and in\-store. For more information, visit www.joinstatus.com. Our product is our business model. Every improvement in how we match creators to campaigns and deliver on time comes from the platform, not from manual effort. We bring the same approach to how we run the company: documented, repeatable, and automated wherever we can. We are a distributed team of about 50 employees plus a network of contractors, and we expect to keep growing. As our first dedicated IT hire, you will build the foundation that keeps everyone equipped, secure, and productive as we scale. **About the Role:** As our first dedicated IT hire, you'll be the go\-to person for how our team gets equipped, stays secure, and gets unblocked. IT is currently run by our VP of Engineering in addition to their core responsibilities. You'll take ownership of it and turn ad\-hoc work into documented, repeatable, automated systems, reporting initially to our VP of Engineering, and transitioning to our SVP of Engineering \& Technology once that role is in place. You'll partner closely with HR, Finance, Operations, and Engineering, and you'll help shape how IT scales as we grow. You thrive in a startup environment, enjoy building process where none exists, and take pride in making technology just work for the people around you. **What You’ll Do:** * **IT \& Technical Support:** Provide day\-to\-day IT support across the organization, troubleshooting hardware, software, account, and connectivity issues directly, escalating to Engineering or leadership when needed, while building a simple ticketing and knowledge base process that keeps support scalable. * **IT strategy and roadmap:** Assess our current IT and security posture, maintain a lightweight 6–12 month IT roadmap, and own tooling recommendations and the IT budget in partnership with Engineering leadership and the COO/CFO. * **Device management (MDM):** Own and configure our MDM platform (Iru, formerly Kandji), including enrollment, configuration profiles, patching, app deployment, and compliance policies. Confirm the size of our Windows footprint (including company\-issued machines used by contractors) and, if warranted, define a lightweight baseline for those devices (approved software, encryption, patching). Recommend, with Engineering leadership, an approach for personal devices that access company data (for example, a BYOD policy and conditional access through Google Workspace and SSO rather than full MDM). * **Identity and access management:** Administer SSO and enforce MFA. Manage our password manager, 1Password, and run periodic access reviews so everyone has the access they need and nothing more. Production AWS and application\-level access remain owned by Engineering; this role supports provisioning, where needed, and the review process. * **Scaling through automation and policy:** Find repetitive work and automate it where the time savings are clear using tools like n8n, Google Workspace admin tooling, and MDM workflows. Draft and maintain IT policies such as acceptable use, device standards, personal device use, and access management. * **Security awareness:** Run phishing and security awareness training, using KnowBe4\. Help employees understand and follow IT policies, including what software is and isn't permitted on company devices. * **Incident response:** Act as first responder when an endpoint or user account is compromised, handling quarantine, initial investigation, and documentation, following the incident management framework owned by Engineering leadership. * **Documentation and standard processes:** Build and maintain runbooks, a knowledge base, and standard operating procedures so IT knowledge doesn't live in one person's head. * **Onboarding and offboarding:** Run the full employee and contractor lifecycle for IT. That means provisioning laptops, accounts, and access on day one, and cleanly recovering devices and revoking access when people leave. * **Remote logistics:** Coordinate shipping, setup, repairs, and equipment returns for a distributed team. * **Asset and license management:** Maintain an accurate hardware inventory covering assignments, warranties, and refresh cycles. Track SaaS licenses and reclaim unused seats to keep costs in check. Report savings opportunities to the COO/CFO quarterly. * **Data protection:** Ensure device encryption (FileVault/BitLocker) is enforced, manage Google Workspace data retention, and own recovery procedures for lost or stolen devices. * **Vendor management:** Manage day\-to\-day relationships with IT vendors (MDM, endpoint protection, hardware suppliers) and evaluate new tools as needs evolve, with purchasing approval through Engineering leadership and the COO/CFO. * **Engineering enablement:** Support engineers with laptop standards, tool access (for example GitHub and Workspace), and secure setup for US and international team members, in coordination with the VP of Engineering. * **Cross\-functional partnership:** Work with HR on onboarding and offboarding timing and on the employee experience. Work with Finance and Operations on purchasing and budget. Keep IT controls (device management, access reviews, training, onboarding/offboarding) documented and evidence\-ready to support future compliance efforts, including SOC 2\. This role does not own the compliance program. * Other duties as assigned **What You Bring:** * 3–5\+ years in IT support or systems administration, ideally at a startup or SMB * Experience as a sole or lead IT person, or building IT processes from the ground up * Hands\-on experience with an MDM platform (Iru/Kandji, Jamf, Intune, or similar) * Strong Google Workspace administration skills * Experience with SSO, MFA, and identity management tools * Comfort supporting both macOS and Windows * Experience writing and implementing IT policies (device, access, acceptable use) * A documentation\-first habit: you write things down so others can follow them * Scripting or automation experience (Bash, PowerShell, Python, or low\-code tools like n8n or Zapier) * Clear, friendly communication with non\-technical coworkers **Nice to Have:** * Experience with SaaS management platforms * Hands\-on incident response or endpoint investigation experience * Exposure to a SOC 2 readiness effort (ISO 27001 or similar a plus) * Familiarity with AWS or cloud infrastructure basics **Education:** * Associate’s degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days:** * Learn our environment, tools, and current IT processes * Take over day\-to\-day support and onboarding/offboarding * Document onboarding and offboarding end\-to\-end * Complete a full hardware and SaaS inventory * Confirm the Windows and personal device footprint and propose an approach * Publish runbooks for our most common support issues * Identify and automate at least two repetitive IT processes * Deliver an IT and security gap assessment with prioritized recommendations * Present a lightweight 6–12 month IT roadmap to Engineering leadership and the COO/CFO **Hours and Availability:** * Work Schedule: We offer flexibility in scheduling, with a preference for three days per week (Monday, Wednesday, and Friday) or approximately 24–28 hours per week. We are open to discussing alternative schedules based on availability and business needs. * Most support happens during standard business hours. Occasionally, evening or weekend support may be needed for urgent issues or planned maintenance, but this isn't a regular occurrence. **Travel:** Typically, less than 5%. Primarily remote environment with occasional travel to the company’s warehouse for on\-site IT support. No special physical demands required. Pay: $40\.00 \- $48\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 24\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Application Question(s): * This is a part\-time role (24–28 hours per week). Are you able to work a part\-time position? Location: * Orlando, FL 32822 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Orlando, FL 32822

medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage \- ensuring you and your family stay healthy and protected. **Generous Paid Time Off** We believe in work\-life balance. By leveraging data from connected devices, wearables, and nutrition tracking, the platform provides highly personalized guidance designed to improve long\-term health outcomes. jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Strategic ACI is seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, build, deploy, and operate production AI capabilities for NGA on a new Digital Ecosystem program. As a member of the Platform/Cloud team, this individual will develop the reusable services, integrations, agent harnesses, and operational practices that enable large language models (LLMs) and AI agents across the customer’s broader Digital Ecosystem. You will help develop an enterprise architecture digital twin, connecting UAF and SysML models with real\-time and near\-real\-time operational data. These capabilities will enable AI\-assisted analysis, data\-driven insights, and visualizations of enterprise capabilities, dependencies, risks, and mission impacts. The role combines architecture with direct implementation, including writing code, integrating models and tools, building deployment pipelines, evaluating AI performance, and troubleshooting production systems. Working alongside platform engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and mission teams, this individual will turn emerging AI technologies into secure, reliable capabilities that support customer workflows. Salary will be commensurate within the advertised range, based on applicable qualifications. **Responsibilities:** **AI Platform Development:** Design and implement reusable AI services, APIs, components, and reference architectures that support multiple applications and mission workflows across the Digital Ecosystem. **LLM Integration and Engineering:** Build LLM\-enabled capabilities using model APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, and inference services. Evaluate hosted, self\-hosted, and open\-weight models against security, performance, deployment, and cost requirements. **Agent Harnesses and Workflows:** Develop agent harnesses that manage model interactions, context, state, memory, tool access, workflow execution, and error handling. Implement bounded autonomy, human approval, execution limits, and recovery mechanisms for agents interacting with enterprise systems. **Production Deployment and Operations:** Build automated testing and deployment pipelines for AI services and agent workflows. Implement versioning, configuration management, monitoring, rollback, incident troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Address reliability, latency, resource consumption, and operational cost. **AI Evaluation and Observability:** Develop representative evaluation datasets and automated tests for accuracy, groundedness, task completion, safety, and tool\-use behavior. Instrument AI services to trace model interactions and agent actions, support troubleshooting, and detect performance degradation. **AI Governance and Cybersecurity:** Implement controls for approved models and tools, identity, least\-privilege access, secrets management, sensitive data handling, audit logging, and third\-party dependencies. Address prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool execution, and AI supply chain risks in coordination with cybersecurity and governance teams. **Enterprise Architecture Digital Twin:** Work with enterprise architects and digital engineering teams to build a digital twin that connects UAF and SysML models with enterprise applications, infrastructure, services, and operational information. Support an evolving view of enterprise capabilities, dependencies, and conditions. **Real\-Time Model Integration:** Build interfaces and event\-driven integrations that associate real\-time and near\-real\-time feeds with UAF and SysML model elements. Apply AI to correlate information, identify changes and inconsistencies, and propose validated model updates while preserving provenance, configuration control, and human oversight. **AI\-Enabled Insights and Visualizations:** Combine architecture models and operational data to identify patterns, anomalies, dependencies, risks, and potential mission impacts. Develop AI\-enabled dashboards, visualizations, natural language interfaces, and analytical services that make findings traceable to supporting information. **Data and Knowledge Integration:** Partner with data engineers and data owners to connect AI services with approved structured and unstructured sources. Implement retrieval, indexing, metadata, provenance, and access\-aware information delivery within established data governance practices. **Digital Ecosystem Integration:** Connect AI services with Digital Engineering, MBSE, modeling, simulation and analysis, software development, and mission workflows through governed APIs and tool interfaces. **Technical Collaboration:** Contribute code, design reviews, documentation, demonstrations, and delivery estimates. Work with customer stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to prioritize use cases, resolve technical issues, and transition prototypes into supported production capabilities. **Qualifications:****Required:** Active TS clearance, with SCI eligibility ty to troubleshoot issues across AI applications, integrations, and supporting platform services. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with data, platform, cybersecurity, architecture, and mission teams. Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across mission and technical stakeholder groups. **Desired:** Experience operating self\-hosted or open\-weight LLMs, including inference optimization, GPU resource management, and capacity planning. Experience implementing LLMOps or MLOps practices, including model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, deployment gates, monitoring, and rollback. Experience developing enterprise architecture digital twins or other model\-driven decision\-support capabilities. Familiarity with UAF, SysML v1 or v2, and integration of architecture models with external data, APIs, or analytical tools. Experience applying AI to correlate operational information with model elements, detect changes, or support controlled model maintenance. Experience building AI\-enabled dashboards, visualizations, natural language query interfaces, or analytical applications. Experience with vector search, knowledge graphs, semantic models, or access\-controlled enterprise retrieval. Experience with infrastructure as code, identity federation, secrets management, distributed tracing, and observability platforms. Experience conducting AI security testing, red teaming, or threat modeling for LLM applications and agent workflows. Experience supporting Intelligence Community, defense, or other regulated mission environments. Experience deploying AI capabilities in government cloud, restricted\-network, disconnected, or edge environments. Familiarity with Digital Engineering, MBSE, Digital Twins, or modeling, simulation and analysis workflows. Experience supporting security accreditation, controlled data handling, and evidence\-based compliance. Applicants can learn more about the company’s status as an equal opportunity employer by viewing the federal EEO is the Law poster. Why choose a career with Strategic ACI? Strategic ACI believes that our greatest asset is our employees. Our goal is not to meet our staff’s expectations, but to exceed them. In this role, you'll work closely with senior/lead engineers and play an active part in expanding our security automation capabilities. You will gain hands\-on experience with a diverse set of technologies, including various security tools, APIs, and cloud services, helping to streamline our security operations and enhance our incident response efficiency. You will work with Take\-Two's Information Security teams, reporting to the Director of Security Operations Engineering. **WHAT YOU'LL TAKE ON** ----------------------- * SOAR Platform Support: Assist in the development, testing, and maintenance of SOAR playbooks, workflows, and integrations under the guidance of senior team members. * Automation Execution: Help identify repetitive, manual tasks within security operations and work to implement automated solutions that improve response speeds. * Collaboration and Learning: Partner with other security analysts to understand their workflows, acting as a collaborative peer while actively developing your own technical skills. * Documentation and Maintenance: Create and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for automation workflows, scripts, and tool integrations. * System Health: Assist with basic SOAR platform maintenance, routine updates, tool migrations, and logging system changes **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ * Experience: 1–3 years of experience in a Security Engineering level role. Previous experience working as a Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst or IT support technician is a strong plus. * Technical Foundational Knowledge: A solid understanding of core security concepts and exposure to how tools like SOAR, SIEM, EDR, and threat intelligence platforms operate. * Scripting Skills: Foundational scripting skills in Python (or similar languages) with the ability to read, troubleshoot, and write basic scripts for API integrations. * Analytical Mindset: Strong problem\-solving skills with a natural curiosity for breaking down manual workflows into logical, step\-by\-step processes. * Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical workflows accurately and collaborate effectively with teammates. #### **Great to Have** * Certifications: Entry\-to\-intermediate industry certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, GIAC Information Security Fundamentals (GISF), or GSEC. * Tool Exposure: Familiarity or academic/lab experience with a leading SOAR platform (such as Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSOAR, Tines, or Splunk SOAR). * Additional Scripting: Exposure to programming and scripting languages like Go, Bash, PowerShell, or JavaScript. * Security Frameworks: Basic familiarity with security frameworks like MITRE ATT\&CK or NIST. **WHAT WE OFFER YOU** --------------------- * **Great attribution, and SLA\-based remediation * Track record of running production services with clear SLOs, on\-call coverage, change management, and continuous\-improvement loops * Experience driving multi\-quarter roadmaps end\-to\-end — from problem framing through rollout, adoption, and steady\-state operation — and delivering predictably against them * Comfortable making and defending pragmatic build\-vs\-buy decisions, and knowing when to invest in custom engineering vs. lean on an existing capability * Strong experience with relational databases, cloud\-based data warehouses, schema design, data migrations, and data lifecycle considerations for security services; experience with event\-streaming technologies such as Kafka or Pub/Sub. * Hands\-on experience with public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure experience also valued) and with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) at enterprise scale * Strong understanding of automated testing — unit, integration, contract, regression, and end\-to\-end — and a demonstrated commitment to shipping code with tests, not around them * Strong understanding of observability practices and tools for metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and service\-level objectives * Hands\-on experience integrating backend services with developer workflows (CI/CD, source control, ticketing) in a way that scales with a large engineering organization * Strong understanding of secure software development practices and modern cloud\-native architectures * Solid understanding of AI/ML and the emerging engineering considerations associated with it, including the responsible use of AI\-assisted and agentic engineering tools such as Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex * Strong cross\-functional partner: comfortable working closely with a variety of security and product engineering teams to align requirements, rollout plans, and operational ownership * Effective at representing your work, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership, and equally effective explaining the same content to staff engineers in detail * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong presentation abilities * Demonstrated curiosity, bias for action, and a genuine builder's mindset — you want to ship the services, not just describe them **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working in cybersecurity, cloud security, or another highly available and risk\-sensitive production environment * Familiarity with CSPM, CNAPP, IaC scanning, admission control, SSPM, or cloud workload protection tooling and the shape of the findings they produce * Experience integrating with security analytics, SIEM, SOAR, detection, or response platforms * Experience with policy\-as\-code (e.g., Rego) and infrastructure as code
