jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30\+ media brands and 50\+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines. We're a remote\-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern. We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all\-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in\-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together. **All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.** **The opportunity** ------------------- We're seeking a **Product Engineer** with a builder's mindset: someone who naturally spots problems, gets excited about finding solutions, and enjoys turning ideas into working products. You might have founded a startup, launched your own product, built side projects, automated something that frustrated you, or simply be the person who is always looking for a better way to do things. At TechnologyAdvice, engineers don't just implement requirements or wait for work to be assigned. They work directly with business stakeholders, Product, and other engineers to discover problems worth solving, determine what solutions make sense, and take ownership of delivering measurable results. You'll work across the full problem\-solving lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and understanding business needs to evaluating solutions, implementation, deployment, measurement, and iteration. Sometimes the right solution is a new application. Other times it's improving an existing process, automating manual work, or recognizing that something isn't worth building at all. We value engineers who are just as interested in figuring out what to build and why as they are in actually building it. AI is a core part of how we work. We expect engineers to use AI throughout their workflows to accelerate research, discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and delivery. We believe AI enables resourceful engineers to experiment faster, tackle more ambitious problems, and create impact well beyond what would traditionally be possible for a small team. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment remain essential to ensuring those solutions are reliable, secure, and maintainable. You won't be expected to independently navigate every complex opportunity from day one. You'll collaborate with Product, Engineering leadership, and experienced engineers as you develop the judgment to assess opportunities, make tradeoffs, and own increasingly ambiguous problems. What matters is that you take initiative, seek out context, and drive problems forward rather than waiting for detailed instructions. Success in this role is measured by the business impact you create, your ability to identify and solve meaningful problems, the speed and quality of your execution, and how effectively you use AI and technology to increase your leverage. We care more about whether your solutions create value than how much code you write. The best candidates are curious, resourceful, action\-oriented builders who enjoy experimenting, challenging assumptions, and turning ideas into reality. Whether your experience comes from building products at work, launching your own ventures, or pursuing projects simply because you wanted to see if something could be done, we're looking for people who take pride in solving problems and want to have a direct hand in making a business better. **Location:** United States **What you'll do** ------------------ * Use AI\-assisted development practices to rapidly prototype, validate, and ship production\-ready solutions. * Work directly with business stakeholders and Product to understand business problems, user needs, constraints, and desired outcomes. * Proactively identify opportunities to improve business outcomes by engaging stakeholders, examining data, questioning existing processes, and investigating problems, not just responding to assigned work. * Take ownership of problems from solution definition through implementation, deployment, measurement, and iteration. * Build and maintain full\-stack applications, backend services, automations, data workflows, and internal tools that create business value. * Understand how your work connects to measurable outcomes such as revenue, cost, speed, quality, capacity, risk, or customer experience. * Use data, feedback, and product analy learn quickly. * **We embrace AI** — AI\-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT are expected parts of the engineering workflow. * **We understand the problem** — Engineers don't just receive requirements; they seek out the context necessary to make good decisions. * **We own outcomes** — Shipping code isn't the finish line. We care whether what we built actually solved the problem. * **We use judgment** — Not every decision needs a process, framework, or escalation. We expect engineers to develop the judgment to make good decisions at the appropriate level. * **We stay curious** — Engineers are encouraged to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, experiment, and learn. * **We increase our leverage** — We continually look for ways technology and AI can allow a small team to create disproportionate business impact. **Growth to Senior Product Engineer** ------------------------------------- Product Engineers are expected to develop increasing autonomy, judgment, scope, and business ownership over time. A Senior Product Engineer consistently demonstrates the ability to independently identify high\-value opportunities, turn ambiguous business problems into solutions, make sound architectural and build\-vs\-buy decisions, and own complex work from discovery through measurable business impact with minimal oversight. Progression to Senior is based on demonstrated scope, autonomy, judgment, leverage, and impact—not tenure. **What we offer you** --------------------- * **Career Growth:** Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives. * **Flex Fridays:** Adjust your 40\-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays. * **Remote\-First Culture:** Work from the comfort of your home. * **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need, when you need it. * **Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. * **Insurance Protection:** Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability coverage. * **401K with Match:** Secure your future with our company\-matched retirement savings. * **Paid Parental Leave:** Support for new parents during life's special moments. * **Wellness Perks:** Access Headspace and enjoy monthly fitness reimbursements. * **Pet Insurance:** Care for your furry family members. * **Speaker Series Bonus:** Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus. * **Book Reimbursement:** Get up to 12 books reimbursed per year to fuel your learning. * **Bucket List Benefit:** Celebrate milestones with annual contributions toward your dream adventures after 3 years. * **In\-Office Perks:** Enjoy catered lunches for our in\-office team. \#LI\-Remote **Work authorization** Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire in an employer approved US state and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company. **EOE statement** We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law. *Pre\-employment screening required.* *TechnologyAdvice does not engage with external staffing agencies. Any candidates introduced by such firms will not be eligible for compensation. TechnologyAdvice communicates only through* *@technologyadvice.com* *emails and official recruiting platforms. We never recruit via Teams, WhatsApp, or similar apps, and we will never request money, gift cards, or personal financial details during hiring.* *Any AI\-generated or incomplete application answers will be auto\-rejected.*

jobs.title: Sr. Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. We are looking for a **Senior Software Quality Engineer** who will * Support Tempus’ software development lifecycle (SDLC) activities for medical device software by ensuring Design and Development file (DHF) documentation and are generated, maintained, and compliant throughout the product lifecycle. * This role will support requirements, architecture, verification and validation, traceability, risk management, cybersecurity, and quality\-system activities including CAPAs, change control, audits, and training. The Senior Software Quality Engineer will apply scalable, risk\-based approaches to evolve Tempus’ QMS for novel digital health, AI, and machine\-learning technologies, while ensuring alignment with FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and other applicable regulatory requirements. This position will report to the Director, Software Quality Engineering. **Responsibilities** * Support Tempus’ SDLC activities for medical device software by ensuring required documentation and Design and Development file (aka DHF) deliverables are generated and maintained throughout lifecycle of medical device software/SaMD, including: + SRS, SAD, SDS, V\&V + Traceability + Risk management/FMEA + Cybersecurity * Own project compliance to various QMS procedures and activities including: + Change control + CAPAs and NCRs + internal and external audits + management reviews + training * Apply innovative, scalable and risk\-based approaches to optimize the QMS, including integrating eQMS systems, while meeting compliance for novel technologies. * Maintain knowledge of the evolving regulatory landscape for Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies, and incorporate best practices in Tempus’ SDLC processes and QMS. * Work cross functionally with project teams, including Product, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs * Performs other Quality Assurance related duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * BA/B.S. or higher preferred in Biomedical, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or relevant engineering disciplines. * 5\+ years in a software quality role within the FDA regulated medical device/IVD (or EU MDR/IVDR) industry. * Experience and working knowledge of applicable regulations and standards: FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with various QMS approaches and consolidating multiple QMS * Experience with FDA Class I and II AI/ML\-enabled software, including LLM\-based agents * ASQ CSQE or comparable quality/regulatory certification Chicago/National: $110,000\-$155,000 NY/SF: $120,000\-$165,000 The expected salary range above is applicable if the role is performed from California and may vary for other locations (Colorado, Illinois, New York). Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position. Additionally, ***for remote roles open to individuals in unincorporated Los Angeles*** *– including remote roles\-* Tempus reasonably believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: engaging positively with customers and other employees; accessing confidential information, including intellectual property, trade secrets, and protected health information; and appropriately handling such information in accordance with legal and ethical standards. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **About Us** Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives. ### **Why Work Here?** We’re looking for people who can change the world. Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Enterprise Modernization & AI Delivery
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. Our mission: Modernize global enterprises safely, automatically, and at unprecedented speed. We move fast, own outcomes end\-to\-end, and build at the frontier of applied AI for large\-scale transformation. **Role Summary** We are seeking a Technical Project Manager (TPM) with deep expertise in delivery and value stream management to lead our most strategic customer implementations. In this role, you are not just a project scheduler. You are the delivery leader who directs cross\-functional pods across multiple parallel workstreams, making sure Tessera’s multi\-agent AI solutions are integrated predictably, safely, and successfully into complex enterprise environments, and that every phase of the engagement delivers measurable value. You will be the bridge between Tessera and enterprise client’s delivery team spanning core business systems, ERP, CRM, finance, HR, and operational platforms. The role calls for strong technical fluency across enterprise architectures, business processes, integrations, and transformation programs. You will work closely with customer Solution Architects, technical teams, system owners, and business stakeholders, translating operational and technical requirements into actionable plans for Tessera’s delivery pods. You will use your understanding of enterprise modernization to guide issue resolution, support architecture discussions, and keep every workstream aligned on what is required, technically feasible, and most valuable to the customer. The ideal candidate has spent years leading delivery within System Integrator environments or large enterprises and wants to apply AI to accelerate modernization at scale. **Key Responsibilities** *Cross\-Functional Delivery Pod Leadership* * Lead cross\-functional delivery pods of Forward\-Deployed Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI engineering teams, setting priorities, removing blockers, and holding the team accountable to outcomes * Own end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-agent AI modernization programs from discovery through deployment and operational handoff * Build pod structures, cadences, and operating rhythms that scale across multiple concurrent customer engagements * Anticipate technical friction points related to data structures, legacy customizations, integrations, and workflow orchestration before they affect the pod’s velocity *Multi\-Workstream Orchestration* * Run multiple parallel workstreams across data, integration, AI agent configuration, testing, and business process alignment, managing dependencies and sequencing between them * Coordinate across Tessera teams, customer stakeholders, and third\-party vendors to maintain delivery momentum across every workstream * Develop integrated program plans that give leadership a single view of progress, risk, and value across all workstreams * Support modernization efforts spanning core business systems, CRM, finance, HRIS, and operational platforms *Delivery \& Value Stream Management* * Map customer value streams end to end, identifying where Tessera’s agentic AI capabilities remove manual effort, shorten cycle times, and reduce cost * Define and track delivery and value metrics such as time\-to\-value, throughput, cycle time, and business outcomes achieved, and report them to executive stakeholders * Prioritize work by business value, so the highest\-impact capabilities reach customers first * Continuously improve delivery flow by identifying bottlenecks, handoff delays, and waste across the program *Technical Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment* * Act as the primary technical interpreter between customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and Tessera’s AI and product organizations * Lead discovery workshops to map system landscapes, business processes, data flows, and integration points to Tessera’s agentic AI capabilities * Translate technical trade\-offs, delivery plans, and value outcomes for both executive stakeholders and delivery teams * Facilitate alignment across enterprise architecture, IT operations, security, and business functions *Execution in Complex Enterprise Landscapes* * Drive Agile delivery within enterprise change management frameworks and modernization methodologies * Anticipate risks related to legacy system remediation, data harmonization, integration dependencies, and business continuity * Develop mitigation plans grounded in operational and technical realities *Enterprise\-Grade Governance \& Deployment* * Ensure all delivery activities meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, auditability, and operational governance * Oversee technical prerequisites for integrations across enterprise platforms and cloud environments * Partner with customer security and infrastructure teams to ensure successful deployments and operational readiness *Customer Engagement \& Escalation Management* * Serve as the primary delivery contact during onboarding and implementation * Manage technical escalations from customer IT and business teams, coordinating responses across pods, engineering, and product * Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers through clear communication, accountability, and consistent delivery *Startup Mindset \& Extreme Ownership* * Operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment with evolving priorities and ambiguous challenges * Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex enterprise transformation programs * Travel to customer sites for workshops, solution design sessions, and implementation oversight as needed **Required Qualifications** * 4–6\+ years of experience leading technical delivery for large enterprise modernization or transformation programs * Proven track record leading cross\-functional delivery teams or pods through complex, technically demanding implementations * Demonstrated experience running multiple concurrent workstreams with significant dependencies * Experience mapping and managing value streams, and tying delivery work to measurable business outcomes * Comfort defining, tracking, and reporting delivery and value metrics to executive audiences * Strong understanding of enterprise business systems, integrations, data flows, and modernization challenges * Experience with one or more enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or similar * Familiarity with enterprise architecture concepts, APIs, middleware, and cross\-platform integrations * Ability to explain technical concepts, system constraints, integration challenges, and data models to both engineering teams and business stakeholders * Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills * Strong command of Agile methodologies and experience orchestrating complex programs with multiple dependencies **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience at a top\-tier consulting or system integration firm (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, IBM, Capgemini), or leading large enterprise modernization programs internally * Experience delivering AI/ML\-enabled programs, or strong interest in LLMs, automation, and multi\-agent AI orchestration * Familiarity integrating ERP and other core systems with adjacent platforms including CRM, HRIS, finance, analytics, middleware, and cloud infrastructure * PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, value stream management, enterprise platform certifications, or related certifications are a plus **Behavioral \& Problem\-Solving Expectations** * Balance technical systems understanding with program structure and executive communication * Lead pods with clarity, accountability, and a bias toward outcomes over activity * Operate with extreme ownership and thrive in ambiguity * Simplify complexity and drive alignment across technical and business teams * Keep a strong customer\-first, value\-first mindset throughout complex transformation programs Compensation Range: $170K \- $250K

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early\-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end\-to\-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI\-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote in Latin America. **About the Role** ------------------ As our Technical Recruiter, you'll specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment and own hiring from intake to offer. That includes our hardest searches, Senior and Principal AI Engineers, plus our regular full\-stack, front\-end and back\-end roles. You'll know the AI engineering market well enough to tell a mid\-level from a senior, from a principal before they reach our interview team. You'll also use AI tools to source and run searches better than a manual process can. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities** * Specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment: own full\-cycle hiring for AI and ML Engineers (Senior and Principal) and for full\-stack, front\-end and back\-end engineers. That covers intake, sourcing, screening, scheduling, feedback, debriefs and offers. * Design and execute recruitment strategies: build a search plan for each role, covering target profiles, channels, messaging and timelines. Adjust it when the market says otherwise. * Find principal\-level AI talent: build pipelines for Senior and Principal AI Engineers beyond LinkedIn. Look in GitHub, open\-source projects, research papers, technical communities and referrals. * Level candidates accurately: screen against senior\-vs\-principal so the interview team only meets candidates at the right level. * Use AI tools to improve search: use AI tools and LLM assistants for market mapping, search strings, candidate research and outreach. * Turn recruiting data into insights: track time\-to\-fill, pass\-through rates, sources and decline reasons in Greenhouse. Use them to show where searches stall and what to change. * Optimize hiring processes: tighten intake, scorecards, scheduling and candidate communication. Document playbooks and interview plans so searches run the same way every time. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 5\+ years of technical recruiting, with full\-cycle ownership of engineering searches. * Recent experience hiring AI or ML engineers at Senior level or above, and you can explain how a Principal differs from a Senior. * Enough technical fluency to discuss LLM applications, RAG, evaluation, fine\-tuning and MLOps with engineers, and to probe their claims. * Hands\-on, daily use of AI tools in your recruiting work, with examples of what changed because of them. * A track record of sourcing passive senior candidates through channels other than LinkedIn. * Fluent written and spoken English. You'll work with engineers and leaders across many countries. * A data\-driven approach: you use funnel metrics to make decisions and explain them to hiring managers. Comfortable with Greenhouse or a similar ATS. * Experience designing recruitment strategies and improving hiring processes, not only running them, in a small team where processes are still being built. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience recruiting for consulting firms or agencies with client\-driven hiring * Experience hiring across multiple LATAM countries and the US * Spanish or Portuguese * Experience with Juicebox AI or similar AI sourcing tools **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is: * **AI\-fluent.** You already use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently. * **A builder.** You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection. * **A clear communicator.** You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t. * **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge\-sharing, and hands\-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. **This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.** As a team member, you can expect: * To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed * Payments made in USD * 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years * Wellness \+ Remote Stipend * AI Voucher **About Able** -------------- Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio\-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. **Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!**

Communication:** * Coordinate technical activities and interfaces across engineering, project teams, customers, partners, and other disciplines as required for successful delivery. * Serve as a primary technical point of contact for assigned projects or engineering efforts, communicating status, decisions, technical needs, and risks to appropriate stakeholders. * Identify communication or coordination gaps that could affect delivery and take action to resolve them. * Communicate problems requiring broader involvement with sufficient context, potential solutions, and expected impacts to support timely decisions. * Adapt technical communication to the needs and knowledge of customers, project teams, and technical contributors. **Quality, Safety \& Process:** * Apply company policies, quality requirements, engineering practices, and established processes throughout assigned engineering work. * Follow all safety requirements, identify and communicate unsafe conditions, and stop or escalate work when necessary to protect people, equipment, or operations. * Plan and perform appropriate technical reviews, checks, and testing to ensure engineering deliverables and integrated systems meet applicable requirements. * Identify quality, safety, or process risks affecting assigned work and take appropriate action to resolve them, including engaging others when broader involvement is required. * Identify and recommend practical improvements to engineering practices and processes based on project experience and lessons learned. **Leadership \& Organizational Influence:** * Promote a professional, collaborative, and respectful work environment through consistent actions, communication, and interactions with others. * Provide technical guidance, feedback, and informal mentoring to less experienced team members as opportunities arise. * Share technical knowledge and lessons learned and help others understand engineering practices, project requirements, and effective approaches to completing their work. * Provide technical direction to others when coordinating engineering work for assigned projects or systems. **People Leadership:** * This role does not normally have formal responsibility for managing employees. Employees may provide technical direction, mentoring, and feedback to others. * Employees preparing to transition to the people\-management career track may also be assigned supervisory responsibilities as part of a documented development plan. **What We’re Looking For** **Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or another pertinent technical discipline. * Typically 4 or more years of relevant experience, with demonstrated capability consistent with the expectations of the role. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * Strong working knowledge of engineering, automation, and control\-system concepts, with the ability to apply that knowledge across complete projects or significant engineering efforts. * Ability to interpret, apply, and reconcile project requirements, drawings, specifications, procedures, standards, and other technical information. * Ability to learn and work effectively with new engineering tools, software, platforms, equipment, and customer technologies as assignments require. * Sound technical judgment, including evaluating problems and risks, developing potential solutions, and recognizing when additional expertise or broader involvement is needed. * Effective written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to organize and prioritize engineering work, manage competing needs, follow through on commitments, and communicate risks that could affect successful delivery. * Commitment to quality, safety, professional conduct, and continuous improvement. **What You’ll Get** * Competitive compensation with annual bonus opportunity * 401(k) with company match * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with low\-cost options * Paid time off and sick leave * Tuition reimbursement and professional credential support * In\-house and external technical training opportunities * Exposure to jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Governance - TikTok Privacy and Security
jobs.description: Technology Software Engineer \- AI Governance \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** Seattle **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A39691A Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. TikTok's Privacy and Security (PNS) Data Retention team makes sure that data across the platform is kept only as long as it is needed, and is then deleted reliably and verifiably. The data covers online services, offline warehouses, logs, backups, and ML training datasets. Global privacy rules keep getting stricter, and the data estate keeps growing to exabyte scale. The team owns the policies, platforms, and technical controls that turn retention commitments into guarantees we can enforce and audit. As a Backend Engineer \- Data Retention, you will design and build scalable, reliable, high\-performance systems that manage the lifecycle of data at TikTok scale. That includes finding and classifying data, applying retention policies, running deletion, and proving that deletion happened. You will turn fast\-changing privacy and regulatory requirements into concrete platform capabilities. You will work closely with storage infrastructure, data platform, ML platform, product, privacy, legal, and security teams to ship solutions across thousands of services and storage systems. Responsibilities: \- Design and build large\-scale data lifecycle management systems that enforce retention policies across heterogeneous storage: RDBMS, KV stores, caches, message queues, data warehouses (Hive/HDFS), object storage, logs, and backups. \- Build and run high\-throughput deletion pipelines, such as TTL enforcement, user account deletion propagation, and partition and snapshot expiry. They must be correct, idempotent, and observable, and must not hurt the stability or performance of production systems. \- Build data discovery and inventory capabilities, including metadata collection, data lineage, and classification of personal and sensitive data. These keep retention policies accurately mapped to real storage assets. \- Build verification, auditing, and reporting systems that prove deletion is complete and on time. Provide evidence for internal audits and regulator inquiries. \- Support exception workflows such as legal holds, retention extensions, and policy approvals, with fine\-grained access control and full audit trails. \- Work with ML platform teams to extend retention and deletion controls to training datasets, feature stores, and derived artifacts such as embeddings and model checkpoints. \- Work with privacy, legal, and compliance teams so that systems meet applicable regulations (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other global and regional privacy laws) and TikTok's own data commitments. \- Help shape the technical roadmap for the data retention platform, and find and evaluate new techniques and tools that improve coverage, efficiency, and reliability at scale. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. \- Strong background in large\-scale distributed systems, databases, messaging and streaming systems (such as Kafka or Flink), and caching. \- Solid understanding of storage internals and data lifecycle concepts, such as TTL, compaction, partitioning, snapshots and backups, and consistency models. \- Experience building high\-throughput batch or streaming data pipelines with strong correctness guarant age systems. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $207480 \- $368220 annually. ​ Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: ​ 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; ​ 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. ​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ ​ Diversity \& Inclusion ​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. jobs.title: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description: ### **About this role** We're looking for a software engineer, reliability\-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest\-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero\-model and LoRA\-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self\-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page. The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin\-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands\-on production\-reliability experience on large\-scale distributed or GPU\-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD\-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered. A product mindset applies: the on\-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on. ### **Responsibilities** * Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed. * Triage and extend automated self\-healing: when the node\-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero\-model or LoRA\-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time. * Own end\-to\-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix. * Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first\-class requirements into the platform's abstractions. * Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering. * Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack. * Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest\-priority issues. * Lead reliability cross\-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade\-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage. ### **Requirements** * Experience operating a provisioning or host\-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design. * Deep experience owning production reliability for large\-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML\-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi\-node training or disaggregated\-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics. * Familiarity with the operational realities of multi\-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter\-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority. * A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node\-level health/remediation systems. * Comfort with event\-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit\-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident. * A software\-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $160,000 \- $280,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Platform Integration
jobs.description: **Job Description:** ==================== **Shape the Future of AI in Capital Markets and Legal Disclosure** At Toppan Merrill, we’re building Quinn, a cloud\-based platform that helps law firms, investment banks, and public companies draft, review, and file SEC documents, including IPO registration statements, prospectuses, proxy statements, and annual and quarterly reports. We’re applying AI to one of the most consequential document workflows in the world, where precision, trust, and accountability matter most. You’ll join a small, highly visible team, work directly with senior engineering leadership, and engage with some of the world’s largest law firms. In this role, you’ll be the founding engineer for how outside AI tools such as Harvey and ChatGPT Enterprise securely connect to Quinn. That means production\-ready OAuth 2\.1 with token exchange, deny\-by\-default authorization, and a complete audit trail, built on the emerging Model Context Protocol standard and held to the security bar of the most demanding enterprise clients there are. The first thing Quinn will pilot with clients is this integration. A working prototype already exists; turning it into a service a law firm’s security team will approve is the core of this role. You’ll build it and own it after launch. **What you will do** * Productionize the integration service (an MCP server) that outside AI tools connect to, over the Streamable HTTP transport * Implement sign\-in with OAuth 2\.1 using our identity provider (Okta), including token exchange so the service calls Quinn on behalf of the attorney and never passes an outside tool’s token through * Enforce what each outside tool may do: which actions its permissions allow, and which documents are on each client firm’s approved list, denying everything else by default * Keep an immutable, exportable audit trail of every action an outside tool takes, including reads, that client firms can review * Design controls for AI\-specific risks, including tool misuse driven by content in documents and abnormal bulk access to documents * Test with at least two external AI tools, and support client firms’ security reviews * Build an internal command\-line tool for our operations teams on the same service **How you’ll work** You’ll own the integration service end to end and partner closely with our Identity and Security teams on the authorization design and client security reviews. You’ll also work with a backend engineer building the matching controls inside the Quinn platform, and with the IT and innovation teams at our design partner law firms. **First 90 days** * Stand up the service with production sign\-in in a test environment * Implement the approved\-document list and the audit log * Connect a first external AI tool end to end **Required** * 6\+ years of backend or platform engineering * Deep, hands\-on OAuth 2\.0 or 2\.1 and OIDC experience: authorization servers, scopes, audience, PKCE, token exchange * Experience building services that external customers or partners integrate with, including security reviews * Security\-first engineering habits: deny by default, least privilege, audit logging * Strong in TypeScript (Node.js) or Python, and comfortable working in the other; our services use both * Experience integrating with customers’ identity providers (OIDC or SAML federation, multi\-tenant SSO) **Preferred** * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or AI tool and agent integrations * Okta administration or custom authorization servers * Experience integrating with enterprise legal software (document management systems, Harvey, or similar) **Success at 12 months** * Pilot running with design partner firms, having passed Toppan Merrill’s security review and each firm’s own * Service passed an external penetration test with no open critical or high findings * At least two different AI platforms connected Learn more at https://www.toppanmerrill.com/careers/. About Toppan Merrill *We understand that your skills deserve recognition. That’s why we offer a competitive pay scale ranging from* $135K–$175K ***annually,*** *based on experience and expertise. We believe in compensating our dedicated team members fairly for their hard work and commitment. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.* *Toppan Merrill strives to provide our employees and loved ones with competitive benefits including:* * *Enhanced Medical, Dental, Vision and, Life insurance for employees and dependents* * *Employer Contribution to* 401(k) * *Paid time off including vacation, sick, community involvement, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays* * *Paid parental leave* * *Paid community* *involvement/volunteer* *days* * *Wellness Resources and Employee Assistance Programming* Toppan Merrill is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified individuals, including qualified women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and veterans, are encouraged to apply.

That growth creates opportunities to build new skills, work with new technologies, and take on new challenges to keep building our business. * **Better together:** We work across teams, solve problems together, and support one another through both successes and setbacks. **More to Love** * **Healthcare that's fully covered:** We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for our team members. * **Celebrate together:** From Company Day and cultural heritage celebrations to team lunches and milestone celebrations, we make time to connect and celebrate. * **The perks are pretty delicious:** Enjoy unlimited Italian sodas, flavored lattes, and plenty of opportunities to taste the products we're creating together. * **And, of course, the essentials:** Competitive pay, paid time off, and a comprehensive benefits package to support you. **Work Location:** San Leandro, 5 days on\-site at Toraniland: Flavor Factory. rapidly develop application solutions. * Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement. * Support production applications, troubleshoot with application integration, microservices, and REST\-based service development. * Proficiency in database design techniques and philosophies. * Knowledge in Agile development, its tools and, and The **Senior Software Engineer** is responsible for the analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of API proxies and integration services on the **Google Apigee** platform within the enterprise portfolio. The Engineer will provide the technical expertise on the design and construction of new and existing modules as well as the use ofappropriate development tools and data flows across the API and Middleware Integrations stack. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: ### **About Treeswift:** In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead. We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments. Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms. To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital. We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia. Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us. **About the role** ML sits at the heart of Treeswift’s product translating complex sensor data into meaningful insights that drive critical decision\-making for our customers. As our business grows the importance of this work only grows with it. You will join at a critical inflection point and will lead the charge on the following priorities (amongst others): * **Technical Leadership.** You will be responsible for continuing to improve the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. As the breadth of models and datasets grows you will thoughtfully introduce feedback loops and ML Ops that accelerate model improvement. You have excellent judgement on what problems require fast experimentation/validation, and where we should be focused on sustainable scalable improvement over a longer period of time. * **Edge model development.** Working closely with our robotics and embedded teams, you will support growing exploration of model deployment on devices for real\-time use cases. * **Lead and grow our team (as needed)**. We have an incredibly talented ML team distributed across our NYC, Philly and SF offices. You will lead the current team, identify gaps and grow the team as needed. * **Collaborate closely** with our Software, Robotics, Hardware and Product teams to deliver on Treeswift’s vision and business objectives. You will report to our Head of Software Engineering. This is a full\-time, hybrid role based out of our Lower Manhattan, NYC office (2\-3 days per week in person, currently pinned to Tuesdays and Wednesdays). ### **About Machine Learning At Treeswift** Machine Learning at Treeswift is the layer that translates sensor data into meaning for our end\-users. At a high\-level we develop three categories of model that power downstream business decisions. * **Classifying** a point cloud \- distinguishing ground from vegetation from structures etc. * **Identifying** individual objects within 3D space — poles, equipment, wires, trees, etc. * **Describing** characteristics of individual objects. This includes everything from tree species and health, detailed wire types, pole information (height, attachments, etc.) etc. Together this information informs critical decision\-making for our customers such as: * What vegetation is a risk to utility infrastructure and how severe is that risk? What action is recommended as a result (trim, removal, etc…)? * Is ongoing asset construction deviating from the expected design and if so how? If so, is this an approved deviation or a quality issue that needs to be addressed before a downstream customer or financial impact? ### **Required skills and experience** * Early\-stage or fast\-moving environments where scope and ownership evolve quickly. * Strong familiarity with models built on images, video, lidar, pointclouds, speech, or geospatial data sources. * Building and using cloud\-based training and inference pipelines (including orchestration, deployment, and the operational realities of running models at scale). * Willingness to drive architecture and approach across both, bring innovative ideas and rapid execution to new and existing models, and be accountable for the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. * Leading development of our training and inference pipelines. You will lead how we build and evolve these pipelines as well as move us towards on\-device inference for time\-sensitive use cases. * 3\+ years experience in leadership: setting clear direction for a team, driving architecture and design decisions, reviewing others' work, and mentoring individual engineers. * Experience creating, curating, and cleaning training datasets, and building the evaluation and feedback loops that drive model improvement. * Strong programming skills and expertise in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and TensorFlow. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You have the ability to keep a team distributed across three offices (NY, Philly, SF) well\-aligned. You will be a strong partner to the product team on how to balance technical trade\-offs and product objectives. ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience developing models for and deploying models to run on edge\-devices. * Experience with deep learning training frameworks such as MLflow, Lightning, Weights and Biases, or similar. * Experience with semantic mapping, image processing techniques and/or computer vision fundamentals. * Experience with Apache Airflow (especially 3\.x) and/or Astronomer. * Experience with one or more of: Sensor Fusion, SLAM, Visual Odometry. * 8\+ years of professional experience **Benefits** * Competitive salary and equity package * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents * Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents * Flexible, unlimited paid time off * 401(k) retirement savings plan * Free OneMedical membership * Commuter benefits * Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues. The estimated salary range for this position is $225,000 \- $265,000 USD. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City. Treeswift is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.description: **The position is described below. If you want to apply, click the Apply Now button at the top or bottom of this page. Send an email to* *Accessibility* *(accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response).* **Regular or Temporary:** Regular**Language Fluency:** English (Required) **Work Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America)### **Please review the following job description:** The AI Security Engineer is responsible for implementing, validating, and supporting security controls for artificial intelligence, generative AI, and agentic solutions across the enterprise. This role works closely with AI engineering, application development, platform, cybersecurity, governance, and architecture teams to help ensure AI\-enabled solutions are secure, resilient, compliant, and operationally ready. As a key contributor within the Forge AI Security organization, the AI Security Engineer assists in the design, implementation, testing, monitoring, and validation of security capabilities for AI\-enabled applications, intelligent agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, and enterprise AI platforms. The role supports security reviews, threat modeling activities, adversarial testing exercises, control validation efforts, and deployment readiness assessments throughout the AI delivery lifecycle. This position requires hands\-on security engineering experience and a strong understanding of modern application security principles, cloud security, and AI security concepts. The role regularly partners with developers and solution teams to implement security controls, troubleshoot security issues, validate configurations, and improve the overall security posture of AI\-enabled systems. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across no\-code, low\-code, and pro\-code AI development environments and supporting AI solutions deployed within Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud platforms, including services such as Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, and Amazon Bedrock.**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** The following is a summary of the essential functions for this role. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. **AI Security Engineering** * Implement and maintain security controls for AI\-enabled applications, agentic workflows, intelligent automation solutions, and AI platforms. * Support secure integration of AI services, APIs, orchestration frameworks, and external tool connections. * Configure and validate security controls including identity protections, access controls, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and deployment safeguards. * Assist engineering teams in implementing secure patterns for AI and generative AI solutions. * Support AI solution development across no\-code, low\-code, and pro\-code environments. **Security Reviews and Testing** * Participate in security architecture reviews, threat modeling activities, and AI security assessments. * Assist in identifying security risks, design weaknesses, and control gaps within AI\-enabled solutions. * Perform validation testing to verify effectiveness of implemented controls and security requirements. * Support adversarial testing, misuse\-case analysis, vulnerability assessments, and deployment readiness reviews. * Document findings, recommendations, remediation activities, and validation results. **Detection, Monitoring, and Observability** * Build and maintain monitoring and alerting capabilities for AI\-enabled applications and workflows. * Develop and enhance detection logic designed to identify suspicious prompts, unusual workflow behavior, unauthorized access attempts, and policy violations. * Support collection and analysis of telemetry used to monitor AI system health, security, and compliance. * Assist cybersecurity operations teams with investigation and remediation of AI\-related security events. **Project Support and Collaboration** * Partner with software engineering, platform, product, architecture, and cybersecurity teams to implement security requirements throughout the development lifecycle. * Support project teams by providing technical guidance on secure implementation practices and control requirements. * Participate in design reviews, working sessions, and implementation discussions to ensure security considerations are included early in the delivery process. * Assist in remediation planning and implementation activities for identified security findings. **Continuous Improvement** * Stay current on emerging AI security risks, threats, technologies, and industry  ** * Understanding of AI and LLM security concepts including prompt injection, jailbreak techniques, sensitive data exposure, tool\-use risks, model misuse, and output handling concerns. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled applications, intelligent agents, automation platforms, or generative AI solutions. * Knowledge of cloud\-native security principles, access control, identity management, secrets handling, and secure integration design. * Understanding of monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability concepts. * Familiarity with no\-code, low\-code, and pro\-code development environments and associated security considerations. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective written and verbal communication skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Minimum of 5 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, application security, cloud security, software engineering, DevSecOps, or related technical disciplines. * Experience implementing security controls for enterprise applications, APIs, cloud\-native solutions, or distributed systems. * Experience participating in security reviews, security testing, vulnerability management, or threat modeling activities. * Experience supporting software development lifecycle security practices. * Experience collaborating with software engineering and technology teams to address security requirements and remediation activities. * Experience implementing or supporting security controls for generative AI, AI\-enabled applications, agentic systems, or intelligent automation platforms. * Experience with Microsoft Azure security services, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, or related technologies. * Experience with AWS cloud services, including Amazon Bedrock and related AI capabilities. * Experience performing application security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, or security validation activities. * Experience working in financial services, banking, healthcare, government, or other regulated industries. * Experience supporting governance, compliance, or audit\-driven technology environments. * Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, agent orchestration frameworks, and AI workflow platforms. * Industry certifications such as Security\+, Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Security Specialty, CISSP Associate, GIAC certifications, or similar credentials. **General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible
