jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Overview: Turn5 is a fast\-growing eCommerce company serving automotive enthusiasts across multiple brands including AmericanMuscle.com, AmericanTrucks.com, ExtremeTerrain.com and Eckler’s.com. We build platforms, content, and customer experiences that help people customize, restore, and enjoy their cars and trucks. We’re people\-first, team\-oriented, and looking for someone excited to contribute to meaningful, high\-impact work. **What****You’ll****Do*** Develop and support new and existing web applications and site features * Work across the SDLC: planning, estimation, development, testing, deployment * Collaborate with the development team, product, UX \& QA to clarify requirements and deliver solutions * Take ownership of assigned work from start to finish * Be a mentor or provide guidance to teammates when appropriate **What****We’re****Looking For** We value strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to grow. If you’re stronger on some of these and lighter on others, that’s perfectly fine – we’re more interested in your ability to solve problems, collaborate, and grow with the team. If you have a solid foundation and are excited to learn, we want to hear from you.* **Required fundamentals:** * Strong proficiency developing object\-oriented backend code in the Microsoft tech stack (.NET 6/8 MVC), and experience with Javascript component\-based libraries frontend frameworks (i.e. React) * Hands\-on experience working within an Agile environment (planning, estimation, development, testing, deployment) * Familiarity with modern web development practices and building scalable applications * **Technologies you may work with here** (These are things you’ll encounter, not hard requirements, so exposure to even a few is great): * SQL and data querying, including stored procedures * Search technologies such as ElasticSearch * Caching and performance optimization * Modern build and deployment tooling, including containerization * Modern UI development with TypeScript, responsive design, and contemporary CSS or testing tools **Who****You’ll****Work With** You’ll join an eCommerce Development group that includes a mix of senior and mid\-level developers, and that partners closely with the QA, UX \& Product teams and well as the IT Development, Data Engineering and Marketing teams. We prioritize work\-life balance, clear communication, and helping each other succeed. **Why****You’ll****Love Working Here** We offer: * Hybrid schedule: * Local (within 50 miles of our HQ in Paoli, PA): typically 2 days onsite per month (yes, month!) * Remote: 2 weeks onsite per year * Competitive compensation in\-line with experience \& impact, plus a quarterly bonus program * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plus immediate vesting on your 401k match * A people\-first culture where curiosity, ownership, and collaboration are valued * Opportunities to grow your technical skillset and contribute to impactful, high\-visibility products **About Turn5** Turn5 is one of the largest and fastest growing eCommerce retailers in the Greater Philadelphia area. Best known for our award\-winning, eCommerce platforms, AmericanMuscle.com, ExtremeTerrain.com, and AmericanTrucks.com, we’ve been engaging muscle car, truck, and off\-road enthusiasts with exceptional products, services, and experiences since 2004\. With the acquisition of Eckler’s in 2022, a pioneer in classic car restoration \& modification for over 60 years, Turn5’s catalog of brands has expanded to now offer aftermarket automotive products for vehicles as classic as the Model T. Our purpose, however, extends beyond selling car parts. We have a commitment to creating meaningful customer experiences at every step of their journey. Whether it’s supplying a unique product that customizes the look and feel of their ride, providing thousands of educational videos for the DIYer or leveraging user generated content to inspire even the most experienced owner, we are obsessed with ensuring we reach as many like\-minded gearheads across the globe as we can. \#CORP

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 2
jobs.description: **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory. **About the job** This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves. You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first\-class part of the work. **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets. * Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking * Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships. * Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces. * Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! **Required:** * Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands. * A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability. * Experience building or working with evaluation/quality\-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn. * Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production. * Fluency with AI\-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking. **Desired:** * Experience with Go and/or Python. * Experience with event\-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka). * Experience building LLM\-backed products. * Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models. **Location** * This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas. **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings. **What We Offer** Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. **Compensation** * *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.* The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: * Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560 \- $160,700 * Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 \- $170,000\. * This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. **Application deadline information** Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, but may change based on business needs.

jobs.description: University Staff**Description** --------------- **Join Our Team and Make a Difference in Higher Education!** At the System Administration office at the University of Colorado, we are dedicated to building a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Our office is committed to fostering a culture where employees find community, a sense of belonging, and the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our mission and purpose. By joining our team, you’ll have a direct impact on shaping the future of higher education. In addition to the Office of the Board of Regents, the University of Colorado’s system administration includes 19 units that provide essential services to CU’s campuses in Aurora, Boulder, Colorado Springs, and Denver, as well as the Office of the President. While not a part of any one campus, we are proud to serve in the centralized office for the University system. Together, we ensure CU continues to deliver outstanding education, groundbreaking research, and valuable service to our communities. We believe in creating an environment where the unique experiences and perspectives of everyone are embraced, enriching the work we do and the strategic outcomes we pursue. If you’re passionate about making a difference, contributing to a dynamic team, and supporting a mission that matters, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey. Learn more about CU System Administration. **Position Summary:** University Information Services (UIS) provides technical services and enterprise applications to the University of Colorado campuses and the Office of the President. UIS is committed to excellence in customer service and technical expertise. Through the development of enterprise applications, UIS supports the University systems used by students, faculty, human resources employees, finance employees, and others. The Senior DevOps Engineer applies an automation mindset leveraging DevOps tools with the application of technical skills and leadership to the areas of application and infrastructure deployment, patching, and support. individuals with disabilities. **Duties and Responsibilities:** Duties and responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to: * Serve as a senior technical architect and systems integrator for large complex systems and applications, including monitoring, orchestration, and automation. * Communicate and collaborate with application owners/managers, initiative leaders, and project leadership to clarify requirements, develop work plans, document, and lead technical architecture. * Apply DevOps methodologies for building and operating highly available, scalable applications and services. * Evaluate, build and modify automation for deploying applications and services based on DevOps and GitOps principles internally and for external teams * Serve as a domain architect providing advice and guidance on new technical solutions and/or architectural changes to existing design, particularly as it pertains to the CrossApps Middleware areas of discipline and support. * Maintain, upgrade, and extend a library of Ansible playbooks, Bash, and m administration, web servers, application servers, database servers, SSL/TLS, logging, clustering, monitoring, RESTful APIs, and container/orchestration. * Ability to apply best practices, design patterns, and DevOps / GitOps principles. * Envision automating everything such that all the organization’s systems could be re\-created from a git repo. * Ability to troubleshoot, resolve, and explain complex problems and discuss trade\-offs of potential solutions. * Skilled in finding, fixing, repairing, and preventing issues. * Ability to learn and use new applications and computer languages, including the use of source control * Ability to work in a twenty\-four\-seven (24x7\) operational environment with on\-call and production support responsibilities * Ability to work remotely while remaining attentive, engaged, responsive, and productive * Knowledgeable in supporting Enterprise Java applications. * Strong attention to detail. * Excellent oral and written communication skills. **How to Apply:** For full consideration, please attach the following as separate documents to your jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Fully onsite in Austin TX AI Engineer — Agentic Systems Mid\-Level Individual Contributor \| 3–5 Years Experience Role **Summary** We are hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and operate agentic AI systems — LLM\-powered agents that reason over enterprise data, call tools, and execute multi\-step workflows end to end. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the center of how we automate complex technical and operational work. You will take ambiguous problems, decompose them into agent workflows, and ship production services that engineering teams depend on daily. This is an ideal role for an engineer with a strong Python and ML foundation who has already shipped LLM or RAG applications and now wants to go deeper into orchestration, tool\-calling, and autonomous multi\-agent architectures. You will work within an established platform and architecture, with senior engineers available for design review — but you will own your components from prototype through production. **Key Responsibilities** Agent Design \& Orchestration Build and ship LLM\-powered agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi\-step tasks using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent orchestration libraries. Implement multi\-agent workflows — planner, executor, reviewer, and specialist roles — including state handling, hand\-off logic, retries, and graceful failure paths. Design and expose tools to agents via function\-calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, wrapping internal APIs, databases, and enterprise systems as safe, well\-scoped agent capabilities. Retrieval \& Knowledge Systems Build and operationalize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines**:** chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, re\-ranking, and context assembly. Integrate structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured sources — SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, REST APIs, Excel, and SQL warehouses — into retrieval and agent context layers. Continuously improve answer grounding and reduce hallucination through better retrieval, prompt design, and context management. Engineering \& Deployment Develop production Python services and APIs for agent and model inference using FastAPI, containerized with Docker and deployed through standard CI/CD pipelines. Instrument agents with tracing, token and cost accounting, latency monitoring, and structured logging so that behavior is observable and debuggable in production. Apply MLOps and LLMOps practices including version control for prompts and configs, automated regression testing, and safe rollout of model or prompt changes. Evaluation \& Quality Build evaluation harnesses for agent workflows — golden datasets, task\-level success metrics, LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression suites that gate releases. Measure and tune for accuracy, latency, and cost, and make explicit trade\-offs between them based on the use case. Collaboration Partner with domain experts, data engineers, and product stakeholders to turn manual workflows into reliable automated agents. Deliver results through interfaces users actually adopt — Streamlit apps, chat interfaces, dashboards, and embedded integrations. Write clear design notes and runbooks, and participate actively in code and design reviews. **Required Qualifications** 3–5 years of professional software, ML, or data engineering experience, including at least 1 year building LLM\-based or GenAI applications. Strong Python engineering skills — not just notebooks. Production code, testing, packaging, async patterns, and API development with FastAPI or similar. Hands\-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or an equivalent) in a shipped application. Demonstrated experience building RAG systems**:** embeddings, vector stores (e.g., FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma), and retrieval quality tuning. Practical command of prompt engineering, structured output, function/tool calling, and context\-window management. Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent), and comfort writing queries against enterprise schemas. Experience containerizing and deploying services with Docker and shipping through CI/CD on a major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Solid grounding in ML fundamentals and familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or HuggingFace Transformers. Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to escalate when a problem is under\-specified rather than guessing. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or comparable agent tool\-integration layers. Production experience with multi\-agent or agentic workflow systems, including human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and approval gates. Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Weights \& Biases, or MLflow. Experience with workflow orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect — or analytics engineering with DBT. Exposure to model fine\-tuning or parameter\-efficient adaptation (LoRA/PEFT) and knowing when it is — and is not — the right answer. Background in a technical engineering domain (semiconductor, hardware validation, manufacturing, or similar) where agents operate over specialized data. Experience with AI governance, responsible\-AI review, or enterprise security requirements for LLM deployments. Building AI Tools and flows for Server Validation Must Have**:** Optimizing Token utilization Python Scripting Database \- Azure VIVA is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: SDK Developer
jobs.description: **About VectorWave** VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio\-frequency waveforms pre\-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog. We are a venture\-backed MIT spinout translating award\-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti\-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi\-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications! **The role** The SDK developer role focuses on building the interface for users to control, program, and operate the APU. You will work closely with the APU development engineers to integrate the functionalities into software packages that ship with the APU. Your work here will create SDKs that seamlessly connect the user to the programmable APU AI signal processing \& inferencing. **Location:** This is an in\-person, full\-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences. **What you'll do** * Design \& deliver SDKs for VectorWave’s partners and APU developers * Integrate automated controls, calibrations, etc. as necessary into the software interface for the APU * Distill which physical parameters are user\-controllable, visible, or automated within the SDK * Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter\-system compatibility * Help build a new developer community around APU edge AI inferencing * Provide SDK support for early partners and developers to ensure successful APU integration **What you bring** * Experience creating SDKs for electronic or radio systems * Experience in system lifecycle management (i.e. updates, feature integration) * Experience creating detailed system and user guide documentation * Expertise in UX and UI for controlling complex systems * Expertise in bug testing and/or software robustness * Familiarity with the basics of deep neural networks **Nice to have** * Explicit SDK design for SDRs, RFSoCs, or other similar systems * UX and UI for manipulating deep neural networks * Software security and application shielding * Remote/web cyber security * Familiarity with PyTorch **How we work** * **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details. * **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them. * **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non\-technical helps us solve problems together. * **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve. * **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust. * **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie. **Compensation and benefits** Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus: **The basics** * Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits. * Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included. * Vision: Guardian. * Unlimited PTO. **Family matters** * We offer 95% dependent premium coverage. * Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning. * Coming soon: Twenty\-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non\-birthing, adoptive, and foster. **For life beyond work** * 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar. * Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit. **Equal opportunity** VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. VectorWave participates in E\-Verify. See the E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters in English and Spanish.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Evergreen)
jobs.description: Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs. We’re more than just a team; we're a close\-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day. At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home. ### **About the job** We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5\+ years of experience building production\-grade applications across the stack. You will work on our Vynca Clinical solution, collaborating closely with design, product, and engineering teammates to deliver performant, secure, and user\-friendly software that improves the delivery of high\-touch care. You’ll own features end\-to\-end—from backend APIs to frontend UI—and work across a modern stack that includes React, TypeScript, FastAPI, and GraphQL. We are looking for someone excited by clean code, thoughtful design, and a strong sense of ownership in building product\-focused software. *This is a hybrid position based in San Mateo, CA, with an expectation of working from the office 2 days per week.* ### **Evergreen Posting** ***Vynca hires for this role on an ongoing basis throughout the year. This posting stays open because we regularly have openings for Senior Full Stack Engineers, but we don’t have a fixed start date or hiring timeline. We review applications as positions become available, and not every applicant will be contacted right away. Submitting an application doesn’t guarantee an interview or offer. If your background strongly matches a current or upcoming opening, a member of our team will reach out. Applications may be kept on file for 6 months for future openings.*** ### **What you’ll do** ### **Backend (Python \+ FastAPI)** * Design and implement GraphQL and RESTful APIs using FastAPI and Strawberry GraphQL. * Build and maintain backend services to support UI features, authentication flows, and patient/provider workflows. * Model data with SQLAlchemy and manage schema changes with Alembic. * Integrate with third\-party APIs (e.g., HealthGorilla, Salesforce, PVerify, Google APIs, Slack). * Write unit and integration tests using Pytest and testcontainers. * Maintain API security, access control, and logging practices. * Event driven architecture, CQRS design patterns, HAPI FHIR Server, Full Text/Fuzzy Search \& Semantic Search. ### **Frontend (React \+ TypeScript)** * Build and maintain features in a React \+ TypeScript codebase using functional components and hooks. * Implement responsive UI components using Material UI (MUI) and Emotion for styling. * Manage client\-side state using Redux Toolkit, Formik, and Yup. * Integrate with backend services via GraphQL (Apollo Client) and REST APIs (Axios). * Handle authentication flows with Auth0\. * Build protected and dynamic routes with react\-router\-dom. * Write unit and integration tests using tools like Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright and MSW. * Implement features like file uploads, PDF generation (pdf\-lib), digital signature capture, and custom surveys. * Use LaunchDarkly for feature flagging and Vite for builds and local dev. ### **Your experience and qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (advanced degree preferred). * 5\+ years of experience in full stack or frontend/backend development roles. * Proficient in React and TypeScript. * Experience integrating GraphQL and REST APIs. * Familiarity with backend frameworks such as FastAPI or similar. * Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ORMs like SQLAlchemy. * Comfortable with git, monorepos, and Yarn or similar package managers. * Testing experience on both frontend (Vitest, Testing Library) and backend (Pytest). * Experience working in Agile teams using Jira and Scrum ceremonies. ### ***Preferred Qualifications*** * Experience with Strawberry GraphQL or Apollo Server, HAPI FHIR. * Familiarity with Auth0 and OAuth\-based authentication. * Experience with document generation or PDF handling (e.g., pdf\-lib, fpdf2, survey.js). * Exposure to Slack bots, email validation, or healthcare\-specific data models (FHIR, HL7\). * Experience with semantic search (e.g. typesense). * Knowledge of building secure systems adhering to law governance standards like HIPPA. ### **Tech Stack You’ll Work With** Frontend: * React 18\+, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Apollo Client, Formik, Yup, MUI, Emotion, Axios, Vite, MSW, Testing Library, Vitest, pdf\-lib, LaunchDarkly Backend: * Python 3\.11\+, FastAPI, Strawberry GraphQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Pydantic v2, Pytest, Auth0, Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Typer, HAPI, Typesense Dev \& Infra: * Docker, GitHub Actions, Poetry, testcontainers, Jira, Scrum ### **Who You Are** * Curious and eager to learn—especially from principal engineers. * Thoughtful about UX and backend reliability. * A proactive communicator and collaborator. * Excited by healthcare complexity and impact. * Comfortable asking for help and giving/receiving feedback. **Additional Information** -------------------------- * The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks. * Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment. * Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein. * Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer\-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved. * Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E\-Verify upon hire. * Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law. * Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in\-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below: + Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing. + Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks). + Regularly requires use of laptop and video\-conferencing technology. + Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less. + Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events. jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: **About WCG** ------------- WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials. **Why WCG** ----------- At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives. What we offer: * Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts * Resources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance tools * Investment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on\-the\-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education support * Time to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time * Pathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission. **Job Summary** --------------- The Software Test Engineer is a member of the Quality Engineering team, responsible for supporting the testing, validation and delivery of WCG namedproducts and systems. The role applies established testing and validation practices across the software development life cycle (SDLC), executes manual and automated test activities, prepares validation documentation, and collaborates closely with Software Engineering, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to support product quality and compliance. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required. * Review requirements and design documentation to help ensure requirements are clear, testable, and consistent with the clinical trial protocol and system design specifications before test design begins. * Develop and execute test and validation activities using established risk\-based testing methodologies; prepare and maintain CSV documentation i test scripts, test summary reports, and requirements\-to\-test traceability matrices. * Contribute to the execution and maintenance of automated test suites using Playwright across UI, API, and real\-time (Socket.io) application components. * Maintain test cases , execution cycles, and traceability records in Zephyr and JIRA, or equivalent test management tools for assigned products and projects. * Conduct and build upon comprehensive manual regression testing cases and scripts to ensure release product quality. * Prepare data sets to test logic, error handling, and system workflows; perform load, performance, and user\-simulation testing. * Report and track defects in the official bug tracking system (e.g., JIRA); ensure reported defects are remediated and re\-validated in a timely manner. * Support ongoing enhancement of manual and automated tests into existing regression and CI/CD test suites, actively working to increase reliability and improve release confidence. * Analyze test results, identify defects or performance concerns, and collaborate with Software Engineering to investigate and resolve issues. * Support change\-control and validation activities by preparing and maintaining required documentation. * Participate in the evaluation and use of approved AI\-augmented testing tools (e.g., AI\-assisted test case generation, self\-healing automation, LLM\-based output evaluation) in accordance with established validation and compliance requirements. * Communicate testing status, findings, and issues to project stakeholders and support customer testing activities as needed. * Periodically conduct training for other team members on testing/validation tools, standards, and best practices. * Follow established testing and validation methodologies and provide feedback on process improvements when appropriate.. * Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here. * Attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the position. **EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, skills, and related experience. * **CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:** * None r ement tools such as Zephyr (or equivalent Xray/TestRail) or Helix ALM (Test Track). * Experience executing and contributing to automated regression suites with Playwright preferred * Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, risk\-based testing, and software/validation testing life cycles. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; exceptional attention to detail. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects in a dynamic environment. * Ability to work in multi\-disciplinary teams (Developers, Business Analysts, QA, Validation Compliance) to meet aggressive goals and deliver quality results. * Ability to translate product and protocol requirements into test cases, validation deliverables, and automated test scripts. * Ability to analyze and troubleshoot product defects and provide creative solutions for optimizing system performance. Preferred: * Proficiency in one or more scripting/programming languages, preferably Typescript * SQL scripting and API testing experience (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured). * Experience with JIRA and Scrum or Kanban/Agile methodologies. * Exposure to AI\-augmented/agentic testing tools or workflows (e.g., AI\-assisted test authoring, prompt engineering for test\-case generation, self\-healing automation). * Modern Tooling \& Technical Ecosystem Skills: Given WCG's technology ecosystem spans PHP, Socket.io (real\-time/WebSocket communication), React, Valkey (Redis\-compatible caching/data store), MySQL, both virtually and deployed in local meetings, the following modern tools and skills are especially valuable for a test engineer supporting this stack: + Enterprise Test Management: Zephyr Scale/Squad (Jira), Xray, or TestRail for test case authoring, traceability matrices, and release/validation cycle reporting. + Automated Regression \& E2E Testing: Playwright (cross\-browser, API, and component testing) with parallelized CI execution. + API Testing \& Contract Validation: Postman/Newman or REST Assured for validating PHP backend endpoints and service contracts. + Real\-Time/WebSocket Testing: Experience testing Socket.io event\-driven flows (socket.io\-client test harnesses, Artillery's socket.io engine) to validate real\-time messaging, reconnection logic, and race conditions. + Database Testing: MySQL query validation, data integrity checks, and performance tuning (EXPLAIN plans, indexing); tools like MySQL Workbench or DBeaver. + Performance \& Load Testing: Artillery is preferred for modern, scriptable load testing of APIs and WebSocket connections + Observability: experience with tools like New Relic to correlate test failures with backend/service health. + Visual Regression: Playwright's built\-in screenshot comparison for catching unintended React UI regressions. + AI\-Augmented QA (emerging): AI\-assisted test case generation and self\-healing automation, applied with appropriate validation rigor and documentation given the regulated environment. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** May coordinate testing activities for assigned projects and provide informal guidance to team members. **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:** 0\-5% **Pay Range** ------------- USD $52,470\.00 \- USD $95,000\.00 /Yr. **EEOC Statement** ------------------ WCG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, national origin or ancestry, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, age, marital status, family or parental status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran status, or any other legally recognized basis or status protected by federal, state, or local law. WCG complies with the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Act and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. We promote a "One WCG" culture where all are welcome, respected, valued, and empowered to make a difference every day to advance clinical research.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager (Context Engineering)
jobs.description: **About the Team/Role:** ------------------------ At WEX, context engineering is the discipline of turning collective company knowledge, operational reality, and business logic into trusted, timely, and permission\-aware context for AI agents. As a Senior AI Product Manager (Context Engineering), you will own the enterprise context layer that powers WEX's global fleet of AI agents. In this hands\-on builder role within our Data, AI, Risk \& Product organization, you will bridge unstructured knowledge, governed semantic data, and agent execution workflows, partnering directly with global engineering, data, and business teams to ensure every AI action is grounded, authorized, and accurate. **How you’ll make an impact:** ------------------------------ * **Strategy \& Portfolio:** Partner with global product, engineering, and business leaders to prioritize high\-value context initiatives, sequencing workflows based on business impact, agent demand, source readiness, and risk. * **Governed Semantic Layer \& NL\-to\-SQL:** Own the semantic object roadmap for core enterprise entities (e.g., accounts, claims, plans), defining certified measures, join graphs, and Row\-Level Security (RLS) to replace raw schema reasoning and eliminate hallucinations. * **Retrieval \& Grounding:** Establish enterprise standards for federated ingestion, chunking, caching, metadata, and citation enforcement, consolidating legacy knowledge APIs into unified, multi\-tenant interfaces. * **Workflow Context Packs:** Design and deliver production\-ready context packs for critical operational workflows and SOPs, partnering directly with agent teams to inspect retrieval traces, debug failures, and optimize context consumption. * **Quality \& Benchmarks:** Build and run rigorous evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, error taxonomies, and go/no\-go quality gates to benchmark retrieval relevance, query precision, and agent containment. * **Governance \& Value Realization:** Embed auditability, data lineage, least\-privilege access, and responsible AI guardrails into the context layer by design, tracking ROI through API cost reduction, task resolution lift, and operational risk mitigation. **Experience you’ll bring:** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Experience:** Senior\-level Product Management experience owning data platforms, enterprise search/retrieval systems, semantic layers, API products, or internal developer platforms consumed by engineering teams. * **Technical Skills:** Deep understanding of applied generative AI and agentic systems, including advanced RAG, embeddings, chunking, metadata management, grounding, and context window assembly. * **Data Modeling \& SQL:** Strong experience working with structured enterprise data, relational models, certified metrics, and the failure modes of natural\-language querying over raw database schemas. * **Hands\-on Technical Depth:** Demonstrated comfort working directly with technical artifacts—inspecting retrieval traces, reading SQL query plans, reviewing JSON/YAML configurations, and executing API calls. * **AI Evaluation \& Benchmarking:** Proven track record of designing and running evaluation harnesses, golden benchmark datasets, error taxonomies, and quantitative quality gates. * **Security \& Governance:** Solid working knowledge of enterprise controls, including authentication/identity, tenant isolation, Row\-Level Security (RLS), audit logging, and data privacy. * **Communication \& Influence:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with a demonstrated ability to align and influence global engineering, security, compliance, and executive stakeholders without direct authority. **What will give you an edge:** * Experience with Knowledge Graphs, ontologies, taxonomies, and enterprise entity resolution (MDM). * Hands\-on familiarity with headless BI, metric stores (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Cube), or governed NL\-to\-SQL products. * Domain background in payments, fintech, benefits, healthcare\-adjacent platforms, or other highly regulated environments. * Experience with vector databases, automated RAG evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens), or agent tool protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol \- MCP). Proven track record of consolidating or replacing legacy enterprise knowledge management or search systems in active production. * The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non\-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well\-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section. Pay Range: $125,300\.00 \- $154,100\.00

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Summary** We are seeking a **Principal AI Engineer** to define and lead the AI architecture for a large\-scale Audit \& Assurance application portfolio spanning engagement workflows, evidence management, analytics, content intelligence, risk assessment, compliance, and review automation. This is a highly hands\-on technical leadership role for an individual who can bridge modern software architecture, AI engineering, cloud\-native platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise governance. You will architect AI\-enabled systems that operate at enterprise scale across multiple products, regions, and regulatory environments. You will be responsible for establishing the target\-state AI architecture, reference patterns, engineering standards, platform capabilities, and implementation guardrails for AI\-assisted audit workflows. The role requires deep expertise in agentic AI systems, retrieval architectures, knowledge graphs, platform modernization, security\-by\-design, and large\-scale SaaS architecture. You are expected to design, build, prototype, review code, establish architectural direction, and coach engineering teams while remaining actively engaged in implementation and technical decision\-making. The scope spans all Audit \& Assurance products across North America and Europe. **What You'll Do** **AI Platform Architecture** * Define the enterprise AI architecture strategy across the Audit \& Assurance portfolio. * Establish reference architectures for: * Agentic workflows * Multi\-agent orchestration * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) * Knowledge graphs * Semantic search * AI\-assisted content generation * AI\-supported analytical workflows * Create reusable AI platform capabilities consumed across multiple products. **Product \& Domain Architecture** * Architect end\-to\-end solutions across: * Audit engagement lifecycle * Planning and risk assessment * Evidence collection and validation * Compliance and standards interpretation * Analytics and anomaly detection * Quality review and sign\-off workflows * Establish bounded contexts, domain\-driven design principles, API strategies, and event contracts. **AI Systems \& Agent Engineering** * Design scalable multi\-agent systems using: * Manager–Executor * Planner–Executor * Blackboard * Event\-driven agent collaboration * Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Define memory, context, tool usage, routing, evaluation, and safety frameworks. **Technical Leadership** * Lead architecture reviews and design governance. * Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). * Coach engineering teams in: * AI architecture * Distributed systems * Performance engineering * Reliability engineering * Architecture trade\-off analysis * Act as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions. **Required Qualifications** * 15\+ years in software engineering and architecture. * 7\+ years designing large\-scale SaaS and distributed systems. * Proven experience architecting enterprise AI systems in production. * Deep expertise in: * Azure * Kubernetes/AKS * Distributed systems * Microservices * Event\-driven architectures * Large\-scale platform modernization * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience with: * C\# * .NET * Python * APIs * Distributed systems * Demonstrated success designing AI\-enabled enterprise applications. **Preferred Qualifications** **AI \& Agentic Systems** Practical experience with: * Multi\-agent architectures * LangGraph * Semantic Kernel * Microsoft Foundry Agent Service * Model Context Protocol (MCP) * Agent orchestration frameworks **AI jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Admin Central is building the future of how administrators works across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience. The role begins with the operating model, runbooks, automation, monitoring, logging, identity\-integration design, escalation paths, and readiness processes required before platform deployment. As the platform is deployed, Sustainment Engineers will support incident response, configuration and baseline maintenance, patch coordination, capacity and performance monitoring, change management, and knowledge transfer. The role requires disciplined production operations and a strong focus on enabling VA personnel to assume operational responsibility by the end of the period of performance. **KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** · Contribute to the sustainment operating model, support procedures, escalation paths, operational readiness plans, runbooks, and service\-support workflows. · Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 operational support, incident triage, troubleshooting, and service restoration for platform\-attributable incidents within the agreed severity and response framework. · Maintain platform configurations, approved baselines, inventory, configuration backups, operational records, and change history. · Coordinate patch management with the applicable OEM lifecycle and approved maintenance procedures. · Monitor capacity and performance against discovery baselines and the capacity\-sizing model; identify trends, risks, and recommended corrective actions. · Support monitoring, logging, identity integration, alert tuning, service health checks, and operational reporting. · Coordinate all changes through Department\-designated change\-management tooling and respect change freezes and dependencies involving enterprise programs and application owners. · Prepare for production\-impacting events through documented escalation, recovery, validation, and communications procedures; shadowing and reverse\-shadowing opportunities and coach VA subject matter experts through routine and complex operating procedures. · Prepare monthly operations information, incident records, change records, capacity observations, problem analyses, and lessons learned as required by the reporting model. **CORE RESPONSIBILITY AREAS** · Operations readiness, runbooks, and operational model development · Tier 2/Tier 3 support, incident response, and troubleshooting · Configuration baseline, patch, backup, and change management · Capacity/performance monitoring and operational reporting · Shadow/reverse\-shadow knowledge transfer to VA staff **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** · Prior experience supporting a federal agency as a contractor is required, including familiarity with Government stakeholder coordination, security and access requirements, documentation standards, and formal change\-control processes relevant to the role. · Experience supporting production network, infrastructure, application\-delivery, or load\-balancing services in a controlled enterprise environment. · Ability to troubleshoot application connectivity, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/certificates, health checks, traffic behavior, and high\-availability issues. · Experience with incident response, escalation, configuration management, patching, monitoring, change control, and operational documentation. operations experience**. \- **REQUIRED** \* Experience with Tier 2/Tier 3 support, on\-call escalation, HA failover, upgrades, performance monitoring, and certificate management. \* Experience in federal or FISMA High environments. \* Experience with automation, configuration backup/recovery, centralized logging, monitoring, and identity integrations. **EDUCATION** · Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, networking, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent directly relevant experience. · Relevant platform or operations certifications are preferred. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: ### **Engineering Manager** ### **Tucson, AZ** ### **Onsite; Full time** ### **About Our Transition to Ondas Sentinel** World View was recently acquired by Ondas Inc. (NASDAQ: ONDS) and, together with DZYNE Technologies, has joined forces to create Ondas Sentinel. Ondas Sentinel is a next\-generation U.S. defense platform integrating long\-endurance ISR, autonomous systems, counter\-UAS technologies, and mission intelligence. While World View is now part of Ondas Sentinel, we are still legally operating as World View as we complete the formal integration of our systems and processes. As a result, you may see roles cross\-posted across DZYNE and World View, during this transition. All positions represent opportunities within the same combined organization. ### **What does this mean for candidates?** * You’re joining a team that is accelerating the future of autonomous defense. * You’ll be part of a company backed by significant investment, strong growth, and mission\-proven technology. * You’ll work alongside world\-class engineers and innovators who have already delivered thousands of operational flight hours, high\-impact ISR capabilities, leading counter\-UAS systems, and breakthrough autonomous effects. * You’ll help shape a unified platform that enables operators to see more, decide faster, and act with confidence across the modern battlespace. Together, Ondas Sentinel is building something bigger than any one company, a scalable, integrated defense organization designed to meet emerging mission needs with speed, precision, and purpose. If you’re energized by ambitious missions, rapid innovation, and a chance to help define the future of autonomous defense, we’d love to have you on the team. ### **Job Description** We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead execution across the engineering organization. In close partnership with the Chief Engineer and Program Leadership, this role is responsible for delivery planning, team execution, and operational alignment to ensure high\-quality flight systems are delivered on schedule and in accordance with engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain requirements. This position serves as a critical link between technical authority and program priorities, facilitating alignment, fostering effective cross\-functional collaboration, and escalating risks or trade\-offs as appropriate to protect delivery, quality, and safety. ### **Core Responsibilities** * Lead, develop, and support engineering teams through clear expectations, coaching, accountability, and an environment in which risks are identified and addressed early. * Oversee execution planning, resource allocation, and delivery across research and development activities and active programs, with clear ownership, priorities, and timelines. * Translate business and technical objectives into practical execution plans informed by capacity, dependencies, manufacturing readiness, test availability, and supply chain constraints. * Partner effectively with Program Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and technical leadership to resolve trade\-offs, improve visibility, and address bottlenecks before they affect program milestones. * Establish and maintain operating cadences that improve predictability, reduce unnecessary execution disruption, and support alignment among technical integrity, delivery objectives, and safety requirements. ### **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. * Experience leading engineering teams in aerospace, defense, or other complex hardware\-focused environments. * Demonstrated capability in execution planning, resource management, and cross\-functional leadership. * Ability to align technical execution with program priorities, manufacturing readiness, and schedule requirements. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting flight systems or other highly integrated hardware products. * Understanding of engineering\-to\-manufacturing and test transition within a regulated or high\-reliability environment. * Experience operating effectively within matrixed organizations or shared\-responsibility leadership models. ### **What We Offer** You will work side by side with experts in emerging technology, gaining exposure to cutting edge ideas and projects that are shaping the future. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance because we believe in taking care of the you as a person, not just a team member. Our Tucson workplace is designed to support collaboration, focus, and well\-being, with an on\-site environment that keeps supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, quality, and program teams closely connected to the mission. We believe in creating a dynamic and inclusive workplace where creativity thrives, and every voice is heard. Our commitment to all team members is built upon five core cultural pillars: Engage, Lean In, Create, Care, and Own. Together, these pillars form the foundation of our employee experience while adhering to the highest standards of ethical and sustainable practices. ### **Some Final Notes** The description gives you a sense of what the position involves but is not an exhaustive list. We are a growing and evolving team, which means your responsibilities may shift or expand over time as new opportunities arise. Flexibility and curiosity are part of what makes our work exciting! At Ondas Sentinel, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate belonging and diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from every background and life experience because we know our differences make us stronger. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: IT Security Engineer
jobs.description: At Worth AI, we're building technology that transforms how financial decisions are made and we're doing it with precision, security, and speed. As we scale, we're looking for a hands\-on Security Engineer to strengthen our vulnerability management program, harden our AWS environment, and help build application security into how we ship software. This role is project\-driven: you'll own initiatives end to end, from scoping a remediation effort to rolling out a new control, while also handling day\-to\-day security tickets against defined SLAs. You'll work closely with engineering, IT, and compliance, so clear communication and follow\-through matter as much as technical depth. Responsibilities * Vulnerability Management (Primary Focus) * Own the vulnerability scanning program across endpoints, servers, and cloud infrastructure * Triage, prioritize, and track findings through remediation, partnering with engineering and IT owners * Monitor and report on remediation SLAs; escalate aging or high\-severity findings * Maintain vulnerability management documentation, metrics, and recurring reporting * Identity Management * Improve our identity management program through improvements in configurations, automations, to simultaneously improve security and user experience. Cloud Security (AWS) * Monitor and harden AWS environments: IAM, security groups, S3, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config * Implement and maintain security guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts * Investigate and respond to cloud security alerts and incidents * Support least\-privilege access reviews and cloud configuration audits Application Security * Support SAST, DAST, and dependency/SCA scanning integrated into the CI/CD pipeline * Review and triage AppSec findings with engineering teams and track remediation to closure * Participate in secure code reviews and threat modeling for new features and services * Help maintain secure development guidelines and AppSec tooling Security Operations \& Ticketing * Triage and resolve security tickets and requests within defined SLAs * Take ownership of incidents and requests through to resolution, escalating when needed * Maintain clear, accurate documentation of decisions, incidents, and remediation status * Project \& Cross\-Functional Work * Lead or contribute to security initiatives — tooling rollouts, control implementations, audit and compliance prep * Collaborate with engineering, IT, and compliance to embed security into everyday workflows * Communicate risk, status, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Requirements** * 2–4 years of experience in a security engineering, security analyst, or related role * Hands\-on experience with AWS security services and concepts (IAM, VPC, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail) * Practical experience with vulnerability management tools and remediation workflows * Working knowledge of application security concepts (OWASP Top 10, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning) * Experience managing a ticket queue against SLAs, with strong ownership and follow\-through * Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working cross\-functionally * Solid analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to prioritize under competing deadlines Preferred * AWS certification (Security Specialty or equivalent) * Experience with tools such as Wiz, Tenable, Qualys, or Snyk * Scripting experience (Python or bash) for automation and tooling * Exposure to compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 * Experience with Jira, Linear, or similar ticketing/project tools Additional Requirements * Comfortable working in\-office 3 days per week * Able to work independently as a self\-starter while collaborating across teams * Willing to participate in on\-call or escalation coverage as needed **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance * Flexible Paid Time Off * 9 paid Holidays * Family Leave * Remote * Hybrid work (for Orlando Associates) * Free Food \& Snacks (Orlando) * Wellness Resources

The ideal candidate has deep practical experience with Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Edge APIs, personalization, and enterprise integrations, including hands\-on experience migrating AEM as a Cloud Service to EDS and converting existing AEM components into reusable EDS blocks. The role provides day\-to\-day technical guidance, but success is measured primarily by high\-quality code, reliable releases, effective troubleshooting, and completed solutions. ***Please note: We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States.
