jobs.title: Software Developer 2
jobs.description: **Software Developer 2** *Location:* Centennial, CO (In\-Office) *Company:* RefiJet *Reports to:* Director of Software Development **The Opportunity** RefiJet processes a high volume of auto refinance applications every month across a network of 30\+ lending partners. The software running that operation spans borrower\-facing applications, lender integrations, and internal tools used by our operations teams. The quality, reliability, and usability of that software directly affects real financial outcomes for real people. Software Developer 2 is the level where you stop needing the work handed to you fully defined. You already know how to ship. This role is about widening what you can be trusted with: features that touch more than one system, requirements that arrive incomplete, and problems where the right answer is not obvious from the ticket. You will work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, lender integrations, and internal operations tools. This level carries in both directions. You are still learning, and you still have people invested in your development: structured code review, a manager whose job includes your growth, and senior engineers who will make you better when you use them. You are also now someone other people learn from. You will mentor Software Developer 1 engineers, review their code with care rather than speed, and answer the questions that are still hard when you are new to a codebase. Carrying someone else is part of the job at this level, not an extra. We are deliberately stack and platform agnostic. We care that you can think clearly, learn a codebase quickly, and write code other engineers can build on. We do not care which language or framework you learned first. The specific technologies you will work in are covered in the interview process, and they will change over the course of your career here. The fundamentals will not. **Location and schedule.** Plan on five days per week on site in Centennial, Colorado. We say that plainly instead of calling the role hybrid, because the mentoring and cross\-team work this level depends on happens faster in person and because we would rather be clear now than surprise you at offer stage. One or two remote days per week may become available once you are established and performing well. You earn it, the Director of Software Development decides it, and no date is attached to it. **What You'll Do \- Key Responsibilities** **Strategy \& Leadership** At this level, leadership means owning outcomes rather than tasks, and starting to make the engineers around you better. * Own the features and components assigned to you end to end, including design decisions within an agreed approach, testing, release, and support after release * Mentor Software Developer 1 engineers through pairing, code review, and onboarding, and treat their questions as part of your workload rather than an interruption * Review code as a contributor of useful feedback, not a rubber stamp. Catch the design problem, not only the style problem. * Push back on work that does not hold together, and propose the alternative rather than only naming the objection * Estimate your own work with enough accuracy that others can plan around it, and communicate a slipping estimate before the date, not after * Improve how the team works by strengthening documentation, tightening standards, and reducing recurring toil * Represent engineering credibly in conversations with product, operations, and other internal partners, including explaining technical constraints in terms a non\-engineer can act on **Discovery \& Execution** * Deliver features across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and internal tools, including work that spans more than one service or team boundary * Take a requirement that is incomplete or ambiguous, ask the questions that make it concrete, and turn it into a workable plan before writing code * Author specifications for your own work and review specifications written by others, under our spec\-driven development practice in which a feature is specified in writing and agreed before it is built * Design and build API integrations, including work with external lending partner systems, with attention to error handling, retries, idempotency, and failure modes * Model and query data correctly, and understand the performance and integrity consequences of the schema and queries you write * Write and maintain automated tests that give the team real confidence, and recognize when a test is protecting behavior rather than only raising coverage * Debug production issues methodically, identify the actual cause, verify the fix, and record what you learned so the next person does not repeat it * Participate in release, deployment, monitoring, and production support for the systems you build * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of normal daily work, and remain fully accountable for every line you ship, whether you or a tool wrote it first **Growth \& O er data responsibly and follow all internal security, privacy, and data handling requirements. We operate in a regulated industry. Careful data handling is a condition of the role, not a preference. * Never move production data into a non\-production environment, share credentials, or work around a security control to save time. If a control is blocking legitimate work, escalate it and help fix the control. * Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture by being dependable, communicative, and open to feedback **Required Skills \& Experience** This list is short and every item on it is real. If you meet these, apply. * Professional experience building and maintaining production web applications across both frontend and backend, with a track record of features you delivered end to end * Working proficiency in a modern backend language and a modern frontend framework, with enough depth to debug problems in both * Practical experience with REST APIs or service\-to\-service integration, including handling failures rather than only the happy path * Practical experience with relational databases, including writing queries you can reason about and schema changes you can defend * Experience writing automated tests and using them to ship with confidence * Experience debugging issues in a running production system * Comfortable working from written specifications, and able to identify when a specification is wrong or incomplete * Version control fluency with Git and collaborative development workflows * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to someone who is not an engineer * Demonstrated ability to give and receive feedback constructively * Legally authorized to work in the United States, and able to work on site in Centennial, CO five days per week **Education:** No specific degree is required. A computer science or related degree, a bootcamp, self\-directed learning, or equivalent practical experience are all acceptable paths. We evaluate demonstrated ability. **On experience level:** This role is scoped for roughly 2 to 5 years of professional experience. Range is a proxy, not the bar. If you are outside it in either direction and the rest of this description fits, apply anyway and let us make the call. **Nice to Have** None of the following is required, and their absence will not remove you from consideration. * Experience owning a feature area or service that other engineers depended on * Experience mentoring or onboarding a more junior engineer * Experience integrating with third\-party or partner APIs where you did not control the other side * Experience with containerized or cloud\-hosted environments and the deployment pipeline that reaches them * Experience with observability tooling, including tracing a real incident through logs and metrics * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with good judgment about when to trust them * Interest in fintech, lending platforms, or transaction\-heavy software products * Experience with auto lending, auto refinancing, or consumer credit products. * Familiarity with loan origination systems (LOS), credit decisioning, or lending infrastructure. * Experience working with external partners or B2B clients in a product\-led organization. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Salary:** $108,000 \- $137,000 annually, commensurate with experience **Bonus:** Eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus with a defined target percentage of base salary, tied to company and individual goals. **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), PTO, career development opportunities, and the chance to join Denver's Best Place to Work (2024 \& 2025\) with a dynamic culture focused on internal promotion and employee growth. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Yield Solutions Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

jobs.title: Policy Manager, YouTube Trust and Safety
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Bruno, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 7 years of experience in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields. * 1 year of experience in people management, leading a team. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience as a thought leader and team lead or people manager in an investigative, anti\-abuse environment (e.g., content abuse, spam, or other behavioral abuse). * Ability to work in a rapidly\-changing industry and manage ambiguity while minimizing uncertainty through quantitative insights. * Ability to lead a team to frame problems, structure analyses, and drive impact. * Ability to build effective relationships with cross\-functional partners across geographies. * Excellent strategic and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent business judgment, influencing, and communication skills. **About the job** ----------------- Trust \& Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. As a Trust and Safety Policy Manager, you’re a skilled and experienced people manager. You are adept at context switching and multi\-tasking, and someone who naturally rallies colleagues around shared goals. You will manage a team of skilled Policy Leads working on content moderation challenges facing YouTube today. Your team will focus on Adversarial Abuse Policy Development, operating on the front lines of platform defense. Bad actors do not play by traditional rules—they rapidly adapt and weaponize cutting\-edge technologies to execute coordinated spam campaigns, synthetic media impersonations, and sophisticated scams. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between behavioral threat analysis, machine learning engineering, operations, and product strategy. This role will sometimes involve reviewing graphic, controversial, or offensive video content in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and our policies for the YouTube Partner Program. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $164000 \- $239000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Manage a team of Policy Leads working on multiple controversial content areas, helping to ensure the team sets clear priorities, manages its time effectively, and develops clear and compelling policy proposals for executive audiences. * Lead the end\-to\-end development, implementation, and lifecycle governance of global policies targeting scaled adversarial abuse, generative AI exploitation, coordinated spam networks, and inorganic platform manipulation. * Be an expert in all of the policy areas under your supervision so that you can support your team members, and guide efficient and effective policy development efforts. * Build and strengthen partnerships with cross\-functional groups including engineering, data science generative AI teams, public policy, Public Relations (PR), legal, and product. * Brief cross\-functional executives on risk investigations and policy proposals. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results\-driven individuals to join our dynamic team. The Senior Product Engineer owns technically complex product initiatives from problem definition through release. You'll have the accountability of a product owner (you own the outcome, the scope decisions, and getting it across the finish line to customer success and marketing) along with the engineering depth to design and build much of the solution yourself. This is not a traditional product owner role and not a traditional engineering role. A product owner defines what should be built and hands it off. Our engineering team owns the platform: the frameworks, components, security, performance, and delivery standards that keep our application consistent. A Product Engineer builds on that foundation to deliver usable features quickly. You'll take an ambiguous problem, understand the domain and the users, make sound decisions about application logic and data flow, and carry it from early prototype to beta to full release. This role sits on the product team and reports to the CTO. Today, the CTO sets priorities and assigns initiatives across this role and our product owner. You'll be assigned initiatives where a handoff between a product owner and an engineer would lose too much in translation: complex workflow\-driven features, rapid prototyping, AI integrations, and UI overhauls that require deep knowledge of how the application works underneath. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** Deliver product initiatives * Take high\-ambiguity projects from discovery through release, including scoping, technical design, implementation, QA coordination, rollout, handoff to customer success and marketing, and post\-launch iteration. * Turn early ideas into working prototypes quickly, test them with real users, and carry the strongest ones through beta to full release. * Set clear acceptance criteria and success metrics, instrument features with product analytics, and use the data to decide what to improve next. Build complex, user\-facing features * Design and deliver workflow\-driven, multi\-step features with state, rules, and edge cases, such as lien intake, case status progression, negotiation tracking, and approval flows, where the logic matters as much as the interface. * Identify where AI can meaningfully reduce manual work (document processing, intake automation, data extraction, summarization) and turn those ideas into reliable, production\-grade features with appropriate human review and fallbacks. * Rework confusing or outdated screens into clear, consistent experiences, partnering with product design and using the established design system and component framework rather than reinventing them. * Build features hands\-on within the engineering team's frameworks and standards. Bring in engineers for larger pieces of work, such as significant backend changes, and take part in architectural decisions. Partner across the business and team * Work directly with lien negotiators, customer success, support, and law firm users to understand the real problem, then make informed tradeoffs on scope, complexity, and timeline. * Bring user data and findings into roadmap and prioritization discussions. * Raise the bar on how we build. Model a fast, pragmatic, user\-centered approach to delivery, and share what you learn with the product and engineering teams. ### **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, with meaningful time spent building user\-facing applications (frontend, full\-stack, or UI engineering backgrounds are a strong fit) * Demonstrated ownership of features or projects from concept to production, beyond executing predefined tickets * Experience working directly with users or business stakeholders to define requirements, and keeping those relationships strong through delivery * Strong understanding of application design: data models, state management, business logic, APIs, and how frontend and backend fit together * Product instincts: you ask "why" before "how," notice when a requirement doesn't match the user's actual problem, and are comfortable cutting scope to ship something valuable * Ability to work through ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, including explaining engineering complexity in plain terms to stakeholders * Hands\-on experience with a modern web stack (Python/Django and a modern JavaScript framework preferred) * Experience building or integrating LLM\-powered features (prompt design, structured outputs, evaluation, document processing) * Familiarity with product analytics tools (e.g., PostHog), project tracking tools like Jira/Confluence, and cloud platforms like AWS * Ability to work on\-site at least three days per week (60%) in our Franklin, TN office Nice to Have * Experience in a product owner, product manager, or technical lead capacity * Background in workflow\-heavy B2B software, legal tech, healthcare, insurance, or claims processing * Experience integrating with third\-party platforms such as Salesforce or legal case management systems like Filevine **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants * Flexible Spending Accounts (Health \& Dependent Care) * Company\-Paid Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $126,000 \- $171,000 annually, with opportunity for a quarterly discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience. Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer\-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. Our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. We are looking for a senior quality engineer who is passionate about setting the quality standards for a growing engineering team and building the testing and evaluation that keeps complex, data\-heavy products working correctly at scale. Zipliens is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our team and lead quality for the applications we build for the legal industry. After several years of high growth, Zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. The software we build supports that work, so the quality of what we ship has a clear, real\-world impact on law firms and the people they represent. We're scaling engineering significantly this year, and quality engineering is growing along with it. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams and combines exploratory testing with automation. As the senior on the team, you'd set the standards the rest of the team works to: what sufficient coverage looks like, what gates a merge and a deploy, which frameworks and tools we standardize on, and how the quality engineers we add this year learn to think about risk. You'll have context available rather than a blank slate, and your judgment will shape the team's standards rather than just inheriting them. We also build with AI as a first\-class part of the workflow, and that applies to testing as much as to development. Our product uses LLMs to extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, so deciding how non\-deterministic output gets validated before release is a core part of this role. We also use agentic coding tools and internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves to build and maintain automation, and you'd be expected to use them well, set the standard for how their output gets reviewed, and evaluate new tools as they come along. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** * Lead quality for medium to large features, including ones that cross team boundaries. You'll own the risk analysis, the test strategy, the release criteria, and the final sign\-off. * Set, follow, and advocate for the team's test standards and frameworks, including what sufficient coverage means for the team and what a passing build is expected to guarantee. * Own the automation and CI/CD gating strategy: which suites run at which stage, what gates a merge versus a deploy, and how we keep suite runtime and flakiness under control so engineers trust the results. * Own the evaluation methodology for our LLM features, including sampling and significance, rubric design, regression gates on prompt and model changes, production quality monitoring and drift alerts, and re\-running golden sets when a vendor updates a model. * Set the team's standards for validating AI\-generated output, both in the product and in the tests and tooling we generate with AI. * Collaborate with the Product Owner to define Acceptance Criteria and release criteria, and serve as the primary QA point of contact for cross\-functional planning. * Evaluate and introduce new tools and AI capabilities for the team. * Mentor the quality engineers on the team and coach engineers on exploratory technique and risk\-based testing. We're adding people quickly this year; the seniors we hire now establish what good looks like for everyone who follows. * Weigh in on the testability of application designs early, while changes are still cheap to make. ### **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years on a QA or software development team, with experience across a range of products and test approaches. * Expert\-level skills in at least one of exploratory testing and test design, test automation and infrastructure, or AI/LLM evaluation, and solid proficiency in the other two. At this level we expect you to have set the methodology for a team, not only followed one. * Experience setting test standards and choosing frameworks for a team, and getting the team to adopt them. * Significant experience building and owning automation in a modern framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar), including designing the CI/CD gating strategy around it. * Comfortable in code. Our backend is Python/Django and our frontend is React, and you'll be reviewing test code, reading changes for risk, and contributing to shared test infrastructure. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL. Verifying a workflow here usually means verifying the data it produced as well as what the UI shows. * Hands\-on experience evaluating LLM or ML features in production: golden datasets, acceptance thresholds, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, and monitoring quality after release. * Experience using agentic coding tools for test work, and a clear view of where their output needs human review. * Experience mentoring quality engineers or developers and raising standards on a growing team. * Excellent written and verbal communication \- you'll be defining release criteria with product, explaining risk to non\-technical stakeholders, and making the case for quality investment to engineering leadership. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience testing document processing or extraction from unstructured data, including defining acceptance thresholds for it. * Experience building or owning test infrastructure shared across multiple teams. * Experience testing third\-party integrations, especially where the counterparty's documentation isn't solid and you need contract tests, sandboxes, or recorded fixtures to work around it. * Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. We have an SRE who owns the cluster \- you won't be running it, but you'll be working with them on test environments and tracking down where a failure happened. * Experience handling sensitive data such as PHI, or working under HIPAA\-style requirements. **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants * Flexible Spending Accounts (Health \& Dependent Care) * Company\-Paid Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $98,000 \- $132,000 annually with an opportunity to earn a discretionary quarterly bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience. Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer\-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

jobs.title: Cloud Application & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** Zoetis’ Tech and Digital (ZTD) organization is seeking an experienced Cloud Security professional to support its Cloud Security function. In this role, you will help strengthen and evolve security standards for cloud resources and applications, contribute to key security initiatives, and partner with engineering and business teams to design and implement practical, risk\-based security controls. You will help enhance how Zoetis secures, governs, manages, and monitors its cloud environments, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Vision Foundation Models
jobs.description: The Perception team at Zoox is responsible for how our purpose\-built robotaxi understands the world, including what happens inside the cabin. In this role, you will design, train, and evaluate vision\-based in\-cabin perception models that understand passengers, objects, and behaviors inside the vehicle. These models support rider safety and the operations that keep each ride running smoothly. You will independently own a model area end to end, from data curation and training through evaluation and deployment under real\-time and compute constraints, working closely with partners across the company. Your work has a direct impact on rider safety and experience as Zoox scales its robotaxi service. ### **In this role, you will...** * Design, train, and evaluate vision models that understand passengers, objects, and behaviors inside the vehicle, across detection, pose, and action recognition. * Independently own a model or feature area end to end: curate data, define labeling guidelines, train and evaluate models, and take them through deployment. * Set the quality bar for the models you own, using rigorous evaluation and error analysis so they are reliable enough to support live operations. * Deploy models under real\-time and compute constraints shared with the rest of the onboard perception system. * Partner across product, operations, safety, and vehicle software to turn requirements into model specifications, metrics, and validation plans. ### **Qualifications** * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related field with 6\+ years of industry experience (PhD with 3\+ years). * Deep expertise in computer vision and deep learning for image and video understanding: object detection, pose and action recognition, and fine\-grained classification, with hands\-on experience with modern architectures (convolutional and vision\-transformer detectors, and self\-supervised or foundation\-model backbones such as DINOv3\). * Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch for model design, training, and evaluation. * Experience with vision\-language models or foundation\-model backbones, and with auto\-labeling or synthetic data for long\-tail and rare classes. * Track record of owning the full ML lifecycle on real\-world data: dataset curation and labeling guidelines, training, metric design (precision, recall, and false\-positive rate at an operating point), and error analysis. ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with in\-cabin or occupant monitoring (occupant or driver monitoring systems), ideally including multi\-camera or fisheye imagery and low\-light conditions. * Experience deploying deep learning models to real\-time, resource\-constrained systems (robotics, automotive, or edge devices) with TensorRT / ONNX or similar. * Proficiency in C\+\+ for model integration. **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer- Go
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer (Service Platform \& Orchestration) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days in office) role, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. In this high\-ownership position, you will engineer the management plane and reliability systems that govern ZIA's fleet lifecycle at massive scale. This is a hands\-on building role where you will lead the transformation of our infrastructure from legacy automation into a stateful, durable management plane (built on Temporal) to achieve deterministic "one\-touch" provisioning and lifecycle operations. You will treat "infrastructure as a distributed system," developing self\-healing capabilities and AI\-driven SRE practices for a global fleet of 100k\+ instances. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Lead the hands\-on development and migration to a workflow\-as\-code platform (Temporal), building replay\-safe, idempotent workflows that ensure deterministic operations across a global scale * Move the organization beyond "scripted automation" toward a robust management plane that treats the entire global fleet as a single, eventually\-consistent distributed system * Design and implement services that leverage LLMs and ML for intelligent signal correlation, automated triage, and "self\-correcting" fleet operations * Develop framework\-level services and internal APIs that ensure all new products are delivered "orchestration\-ready" with reliability hooks built directly into the code * Build deep telemetry (metrics, traces, and events) into the management plane so that every fleet\-wide action is fully explainable, auditable, and replayable **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. * You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what's needed, navigating seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution. * You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high\-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high\-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team. * You think at scale. You connect your day\-to\-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and teams that are not just effective today but are built to last and support a high\-growth, global organization. * You are resilient and adaptable. You view change as an opportunity and setbacks as temporary. You maintain composure and focus in high\-pressure situations, guiding yourself and your team through complexity with a steady, positive hand. **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain * BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field with **12\+ years of experience** in hyperscale systems, with a deep understanding of the unique failure modes and technical hurdles that only emerge at massive scale * Mastery of backend systems languages with a strong preference for **Go** (or deep expertise in Java, C\+\+, or Python with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt Go), along with a proven track record of setting the bar for code quality and distributed system correctness. * Strong experience designing and operating complex distributed systems, with a focus on solving systemic challenges in concurrency, failure handling, and performance optimization * Proven track record of developing Platform APIs (REST/gRPC) with strong guarantees for idempotency, verification, and safe rollout patterns **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Proficiency with AI code\-assistance tools (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate legacy refactoring and system development * Proficiency in PostgreSQL, or other relational stores used for high\-scale, stateful management\-plane services * Direct experience building or operating systems with Temporal.io, Cadence, or similar workflow engines \#LI\-YC2 \#LI\-Hybrid At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: * Various health plans * Time off plans for vacation and sick time * Parental leave options * Retirement options * Education reimbursement * In\-office perks, and more! jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Zuora** At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue. We've led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we're evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation. ### **The Opportunity** Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is Zuora's newest technical go\-to\-market motion. Forward Deployed Engineers are full\-time engineers in Zuora's Product \& Engineering organization who embed directly with customer engineering teams to build the integrations, prototypes and agents that no existing motion reaches. You work in a pod with a Forward Deployed Product Manager and, where scope requires, a second engineer. Our focus: building the future of agentic quote\-to\-cash, which means helping enterprises monetize AI\-native and usage\-based products, and taking Zuora's new AI agents into their first customer deployments. Internally, we call this role a Delta. The job is to embed with a customer's software engineers and build the ideal end\-state integration: real code, not slideware or a bare\-bones demo, taken from idea to production in weeks, not quarters. You'll expose what the platform can't do yet, fill the gap fast, and document exactly what product must pave next. You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Services and Support so what you learn in the field becomes a capability the whole company can use. Our tech stack: Zuora Billing and Revenue platform APIs; customer\-side integration stacks vary by engagement. #### **What you'll do \& achieve** **Embedded build** * Co\-build integrations, prototypes and agents with customer engineering teams in fixed\-time engagements measured in weeks to months: production\-quality code with a declared destination and a maintainer of record. * Co\-author the specification with your Forward Deployed Product Manager. Build only after the spec is signed by the customer sponsor, FDE leadership and Product \& Engineering. No unsigned builds. * Prototype on the customer's real data within the first few weeks, then harden it for production: security review, monitoring, and evals for AI\-driven workflows. * Design and ship production agents and multi\-agent workflows: tool and function calling, sub\-agents, orchestration, and MCP servers and clients, with context and retrieval engineered for quality, latency and cost. * Integrate Zuora with the customer's existing stack, including third\-party metering and entitlement tools and ERP, CRM and finance systems, with Zuora as the order\-to\-revenue system of record. * Build AI\-monetization integrations: usage and AI\-credit metering feeds, credit wallets and drawdown, and the billing and revenue flows behind them. * Take Zuora's new AI agents into their first customer deployments, extending the platform toward new use cases and new customer segments. **Agent quality and control** * Build eval harnesses and golden datasets with your Forward Deployed Product Manager and customer experts. Set acceptance thresholds and run evals in CI to gate every change. * Implement guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop controls: least\-privilege access, approval gates for write actions, and segregation of duties. * Instrument everything (tracing, logging of prompts, inputs, outputs and model versions) so every agent action can be reconstructed for audit. * Build with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) as an everyday practice, and review their output with production rigor. **Product feedback loop** * File gap reports into the product roadmap. You're the highest\-fidelity sensor the product org has on what customers actually need built. * Write the engagement Brief at exit, our standard write\-up of what was built, what broke, what's reusable and where it should live next. Turn what works into reusable components. **Ownership \& handoff** * Hold the warranty window (roughly 30–60 days after go\-live), then hand off to the named maintainer of record with runbooks and documentation. FDE doesn't keep a maintenance book of business. * An engagement isn't done until the customer's own team can run what you built without you in the room. Upskilling them is part of the build, not an afterthought. **Multiply what you build** * Delegate to agents and pull in Zuora engineers, partners and the customer's engineers so the work moves faster than one person could carry it. * Leave behind tools, components and agents that make the next engagement faster. * Onboard new teammates inside live engagements on a watch one do one teach one progression. #### **What success looks like** * Customers adopt what you build: Zuora's agents and  sers and architects alike, with strong technical communication under ambiguity. * Write things down without being asked: specs, gap reports and the exit Brief are part of the job. * Low ego. This is a founding role: the job description will change under you, and you'll help write the next version of it. #### **Nice to have** * Founder or early\-team experience, ideally in AI monetization, agentic product development and deployment, or the quote\-to\-cash lifecycle: CPQ, contracts and orders, usage metering and rating, billing, payments, collections and AR, and revenue recognition. * Experience with subscription billing, usage\-based pricing, payments or monetization platforms. * Exposure to agentic or usage\-based AI pricing models, AI agents, MCP servers or agent frameworks, or a prior customer\-facing or forward\-deployed engineering role. * ERP, CRM or finance integration experience (NetSuite, SAP, Salesforce, Workday or similar), and familiarity with SOX or IT general controls. #### **How we'll evaluate** Expect a deep\-dive walkthrough of something you've built, including how you used AI tools to build it, and a conversation about a time you pushed something through when it stalled. We look at judgment (what you delegated, what you checked, when you stopped trusting the output), curiosity and ownership, not just speed. ### **About the Team** As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly. It's exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as "ZEOs," are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we're making what's next possible for our customers, community and the world. ### ### **Benefits** Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs' wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide: * Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance\-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company\-wide year\-end break * Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy) * Learning \& development stipend to support ongoing growth * Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available * Mental wellbeing resources and support * *Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process* \#ZEOLife at Zuora ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We: * Collaborate deeply across teams and regions * Learn constantly and iterate often * Build an inclusive, high\-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued #### **Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace** Think, be and do you. At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to **assistance@zuora.com** (or local equivalent, where applicable).

jobs.description: ### **About CrewAI** CrewAI is the leading framework and enterprise platform for building and orchestrating multi\-agent AI systems, powering 300M\+ agent executions per month across thousands of companies. The Agent Management Platform is our control plane for deploying, monitoring, governing, and scaling agents in production. ### **The Role** You'll build the CrewAI Agent Management Platform, where teams create, deploy, monitor, and govern AI agents in production. You'll make complex AI infrastructure feel understandable and usable, helping customers diagnose failures, review decisions, and stay in control of their automations. This is a senior full\-stack product engineering role with a strong frontend emphasis. You'll spend most of your time building rich, intuitive interfaces, while owning the backend changes needed to deliver complete features. Our stack combines React and TypeScript with Rails, Hotwire, and PostgreSQL. You'll lead work from problem definition through launch, partnering closely with design, product, and runtime engineers. ### **What You'll Do** * Build complete product workflows across Studio's visual editor, deployments, traces, and human review, as well as onboarding, integrations, permissions, and settings. * Work with design and product to clarify customer problems, prototype solutions, and iterate using real usage and feedback. * Shape frontend architecture: component APIs, state management, data fetching, navigation, and rendering performance. Balance maintainability with shipping speed. * Make asynchronous workflows reliable and understandable: live updates, editing and saving, validation, errors, retries, and recovery. * Extend our shared design system across React and Rails, improving consistency, accessibility, and theming. * Build the Rails models, services, APIs, and background jobs your features need. Partner with runtime and infrastructure engineers on deeper platform capabilities. * Ship with meaningful frontend and Rails tests, browser verification, and instrumentation; diagnose and resolve production issues. * Help the team ship better work through technical decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and reusable patterns. ### **What We're Looking For** * A track record of independently delivering substantial full\-stack product features, with particular depth in frontend engineering. * Deep proficiency in React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, including component design, complex state, asynchronous behavior, and performance. * Experience shipping rich, interactive products such as editors, workflow builders, developer tools, or applications with complex data. * Strong product and interaction judgment. You can simplify technical workflows and make thoughtful decisions without needing every interaction specified. * Practical accessibility knowledge: semantic interfaces, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessible component behavior. * Demonstrated ability to independently ship backend changes supporting your features, including data models, APIs, services, and background jobs. Experience with Rails or a comparable framework; Rails experience is preferred. * Pragmatic judgment about improving an existing codebase: when to reuse, refactor, or introduce a new abstraction. * Clear communication and the ability to align engineering, product, and design around a solution. * Ownership of production outcomes and curiosity about AI agents, execution traces, and human review workflows. ### **Bonus** * Experience with visual canvases, graph interfaces, observability products, or live event streams. * Ruby on Rails, Hotwire/Stimulus, ViewComponent, or shared design\-system experience. * Experience building AI products, human review workflows, or enterprise permission and integration experiences. * Experience improving frontend developer tooling, testing infrastructure, or component documentation.

jobs.description: Network Engineer San Diego, California \| Onsite **Position Summary** ==================== The Network Engineer delivers, monitors, maintains, and configures network equipment, services, and solutions that support client networking systems and environments. This role performs day\-to\-day field installation, configuration, service, preventive maintenance, upgrades, and decommissioning of dedicated and shared data infrastructure, including network and telecommunications equipment. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Identify, research, analyze, diagnose, resolve, and close escalated technical issues accurately and within established service levels. * Provide data center and data hall floor support, including equipment installation, turn\-up, preventive maintenance, upgrades, lease replacements, and decommissioning. * Review log files, assess overall network health, and monitor network performance using SolarWinds NPM, NCM, IPAM, NetFlow, PingPlotter, MIBs, and OIDs. * Respond to network outages and troubleshoot LAN and WAN environments during primary shifts and after\-hours on\-call rotations. * Coordinate with vendors, carriers, manufacturers, and field service resources to support remote sites and resolve incidents requiring advanced support. * Perform incident, problem, configuration, and change management activities. * Support network projects, including solution design, equipment ordering, new\-device configuration, deployment, and lifecycle replacement. * Provide customer support by testing network connections, installing equipment, and completing service activation and turn\-up activities. * Handle second\-level troubleshooting, operating system upgrades, and configuration\-system layout planning. * Schedule and perform maintenance and system upgrades for network infrastructure. * Assist Network Engineering with the design and configuration of switches, routers, firewalls, wireless systems, and load balancers. * Provide comprehensive diagnostics, root\-cause analysis, and accurate problem resolution; document findings for future troubleshooting and analysis. **Service Delivery and Operational Excellence** ----------------------------------------------- * Assess service requests and determine when field resources are required through established incident\-management, dispatch, and service\-desk processes. * Escalate unresolved issues requiring advanced manufacturer or carrier support in accordance with prescribed procedures and service levels. * Monitor service\-desk ticket volume, identify trends, document findings, and ensure timely closure of assigned tickets. * Use ServiceNow and related service\-delivery systems and tools to execute service\-desk activities efficiently. * Follow escalation and exception processes, report current performance, and recommend improvements. * Maintain a client\-focused environment centered on problem prediction, detection, and resolution; proactively remove barriers to meeting client expectations. * Document issues, action plans, and outcomes promptly while meeting client\-satisfaction objectives and internal and external service\-level agreements. * Recommend and support initiatives that simplify, automate, and improve daily service\-delivery operations and the client experience. * Research technology, market, and industry trends and benchmarking data to identify and implement relevant best practices, methodologies, and analytics. * Continuously develop technical and nontechnical capabilities across supported products and services. * Contribute to collaborative relationships across operational teams, departments, **Qualifications** ================== **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * At least five years of technical support engineering experience in a call\-center environment, with required experience in the technology\-services or managed\-service\-provider industry. * Demonstrated experience supporting data center floor operations and production, high\-availability network environments. * Experience coordinating multiple vendors to support work at remote sites. **Technical Expertise** ----------------------- * Ruckus LAN and WLAN environments, including Ruckus ICX 7150\-48PF access switches and ICX 7650\-48F core switches. * Sophos WAN solutions and firewalls. * Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI), Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Palo Alto firewalls, 802\.11 wireless environments, IPS/IDS, jobs.title: Infrastructure Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description: **Service Delivery Manager – SDM** **Purpose:** Accountable for delivery, quality, safety and people across a site cluster of roughly 90–100 field staff running 24x7\. The primary point of contact for the client's site and programme leads in that cluster. **What you will do** * Lead the cluster's Tech Leads, Senior Auditors, Auditors and Lead Network Engineers across day, swing and night shifts. * Deliver the audit plan for each site: coverage, throughput and evidence quality to the client's audit specification. * Hold quality: QA re\-audit pass rate of at least 98%; act fast on rework, method gaps and weak shifts. * Run the site rhythm: shift handovers, daily huddles, discrepancy triage with the client's design and DCIM owners, weekly reviews. * Plan and execute site rotations with PMO, Travel and Admin, so crews move without idle time. * Own people: rosters, overtime approval, attrition, performance, coaching and career paths to Tech Lead. * Work with the EHS lead and site safety officers; stop work when it is not safe. * Report cluster KPIs, risks and staffing to the Senior SDM and PMO; escalate per the defined escalation path. **What you bring** * 10\+ years in data center, network or field operations; 5\+ years managing field teams of 50\+ across shifts. * Hands\-on experience in hyperscaler data center build\-outs or operations: structured cabling, fiber, rack and network turn\-up, QA / QC. * Has run 24x7 operations and handled client escalations on live sites. * Data\-driven: runs a site on KPIs, dashboards and logs. * Willing to be based at, and move between, client data center sites in the US. * Preferred: PMP, ITIL or Lean; OSHA 30; BICSI or fiber certifications. **How we will measure success (first 6 months)** * Cluster audit KPIs at target: QA re\-audit pass rate at least 98%; evidence and log completeness at least 99%. * Zero recordable safety incidents; zero client\-raised SEVs from our work. * Shift coverage at plan; 30\-day attrition below plan. * Site moves completed with no unplanned idle crew days. Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Remote - US)
jobs.description: At TixTrack, we support our clients by creating superior ticketing solutions for performing arts and cultural institutions through a combination of modern technology, beautifully simple design, and the art of listening. Headquartered in the heart of the Broadway Theatre District, NYC, we are a small, but growing team of hardworking, highly motivated individuals. With a presence across both the US and UK, and trusted by key players on Broadway and the West End, we are passionate about our work and driven to innovate with our customers to solve current and future challenges with new solutions. Our core product, Nliven, is a real\-time platform that helps venues manage ticket sales efficiently while creating a more engaging buying experience for customers. We are transforming our engineering culture to align with an Empowered Teams model, embracing Continuous Delivery and focusing on building capabilities to drive higher quality, reliability, and speed. Even with a highly dispersed, largely remote workforce, we stay connected through our Slack channels, virtual events and regional meetups. Come see how we “role”. **About The Role** ------------------ We're looking for a full stack Software Engineer to help build and improve the nLiven platform, working in both the frontend and backend. You'll write code across .NET Core and modern JavaScript frameworks like React and Vue, extending and improving our existing systems with tests as part of every change. We're hiring at two levels, and the scope of the role grows with your experience. Early\-career engineers will start with well\-defined tasks and bug fixes, learning our codebase and practices while senior engineers pair with them, review their code, and help them grow. Engineers with solid full stack experience will own well\-scoped features from start to finish, with guidance from senior engineers when the path isn't clear. You'll report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with a team that invests in its engineers. We'll determine the right level based on your experience and the interview process, so if you're not sure where you land, apply anyway. *This position is full\-time and fully remote. Candidates must be located in California, Oregon, Colorado, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Louisiana, Florida, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, New Jersey, New York, or Connecticut. Candidates may be required to travel and/or meet up in\-person from time to time. There may also be an expectation in the future for hybrid work in a local office.* **About You** ------------- * You're curious about how things work and eager to keep growing, whether that means picking up a new language, learning an unfamiliar part of the codebase, or taking on a bigger piece of work. * You take pride in quality. You write tests, make small and safe changes, and try to leave code better than you found it. * You communicate clearly and ask questions early. When you're stuck, you say so, and when you make a technical decision, you can explain why. * You value feedback and collaboration, whether it's a code review, a pairing session, or working with Product and Design to understand the problem behind the work. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build features and fix bugs across the stack, from well\-defined tasks to features you own from design through production, working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers. * Write clean, readable, maintainable code, with automated tests as part of every change. * Work confidently in existing codebases: read before you change, follow established patterns, and make small, safe changes that get reviewed early. * Understand the customer problem behind your work by partnering with Product and Design. * Participate in code reviews by acting on feedback, asking questions to learn, and giving clear, constructive feedback to others. * Follow the team's coding standards and best practices, and suggest improvements where you see them. * Investigate and fix bugs and performance issues, pulling in senior engineers when a problem needs a wider view. * Build with security in mind, including input validation, authorization checks, and error handling. * Add logging, monitoring, and tests to the features you build, and use what they show to improve them. * Pair and mob regularly with teammates to build skills, share context, and help newer engineers get up to speed. * Update technical documentation, such as API contracts and design notes, when your work changes how something behaves. * Contribute to architectural discussions, bringing perspective from the code you work in day to day. * Point out friction in tooling, docs, CI/CD workflows, or team processes, and help fix it. * Take part in production support and incident reviews alongside experienced teammates. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are r orities. **Tools You’ll Use** -------------------- * Microsoft Office * Google Suite * Slack * JIRA **What We Value** ----------------- Find Harmony \- We confidently manage our work priorities and feel comfortable taking time to enjoy life outside of work. Have a Clear View \- We are transparent and honest, understand our roles, and know how we contribute. Be a Fan \- We are passionate about our work and driven to innovate with our customers to solve current and future challenges with new solutions. Welcome All \- We are a diverse group of employees that come together as a team, without ego, and do great work. Perform at Your Best – We are committed to our customers success, always willing to listen and improve, to ensure our products exceed expectations. **How We Work** --------------- **R**adical Curiosity \- We Stay Hungry \- We approach each day with curiosity and accountability; learning, engaging fully, questioning assumptions, connecting our work to the bigger picture, and always keeping the customer at the center. **E**mbrace Change \- We Own Outcomes Together \- We succeed by holding ourselves accountable, collaborating deeply across teams, embracing change, and continuously improving together. **S**eek Solutions \- We Continuously Innovate Together \- We focus on solutions and client value by acting decisively, prioritizing what matters most, and turning ideas into results through rapid, iterative action. **E**mpathy \- We Grow Together \- We listen deeply to our customers and to each other, using data, empathy, and mutual respect to grow stronger together. **T**ransform \- We Raise The Bar \- We set high standards, honor our commitments, and move forward every day with a success mindset, driving continuous improvement and quality for our customers. **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- TixTrack is committed to a workplace where everyone is free from bias, prejudice, discrimination, and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. We strive to ensure a welcoming work environment where everyone belongs and is valued, encouraged, \& respected. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives, and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. We are focused on building a culture that acknowledges and values diversity, equity, and inclusion. **What We Offer** ----------------- * We are hiring for two Software Engineer levels. Our Software Engineer 1 has a base annual salary range of $75,000 \- $95,000 and our Software Engineer 2 has a base annual salary range of $95,000 \- $115,000\. Salaries are commensurate with experience * Eligibility for annual bonus based on performance and company success * 100% of premium paid for medical, dental and vision benefits for employee and dependents, with an HSA\-eligible option (with a $1,000 employer contribution for 2026\) * Company\-paid life insurance * Traditional and Roth 401k plans * Paid parental leave * Learning \& development opportunities with company reimbursement for eligible educational expenses * Working abroad opportunities * Volunteer days off * Flexible scheduling * Up to $300 reimbursement for initial equipment to set up hybrid work environment * Generous PTO and holiday schedule * Remote work environment California Applicants: CCPA/CPRA Notice Right to Work Poster Notice of E\-verify Participation Our team is here to support you throughout the hiring process with reasonable accommodations. We strive to provide an unbiased and equitable interview experience for all applicants. If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability or special need, please let us know by emailing accommodations@tixtrack.com.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Orgvue is an organizational design and planning platform that empowers your business to transform its workforce by understanding the work people do and the skills they have. Our platform connects strategy to structure, providing clarity of vision, so you can build a more adaptable, better performing organization that thrives in a constantly changing world of work. The world's largest and best\-known enterprises and consulting firms use Orgvue to visualize and model current and future states of the organization and make faster, more informed decisions. The company is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in the United States, Canada, the Netherlands and Australia. We're looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our Partner Solutions team. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-growing SaaS business in the HR technology market. As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will be a recognised technical expert in the Orgvue platform, helping to define, develop and deliver innovative solutions that solve complex customer and partner challenges. You will work closely with partners, Product Management, Engineering and Customer Experience teams to ensure solutions deliver measurable value and align with both business objectives and market needs. You will combine strong technical capability, solution design expertise and commercial awareness to help drive the evolution of Orgvue's platform and solution offerings. **Role** You will be responsible for leading the design and development of complex solution capabilities within the Orgvue platform, helping partners and customers maximise value from their investment in Orgvue. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Partner Success and Customer Experience teams, you'll define solution requirements, guide implementation approaches and support the successful deployment of solution offerings. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys technical problem solving, solution design, stakeholder engagement and innovation. **Responsibilities** * Act as a senior technical subject matter expert on the Orgvue platform, helping solve complex customer and partner challenges. * Build trusted relationships with partners and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and identify solution opportunities. * Lead the definition, design, development and delivery of custom solutions, content and capabilities within the Orgvue platform, from discovery and requirements gathering through to deployment and early adoption. * Identify emerging market and customer needs, translating them into scalable solution concepts and recommending new capabilities and ways of delivering customer value. * Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering and the wider Partner Solutions function to share customer feedback, identify platform enhancements and support continuous improvement. * Develop documentation, configuration guidance, deployment materials, best practices and reusable solution assets to support effective delivery and adoption. * Use LLM tools to speed up research, solution design, configuration, coding and documentation, reviewing outputs for accuracy and suitability before use. * Create and maintain LLM skill files that capture Orgvue expertise, solution patterns and implementation guidance for use through our MCP server. * Mentor Solutions Engineers and provide technical guidance and enablement to Partner Success, Technical Account Management and Customer Experience teams. * Support proof of concept activities, pilot programmes and strategic customer initiatives. **Requirements** * Significant experience working with the Orgvue platform or comparable enterprise SaaS solutions. * Strong solution design, technical consulting and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience leading complex solution development or implementation initiatives. * Strong programming and technical skills, including JavaScript and ideally Python or similar technologies. * Practical experience using LLM tools in technical or consulting workflows, including writing clear instructions and examples, testing performance and assessing and improving outputs. * Strong understanding of data structures, data management, analytics and modelling concepts. * Experience gathering, analysing and translating business requirements into technical solutions. * Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills, with experience presenting solutions and recommendations to customers, partners and senior stakeholders. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Product, Engineering and Customer Experience teams. * Passion for innovation, continuous learning and creating customer value through technology. **Benefits** * Hybrid/remote working depending on your preference. * 5% matched 401K. * Wellbeing: Sanctus Coaching, Headspace Mindfulness App, Wellbeing Webinars, Annual Wellbeing Day. * 25 days paid vacation (plus 1 extra day for every year of employment up to a maximum of 30 days). * Healthcare premiums 100% paid by employer for majority of plans including family, dental and vision. * Annual discretionary bonus.
